Job title: Complaints Reviewer x2

Apply Before:13/11/2026, 23:55

Locations: Remote (UK Wide)

Starting Salary(£) 44,139

Working Hours: 35

Contract Type: Permanent

Headline

Manage and review enquiries and complaints for the final ombudsman-style stage of a new standardised process for complaints about how safeguarding concerns have been handled by Church of England bodies. Handle enquiries and complaints in a fair, independent and timely manner, helping to deliver a high-quality complaints handling service and improve organisational learning.

Description

The Church of England’s Safeguarding Structures Reform Programme is delivering a programme to strengthen safeguarding and rebuild trust. The Programme will roll out a standardised process across Church of England bodies for complaints about how safeguarding matters have been handled. Where matters cannot be resolved locally, they can be referred to an independent complaints body to review and make a final determination.

The Complaints Reviewer is responsible for reviewing complaints and enquiries, carrying out investigations, gathering and assessing evidence, and making recommendations to the Independent Complaints Adjudicator. The role supports effective, transparent and empathetic complaint handling while contributing to service improvement and stakeholder confidence.

The postholder will work closely with the Independent Complaints Adjudicator, colleagues and external stakeholders, balancing casework delivery with continuous improvement and the promotion of best practice in complaints handling. The Complaints Reviewer may be delegated additional responsibilities by the Independent Complaints Adjudicator as relevant.

Responsibilities

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Managing a caseload of enquiries and complaints and ensuring that they are progressed in a timely manner.
  • Planning and conducting investigations, including gathering evidence, analysing information and seeking specialist advice where required.
  • Supporting the handling of subject access requests and other information rights enquiries relating to complaints and case records, including identifying, reviewing and providing relevant information in accordance with legal and organisational requirements.
  • Communicating effectively with complainants and stakeholders, managing expectations and providing clear written decisions and recommendations.
  • Maintaining accurate case records and using case management systems effectively.
  • Contributing to service improvement and best practice.
  • Supporting outreach activities and stakeholder engagement.
  • Building constructive working relationships.
  • Contributing to organisational objectives and policy development where appropriate.

Requirements

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Complaint handling, investigation or casework experience.
  • Strong analytical and evidence-assessment skills.
  • Excellent written and oral communication and report writing abilities.
  • Sound judgement, impartiality and discretion.
  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills.
  • Experience using case management systems.
  • Stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement, equality and inclusion.

Desirable

  • Experience supporting complaint handling, investigations, regulatory, safeguarding or ombudsman services.
  • Understanding of complaint handling principles and customer service standards.
  • Experience of applying trauma-informed principles in practice.
  • Experience working in a public sector, charity, regulatory or ecclesiastical environment.

jobs.excerpt: Principal Data Scientist, AI (Architect-Level Scope) About KLDiscoveryKLDiscovery is a global eDiscovery and legal technology provider serving large law firms, corporate legal departments, and government agencies.
jobs.description:
Principal Data Scientist, AI (Architect-Level Scope)

About KLDiscovery

KLDiscovery is a global eDiscovery and legal technology provider serving large law firms, corporate legal departments, and government agencies. We build and operate the products and services that legal teams rely on to manage, process, and review case data at scale. With operations across multiple countries and a client base that includes AmLaw 200 firms, we handle some of the largest and most complex matters in the industry.

About the Role

We're hiring our most senior AI practitioner — someone with genuine data science rigor who also wants to build. In this role, you'll set the scientific and architectural direction for gen AI and ML at KLDiscovery: designing the evaluation methodology that proves our AI holds up under legal scrutiny, choosing and validating the models and retrieval systems that power our products, and building the hardest parts of that system yourself.

This is one of the most interesting data science problem sets in enterprise software. You'll work with terabytes of real-world legal data — emails, contracts, chat transcripts, images, video, depositions, and regulatory filings — from some of the largest litigation and investigation matters in the world. The work is hard in ways that matter: documents are messy and adversarial, the stakes are real (privilege, defensibility, attorney work product), and getting the evaluation wrong has real consequences. AI that can surface key people, themes, and timelines in hours instead of weeks, or pre-classify millions of documents for relevance and privilege with results that survive scrutiny, directly changes the economics of how legal matters get resolved. We build solutions that turn data into evidence the legal system can trust.

This is a builder-first role, not a research-only or advisory one. You'll design experiments and evaluation frameworks that prove our AI is defensible in court, build the retrieval and agent systems that reason over case data, and personally ship the hardest, most novel parts of that system. You'll set strategic direction across Nebula, our eDiscovery platform, and CS & Operations, then prove out the science and the architecture by building it yourself. Not a role for anyone stepping back from the keyboard, and not a role for anyone who treats evaluation as an afterthought.

We offer competitive total compensation that includes base pay, bonus potential, equity, inclusive benefits, wellness programs, and perks. We use market and industry data to inform pay decisions while considering geography and labor markets, individual experience, and business needs. Individual compensation will vary, although a reasonable estimate of the current annualized base pay range for this position is $190,000 to $240,000.

Job location: Remote (candidate must be based in the United States)

Key Responsibilities

Own the science and the architecture, and build both personally. Design the experimentation and evaluation methodology that determines whether our AI's outputs are accurate, consistent, and defensible — then define the end-to-end gen AI architecture across Nebula and CS & Operations to deliver on it: LLMs, agent harnesses, RAG, vector search, embeddings, and model selection and triage. Build the hardest parts personally: prototype agent loops, design and run the evaluations that validate them, tune retrieval, and ship the shared infrastructure that powers AI Case Explorer (case overviews, timelines, key people and themes, PII surfacing, and Agent chat), AI Agent Review (pre-classifying relevance, privilege, and key issues, shipping MLP), and CS & Ops tech-enablement as part of our central work orchestration system.

Own evaluation rigor, AI/MLOps, and telemetry end-to-end. Design the statistical and experimental methodology behind our evaluation harnesses — the standard our outputs have to meet to hold up under legal scrutiny — and own the infrastructure that enforces it: model deployment and versioning, eval pipelines, drift and quality monitoring, cost and latency telemetry, and prompt and agent observability. Define and implement how we select, triage, and route across models (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source, fine-tuned), manage vector databases and retrieval, and evolve our evaluation methodology and agent harness as the frontier moves.

Lead the practice from the front. Set the technical and scientific bar by building, not by reviewing. Partner with Engineering, Product, and Data Science leadership to translate that rigor into shipped product. Raise the bar on both AI engineering and evaluation discipline, mentor senior ICs through hands-on technical leadership, build and maintain relationships with model and infrastructure vendors, and represent KLD's AI strategy directly with customers, partners, and at industry events.

What You Bring (Required)

  • 7+ years in data science, applied AI/ML, or ML engineering, with recent hands-on experience as a senior or principal-level practitioner in the gen AI era
  • Real training in statistics, experimentation, or applied research you know how to design an evaluation that actually tests what you think it tests, not just one that looks reasonable
  • Proven track record architecting and personally building enterprise gen AI systems in production with measurable customer impact
  • Experience with consumer-facing or B2B customer-facing AI products — systems that real external users or customers depend on, not only internal tooling
  • Builder at heart: still writes code, runs experiments, ships, and tunes prompts and evals, and wants to keep doing so as a leader
  • Deep expertise across the modern gen AI stack: LLMs, agents, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, search, and evaluation harnesses
  • Hands-on experience designing system-of-systems AI pipelines spanning search, retrieval, agent harnesses, and model selection/triage
  • Strong proficiency with the Microsoft AI stack: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and supporting Azure infrastructure
  • Excellent technical leadership skills; demonstrated ability to influence architecture and methodology decisions across product, engineering, and data science
  • Strong communication skills, including explaining evaluation results and architecture trade-offs to executive and customer audiences
  • Career experience spanning both a larger, established technology company and a smaller company or startup — comfortable operating with both institutional rigor and startup pace
  • Mentor team members and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement

Nice to Have (Preferred)

  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
  • Peer-reviewed publications, technical writing, conference talks, or other evidence of contributing to the field, not just building within it
  • Background building agentic systems with tool use, planning, and multi-step reasoning in production
  • Prior experience setting up AI governance and evaluation harnesses in a regulated or high-stakes domain
  • Open-source contributions or other evidence of being a recognized builder in the AI community
  • A demonstrated track record of sticking with hard, ambiguous problems over long timeframes rather than pivoting away when the first approach doesn't work.

Turn your university experience into career experience

Want to build your CV, develop your communication and marketing skills, and help other students get more from the digital learning tools available to them?


We’re looking for enthusiastic, creative and reliable students to join us as Cengage Student Ambassadors.


This is a flexible, paid opportunity designed to fit around your studies. You’ll become a student voice for Cengage at your university, helping fellow students get started with and make effective use of Cengage digital learning products.

Along the way, you’ll gain practical experience in areas including marketing, content creation, communication, peer support and student engagement – all while working with a global education company.


What will you do?

As a Cengage Student Ambassador, you’ll help students at your university get the most from the Cengage products available to them.


Your activities could include:

  • Helping fellow students get started with and use Cengage digital learning products
  • Supporting student onboarding sessions, in-class activities, demonstrations or peer Q&As
  • Creating social media content about Cengage products, student activities and your experience as an Ambassador
  • Writing student-focused content about your experience of digital learning
  • Creating a short video or testimonial about your experience with Cengage
  • Sharing authentic feedback and student perspectives with our team
  • Supporting selected Cengage marketing or student engagement activities
  • Attending training sessions and programme check-ins with the Cengage team

You won't be expected to know everything from day one. We'll provide training and guidance to help you understand our products, plan your activities and make the most of the programme.


Who are we looking for?

You don't need extensive work experience. We're much more interested in your enthusiasm, ideas and ability to connect with other students.


You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Are currently enrolled as an undergraduate, postgraduate or PhD student
  • Study at an institution using a relevant Cengage digital learning product
  • Are a confident and friendly communicator
  • Enjoy helping and engaging with other students
  • Are organised, reliable and comfortable managing your own time
  • Can work independently and meet agreed deadlines
  • Are interested in creating content or using social media
  • Are comfortable getting involved in student-facing activities

Experience with social media, video creation, presenting, student societies, peer support or campus activities would be useful, but isn't essential.


What you'll get

As a Cengage Student Ambassador, you'll gain practical experience that you can add to your CV and talk about in future interviews, including:

  • Working with a global education and technology company
  • Marketing and social media experience
  • Content and video creation
  • Presentation and communication skills
  • Student engagement and peer support
  • Experience managing your own activities and deadlines
  • The opportunity to share the student voice directly with Cengage

Most importantly, you'll play a role in helping fellow students get more from the digital learning tools designed to support their studies.


How does the programme work?

The programme is designed to fit around your studies. Rather than working fixed weekly hours, you'll complete a series of agreed activities and can organise much of the work around your own schedule.


Depending on your location and programme length, the expected commitment will be approximately 26 hours over a six-month programme or 37 hours over a nine-month/full programme.


You'll also attend three online training sessions and a programme check-in, giving you support and guidance throughout your time as an Ambassador.


Payment

This is a paid opportunity.


Depending on programme length and location, Ambassadors will receive:

£350 (or local equivalent) for the shorter/pro-rated programme, or
£500 (or local equivalent) for the full programme.


Payments will be made in stages during the programme, subject to completion of the agreed activities.


About Cengage

Cengage is a global education technology company helping millions of learners develop the skills and knowledge they need to achieve their goals.

As a Cengage Student Ambassador, you'll help us make sure our digital learning products don't just reach universities – they genuinely reach, engage and support the students they're designed for.


Interested? We'd love to hear from you.

Apply to become a Cengage Student Ambassador and turn your student experience into experience that can help shape your future career.

jobs.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer, Email Platform (L3)

About the job

This position is a critical engineering role within Twilio SendGrid, requiring a hands-on engineer capable of developing, deploying, and managing highly available, massive-scale distributed systems.

Our systems regularly process more than 12 billion emails during peak events like Black Friday, and our throughput requirements continue to scale rapidly. As an L3 engineer, you will act as a key driver of execution within our core services. You will be heavily involved in modernizing our backend systems, optimizing our extensive Go-based microservices, and contributing to the design and reliability of our dual-cloud infrastructure span across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • WEAR THE CUSTOMER’S SHOES: Architect and ship reliable, high-velocity features that handle critical traffic with low end-to-end latency. Partner closely with product management and technical leadership to break down complex system requirements into manageable, iterative milestones.
  • BE AN OWNER (CODE QUALITY): Drive rigorous code reviews and push for maintainable patterns in our Go codebase, ensuring high testing standards (unit, integration, and component testing) are executed across the team.
  • BE AN OWNER (INFRASTRUCTURE & OBSERVABILITY): Manage and enhance cloud configurations across AWS and Azure environments utilizing Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). Ensure deep observability coverage by standardizing metrics, alerts, and distributed tracing across core data pipelines.
  • CHAMPION ENGINEERING HEALTH: Advocate for a clean architectural foundation. Proactively identify technical debt, system bottlenecks, and single points of failure (SPOF), balancing feature delivery with critical platform refactoring.
  • MENTOR AND LEAD: Foster a collaborative environment by mentoring junior engineers, leading technical sprint planning, and sharing expertise across distributed engineering nodes.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • Experience: 4+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating resilient backend services at scale.
  • Modern Development Workflow: Practical experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (such as Claude Code) to accelerate code generation, automate testing, and streamline debugging workflows.
  • Language Proficiency: Strong, hands-on production experience writing clean, idiomatic, and highly concurrent Go (Golang), Java or Python.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Solid experience deploying and managing production workloads in cloud environments—ideally with deep exposure to AWS core services (such as EC2, S3, Aurora, or DynamoDB) AND Microsoft Azure equivalents (such as Virtual Machines, Blob Storage, Azure SQL, or Cosmos DB).
  • Infrastructure as Code: Proficiency with Terraform for provision-level automation and maintaining environment parity.
  • Distributed Systems: Strong theoretical and practical understanding of distributed datastores, caching layers, and asynchronous event streaming (e.g., Kafka or similar queuing ecosystems).
  • Systems Mindset: Strong foundational background in computer science fundamentals, data structures, and building self-healing cloud architectures.

Desired:

  • Prior experience managing high-throughput applications running inside containerized infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with database migration pathways (e.g., transitioning traditional on-prem/relational datastores to managed instances like AWS Aurora).
  • Experience implementing OpenTelemetry or distributed tracing systems across decoupled microservice platforms.
  • Direct experience handling constraints related to network topology, proxy layers, or mail transfer agent (MTA) protocols.

Location

This role will be remote,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $138,700 - $173,400
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $146,800 - $183,600
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $163,100 - $203,900.
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 7/28/2026, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityFinance teams at B2B companies lose cash the same way every month: an invoice ages past 45 days, someone sends an email, no reply, someone calls, voicemail, they call again next week, still nothing.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Finance teams at B2B companies lose cash the same way every month: an invoice ages past 45 days, someone sends an email, no reply, someone calls, voicemail, they call again next week, still nothing. AR teams spend 60–70% of their week on manual follow-up instead of posting cash, closing disputes, or analyzing aging. Adding headcount doesn't fix it; manual follow-up simply doesn't scale, and every ERP hits the same wall.

Problem and solution validation are complete. Live pilots are running with early design partners and entering production evaluation. The next phase is proving in-production reliability, delivery economics, and scalability. The teams that ship credible AI workers into finance-sensitive functions in the next 18 months will define the category. We intend to be one of them.

The Venture

Argentl delivers an AI collections agent that handles outbound debtor follow-up automatically — trained, monitored, and continuously improved by our team. Rather than another self-serve SaaS tool, Argentl is evaluated on outcomes: DSO reduction, hours returned to the AR team, and cash commitments captured — not configuration effort.

Give us a list of overdue accounts and our voice agent calls each debtor, confirms invoice awareness, and captures exactly what they say — a payment commitment, a dispute, a request to split, or silence. The AR team gets a clean morning report: who's committed, who's disputing, who's gone silent, and what to do next. No ERP migration, no system credentials, no workflow overhaul — we're calling within a week of receiving the data. The roadmap expands from collections follow-up into adjacent AI finance-ops roles, all delivered through the same managed model.

The Partnership

The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, and live pilots are running. What remains is to bring on the technical co-founder — a partner who will own product and engineering with the same conviction, urgency, and ownership stake.

This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will take over the production code and continue building the product (the first lines of production code), set the technical direction, and lead execution end-to-end.

  • Architecture & Reliability — Harden the voice and workflow systems for in-production reliability. Establish core architecture, observability, and audit-trail standards for a product that speaks to customers' debtors on their behalf.

  • Delivery Layer — Build the internal infrastructure that lets the team configure, monitor, and optimize agent performance without scaling engineering headcount. Mature the workflow engine so every call, intent classification, and next-action flows through reliably.

  • Integrations & Distribution — Own the accounting and ERP integration layer (QuickBooks, Xero, and beyond) that turns Argentl from a CSV upload into an embedded part of the finance stack — the primary distribution unlock.

  • Unit Economics — Own the trade-offs between AI quality and cost-per-call, and lock in unit economics within a productized monthly pricing model.

  • Customer & Market — Represent the company in front of finance leaders, partners, and investors as the technical voice of the venture.

  • Roadmap — Convert pilots into paying customers, expand the AI staff beyond collections, and begin a path toward custom and self-hosted models where data-privacy and financial-compliance requirements demand it.

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding engineering team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

Must Have:

  • Shipped LLM-powered and voice systems into production environments where incorrect outputs carried real consequences

  • Full-stack confidence across applied LLMs, real-time voice and conversational AI, telephony, human-in-the-loop workflows, observability, and secure multi-tenant SaaS

  • Well-formed convictions about reliability engineering, edge-case management, and the trade-offs between AI quality and cost-per-call

  • Experience building managed and service-heavy platforms, with the discipline to scale delivery without scaling engineering headcount

  • Prepared to operate as a principal — including saying "this won't scale" or "this isn't ready" when the integrity of the product requires it

  • A hands-on builder — you still write code and ship, and you're happiest close to the product

Great to Have:

  • Finance, accounting, or FinOps background — you understand AR, DSO, aging, disputes, and how finance teams actually work

  • Based in Los Angeles or the San Francisco Bay Area (or ready to be)

  • Pragmatic and creative — a solution finder who gets to "working" fast and iterates from there

  • Co-operative, strategic, and hands-on in equal measure

  • Capable and willing to help in finding and closing early customer partnerships

  • An active social media presence you can put to work for founder-led distribution

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Job Description

Arc XP is the content platform and operating system built to power growth for ambitious media companies. Developed by The Washington Post, Arc XP enables media organizations to innovate rapidly, strengthen direct audience relationships, and grow independent revenue.

The Content Marketing Manager creates and activates content that helps media and publishing buyers understand Arc XP’s products, expertise, and customer outcomes. Reporting to the Global VP of Marketing, this individual contributor manages the content calendar and day-to-day content program across written, social, video, webinar, and digital channels. The role partners with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Sales, Customer Success, Creative, and subject matter experts to produce useful, credible content that strengthens engagement and supports qualified pipeline.

What Motivates You

  • You care about clear, thoughtful writing and understand the value of strong editing, reporting, and storytelling.
  • You enjoy turning complex technology, product, and customer information into content that is useful to a defined audience.
  • You are motivated by producing content that contributes to engagement, signups, and pipeline—not simply page views.
  • You are curious about how buyers find information through search, AI-powered tools, social media, and trusted industry sources.
  • You use AI thoughtfully to improve research, workflow, and content repurposing while maintaining editorial judgment and accuracy.

How You’ll Support the Mission

  • Manage the editorial calendar and content-development workflow to deliver timely, audience-focused content aligned with marketing priorities and campaign goals.
  • Write and edit short- and long-form content—including articles, web and landing-page copy, emails, customer stories, case studies, guides, and thought-leadership materials—to communicate Arc XP’s value clearly.
  • Interview customers, partners, and internal subject matter experts to develop credible stories that demonstrate Arc XP’s products and customer outcomes.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Sales, Customer Success, and Creative to support campaigns with relevant content that drives engagement and qualified demand.
  • Coordinate freelancers, agencies, and internal contributors to maintain content quality, accuracy, consistency, and alignment with Arc XP’s brand voice.
  • Conduct keyword and audience-intent research and apply on-page optimization practices to improve organic discoverability and conversion opportunities.
  • Monitor emerging AI-search and answer-engine trends and recommend practical content improvements that strengthen Arc XP’s visibility with prospective buyers.
  • Manage Arc XP’s B2B social-media calendar and day-to-day channel activity to extend the reach and relevance of marketing content.
  • Produce or coordinate content across formats—including short-form video, webinar materials, social assets, and basic visual content—to engage audiences through appropriate channels.
  • Track content performance using web analytics, search tools, marketing automation, and CRM data to identify insights and improve future content investments.
  • Use AI-enabled tools for approved research, drafting, repurposing, and production activities while maintaining source validation, human review, and editorial standards.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
  • Three to five years of experience in content marketing, editorial, journalism, communications, or a related field.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, demonstrated through a professional portfolio.
  • Experience creating content for multiple channels and formats, including web, email, social media, and longer-form assets.
  • Experience managing an editorial calendar, content workflow, or content-development process.
  • Working knowledge of SEO, including keyword research, on-page optimization, and performance reporting.
  • Experience using web analytics and search-performance tools, such as Google Analytics and Google Search Console.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners and incorporate feedback from subject matter experts.
  • Ability to organize work independently, manage deadlines, and maintain high editorial standards.
  • Authorization to work in the United States and ability to work remotely from the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Technical Co-founder (CTO) - AI Workforce for Solo Practitioners and Small Law F
jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityAI is changing the economics of legal practice.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

AI is changing the economics of legal practice. Work that once took hours can increasingly be done in minutes, creating both enormous leverage for lawyers and new pressure to win and serve more clients efficiently.

Yet solo practitioners and small law firms still face many of the same constraints: missed calls, slow follow-up, intake handled between client matters, inconsistent marketing, and administrative work competing with billable time. Building larger intake, administrative, and marketing teams is expensive and increasingly unnecessary.

BloomLex is building a different model: a managed AI workforce that helps small law firms grow without growing their team.

The customer thesis has been validated through live pilots, and multiple deployments are moving into production evaluation. The next phase is proving in-production reliability, delivery economics, repeatability, and scalability. The companies that successfully deploy trusted AI workers into professional-service verticals over the next 18 months have an opportunity to define entirely new categories. We intend to be one of them.

The Venture

BloomLex is building an AI workforce for solo practitioners and small law firms, helping them win and serve more clients without adding headcount.

We call the broader shift the Rise of the Solo: AI gives an individual lawyer or a small firm access to capabilities that historically required a much larger organization.

Unlike self-serve software, BloomLex is fully managed. We configure, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve the AI workforce for each firm. Our customers evaluate us on outcomes — calls answered, prospective clients captured, consultations booked, demand generated, follow-up completed, and time saved — not on how much software they configure themselves.

Our Bloomlex workforce starts with two teammates:

Ava — AI Front Desk. Ava answers calls 24/7, handles structured intake, screens and routes inquiries, books consultations, performs outbound callbacks and follow-up, and integrates those interactions into the firm's workflow.

Claire — AI Marketing Assistant. Claire helps firms generate and nurture demand through content, digital marketing, campaign management and optimization, lead nurturing, and ongoing marketing execution.

Together, Ava and Claire address both sides of growth: Claire helps create demand; Ava helps ensure that demand is captured and converted.

They are also the beginning, not the end, of the platform. Our roadmap expands the AI workforce across the operational side of the practice — including custom workflows and additional specialized AI roles — all delivered through the same managed model and coordinated around the lawyer.

The Partnership

The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, live pilots are running, and the initial product architecture exists. What remains is to bring on the technical co-founder — a partner who will own product and engineering with the same conviction, urgency, and ownership as the CEO.

This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with decision collaboration on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

You will inherit working products and live deployments, but you will not inherit sacred architecture. Your job is to determine what should survive, what should be rebuilt, and what needs to exist for BloomLex to scale from pilots to thousands of firms.

Role & Responsibilities

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will be a hands-on builder first and the architect of the technical organization that follows.

  • Product & Architecture — Own the technical architecture across Ava, Claire, and the broader BloomLex AI workforce. Make the build-versus-buy decisions that determine where BloomLex creates durable technical advantage.

  • Voice AI & Reliability — Harden Ava's real-time voice, telephony, intake, scheduling, routing, and workflow systems for production reliability. Establish observability, evaluation, escalation, and audit-trail standards appropriate for a trust-sensitive environment.

  • Agentic Workflows — Build reliable AI systems capable of executing multi-step operational and marketing workflows across voice, email, SMS, web, calendars, CRM and practice-management systems, with appropriate human oversight.

  • Managed AI Delivery Layer — Build the internal infrastructure that allows BloomLex to configure, deploy, monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve AI workers across hundreds and eventually thousands of firms without scaling engineering or implementation headcount linearly.

  • AI Quality & Economics — Own the trade-offs among model capability, latency, reliability, privacy, and inference cost. Build an architecture capable of delivering strong gross margins within the initial ~$499/month product model as usage scales.

  • Data, Security & Trust — Establish the security, privacy, tenancy, permissions, data-retention, and audit architecture required to earn the trust of law firms and their clients.

  • Customer & Market — Work directly with lawyers and design partners, translating real-world workflows and failure modes into product decisions. Represent BloomLex with customers, partners, and investors as the technical voice of the company.

  • Roadmap — Help convert pilots into repeatable commercial deployments, expand the AI workforce beyond Ava and Claire, deepen integrations into law-firm workflows, and establish a path toward custom and self-hosted models where economics, performance, privacy, or legal requirements justify them.

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding engineering team and establish a culture of speed, accountability, technical rigour, and customer obsession.

Co-Founder Profile

We are looking for a technical founder, not simply an engineering manager.

You have:

  • Shipped LLM-powered, agentic, voice, or automation systems into production environments where incorrect outputs and system failures carried meaningful consequences

  • Full-stack confidence across applied LLMs, conversational and real-time voice AI, APIs and integrations, workflow orchestration, observability, data architecture, and secure multi-tenant SaaS

  • Strong instincts around AI evaluation, reliability engineering, edge-case management, hallucination mitigation, human-in-the-loop design, and production monitoring

  • Well-formed convictions about the trade-offs among AI quality, latency, reliability, privacy, and cost

  • Experience building platforms that combine software with managed or service-heavy delivery, with the discipline to automate delivery rather than scale headcount linearly

  • The ability and willingness to work directly with customers and turn messy real-world workflows into reliable products

  • The mindset of a principal and owner — including the willingness to say “this won't scale,” “this isn't ready,” or “we need to rebuild this” when the integrity of the product requires it

  • The desire to remain deeply hands-on while building the team around you

Strongly preferred:

  • Prior founder or early-stage technical leadership experience

  • Experience with production voice AI, telephony, agentic workflows, or AI evaluation infrastructure

  • Background in legal tech, healthcare, financial services, or another trust-sensitive vertical

  • Experience with security, privacy, and compliance requirements involving sensitive customer data

  • Experience deploying or self-hosting open-source/custom models where privacy, latency, control, or economics require it

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

About Us:

Beamdog, a leading video game studio based in Edmonton, Alberta, has been creating captivating gaming experiences since 2009. Led by industry veteran Trent Oster, the studio has become renowned for developing enhanced editions of classic games and original content across multiple platforms, including Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, Xbox, PC, and mobile devices. Best known for reviving iconic Dungeons & Dragons RPGs like Baldur’s Gate and Planescape: Torment, Beamdog is dedicated to delivering unforgettable experiences for gamers worldwide.

Position Summary:

As a Senior Writer, you will create engaging characters, dialogue, and stories that bring our games to life. Working closely with creative leadership and other disciplines, you will contribute ideas and narrative expertise while building on the project’s established voice, themes, and creative direction. This hands-on role combines original writing, editing, and narrative implementation, with a focus on delivering compelling, high-quality content that supports gameplay and meets production needs.

This position offers remote work within Canada, hybrid, or onsite work arrangements, with a strong preference for candidates based in Edmonton, Alberta, who can spend time working from our office.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with the Design Director and/or project leadership to develop and maintain narrative themes, tone, and style that support the game’s creative vision and intended player experience.
  • Write compelling characters, dialogue, quests, and storylines, developing character biographies, motivations, relationships, and arcs that remain consistent across narrative content and gameplay.
  • Write and revise combat barks, quest banter, lore, and other in-game text, adapting voice and style to the needs of the project.
  • Produce high-quality narrative content that meets agreed production targets and maintains the project’s established voice, tone, and brand, communicating progress and dependencies to support timely delivery.
  • Translate narrative concepts, outlines, and creative briefs into production-ready content, incorporating feedback from creative leadership and relevant partners throughout drafting and revision.
  • Work closely with designers, artists, and other disciplines to integrate storytelling with gameplay, worldbuilding, and visual presentation.
  • Review and edit narrative content for clarity, pacing, continuity, character voice, and consistency with established lore and style guidelines.
  • Implement and refine narrative content using project tools and game engines, working with other disciplines to address technical constraints and issues identified through playtesting.
  • Contribute to narrative documentation, including style guides and story outlines.
  • Provide constructive peer feedback and mentor less experienced writers and narrative designers, sharing expertise to strengthen the quality and consistency of the project’s narrative content.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

  • Significant professional writing experience in the game or entertainment industry, including writing contributions to at least one shipped game.
  • Strong understanding of interactive storytelling and game-design fundamentals, including experience developing branching dialogue or nonlinear narratives.
  • Demonstrated ability to write clear, engaging stories and distinctive characters with consistent voices, motivations, and emotional depth.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly understand an established brand and creative direction, sustaining its themes, tone, style, and character voices.
  • A demonstrated record of sustained, high-quality writing output, with the ability to work independently, prioritize assignments, and meet the volume, pace, and revision demands of game production.
  • Strong editing skills, with experience revising creative content for clarity, structure, pacing, and consistency.
  • Ability to interpret and incorporate creative feedback, including making substantive revisions to meet project needs.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working across disciplines and presenting narrative ideas clearly.
  • Strong research and problem-solving skills, with the ability to adapt narrative ideas to technical, production, and resource constraints.
  • Experience implementing narrative content in game engines such as Unreal or Unity, or comparable narrative development tools.

Bonus Points:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in English, Creative Writing, Theatre, Film, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with JIRA, Perforce, and other production or version-control tools.
  • Experience developing narrative style guides, maintaining continuity across substantial bodies of content, and providing peer mentorship.
  • Strong preference to those based in Edmonton, Alberta.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.
  • Three weeks of paid vacation, generous paid sick leave, additional paid personal days, and a paid studio closure over the holiday season.
  • Comprehensive health and dental benefits, including enhanced mental health support.
  • RRSP matching to support your long-term financial goals.
  • Flexible work arrangements, with remote, hybrid, and in-office options.
  • A collaborative environment where you can share ideas, strengthen your craft, and help shape the player experience.

An up to date portfolio/writing samples must be included with your application. There may also be an assessment portion associated with the recruitment process for this role. Thank you to all applicants for your interest in Beamdog. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Beamdog is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

jobs.description:
About Wealth Enhancement


Wealth Enhancement is an independent wealth management firm with an endless passion for enriching the lives of our clients. We continually seek to perfect our craft of personalized financial planning with our team-based Roundtable and UniFi processes that go far beyond the standard approach. We proudly provide unique financial plans and investment management services to over 90,000 households from our over 175 offices - and growing - nationwide.


Since 1997, Wealth Enhancement has tirelessly raised the standard of wealth management with specialized knowledge and more attentive service that helps every client craft their future. For more information, please visit .


We're hiring an UHNW (ultra-high net worth) Marketing Strategist to play a foundational role in building and advancing Wealth Enhancement's UHNW and Private Wealth Advisor Marketing capability while serving as a strategic marketing partner to UHNW advisor teams.


This role combines program development, strategic consulting, market expertise, advisor relationship management and cross-functional leadership. The Strategist will help define the marketing capabilities, programs and experiences required to support the evolving UHNW business while translating individual advisor growth ambitions into differentiated, actionable marketing strategies.


As a trusted partner, the Strategist will bring a strong marketing point of view, deep understanding of affluent audiences and sound business judgment. The role will connect advisor and client needs with enterprise capabilities, influence priorities across teams, and help move opportunities from strategy through implementation, measurement and scale. This role requires a proactive, action-oriented builder who is comfortable creating clarity in ambiguous situations, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and moving ideas quickly from concept to testing, learning, and implementation.


This is a fully remote. Please note that this position will primarily serve offices based in the Eastern Time Zone. While you do not need to be located on the East Coast, you must be available during regular EST/EDT business hours. Additionally, periodic travel is required based on advisor, business, and departmental needs. Travel may include advisor-team meetings, strategic planning sessions, client or prospect events, department meetings, and firm-sponsored gatherings. Roughly 4-6x per year for 2-3 days at a time.


In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share the base salary range for this position is $95,000.00 to $110,000.00, exclusive of bonuses and benefits. The role is also eligible to participate in the corporate bonus plan. We encourage you to apply and provide us with your compensation expectations when you do. We're big on open conversations, so, let's have one.


Primary Job Functions


UHNW Marketing Strategy, Development & Implementation

  • Help define and build Wealth Enhancement's UHNW Advisor Marketing strategy, operating model, capabilities and roadmap
  • Translate advisor, client and business needs into prioritized marketing initiatives, programs and solutions
  • Take ownership of developing, launching, testing, and refining new UHNW marketing programs, moving from concept to pilot with appropriate speed and limited oversight, then applying learnings to improve adoption and scale
  • Partner across Content, Creative, Digital, Web, Events, Analytics, Experience, Product and Advisor Marketing to move strategic priorities from opportunity to implementation
  • Balance the high-touch and customized needs of UHNW teams with the development of repeatable, scalable marketing capabilities
  • Define and differentiate UHNW and Private Wealth target audiences, value propositions, service experiences and supporting marketing capabilities
  • Identify and evaluate tools, technologies, partners and emerging approaches that could strengthen advisor growth, marketing effectiveness or the UHNW client experience
  • Establish scalable frameworks, best practices and planning tools and identify successful approaches that can be replicated across UHNW and Private Wealth teams

Advisor Partnership & Strategic Consulting

  • Serve as the primary strategic marketing partner for a portfolio of UHNW and Private Wealth advisor teams
  • Build a deep understanding of advisor business objectives, client demographics, target markets, relationships, referral networks, growth ambitions and barriers to growth
  • Lead strategic conversations that translate business objectives and market opportunities into focused marketing priorities and actionable plans
  • Build trusted relationships with advisors and business leaders by bringing expertise, perspective, thoughtful recommendations and a clear marketing point of view
  • Influence advisor commitment and maintain momentum by establishing priorities, monitoring progress and addressing barriers to execution
  • Proactively identify opportunities, recommend a path forward, and initiate appropriate next steps without relying on advisors or leaders to define every action
  • Partner with Advisor Marketing Specialists and cross-functional partners on execution while maintaining ownership of strategic direction, advisor communication, priorities and accountability

UHNW Marketing Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and manage strategic marketing plans and budgets aligned with advisor business objectives, target audiences and growth opportunities
  • Identify opportunities to deepen client relationships, strengthen market visibility, expand referral and center-of-influence networks, and attract ideal prospective clients
  • Translate strategic priorities into defined initiatives, advisor commitments, timelines, budgets, ownership and measurable outcomes
  • Recommend the appropriate mix of programs, campaigns, content, thought leadership, events, digital experiences and firm resources to advance advisor objectives
  • Continuously evaluate business conditions, advisor priorities and performance indicators and adapt recommendations accordingly

UHNW Market, Client & Competitive Expertise

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on UHNW audiences, affluent client engagement, relationship-based growth and advisor positioning
  • Monitor evolving UHNW client expectations, market trends, competitive activity and emerging growth opportunities and translate insights into practical recommendations
  • Advise teams on thought leadership, community presence, centers of influence, partnerships, client experiences and other strategies designed to strengthen credibility, relationships and influence with affluent audiences
  • Bring the voice of advisors and UHNW clients into the development and evolution of Wealth Enhancement's marketing programs, resources and capabilities
  • Connect enterprise resources and expertise with local market opportunities in ways that are relevant and actionable for advisor teams

Performance, Measurement & Optimization

  • Use Salesforce, firm dashboards, advisor insights and approved reporting tools to evaluate marketing performance and business outcomes
  • Analyze measures including net flows, client acquisition, referrals, advisor activity, audience engagement, event outcomes, marketing adoption and budget utilization
  • Translate data and business context into actionable recommendations and identify opportunities requiring adjustment, additional investment or a different approach
  • Establish measurement approaches that demonstrate the adoption, effectiveness and business impact of UHNW marketing initiatives
  • Identify successful advisor practices and marketing strategies that can be documented, refined and scaled across UHNW and Private Wealth teams

Improve Service Quality by Using AI and Digital Tools

  • Use approved AI and digital tools to simplify work, improve service quality, and increase efficiency, while validating outputs for accuracy, privacy, and business alignment
  • Identify and escalate inaccurate information and knowledge gaps, or issues related to digital tools

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means both building a stronger UHNW Advisor Marketing capability and delivering meaningful value to individual advisor teams.

  • A clearly defined UHNW Advisor Marketing strategy, roadmap and set of priorities are established and continue to evolve with the business
  • New UHNW marketing programs and capabilities are successfully developed, tested, refined and scaled
  • Advisor teams view the Strategist as a trusted business and marketing partner who brings expertise, perspective and direction
  • UHNW advisor teams have focused marketing strategies aligned with their business goals, target audiences and market opportunities
  • Advisors effectively leverage Wealth Enhancement's capabilities and make intentional marketing investments aligned with their highest-priority opportunities
  • Advisor and client insights consistently inform the development of programs, resources and experiences
  • Successful practices are identified and translated into repeatable approaches that benefit the broader UHNW business
  • Cross-functional partners have clarity around UHNW marketing priorities, advisor needs and their role in supporting the business
  • Marketing efforts demonstrate measurable progress toward advisor growth, client acquisition, referrals, engagement and relationship-building objectives
  • The Strategist demonstrates sound judgment under ambiguity, makes timely recommendations, and adjusts course as new information becomes available
  • Leaders, advisors, and partners experience the Strategist as a proactive owner who anticipates needs, removes barriers, and consistently drives work forward

Education/Qualifications

  • Five or more years of experience in marketing strategy, advisor consulting, business development, field marketing, wealth management, client success, practice management, or a related client-facing role
  • Demonstrated ability to develop strategic marketing recommendations and translate them into actionable plans, programs, or growth initiatives
  • Experience supporting high-performing professionals, business owners, advisors, executives, or client-facing teams
  • Strong understanding of relationship-based growth strategies, community engagement, referral development, and advisor positioning
  • Ability to build trust, influence decisions, and gain commitment without direct authority
  • Ability to facilitate strategic discussions and confidently challenge conventional thinking when appropriate
  • Experience developing and managing stakeholder relationships across multiple business functions
  • Strong business acumen and ability to connect marketing recommendations to business outcomes
  • Comfort interpreting data, dashboards, CRM insights, and performance trends to inform recommendations
  • Strong presentation, facilitation, and executive communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining strong advisor and stakeholder relationships
  • Proficiency with CRM, reporting, project-management, and Microsoft 365 tools
  • Proven ability to create structure, establish priorities, and move work forward in an evolving or ambiguous environment
  • Demonstrated bias for action and ability to make sound, timely decisions with incomplete information
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field preferred (or equivalent as demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, or education)
  • Experience within wealth management, private wealth, financial services, family office, banking, or a related industry
  • Experience supporting affluent or UHNW client segments
  • Understanding of centers of influence, business-owner marketing, executive audiences, multigenerational wealth conversations, and relationship-based growth strategies
  • Experience working with Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms
  • Experience leading marketing pilots, strategic initiatives, or cross-functional projects
  • Experience utilizing data, technology, and AI-enabled tools to support marketing effectiveness and advisor growth
  • Demonstrated experience building or launching a new program or business initiative all the way through to go-to-market within an evolving organization

jobs.excerpt: Job SummaryDefines and executes strategies that embed AI into both product capabilities and internal processes, shifting to intelligent, scalable, and automated systems, while owning the strategy for core supply chain forecasting and demand planning capabilities.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Defines and executes strategies that embed AI into both product capabilities and internal processes, shifting to intelligent, scalable, and automated systems, while owning the strategy for core supply chain forecasting and demand planning capabilities. Improves efficiency, accelerates execution, and enhances product performance including automation, decisioning, forecasting, and data-driven insights. Partners across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, and Customer facing teams to deliver solutions that drive measurable outcomes in productivity, revenue, and customer experience. Owns product strategy from opportunity identification and market analysis through definition, build, launch, and continuous iteration.

Key Responsibilities

Develops a deep understanding of marketplace requirements, customer needs, and competitive dynamics in automotive supply chain to apply to continuous product improvements. Owns the end-to-end product lifecycle — from opportunity identification and requirements definition through design, development, launch, and post-launch iteration. Identifies, prioritizes, and builds the business case for high-impact opportunities to apply AI-driven automation, decisioning, and data-driven insights across both customer-facing products and internal operating processes. Partners closely with Engineering and Data Science to translate business problems into clear, well-scoped product requirements, evaluating feasibility, trade-offs, and technical approach. Defines success metrics and experiment designs (e.g., A/B tests, pilots) to validate product hypotheses and quantify impact on productivity, revenue, and customer experience. Partners with OEM field teams and internal Success teams to develop strategic post-launch campaigns that maximize dealer adoption and program ROI. Partners with Sales, Marketing, and Product leadership to align go-to-market strategy, positioning, and pricing for new Supply Chain product capabilities. Develops and delivers product and program performance reporting and insights to OEM customers and OEC leadership, ensuring outcomes are clearly tied back to business impact. Act as an escalation point for product-related issues, driving timely resolution and communicating outcomes to internal and external stakeholders. Serves as a subject-matter expert on applying AI within automotive supply chain, educating stakeholders and leadership on opportunities, risks, and responsible-AI considerations where relevant. Monitors adoption and performance of the product and features, iterating the roadmap based on usage data, customer feedback, and business results. Helps to guide the strategy and roadmap for supply chain forecasting and demand planning capabilities, ensuring models and tools reflect sound forecasting methodology and deliver actionable accuracy for customers.

Education

A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university is required, with a focus Ain Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science, Supply Chain Management, Operations Statistics, Business or related discipline. In the absence of a degree, equivalent work experience directly related to the key responsibilities of the role will be considered as a substitute for the degree.

Experience

At least 6 years of product management experience with a background that includes full product lifecycle ownership (market/opportunity analysis, requirements definition, development partnership, launch, and iteration), at least 3 years leading AI/ML-powered or data-driven product initiatives from concept through launch, prior experience defining and tracking product KPIs and designing experiments (e.g., A/B testing, pilots) to validate product hypotheses, plus a proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional AI or data-driven product initiatives from concept through steady-state performance.

Must also be able to demonstrate the following knowledge, skills, and abilities:

Working knowledge of the AI/ML product development lifecycle, data pipelines, model evaluation, human-in-the-loop design, and responsible AI practices. Deep automotive industry domain expertise, including familiarity with OEM programs, dealer operations, and automotive supply chain workflows. Working knowledge of supply chain forecasting and demand planning methodologies (e.g., statistical forecasting, inventory optimization, forecast accuracy measurement) and how they translate into product requirements. Skilled at identifying high-impact AI use cases that balance technical feasibility, customer desirability, and business value. Ability to build and maintain executive-level relationships with OEM customers and internal senior stakeholders, comfortable owning those conversations directly. Excellent strategic thinking and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous business problems and data into clear product requirements and actionable recommendations. Ability to take initiative and ownership, and drive team and cross-functional efficiency to deliver against aggressive timelines. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced remote work environment while maintaining quality and customer focus. Excellent communication skills and can present product strategy and performance clearly to both customer leadership and internal executive teams.

Special Position Requirements

Willing and able to attend virtual meetings with the laptop camera on.

Job Description

Position Overview

Momentive Software is hiring an Account Development Representative to drive top-of-funnel cross-sell pipeline from our existing client base to our SMB sales team.

Position Summary

Momentive Software is hiring an Account Development Representative to help drive top-of-funnel cross-sell pipeline from the existing Momentive client base to our SMB sellers. We need a self-directed, motivated individual who can identify expansion opportunities, activate relevant client signals, and create qualified cross-sell meetings that progress into meaningful pipeline and closed/won business.

This individual will partner closely with Business Development, SMB Sales, Client Success, Marketing, and Go-To-Market teams to prioritize high-propensity accounts, execute targeted outreach, and ensure a coordinated client experience. The role is an individual contributor position focused on creating qualified expansion opportunities, maintaining strong pipeline hygiene, and delivering clear handoffs to the appropriate sales owner.

A Day in the Life

  • Drive proactive cross-sell prospecting into the existing Momentive client base, with emphasis on SMB accounts and high-propensity white-space opportunities.
  • Research client accounts to understand current Momentive products, potential product gaps, organizational priorities, buying centers, and relevant triggers for expansion conversations.
  • Use account signals, intent data, relationship context, and internal guidance to prioritize outreach and determine the most relevant cross-sell motion.
  • Create personalized multi-channel outreach that connects Momentive product value to the client's current operating environment and likely business priorities.
  • Book and progress qualified cross-sell meetings for SMB sellers, ensuring meetings are well-prepared, well-documented, and connected to a clear business opportunity.

 

We are looking for someone who brings

Experience:

  • 1-2 years of experience in sales development, business development, or a similar prospecting role, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • A track record of building qualified pipeline through outbound prospecting and account research.
  • Experience tailoring outreach based on account signals, buying triggers, or intent data.
  • Comfort partnering with Sales, Marketing, and Client Success to coordinate a consistent client experience.
  • Familiarity with the association, nonprofit, or membership technology space is a plus.

Technical/Computer Skills:

  • Salesforce, or a comparable CRM, used daily to track accounts, activity, and pipeline handoffs.
  • Comfortable with sales engagement tools such as Salesloft, Outreach, or Gong.
  • Familiarity with intent or signal data platforms (e.g., 6sense, ZoomInfo) is a plus.
  • Microsoft Office 365. 

Other Skills:

  • Self-directed and motivated, with the discipline to hit pipeline and meeting targets independently.
  • Strong written and verbal communicator who can earn attention from busy stakeholders.
  • Curious and consultative, asking good questions to uncover real client needs before pitching.
  • Organized enough to manage a high volume of accounts and outreach touches without letting follow-up slip.
  • Collaborative team player who works well across Sales, Marketing, and Client Success.
  • Willingness to travel less than 10% as needed.

About Us

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com.

Why Work Here?

At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are valued, you’ll find it here.

401(k) Savings Plan with Company Match

Flexible Planned Paid Time Off

Generous Sick Leave

Inclusive & Welcoming Environment

Purpose-Driven Culture

Work-Life Balance

Commitment to Community Involvement

Remote Work Flexibility

Position:

SLED Channel Manager - South


Job Description:

Why You'll Love This Role

Innovation happens when the right people, ideas, and technology come together. At Arrow, our Sales teams connect customers with the expertise, solutions, and global capabilities they need to move faster, solve complex challenges, and stay ahead of what's next.


Working across functions and technologies, you'll build lasting partnerships, deliver value beyond products, and help customers transform ideas into real-world solutions while growing your own career in a global technology organization.


Role Overview

As a Southeast SLED Field Channel Manager, you will serve as the primary advocate, trusted advisor, and first point of contact for our strategic reseller partners across the region. This role is focused on building and strengthening long-term partner relationships, aligning Arrow's resources to partner priorities, and driving mutual growth within the State, Local Government, and Education market. Success in this position requires a consultative approach, exceptional relationship-building skills, and the ability to identify and execute opportunities that expand revenue, increase partner engagement, and create lasting value for both Arrow and our partners.

  • Conduct market research to identify potential clients and gather insights on industry trends and competitive landscapes.

  • Team oriented leader

We enable customers and suppliers to design and distribute technology around the world, connecting people, ideas, and innovation to solve real-world challenges. Guided by our purpose of making the benefits of technology accessible to all, we provide expertise, solutions, and connections that help shape what's next. As a global technology solutions provider, Arrow offers opportunities to learn, collaborate, and build a meaningful career while making an impact around the world.

Life at Arrow

At Arrow, we believe innovation starts with people. We create an environment where collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning help our employees grow and make a meaningful impact every day. From your first day, you'll have opportunities to build new skills, work alongside talented teams around the world, and contribute to technology that helps shape a better future.
