Our Chiplets are designed to offer high performance, scalability, and integration flexibility, enabling our clients to achieve breakthroughs in computation speed, data processing, and connectivity. For more information about us, check out our website (Analogue Insight) and LinkedIn Page (Analogue Insight™: Overview | LinkedIn).

THE ROLE
We are seeking a talented and motivated Graduate Digital Design Engineer to join our team and contribute to the design and verification of digital and mixed-signal IP for our chiplet solutions, including PCS (Physical Coding Sublayer) logic and custom high-speed interfaces such as UCIe, Ethernet and PCIe. Working alongside experienced digital and analog engineers, you will write RTL, build testbenches and behavioural models, and see your work go into customer silicon. This role is well suited to recent graduates with a strong foundation in digital design who want to learn fast through hands-on work in a small, high-impact team.
Hiring Manager:Christian Borelli, Founder and CSO.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • RTL Design: Design and implement digital blocks for PCS and interface IP (e.g. encoders/decoders, scramblers, PRBS generators/checkers, FIFOs, CDC logic, control and calibration state machines) in Verilog/SystemVerilog, under the guidance of senior designers.
  • Standards & Specifications: Study SerDes and UCIe standards and architecture documents, and help turn them into clear block-level specifications.
  • Verification: Build testbenches and run simulations to verify your designs, using SystemVerilog, UVM or cocotb, and help develop verification plans and coverage.
  • Mixed-Signal Modelling: Write behavioural models of analog blocks in Verilog/SystemVerilog (and Verilog-A where needed) to support mixed-signal and top-level simulation with the analog team.
  • Implementation Support: Gain exposure to synthesis, lint, CDC checks and static timing analysis, and learn how design choices affect power, performance and area.
  • Scripting & Automation: Use scripting (e.g. Python, TCL or shell) to automate simulation, regression and reporting flows.
  • Documentation & Process: Document your designs and test results clearly, and contribute ideas to improve our design and verification environments and procedures.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with an experienced team of digital, analog and layout engineers across products such as UCIe, Ethernet and PCIe.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Must-have Technical skills:
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field (recent graduates and those graduating within the next 6 months are welcome)
  • 0–2 years of experience in digital design, including internships, placements or university projects
  • Solid understanding of digital logic fundamentals: synchronous design, finite state machines, timing, pipelining and clock-domain crossing
  • Hands-on experience writing RTL in Verilog or SystemVerilog, through coursework, thesis, FPGA or internship projects
  • Experience with an HDL simulator (e.g. Xcelium, VCS, Questa or open-source tools such as Verilator or Icarus)
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail

Soft & Professional Skills:
  • Clear, structured communication in professional English—able to explain complex results concisely
  • Collaborative and feedback-oriented mindset
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through
  • Curious, self-motivated attitude, eager to learn and explore new tools or methods
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information.
Nice-to-have:
  • Exposure to verification methodologies such as UVM, SystemVerilog assertions or cocotb
  • Basic knowledge of synthesis, static timing analysis or place-and-route
  • Familiarity with high-speed serial interfaces or protocols (e.g. UCIe, Ethernet, PCIe) or line coding (e.g. 8b/10b, 64b/66b)
  • Awareness of Design-for-Test concepts (scan, BIST) and hardware/software co-design
  • Scripting skills in Python, TCL or shell, and comfort in a Linux environment
  • FPGA prototyping experience

Soft & Professional Skills:
  • Clear, structured communication in professional English—able to explain your work concisely
  • Collaborative and feedback-oriented mindset, open to learning from design reviews
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through
  • Curious, self-motivated attitude, eager to learn and explore new tools or methods
  • High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information.

OUR CULTURE
We’re a fully remote team of around 45 people distributed across the UK, Armenia, Italy, the US, Estonia, India, and beyond. We believe great talent is everywhere!
  • Our values are our north star: We Grow Together, We Win Together. Excellence Builds Relationships. Trust Is Our Currency. Results Matter, but People Create Them.

Wir von TESVOLT Energy machen es für Betreiber kleiner und mittlerer Batteriespeicher erstmals möglich, lukrativ am Flexibilitätshandel teilzunehmen. Bisher hatten sie keine Chance, einen guten Trader zu finden, der ihre kleineren Speicherkapazitäten an der Energiebörse handelt. Wir bringen sie gebündelt als virtuelles Kraftwerk ans Netz – gehandelt durch die besten Trader am Markt.

Unsere Arbeit ist technisch anspruchsvoll, datenbasiert und nah an der Praxis. Genau das begeistert unser Team: ein Umfeld, in dem Analyst:innen, Entwickler:innen und Strateg:innen gemeinsam etwas bewegen können.

Du denkst Infrastruktur nicht nur mit, sondern voraus? Du willst Systeme bauen, die stabil, sicher und skalierbar sind – und gleichzeitig Entwicklerteams empowern? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Diese Stelle kannst du remote bei uns ausführen.

deine aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt unser Marketing bei der Planung, Umsetzung und Nachbereitung von Kampagnen und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Kommunikationsmaßnahmen ein.
  • Du erstellst und pflegst Content für unsere Website, LinkedIn und weitere Kommunikationskanäle und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Themen verständlich, professionell und zielgruppengerecht aufbereitet werden.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Präsentationen, Broschüren, Grafiken und weiteren Marketingmaterialien und achtest dabei auf eine saubere Umsetzung unseres Corporate Designs.
  • Du wirkst bei der Organisation und Durchführung von Messen, Veranstaltungen und vertriebsnahen Kommunikationsformaten mit.
  • Du wertest Marketing Kennzahlen aus, bereitest Ergebnisse übersichtlich auf und hilfst dabei, unsere Aktivitäten datenbasiert weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du unterstützt den Vertrieb bei der Erstellung von Erlösberechnungen und Wirtschaftlichkeitsbetrachtungen für Batteriespeicherprojekte.
  • Du bereitest Kundendaten, Projektinformationen sowie Angebots- und Präsentationsunterlagen strukturiert für Vertrieb, Partner und Management auf.
  • Du pflegst CRM und Kundendaten zuverlässig und stellst sicher, dass relevante Informationen sauber dokumentiert und für das Team nutzbar sind.
  • Du bekommst einen umfassenden Einblick in Marketing und Sales eines innovativen Unternehmens der Energiewirtschaft, von Website Texten und LinkedIn Beiträgen über Kampagnen bis hin zu konkreten Vertriebsprojekten.

dein profil

  • Du absolvierst ein Studium im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Wirtschaft, Energiewirtschaft oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
  • Du interessierst dich für erneuerbare Energien, Batteriespeicher, Energiehandel und die Frage, wie wirtschaftlich tragfähige Lösungen die Energiewende voranbringen können.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und zuverlässig und hast Freude daran, Themen sauber aufzubereiten und sichtbar voranzubringen.
  • Du verfügst zwingend über gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B1/B2) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse und kannst Inhalte klar, präzise und adressatengerecht formulieren.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Microsoft Office, insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel.
  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Erstellung von Marketing-Content, Präsentationen oder Social Media Beiträgen sind von Vorteil.
  • Ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung, visuelle Kommunikation und saubere Unterlagen ist wünschenswert.
  • Du hast Lust auf die hands-on Mentalität eines jungen Start-ups und schätzt gleichzeitig die Zugehörigkeit zu einer etablierten Unternehmensgruppe

warum wir?

Wir sind ein Team aus Batteriespeicher-, Daten- und Energiemarktexpert:innen, die vorher teils bei
TESVOLT und teils in der Energie-Praxis bei anderen Scale-Ups, einschlägigen Beratungen und
Energieversorgern gearbeitet haben und bringen Know-how zu Batteriespeichern und

Energiehandel aus erster Hand mit.

Uns verbindet die Überzeugung, dass wirtschaftlich tragfähiger Klimaschutz möglich ist – mit
klugen Ideen, starken Partnern und einem besonderen Team.

  • Du erhältst Einblicke in die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft, des Energiehandels und der Flexibilitätsvermarktung von Batteriespeichern.
  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, nah an echten Projekten und mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit Marketing, Vertrieb und Management zusammen und bekommst dadurch einen breiten Blick auf ein wachsendes Geschäftsmodell.
  • Dich erwartet ein motiviertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher fachlicher Nähe und der gemeinsamen Überzeugung, dass wirtschaftlich sinnvoller Klimaschutz möglich ist.
  • Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, arbeitest überwiegend mobil und hast mit unserem Berliner Office einen gemeinsamen Anlaufpunkt für persönlichen Austausch.
  • Du arbeitest mit moderner technischer Ausstattung, digitalen Tools und einem professionellen Setup, das dir flexibles und effizientes Arbeiten von Anfang an ermöglicht

jobs.description:
Associate Managing Editor

Job Purpose

The Associate Managing Editor is responsible for the end-to-end management and development of assigned journals, ensuring timely publication, operational excellence, and strong stakeholder engagement. The role works closely with editors, authors, reviewers, societies, and internal teams to support journal growth, publication quality, indexing objectives, and overall portfolio performance.

Key Responsibilities

Journal & Portfolio Management

  • Manage the end-to-end publication process for assigned journals, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of issues.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for journal-related operational matters and escalations.

  • Coordinate closely with editors, editorial boards, authors, reviewers, and internal stakeholders to ensure efficient journal operations.

  • Ensure a seamless transition of newly acquired journals from the acquisitions stage to editorial management.

  • Monitor publishing schedules and proactively address delays to maintain publication timelines.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with journal editors, authors, reviewers, society partners, and internal teams.

  • Liaise regularly with Sage India, UK, and US colleagues to address editorial, production, and operational requirements.

  • Provide high-quality service and support to editors, societies, and contributors.

Journal Development & Performance

  • Identify opportunities to enhance journal performance, visibility, and impact.

  • Work closely with editors on manuscript flow, turnaround times, editorial planning, and publication strategies.

  • Drive initiatives related to journal indexing, abstracting, Impact Factor acquisition, and overall portfolio growth.

  • Educate and guide editors on indexing criteria, citation performance, and Impact Factor improvement strategies.

  • Identify and implement journal-specific development plans to improve performance and reach.

Marketing & Promotion

  • Collaborate with the Marketing team to develop and execute journal-specific promotional activities, including:

    • Call for Papers campaigns

    • Impact Factor announcements

    • Special Issue promotions

    • Article-level marketing initiatives

    • Conference and event promotional support

Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare and present journal performance reports and publisher reports for internal and external stakeholders.

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics.

  • Maintain accurate journal records, reports, and portfolio documentation.

  • Prepare personal performance reports aligned with departmental objectives.

Contract & Business Management

  • Support drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and managing journal contract renewals and addenda.

  • Develop an understanding of publishing business models and contractual frameworks.

  • Support onboarding, maintenance, and renewal of new publishing products and content solutions.

Continuous Improvement

  • Stay updated on industry developments, publishing trends, and emerging technologies.

  • Contribute to process improvements and operational excellence initiatives.

  • Work independently to achieve departmental objectives while escalating issues appropriately when required.

Key Accountabilities

  • Effective management of assigned journal portfolios.

  • Delivery of publication schedules and service-level commitments.

  • Enhanced journal visibility through indexing and abstracting achievements.

  • Strong stakeholder satisfaction and relationship management.

  • Accurate reporting and performance tracking.

  • Successful implementation of journal development initiatives.

  • Compliance with publishing standards, contracts, and internal policies.

Skills, Qualifications & Experience

Essential Qualifications

  • Postgraduate degree in Life Sciences, Medical Sciences, Publishing, or a related discipline.

Experience

  • 2-3 years of experience in scholarly journal publishing within an editorial or journal management environment.

  • Experience managing journals throughout the publication lifecycle.

  • Hands-on experience with journal development activities, indexing applications, and editorial workflows.

Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Scholarly publishing processes

    • Peer review management

    • Journal management and development

    • Publishing contracts and business models

    • Abstracting and Indexing (A&I) databases

    • Impact Factor and journal performance metrics

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly:

    • Excel

    • PowerPoint

    • Outlook

    • Teams

    • SharePoint

  • Experience with peer review management systems is preferred.

Competencies

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

  • High attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced publishing environment.

Success Measures

  • Timely publication of assigned journals.

  • Improved journal performance and indexing outcomes.

  • High editor, author, reviewer, and society satisfaction.

  • Achievement of departmental and individual KPIs.

  • Effective management of journal portfolios and stakeholder relationships.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Sage we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that is representative of all sections of society and to sustaining a culture that celebrates difference, encourages authenticity, and creates a deep sense of belonging. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, color, race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief as creating value through diversity is what makes us strong.  As a business and as an organization with an increasingly agile workforce, we're open to flexible working arrangements where appropriate.

jobs.description:

Buscamos un/aAI Software Engineer con pasión por la tecnología, curiosidad por la inteligencia artificial y ganas de aprender en un entorno donde la formación, la mentoría y la participación en proyectos reales forman parte del día a día.

Tu misión

Te incorporarás a un equipo altamente especializado participando en el desarrollo de una plataforma tecnológica innovadora, colaborando estrechamente con profesionales senior y adquiriendo experiencia en tecnologías punteras relacionadas con inteligencia artificial, datos y arquitecturas modernas.

Principales responsabilidades

  • Participar en el desarrollo y evolución de soluciones basadas en inteligencia artificial.

  • Colaborar en la construcción de aplicaciones y servicios backend.

  • Trabajar con datos, APIs y procesos de automatización.

  • Contribuir al diseño y mejora de flujos de trabajo inteligentes.

  • Participar en revisiones de código y dinámicas de aprendizaje técnico junto al equipo.

  • Formar parte de proyectos reales con impacto directo en clientes y producto.

Qué buscamos

  • Grado universitario finalizado recientemente o experiencia profesional de hasta 2-3 años en desarrollo de software.

  • Conocimientos de programación y fundamentos sólidos de ingeniería de software.

  • Experiencia o interés en Python.

  • Conocimientos básicos de bases de datos y desarrollo de APIs.

  • Interés genuino por la inteligencia artificial y las tecnologías emergentes.

  • Capacidad de aprendizaje, iniciativa y orientación a la mejora continua.

Valoraremos especialmente

  • Proyectos personales, académicos o contribuciones open source.

  • Conocimientos de Git, Docker o entornos Linux.

  • Experiencia explorando herramientas de IA generativa, agentes o LLMs.

  • Interés por la arquitectura de software y los sistemas distribuidos.

  • Nivel de inglés técnico.

Qué ofrece el proyecto

  • Banda salarial entre 25.000 € y 35.000 € SBA si eres un perfil junior, y entre 40.000€ y 50.000€ BSA si eres un perfil senior.

  • Seguro médico privado.

  • Formación continua y acceso a recursos especializados.

  • Mentoría directa de profesionales senior.

  • Participación en un producto tecnológico propio y en constante evolución.

  • Acceso a herramientas e infraestructura de IA de última generación.

  • Asistencia a eventos y congresos tecnológicos.

  • Plan de crecimiento profesional en un entorno dinámico y altamente técnico.

Si quieres iniciar o impulsar tu carrera profesional en el ámbito de la inteligencia artificial, trabajando con tecnología real y aprendiendo de profesionales con amplia experiencia, nos encantará conocerte.

jobs.description:
Du willst nicht nur das Tagesgeschäft am Laufen halten, sondern die Vision eines Unternehmens operativ Realität werden lassen?

Du denkst in zusammenhängenden System, steuerst komplexe Organisationen und sorgst dafür, dass strategische Konzepte nicht auf Folien bleiben, sondern im Tagesgeschäft gelebt werden?

Als Operations Manager bei EVOLVE trägst du umfassende Verantwortung für Strukturen, Systeme und Teams.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Als Operations Manager bei EVOLVE Digital verantwortest du die operative Steuerung in der Organisation. Du sorgst dafür, dass die strategische Ausrichtung des Unternehmens im operativen Tagesgeschäft wirksam wird. In deinem täglichen Handeln führst du die Organisation durch Phasen von Wachstum und Veränderung. Entwickelst Strukturen, Systeme und Abteilungen weiter und stellst sicher, dass EVOLVE als ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner reibungslos funktioniert - anstatt in Silos zu arbeiten.

Um eine zukunftsträchtige Agentur zu gestalten, nutzt du KI und Automationen gezielt als Wachstumshebel. Du definierst die operative System- und Automationsarchitektur und sorgst dafür, dass Technologie messbar zur Skalierung, Qualitätssicherung und Entlastung der Teams beiträgt.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung triffst du operative Grundsatzentscheidungen, setzt Prioritäten und schaffst die Voraussetzungen dafür, dass das EVOLVE planbar, effizient und zukunftsfähig wachsen kann.

Über EVOLVE Digital

EVOLVE Digital ist eine spezialisierte E-Commerce- und Performance-Marketing-Agentur mit einem klaren Fokus auf skalierbare Wachstumssysteme, strukturierte Prozesse und messbare Ergebnisse.

EVOLVE Digital bietet dir ein Umfeld mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem Team aus 20+ erfahrenen Spezialisten.

Es ist ein Umfeld für Führungspersönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Komplexität beherrschen und Organisationen nachhaltig auf Skalierung ausrichten wollen.

Deine Aufgaben im Überblick

Du baust nicht nur die Prozesse im Hintergrund. Du sorgst im Alltag dafür, dass unser Unternehmen und das gesamte Team reibungsloser funktionieren: Deadlines werden eingehalten, Aufgaben abgeschlossen, Projekte kommen voran.

  • Denn die besten Prozesse bringen nichts, wenn niemand nachhält, ob sie greifen. Genau das ist deine Aufgabe.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass das EVOLVE OS als ganzheitliches System und Kern unserer Dienstleistung funktioniert und sich fortlaufend weiterentwickelt

  • Du steuerst die operativen Abläufe vor allem innerhalb der Agentur und bei Bedarf zusätzlich in Finance und People Ops, von Rechnungswesen über Onboarding.

  • Du entwickelst KPI-Dashboards und Übersichten, wo sie benötigt und sinnvoll sind.

  • Du führst neue Automationen und Prozesse über Claude, Make und n8n ein. Für die Umsetzung stellen wir dir ein Team zur Verfügung.

  • Du betreibst das OKR-System im Alltag: Reminder, Check-ins, Dashboards. Ziele, die niemand nachhält, bleiben.

  • Zusammen mit den Teamleads gehst du Bottlenecks im Tagesgeschäft durch und löst sie an der Wurzel, nicht mit einem Pflaster.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projekt- und Prozessmanagement, idealerweise im Agentur- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld.

  • Du kennst dich mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie ClickUp oder Asana aus und verstehst in den Grundzügen Automation-Tools wie Make oder n8n.

  • Analytisches und systemisches Denken mit Controlling-Grundlagen. Du siehst nicht nur die Kennzahl, sondern auch, was dahinter steckt.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Google-Tabellen und Excel für Auswertungen und Datenstrukturen.

  • Hohe Affinität für AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude und Co. Du nutzt sie, um Systeme zu bauen und Probleme zu lösen, nicht nur ,um Texte zu erstellen.

Was wir dir bieten

jobs.title: Freelance Corporate Facilitator — Leadership & Management
jobs.excerpt: Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities.
jobs.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

Marcus Evans is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

jobs.title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Über DrAnsayDrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland.
jobs.description:
Über DrAnsay

DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.

Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.

Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.

Deine Rolle

Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.

Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.

Was du konkret machst

  • Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

  • OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

  • Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

  • Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

  • User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

  • Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

  • Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

  • Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren

Requirements

Das brauchst du

  • Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

  • Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

  • Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

  • Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu machen: Roadmaps pflegen, Updates einfordern, Reporting am Laufen halten

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weil du täglich in beiden Sprachen mit Product, Engineering und Leadership arbeitest

  • Du kannst die Tätigkeit dauerhaft aus Deutschland ausüben und verfügst zum Start über die hierfür erforderliche Arbeitserlaubnis

Das fällt positiv auf

  • Erfahrung als Head of Product. Voraussetzung ist sie nicht

  • Mehrjährige eigene Produktverantwortung als Product Manager, bevor du in eine Leadership-Rolle gewechselt bist

  • Erfahrung aus einer größeren Produktorganisation mit ausgereiften Arbeitsweisen

  • Erfahrung mit Roadmap- und Produktmanagement-Tools wie airfocus, Productboard, Jira Product Discovery oder Aha!

  • Erfahrung mit Produktanalyse-Tools wie PostHog, Amplitude oder Mixpanel

  • Produkterfahrung in E-Commerce, Marktplätzen oder Digital Health

  • Erfahrung in stark regulierten Produktumfeldern

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit UX-Teams und der Einbindung von User Research

Was wir bieten

  • Vollzeit und unbefristet, Start ab November 2026

  • 100% Remote: Du arbeitest aus Deutschland, Vollzeit, ohne Standortbindung

  • Eine Rolle, die mitwächst: Je tiefer dein Verständnis von Produkten, Markt und Team, desto mehr Entscheidungen übernimmst du

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CPO und Zeit, alle Produktbereiche gründlich kennenzulernen

  • Sichtbare Wirkung: Du prägst, wie DrAnsay neue Produkte startet und woran das Product-Team arbeitet

  • Kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, Low-Ego-Kultur und direktem Feedback

  • Ein Produkt mit realem Nutzen: Wir helfen täglich Menschen, Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher zu bekommen

Wie du dich bewirbst

Bewirb dich direkt über das Bewerbungsformular. Kein Anschreiben erforderlich, wir stellen dir einige kurze Fragen, die uns helfen zu verstehen, wie du arbeitest. Diese Antworten sind uns wichtiger als dein LinkedIn-Profil.

Du hörst von uns innerhalb von fünf Arbeitstagen.

DrAnsay ist ein chancengleicher Arbeitgeber. Bewerbungen werden auf Basis von Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung bewertet. Alle Bewerbenden werden unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Herkunft, Behinderung, Religion oder anderen geschützten Merkmalen berücksichtigt. DrAnsay verarbeitet die mit deiner Bewerbung übermittelten personenbezogenen Daten zur Durchführung des Recruitingprozesses.

jobs.description:
Firmable's product depends on customer trust in how we handle their data. This role is the operational backbone of that trust: the controls you run are what let 1,000+ customers rely on Firmable with their data.

The Role

As our Security Engineer, you'll own the day-to-day execution of the security controls and policies that keep Firmable compliant against SOC 2 (all five TSC) and ISO 27001:2022. You'll report into the Security & Compliance team, fully remote and open globally. This is a hands-on operational role, not a paper-compliance one: you implement, monitor and continuously tighten the controls auditors and customers actually test against.

~90% hands-on execution: control implementation, continuous monitoring, evidence collection, vulnerability and access management.
~10% cross-functional: partnering with engineering on secure cloud config and shaping the program as it scales across frameworks.

What You'll Own

  • SOC 2 & ISO 27001 execution: implement and maintain controls across infrastructure, applications and internal systems; close gaps as they're identified

  • Security policy enforcement: put information security policy into daily practice across engineering and business teams, covering access control, data classification, incident response, vendor risk and change management

  • Continuous control monitoring: recurring access reviews, log reviews, vulnerability scans and patch cadence checks; organise evidence ahead of audits

  • Vulnerability management: triage scanner findings, coordinate remediation with engineering, verify closure

  • Identity & access management: onboarding/offboarding, least-privilege and MFA enforcement, periodic access recertification

  • Monitoring & incident response: watch security alerts and logs, triage and escalate per the incident response plan

  • Risk & vendor management: maintain the risk register and third-party risk assessments, track remediation to closure

  • Audit readiness: prepare evidence for annual assessments and respond to customer security questionnaires

  • Security awareness: run employee training and phishing simulations

  • Secure cloud configuration: partner with engineering on least-privilege IAM, encryption at rest and in transit, and secrets management (AWS)

What We're Looking For

Must haves

  • 2–5 years in security engineering, cloud security or infrastructure security, ideally with direct SOC 2 or ISO 27001 exposure

  • Working knowledge of the SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria and how technical controls map to them

  • Hands-on cloud security fundamentals (AWS preferred): IAM, logging/monitoring, vulnerability scanning

  • Comfortable executing policy day to day (access reviews, evidence collection, remediation tracking), not just writing it

  • Clear written communication and comfortable working async across time zones with a distributed team

Highly valued

  • Familiarity with GRC automation platforms (Vanta, Drata or similar)

  • Relevant certification (Security+, CySA+, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, or progress toward CISA/CISSP)

The Environment

Fully remote, open globally, working closely with a distributed Security and Engineering team across time zones. Real ownership over controls that directly protect customer trust, not a box-ticking exercise. Fast-moving, AI-native product team.

Why This Role

  • Real ownership: the controls you run directly protect the trust 1,000+ customers place in Firmable's data

  • Multi-framework exposure from day one: a live SOC 2 and ISO 27001 program, not a single-framework box-tick

  • Competitive compensation and flexible hours in a fast-moving, AI-native product team

About Lokal :

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

    • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
    • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
    • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
    • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs)
    • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
    • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
    • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
    • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.

jobs.excerpt: Our StoryTopDog Law is not your typical law firm.
jobs.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Senior Data Engineer to own a business domain's data end-to-end, with a specific mandate: be the person who makes ingestion reliable and the numbers trustworthy.

You are expected to be the trusted authority on getting data in correctly and proving it's right for your division. You'll partner closely with the Director of Data to turn platform strategy into reliable production systems, and own the day-to-day reliability, performance, and scalability of what you build.

What You Will Own

Ingestion, End-to-End

  • Design and build how source data lands — third-party connectors, APIs, webhooks, file drops, CDC and batch loads.
  • Master API-based ingestion: authentication and token-refresh flows (OAuth2, API keys), pagination, rate-limit handling, retry and backoff, and reconciling incremental/paginated pulls into complete, correct datasets.
  • Own schema-drift handling, incremental vs. full-refresh strategy, idempotency and replayability, backfills, and late/duplicate-record handling.

Data Quality as a First-Class Deliverable

  • Build the tests, contracts, and monitoring that let stakeholders trust the numbers: freshness and volume checks, schema/type enforcement at the boundary, referential and uniqueness constraints, reconciliation against source-of-truth, and anomaly detection on business-critical metrics.
  • Ensure failures surface loudly and early — caught at the boundary, not discovered in a dashboard three days later.

Full Domain Delivery

  • Deliver the full pipeline for your domain: ingestion config, raw landing, dbt staging and mart models, data-quality tests, orchestration DAG, and runbook.
  • Stakeholders own the business definitions; you own translating them into correct, tested transformations — and you own the documentation that makes those definitions authoritative, traceable, and fuels our AI-ready environment.

Architecting an AI-Ready Single Source of Truth

  • Design domain data so it's clean, consistently grained, well-documented, and semantically unambiguous — the kind of SSOT that both dashboards and AI/agent-driven consumers can query reliably, without hidden business rules or hallucination.
  • Treat documentation and metric traceability as part of the deliverable, not an afterthought.

Platform Reliability & Performance

  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability across your pipelines and their platform dependencies.
  • Ensure data freshness and system uptime meet defined service expectations; optimize pipeline performance, compute utilization, and system efficiency.

Engineering Standards

  • Maintain version-controlled data infrastructure and CI/CD workflows for your pipelines.
  • Set the reference implementation others follow — especially for ingestion and DQ, where the team currently lacks a pattern.

Mentorship & Collaboration

  • Review other engineers' work, pair on hard problems, and raise the team's bar — senior impact shows up through others, not only your own commits.
  • Translate business needs into data solutions directly with your domain's stakeholders; understand not just how to build it but why the business needs it built that way.

What You Bring

Required:

  • 5+ years building and maintaining production data pipelines.
  • Expert-level dbt — staging/mart architecture, incremental models, tests, macros, documentation, and exposures. This is non-negotiable.
  • Mastery of API-based data ingestion — authentication and token-refresh (OAuth2, keys), pagination, rate limiting, retry/backoff, and assembling incremental pulls into complete, correct datasets.
  • Demonstrated expertise across other ingestion source types (webhooks, files, databases/CDC), including schema drift, idempotency, backfills, and incremental loading.
  • A strong track record designing data-quality frameworks — not a handful of not_null tests, but freshness/volume/reconciliation/anomaly checks and the alerting around them.
  • Strong Python for custom extraction, loading, and tooling — able to build and maintain production ingestion code, not just glue scripts.
  • Fluent SQL and hands-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse (BigQuery or Snowflake preferred; comparable considered ).
  • Experience architecting a clean, documented, AI-ready single source of truth that downstream analytics and AI consumers can trust without hidden logic.
  • Experience with orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, or dbt Cloud jobs) and with Git in collaborative development environments.

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: $148,800 and $181,700, commensurate with experience
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you’re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.

We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth stor​y while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

Iron Mountain is seeking a high-performing, motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to join our Data Centers team. In this role, you will be responsible for orchestrating contractual compliance and technical alignment for multimillion-dollar hyperscale data center builds. You will lead cross-functional, geographically distributed teams to ensure the successful, on-time delivery of complex multi-megawatt data center projects per contractual requirements.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Lead Project Execution: Coordinate the end-to-end delivery of hyperscale customer deployments, including white space readiness and fit-out, while managing critical path project schedules.

  • Collaborate with Stakeholders: Serve as the primary point of contact between customers and internal teams (Sales, Design, Construction, and Operations) to ensure technical scope alignment and requirement fulfillment.

  • Manage Risk and Compliance: Proactively identify and resolve blockers, manage customer scope changes, and ensure all deliverables align with organizational standards and contractual obligations.

  • Scope: Manage customer scope changes and internal change requests including Non-Recurring Charges (NRCs), work orders, and technical scope updates.

  • Customer Review: Review and interpret customer service orders, statements of work, and technical requirements to ensure project scope is understood and deliverable.

  • Reviews: Coordinate hyperscale design reviews with customer engineering teams and internal design/construction teams to ensure technical scope alignment prior to deployment.

What You’ll Bring

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Professional Experience: 10+ years of experience as a technical program manager supporting data center construction or infrastructure program management.

  • Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of data center infrastructure, including commissioning, power distribution, cooling systems, and rack-level fit-out environments.

  • Leadership & Innovation: Proven ability to lead cross-functional spheres of influence, innovate processes, and excel in high-velocity, nebulous environments.

What We Offer

  • Location: Remote role with a requirement for 15% travel.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary and benefits aligned with your experience.

jobs.excerpt: Buscamos un Representante Técnico de Ventas responsable del desarrollo comercial y la venta consultiva de soluciones de Reología y Calorimetría Diferencial de Barrido (DSC), con foco principal en Reología y una responsabilidad complementaria en análisis térmico por DSC.
jobs.description:
Buscamos un Representante Técnico de Ventas responsable del desarrollo comercial y la venta consultiva de soluciones de Reología y Calorimetría Diferencial de Barrido (DSC), con foco principal en Reología y una responsabilidad complementaria en análisis térmico por DSC.

Esta posición combina prospección, desarrollo de cuentas, calificación técnica, demostraciones y cierre de ventas. Buscamos un perfil claramente comercial, con capacidad para abrir mercado y suficiente base técnica para conversar con formuladores, investigadores, responsables de calidad, proceso, laboratorio, compras y dirección.

Responsabilidades principales

  • Desarrollar comercialmente el portafolio de Reología y DSC en el territorio asignado, dedicando la mayor parte del esfuerzo comercial a soluciones de Reología.
  • Prospectar y desarrollar nuevos clientes en sectores como pinturas y recubrimientos, polímeros, adhesivos, farmacéutica, cosmética, alimentos, químicos, petroquímicos, lubricantes, baterías, academia, I+D y control de calidad.
  • Gestionar el ciclo completo de venta: identificación de oportunidades, calificación técnica, presentación de soluciones, elaboración de propuestas, negociación y cierre.
  • Identificar aplicaciones reológicas relacionadas con viscosidad y curvas de flujo, esfuerzo de cedencia, tixotropía, viscoelasticidad, estabilidad de formulaciones y comportamiento dependiente del tiempo, temperatura y frecuencia.
  • Identificar oportunidades de DSC para caracterización de transiciones térmicas, temperatura de transición vítrea (Tg), fusión, cristalización, curado, estabilidad oxidativa, polimorfismo, compatibilidad y pureza, según la aplicación.
  • Realizar presentaciones técnico-comerciales y coordinar demostraciones de reómetros y calorímetros DSC, con apoyo de especialistas de aplicación cuando sea necesario.
  • Asesorar al cliente en la selección de la solución adecuada de acuerdo con muestra, formulación, proceso, rango de temperatura, método de prueba, nivel de automatización y objetivos de medición.
  • Desarrollar relaciones de largo plazo con formuladores, investigadores, responsables de laboratorio, calidad, I+D, producción, proceso, compras y tomadores de decisión.
  • Cumplir los objetivos de venta trimestrales y anuales, así como los indicadores comerciales definidos por la gerencia.
  • Mantener actualizado el CRM con oportunidades, actividades, forecast, seguimiento comercial y etapas del pipeline.
  • Identificar oportunidades de venta cruzada con otras líneas de producto de la compañía.
  • Dar seguimiento postventa para asegurar la satisfacción del cliente, fortalecer la relación y detectar nuevas oportunidades de negocio.
  • Participar en capacitaciones técnicas y comerciales, ferias, seminarios, workshops y eventos especializados en México y en el extranjero.
  • Formación profesional en Ingeniería Química, Química, Materiales, Polímeros, Alimentos, Farmacéutica, Mecánica, Mecatrónica, Física, Nanotecnología o carrera afín con base técnica sólida.
  • Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en ventas técnicas B2B, indispensable, preferentemente de instrumentación científica, equipos analíticos, equipos de laboratorio, reómetros, viscosímetros, análisis térmico o soluciones para formulación, I+D y control de calidad.
  • Se valorará especialmente experiencia comercial o de aplicaciones en Reología/Viscosimetría, o experiencia vendiendo instrumentación a industrias donde la formulación y el comportamiento de flujo sean variables críticas.
  • Experiencia comprobable en prospección, apertura de cuentas nuevas, desarrollo de oportunidades y construcción de pipeline; no buscamos un perfil limitado únicamente al mantenimiento de cuentas existentes.
  • Capacidad para comprender una necesidad técnica y convertirla en una propuesta comercial de valor, sin perder el enfoque en avance de oportunidad, negociación y cierre.
  • Habilidad para comunicarse con perfiles técnicos y no técnicos: formuladores, investigadores, ingenieros, responsables de calidad, producción, laboratorio, compras y dirección.
  • Perfil altamente orientado a resultados, con disciplina para el cumplimiento de objetivos y seguimiento sistemático de oportunidades.
  • Manejo de CRM/ERP, forecast y metodología de seguimiento comercial.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar frecuentemente dentro y fuera del país.
  • Manejo de automóvil y disponibilidad para traslados en carretera.
  • Inglés intermedio conversacional indispensable para capacitación y comunicación técnica.

Experiencia deseable

Se dará prioridad a candidatos con experiencia directa en Reología o Viscometría, aunque no cuenten todavía con experiencia específica en DSC.

  • Venta, aplicación o uso técnico de reómetros rotacionales/oscilatorios, viscosímetros de laboratorio o sistemas de caracterización de flujo y viscoelasticidad.
  • Desarrollo, formulación o control de calidad de pinturas, recubrimientos, tintas, adhesivos, asfaltos, cosméticos, productos farmacéuticos, alimentos o formulaciones químicas.
  • Pruebas reológicas como curvas de flujo, esfuerzo de cedencia, tixotropía, barridos de amplitud/frecuencia/temperatura, recuperación estructural, creep o relajación.
  • Caracterización de polímeros, elastómeros, resinas, materiales fundidos, slurries, suspensiones, emulsiones, geles, pastas o materiales para baterías.
  • Experiencia en análisis térmico, DSC, DMA, TGA o técnicas relacionadas será considerada un valor adicional, pero no es un requisito indispensable.
  • Conocimiento de aplicaciones de DSC en polímeros o farmacéutica, incluyendo Tg, fusión, cristalización, curado, estabilidad, polimorfismo o pureza.

La prioridad es encontrar un vendedor técnico fuerte en Reología. El conocimiento de DSC puede desarrollarse mediante entrenamiento técnico y acompañamiento de especialistas de aplicación

Soluciones y tecnologías de la línea

Deseable familiaridad con Reología; el conocimiento de DSC puede adquirirse durante el proceso de capacitación. Las tecnologías incluyen:

  • Reometría rotacional y oscilatoria para líquidos, semisólidos, dispersiones, emulsiones, geles, pastas y materiales complejos.
  • Medición de viscosidad, curvas de flujo, esfuerzo de cedencia, tixotropía, viscoelasticidad, creep, relajación y recuperación estructural.
  • Barridos de amplitud, frecuencia, tiempo y temperatura; control de fuerza normal y accesorios para aplicaciones avanzadas.
  • Sistemas de medición y accesorios para formulación, control de calidad, polímeros, reología de polvos, tribología y caracterización especializada, según aplicación.
  • Calorimetría Diferencial de Barrido para Tg, fusión, cristalización, curado, estabilidad oxidativa, capacidad calorífica y caracterización térmica de materiales.

​​​​​​​Ofrecemos

  • Sueldo competitivo.
  • Bono por desempeño y esquema de comisiones.
  • Prestaciones superiores a las de la ley.
  • Herramientas de trabajo: automóvil, laptop y celular corporativo.
  • Capacitación técnica y comercial continua en México y en el extranjero.
  • Desarrollo profesional dentro de una empresa internacional líder en instrumentación científica.

Our platform, FiftyOne, is where AI work happens. Our enterprise platform is the mission critical linchpin for managing unstructured data, model development, and AI systems at the world's largest companies.

We believe that open source is the way to lead the data-centric AI revolution. Our open source version has 4 million downloads to-date.

Our software massively impacts AI work across almost every vertical: from self-driving cars to medical imaging to revolutionizing agriculture, we are at the thrilling center of real-world AI advancement’s next wave.

And we’re built on three key tenets:

  • We are all human beings: we strive to be a “human-first” organization and treat everyone with the respect, care, and flexibility that all people deserve.
  • We are distributed: we believe in getting autonomy and power into the hands of people actually doing the work
  • We believe in the power of community

We are fully remote, hiring for people based in the United States, and who are prepared to travel to at least 2 in-person retreats per year.

About your role

As a Senior Software Engineer at Voxel51, you’ll collaborate with a team that delivers features to support dataset curation, model analysis, and integrations that span the entire machine learning lifecycle. You’ll build clean, scalable APIs and solve unique challenges that arise when working with unstructured data (images and video). You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a thriving open source community while also emphasizing enterprise-grade engineering for our commercial products.

What you will do

  • Develop our open source SDK, as well as our enterprise APIs, UIs, and backend systems.
  • Help us scale our enterprise solution (deployed into customer’s own cloud and on prem) to support the largest vision AI datasets in existence, supporting individual researchers to Fortune 500 companies; processing petabytes of data.
  • Write production code that is maintainable, flexible, performant, and well tested.
  • Contribute to the department through tooling, automation, and best practices.

What you should bring

  • 8+ years of professional full-stack software engineering experience developing maintainable and scalable systems and software architectures.
  • BS or MS in computer science or a related field.
  • Expertise with Python.
  • Expertise with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DocumentDB, Elasticsearch).
  • Experience maintaining or contributing to open source projects (or the passion to start!).
  • Ability to work in a remote-first, collaborative environment.
  • Experience with Typescript is an asset.

The 4DMT Talent Acquisition team must expressly engage agencies on any requisition. Agencies contacting hiring managers directly will not be tolerated, and doing so may impact your ability to work with 4DMT in the future.

4DMT is a leading late-stage biotechnology company advancing durable and disease-targeted therapeutics with potential to transform treatment paradigms and provide unprecedented benefits to patients. The Company’s lead product candidate 4D-150 is designed to be a backbone therapy forming the foundation of treatment of blinding retinal vascular diseases by providing multi-year sustained delivery of anti-VEGF (aflibercept and anti-VEGF-C) with a single, safe, intravitreal injection, which substantially reduces the treatment burden associated with current bolus injections. The Company’s lead indication for 4D-150 is wet age-related macular degeneration, which is currently in Phase 3 development, and second indication is diabetic macular edema. The Company’s second product candidate is 4D-710, which is the first known genetic medicine to demonstrate successful delivery and expression of the CFTR transgene in the lungs of people with cystic fibrosis after aerosol delivery

GENERAL SUMMARY

The Senior Director of Clinical Quality Assurance (CQA) will provide strategic and operational Quality Assurance leadership and oversight for multiple, registrational, global 4DMT-sponsored clinical trials, ensuring trials are executed in compliance with applicable international regulatory requirements for Good Clinical Practice (GCP).

This position reports to the Executive Director, Quality Assurance and is accountable for advancing the CQA mission, objectives, and strategic plan through proactive quality strategy, risk-based oversight, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement of clinical quality systems.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Provide strategic Quality leadership and oversight for multiple 4DMT Clinical Studies, including the followingstudy-specific activities:

  • Serve as a senior Quality partner to clinical study teams and leadership, providing guidance on GCP, ICH E6, and related regulations and guidance,, decision support, and escalation recommendations, including via attendance at Study team meetings, quality governance forums, and escalation discussions related to Clinical Study Quality Events.
  • Lead the development, implementation, and governance of Clinical Study Quality Plans for specific 4DMT clinical studies, with accountability for protecting subject safety/rights, data integrity, and GCP compliance across assigned studies and associated vendors.
  • Manage, mentor, and develop Clinical QA staff and consultants; establish clear goals, development plans, and succession depth.
  • Define, plan, perform, and/or oversee risk-based GCP Compliance audits of high-risk clinical vendors/sites, including clinical investigator sites
  • Ensure audit findings, quality risks, and CAPA commitments are communicated to senior stakeholders and collaborate with auditees and vendors to track, review, approve, assess the adequacy of CAPAs, and ensure timely escalation of unresolved or recurring issues
  • Provide senior Quality review and strategic input on Clinical documents, ensuring quality, accuracy, completeness, and inspection readiness of key clinical and regulatory documents, including as applicable Clinical Protocols, IBs, DSURs, Module 2.6 and 2.7 Tabulated and Written Summaries, and Integrated Summaries.

Lead and/or provide oversight for investigation and management of significant Clinical Study Quality Events:

  • Identify, communicate, and escalate significant incidents of GCP non-compliance, quality risks, and inspection-readiness concerns, and drive timely resolution, ensuring appropriate executive visibility, escalation, and risk-based decision-making.
  • Provide QA oversight for formal corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), ensuring actions are risk-based, effective, timely, and appropriately escalated to address identified Clinical Study Quality Events, including potential serious breaches of GCP.
  • Partner with CMC Quality, Clinical Operations, and senior cross-functional stakeholders to facilitate the investigation, escalation, and resolution of clinical supply quality issues such as temperature excursions, product complaints, and deviations reported from clinical sites, ensuring appropriate risk assessment, stakeholder communication, and CAPA linkage when applicable.

Champion and advance a culture of quality that fosters learning, respect, open communication, collaboration, integration, and teamwork:

  • Oversee and provide strategic direction for development of GCP compliance training materials and delivery of training to strengthen clinical quality culture and inspection readiness.
  • Partner with Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Biometrics, Data Management, Medical Affairs, and Regulatory Affairs to embed proactive quality and risk management into study design and conduct.
  • Lead the development and continuous improvement of the Clinical Quality Management system through the development / refinement of Clinical QA processes

Lead preparedness / readiness / management of BIMO / GCP inspections:

  • Define and lead GCP inspection readiness strategy, plans, and cross-functional readiness activities, including readiness governance, mock inspection support, inspection logistics, and issue escalation
  • Host, lead, and/or provide senior Quality support for GCP-related inspections

QUALIFICATIONS:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in a life science, nursing, pharmacy, or related field; advanced degree (MS, PharmD, PhD) preferred.

Experience:

  • 12+ years of experience or advanced degree with 10+ years of experience within a regulated environment such as Regulatory, Quality, Pharmacovigilance or Clinical Development / Operations within the Biotech or similar

Industry

  • Proven experience leading Clinical quality strategy, quality governance, and senior-level quality oversight of global clinical trials and associated vendors
  • Minimum of 7 years of significant experience in clinical quality assurance, including experience leading, performing, and/or providing senior oversight of GCP audits and global clinical trials.
  • Experience hosting, leading, and supporting health authority inspections, including inspection readiness preparation, front-room/back-room support, response coordination, and follow-up commitment management
  • Extensive practical experience and understanding of clinical quality assurance applied throughout the clinical development life-cycle
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior cross-functional stakeholders, lead complex clinical quality initiatives, and provide mentorship or functional leadership within Clinical QA

Other Qualifications/Skills:

  • Expert understanding of GCP requirements for investigational products and the ability to interpret and apply requirements strategically across clinical programs
  • Executive-level communication skills, both oral and written, with ability to present quality risks, recommendations, and inspection-readiness status to senior stakeholders
  • Strong leadership, influencing, and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative approach to driving alignment across Clinical, Quality, Regulatory, and external vendor stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a fast-paced small company environment, prioritize complex workstreams, make risk-based decisions with minimal direction, and adjust quickly to changing business priorities

Travel: %5

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Physical Activity - Repetitive motions: Making substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. Fingering: Picking, pinching, typing or otherwise working, primarily with fingers rather than with whole hand or arm as in handling. Talking: Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word.
  • Physical Requirements - Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met.
  • Working Conditions - The worker is not substantially exposed to adverse environmental conditions (as in typical office or administrative work).

Base salary compensation range: $245,000 - 286,000

Please note, the base salary compensation range and actual salary offered to the final candidate depends on various factors: candidate’s geographical location, relevant work experience, skills, and years of experience.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.excerpt: Our Mission Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t.
jobs.description:
Our Mission

Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. Then wait in a room solely designed for waiting. Then wait for a surprise bill. In any other consumer industry, the companies delivering such a poor customer experience would not survive. But in healthcare, patients lack market power. Which means they are expected to accept the unacceptable.

Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. To do that, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace that makes it easy to find and book in-person or virtual care in all 50 states, across +200 specialties and +12k insurance plans. By giving patients the ability to see and choose, we give them power. In doing so, we can make healthcare work like every other consumer sector, where businesses compete for customers, not the other way around. In time, this will drive quality up and prices down.

We’re 18 years old and the leader in our space, but we are still just getting started. If you like solving important, complex problems alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, read on.

Your Impact on our Mission

We are looking for a Senior Staff Data Platform Engineer to elevate the systems that power trusted decision-making at Zocdoc.

In this high-impact role, you will define platform standards, lead complex cross-domain initiatives, and shape the future of our analytics and data infrastructure. Your work will ensure our data ecosystem is secure, reliable, compliant, performant, and cost-efficient—enabling teams across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Leadership to move confidently with trusted insights.

This is a senior individual contributor role open to remote candidates across the United States.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are…

  • Motivated by designing scalable data platforms that serve hundreds of stakeholders.
  • Passionate about building clean, governed, and secure data systems.
  • Known for improving reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.
  • Comfortable operating as a technical authority without formal management.
  • Energized by raising standards across analytics, infrastructure, and governance.
  • Interested in solving complex data challenges in healthcare.

Your day to day is…

  • Architecting and improving orchestration, monitoring, and data reliability systems.
  • Defining modeling, semantic layer, and governance standards across teams.
  • Optimizing warehouse performance and reducing compute spend.
  • Implementing secure access controls and strengthening compliance practices.
  • Partnering with Engineering to improve upstream data quality and contracts.
  • Leading cross-functional initiatives that modernize and future-proof Zocdoc’s data platform.
  • Mentoring engineers and guiding architectural decisions.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have…

  • 10+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Backend Software Engineering.
  • Operated at Staff-level scope with cross-team technical influence.
  • Expert SQL skills and strong proficiency in Python or similar languages.
  • Deep experience with Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar warehouses.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt and orchestration tools like Airflow or Dagster.
  • Experience improving pipeline reliability, observability, and system performance.
  • Proven ownership of warehouse cost optimization.
  • Experience implementing secure data access patterns and working in regulated environments.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to influence across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Benefits

  • Flexible work environment
  • Unlimited Vacation(if salaried) / Competitive PTO (if hourly)
  • 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)
  • 401(k) with employer funded match
  • Corporate wellness program with Wellhub
  • Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)
  • Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement
  • Cell phone reimbursement
  • Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging
  • Great Place to Work Certified

Zocdoc is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Salary ranges are determined through alignment with market data. Base salary offered is determined by a number of factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills. Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay and/or equity.

Remote Base Salary Range
$235,000—$300,000 USD

Zocdoc is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Salary ranges are determined through alignment with market data and internal equity. The base salary offered will depend on experience, skills, qualifications, and business needs. Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay and/or equity.

Silicon Valley, CA Base Salary Range
$235,000—$300,000 USD

About usZocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by oursix core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.

Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values - Together, Not Alone, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

  • Lead Threat Modeling and Risk Assessments for vendor technologies and complex system integrations.

  • Serve as a technical security consultant for product development teams, ensuring security is integrated into product roadmaps.

  • Partner with the Data Governance team to define and implement modern data protection standards across all Nielsen environments.

  • Architect the next iteration of Nielsen’s Security Service Edge (SSE), including device posture, access control, and micro-segmentation strategies.

  • Collaborate with Cybersecurity, Network Operations, and Cloud Operations teams to prioritize work based on risk profiles and threat models.

Power your Future with Qualus as a Senior Distribution Engineer in our Distribution Department.   • Apply client standards, industry best practices, and regulatory requirements to the design and execution of distribution projects.
  • Support project execution by managing assignments, monitoring performance, resolving technical issues, and maintaining strong client relationships.
  • Develop and oversee engineering design packages using client-specific software and design tools, including Distribution Design Studio, Pole Foreman, BOUD, Maximo, and/or AutoCAD.
  • Perform QA/QC reviews of engineering and design deliverables to ensure technical accuracy, quality, consistency, and compliance with project requirements.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers and designers through training, design reviews, and knowledge sharing.
  • Communicate effectively with internal teams, clients, contractors, and regulatory agencies to support successful project delivery.
  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, design standards, team performance, and technical capabilities.
  • Maintain productivity and adaptability in a fast-paced, evolving work environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, or related discipline) from an ABET-accredited institution.
  • 8+ years of experience in electric utility distribution engineering and design.
  • Experience designing and supporting overhead and underground distribution systems.
  • Knowledge of utility distribution standards, NESC requirements, and utility construction practices.
  • Proficiency with utility design and work management software, including Pole Foreman, Maximo, BOUD, DDS, AutoCAD, MicroStation, or similar platforms.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Experience preparing, reviewing, and coordinating engineering design packages and construction work orders.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and client relationship management skills.

  • Excellent organizational, document management, and attention-to-detail skills.

The salary range provided in this job posting may be subject to change for business purposes.

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 1,800 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.
