Role Title: Finance Research Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay: $30 - $60 per hour

Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours

Location: Remote, worldwide

You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP

Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer

Scope of Work

You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer.

  1. Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation.
  2. Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported).
  3. Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version.
  4. Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly.
  5. Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer.

What we’re looking for

Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds:

  1. Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies.
  2. Investment banking or corporate development (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures.
  3. Credit or restructuring analysis, with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings.
  4. SEC reporting or audit (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings.
  5. Corporate law or due diligence (securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records.

You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply with your resume and a short profile.
  2. Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward.
  3. Review. We check your experience against what the project needs.
  4. Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue.

Lead USA TODAY’s social media strategy, working with USA TODAY leaders and the broader USA TODAY audience team to assess our portfolio and performance, develop audience journeys and drive innovation. Develop strategies that encompass the entire audience journey, thinking about every action we want a user to take with us. Assist newsroom in troubleshooting social media issues and represent USA TODAY in strategic conversations with industry, influencer and platform partners. Monitor performance, identify growth opportunities, and lead experiments in partnership with content strategy. Translate data points into actionable insights. Ability to independently manage priorities and execute across competing demands. A collaborative spirit, able to lead not only direct reports but peers across the organization and a passion for coaching others. Strong business judgment and the ability to align editorial work with audience and organizational goals.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewThe Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc.
jobs.description:
Overview

The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems.

CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic, with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.

At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work:

CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion, and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture.

Position Overview

CHAI’s Global Operations team has the mandate to maximize operational effectiveness and efficiency across the organization. The Director, Operations reports to the Chief Operating Officer and oversees three distinct functional areas:

  • Internal AI transformation – leading the adoption of AI across the organization, in close partnership with the Innovation team.
  • Strategic operations – process design and optimization, leading cross-functional operational priorities in collaboration with HR, Finance, IT, Legal & Compliance, etc.
  • Operational infrastructure – managing the foundational functions that enable the organization to operate effectively, including safety & security and knowledge management.

These three areas are not separate bets. They are interdependent: AI is no longer optional in any high-performing operations function, process improvements only stick when the underlying infrastructure is reliable, and stable infrastructure is what makes both transformation and continuous improvement possible. CHAI is looking for a leader with the breadth and adaptability to oversee all three areas, and the credibility to move across very different domains while holding clear strategic direction.

This role offers unusual breadth of operational exposure across a complex, fast-moving global health organization, and is well suited to a leader eager to take on expanded organizational leadership responsibility over time.

What Success Looks Like

The following give a concrete sense of the kinds of outcomes we are looking for; they should be viewed as illustrative, and not comprehensive:

  • CHAI is, at its core, radically more efficient due to the following three levers:
    • AI has fundamentally changed how CHAI works. Core business processes have been reengineered to leverage the benefits that AI can provide. Staff are not occasional users – they are confident, capable practitioners who reach for AI instinctively when solving problems. CHAI can now deliver more with the same resources.
    • Cross-functional work is streamlined and moves ahead rapidly, rather than getting stalled between functions. The energy that used to get lost in unwieldy processes or misalignment between functions is now spent moving the mission forward.
    • Routine operational infrastructure has been streamlined so that teams are no longer spending their time re-inventing the wheel on the same processes. Global Ops is considered the go-to team to figure out the most effective and efficient way to accomplish day-to-day general management and operational tasks.
  • The organization’s biggest operational pain points and risks are tackled successfully – from emergent issues that arise on an ad-hoc basis and require significant attention from the Leadership team, to long-standing issues that remain unresolved.

Responsibilities

  • Set the direction for CHAI’s internal AI transformation in partnership with the C-suite and the Innovation team, and provide strategic and management oversight to the manager who delivers it – covering organization-wide rollout coordination, training and enablement, AI governance and policy, pilot coordination, and vendor relationship management.
  • Lead and facilitate cross-functional operational initiatives across CHAI’s global and country teams, including complex priorities that cut across departmental lines.
  • Identify and drive process improvements across CHAI’s internal operations, designing better ways of working and ensuring changes are implemented durably.
  • Provide executive oversight of CHAI’s global safety and security function, led day-to-day by an Associate Director, Safety & Security; serve as the senior organizational escalation point for significant incidents.
  • Build and oversee an effective, right-sized knowledge management system for CHAI that is aligned with the organization’s AI transformation goals.
  • Lead a Global Operations team of six FTEs – providing direction, coaching, and meaningful investment in each team lead’s development.
  • Serve as PMO for high-priority cross-functional initiatives at the request of CHAI Leadership.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent and at least 12 years of relevant professional experience, including demonstrated success in a leadership role with direct management of teams and cross-functional accountability.
  • Strong operational generalist background with the credibility and range to oversee functions where you are not the deepest subject-matter expert.
  • Genuine working knowledge of AI tools, their capabilities, and limitations, and how they can be applied to transform enterprise workflows; deep technical expertise on AI is not required, but the ability to lead CHAI’s internal AI adoption agenda credibly and engage substantively on AI strategy is.
  • Demonstrated experience leading change management or organizational transformation initiatives, including shifting staff behaviour and building new ways of working across a distributed workforce.
  • Prior experience navigating ambiguity and providing organizational direction in decentralized environments with limited formal structure.
  • Proven ability to build and manage high-performing teams, with experience in coaching and developing staff at the mid-manager level.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, up to 30% annually.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience improving how work gets done across an organization – whether through process redesign, restructuring teams, building new operating models, or leading operational change initiatives.
  • Experience working closely with C-suite leaders to make data-driven recommendations and drive successful execution on leadership priorities.
  • Experience in fast-paced and high-rigour sectors, such as management consulting or tech.
  • Experience in global health, international development, or a comparable mission-driven sector.
  • Exposure to safety, security, or risk management functions in an international operating context.
  • Experience managing geographically dispersed teams across multiple countries, time zones, and cultural contexts.

We’re looking for a Director of Revenue Operations (RevOps) to own the commercial operating system across the group's portfolio brands of Cookie Information, Piwik PRO and Sheltr. You will lead the commercial operating plan, the shared CRM and data, attribution, forecasting, and the objective arbitration of capacity across commercial teams. This role reports to the CCO.

The Director of RevOps is the key connective role between leadership and the commercial team leads, translating strategy into an operating plan they run with, and turning their execution data into insight leadership can act on to drive predictable, efficient and sustainable revenue growth.

We are open to on-site, hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET).

In this role, please expect to travel up to 40% of the time.

About Us

Our group brings together three European software brands that help organisations earn and use data with trust: Cookie Information for consent management; Piwik PRO for privacy-by-design analytics and data activation; and Sheltr for reliably finding personal data in internal data sources.

Headquartered in Copenhagen with an office in Wrocław, our team of 180 people have been building trusted data solutions since 2011. We work with companies and marketing teams across various industries that take control of their data model, including some of the most data-sensitive clients in healthcare, finance, energy & utilities, and the public sector. We are proud that our clients rely on us to meet GDPR and EU data residency requirements across EMEA and the US, as this regulatory depth is hard to build and replicate. We believe compliance and performance are not opposites. Consented data, auditable analytics and full visibility of personal data belong to one data journey; together they form a foundation that marketing, IT, legal and the C-level can rely on.

Our journey is to move from a regulation-driven house of brands to one unified company with a clear point of view. We are creating a new category around this complete data journey, and together we are building an enterprise-ready, data-driven revenue engine led by thought leadership. Want to join us on this journey? Keep reading to find out how you can help shape this with us.

The Role

As Director of RevOps, you will own the commercial revenue engine across all three brands, ensuring alignment between strategy, processes, technology and performance. You will build and lead a multidisciplinary team and act as a strategic partner to commercial leadership, driving operational excellence and turning insights into business outcomes.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the commercial operating plan, revenue forecasting and pipeline performance across the portfolio, translating business objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.

  • Leading BI, marketing automation, customer and partner enablement, and product marketing. Partner with Product on feature prioritisation, pricing and packaging to strengthen go-to-market effectiveness.

About you

You are an experienced B2B SaaS RevOps leader who understands how to build a scalable, data-driven revenue engine. You combine strong commercial and financial acumen with analytical rigour and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance.
You thrive in complex environments where you can bring structure, align competing priorities and turn data into better commercial decisions.

You bring:

  • Significant experience leading Revenue Operations or owning the Sales and Marketing revenue engine in a B2B SaaS business.
  • Strong commercial and financial understanding, including ARR, NRR, churn, CAC, customer lifetime value and payback.
  • Deep expertise in pipeline management, funnel design, forecasting, attribution and performance optimisation.
  • Advanced HubSpot expertise, including architecture, governance and process design.
  • Experience with BI, marketing automation, AI and revenue technology.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary, hybrid-working teams and driving change across functions without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Strong executive communication skills and the ability to influence C-level decision-making.
  • Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience managing multi-brand or multi-product go-to-market operations on shared infrastructure.
  • Experience with partner and channel models or account-based marketing.
  • Familiarity with forecasting, conversation intelligence and advanced BI tools.
  • Background in privacy, MarTech or analytics.
  • Experience in a scale-up or PE- or VC-backed business.
  • Fluency in German, French or a Nordic language.

What we offer

  • Real ownership: Lead the commercial operating model across a three-brand portfolio.
  • You’ll work closely with the CCO, CEO and commercial leadership to shape business priorities and decisions.
  • You get to build shared systems, processes and insights that enable more effective and scalable commercial execution.
  • A chance to make an impact: Strengthen how three growing SaaS brands plan, execute and scale their commercial growth through better data, processes and insights.
  • Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.
  • A positive, informal workplace.

Application process

We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today.

This is what our recruitment process looks like:

  • A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)
  • An in-depth interview with the hiring manager and a member of the team
  • Interview with a key stakeholder including a live case
  • A final interview with our CCO

This process is subject to change. All applicants who progress to the screening call will be informed of the full process as some stages may be combined and/or in person.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.

The CX Intelligence Analyst transforms customer feedback, operational data, and business information into actionable insights that improve customer experience and support business decision-making. jobs.title: Marketing & Brand Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Who Are We? JayWay Travel is approaching its 20th anniversary and has grown into an international travel company with a team of 100+ people across more than 20 countries.
jobs.description:
Who Are We?

JayWay Travel is approaching its 20th anniversary and has grown into an international travel company with a team of 100+ people across more than 20 countries.

We create personalized travel experiences across Europe, Latin America, and other destinations, helping travelers turn their ideas into memorable journeys.

Our team brings together travel enthusiasts, marketers, sales professionals, planners, and problem-solvers — all working toward creating great experiences for our guests.

Are You a Marketing Professional Who Likes to Get Things Done?

We’re looking for an experienced marketing professional who understands brands, enjoys working with people, and is comfortable taking an idea and figuring out how to make it happen.

This is a broad, cross-functional role covering areas such as brand, guest experience, partnerships, and marketing operations. You’ll work closely with the Head of Department and with teams across JayWay to keep projects moving, spot opportunities, and make sure the way we present and deliver JayWay feels consistent.

No two days will necessarily look the same — and that’s part of the appeal.

And don’t worry if you don’t tick every box or have experience in every area listed. We’re interested in how you think, how you approach challenges, and how you turn ideas into action.

What Will You Do?

  • Help manage the JayWay brand across our marketing and guest-facing communications, keeping our voice, messaging, and visual identity consistent.
  • Look at the guest experience across different touchpoints, using feedback, reviews, and other insights to identify what’s working and where we can improve.
  • Research and help develop new partnerships and commercial opportunities that could add value for our guests and our business.
  • Coordinate projects involving internal teams, agencies, freelancers, designers, creators, and other external partners.
  • Keep marketing projects organized, including timelines, budgets, vendors, tools, and documentation.
  • Maintain and improve brand guidelines, templates, processes, and other resources used by the wider team.
  • Keep an eye on industry trends, guest expectations, competitors, and new opportunities, and bring useful ideas to the Head of Department.
  • Help make sure projects are delivered on time, to a high standard, and in a way that feels right for JayWay.

What Makes You a Great Fit?

You’ve already spent a few years working in marketing or a related field and are comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.

We’d expect you to have:

  • 3+ years of experience in brand management, integrated marketing, communications, guest/customer experience, partnerships, business development, marketing operations, or a related area.
  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to work with people across different teams and levels of the organization.
  • Good commercial instincts and an understanding of what makes something valuable for both the customer and the business.
  • Excellent organization and attention to detail — especially when several projects are happening at once.
  • The ability to work with both creative ideas and practical details, from a campaign concept to a budget, deadline, vendor, or approval.
  • An analytical mindset and the ability to turn feedback, data, and research into useful recommendations.
  • A proactive approach. If you see something that could be better, you’re the kind of person who will raise it and help find a solution.

Experience in travel, hospitality, tourism, luxury, lifestyle, destination marketing, or another high-touch service business is a plus, but it’s not essential.

Tools & Platforms

You should be comfortable learning and working with a range of tools. Experience with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Milanote, WordPress, ClickUp, Muck Rack, or similar marketing and project-management platforms is a plus.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

  • Competitive pay & performance bonuses that recognize your impact.
  • Remote-first flexibility, with the opportunity to collaborate across 20+ countries.
  • Annual all-company gatherings in breathtaking European locations.
  • Full support with work-from-home setup and equipment.
  • Wellness programs and travel insurance.
  • Covered travel expenses for business-related trips.

Our Hiring Process

We believe in human-led recruitment — no AI filters. Here’s what you can expect:

  1. Short one-way video questionnaire to learn more about your background.
  2. Initial video interview with our HR team.
  3. Job-related task to see how you approach the work.
  4. Interview with our executive marketing team.

We’ll review your application personally and aim to keep the process straightforward and respectful of your time.

Ready to Join Us?

If you have solid marketing experience, enjoy working across different areas, and like being the person who spots an opportunity and figures out what to do with it, we’d love to hear from you.

You don’t need to have done everything listed above.

What matters is that you’re curious, capable, organized, commercially aware, and comfortable taking ownership.

Think this sounds like you? Apply now.

Please submit your CV in English to get started.

We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

👉 Explore JayWay’s story

JayWay Travel Inc. is committed to ensuring equal opportunities, with recruitment and selection decisions based solely on qualifications and merit, without regard to protected characteristics.

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

  • Professional Experience: 3+ years in a business role or as a Product Owner/Product Manager, with a track record of leading product development, prioritizing work, and delivering outcomes aligned to business strategy;4+ years as an expert contributor on a systems team with deep knowledge of internal/external-facing UI technology and related backend systems that support insurance activities (e.g., enrollment, premium payment, and enrollee/member data management).

  • Agile Product Ownership Expertise: Ability to serve as a Product Owner for one or more Agile Release Train cars, with a conceptual understanding of the SAFe framework and its roles, processes, and collaboration methods.

  • Industry and Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with the insurance industry, operational business processes, and a broad understanding of technology domains, including cloud, client-server, SaaS, and Enterprise Architecture.

  • Leadership and Communication Skills: Strong leadership, collaboration, and negotiation abilities to build relationships with stakeholders, guide teams, and resolve conflicts effectively.

  • Analytical and Organizational Proficiency: Excellent time management, prioritization, and data-driven decision-making skills, coupled with the ability to independently manage complex, multi-year initiatives.

PREFERRED:

  • Proven ability to analyze and map complex data flows across systems, with a focus on external/internal facing User Interface (UI) and relationships to backend systems.

  • Strong understanding of Group Insurance concepts around member enrollment life cycles, member management, premium and billing.

En Grupo Clave, colaboramos con una compañía tecnológica especializada en el desarrollo de soluciones de inteligencia artificial de nueva generación en la búsqueda de un/a Staff Software Engineer.

Buscamos un perfil senior con una sólida capacidad de arquitectura y visión tecnológica, capaz de participar en la construcción de una plataforma innovadora orientada a entornos enterprise, trabajando sobre casos de uso reales y proyectos de alto impacto.

Tu misión

Serás una de las figuras técnicas clave en el diseño, evolución y escalabilidad de una plataforma tecnológica avanzada, participando desde las decisiones de arquitectura hasta la implementación de soluciones en producción.

Trabajarás en un entorno donde convergen inteligencia artificial, sistemas distribuidos, infraestructura cloud, gestión del conocimiento y arquitecturas orientadas a eventos.

Principales responsabilidades

  • Diseñar y desarrollar soluciones escalables para entornos empresariales complejos.

  • Participar en decisiones de arquitectura y evolución tecnológica del producto.

  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas de alto impacto.

  • Contribuir al desarrollo de plataformas basadas en inteligencia artificial y automatización avanzada.

  • Colaborar en la definición de estándares técnicos, buenas prácticas y procesos de ingeniería.

  • Participar activamente en el desarrollo, revisión y despliegue de código.

Qué buscamos

  • Experiencia consolidada en posiciones Senior, Staff o Principal Engineer.

  • Trayectoria en el diseño y construcción de sistemas complejos en producción.

  • Capacidad para combinar visión estratégica y ejecución técnica.

  • Experiencia tomando decisiones de arquitectura y liderazgo técnico.

  • Conocimiento de ecosistemas backend modernos, infraestructuras distribuidas y soluciones escalables.

  • Interés por tecnologías relacionadas con inteligencia artificial, automatización avanzada y plataformas de datos.

Valoraremos especialmente

  • Experiencia en plataformas B2B.

  • Desarrollo de sistemas intensivos en datos.

  • Arquitecturas basadas en eventos.

  • Infraestructura y plataformas de IA.

  • Sistemas de conocimiento, grafos u ontologías.

  • Integraciones enterprise.

  • Diseño de workflows complejos y motores de orquestación.

Qué ofrece el proyecto

  • Modalidad 100% remota.

  • Viajes puntuales durante el año para encuentros de equipo y eventos tecnológicos.

  • Seguro médico privado.

  • Participación en un producto tecnológico propio en plena evolución.

  • Acceso a herramientas de IA e infraestructura avanzada para investigación y desarrollo.

  • Asistencia a eventos y congresos tecnológicos de referencia.

  • Entorno altamente técnico, colaborativo y orientado a la innovación.

  • Posibilidad de influir directamente en las decisiones de producto y arquitectura desde fases tempranas.

  • Proyecto estable con recorrido y capacidad real de crecimiento profesional.

  • Banda salarial orientativa entre 35.000 € y 55.000 € brutos anuales, valorándose especialmente la experiencia y conocimientos aportados.

Si buscas un proyecto donde participar en la construcción de tecnología con impacto, asumir retos de arquitectura y formar parte de un equipo altamente especializado, estaremos encantados de conocerte.

jobs.excerpt: 사람들의 삶의 질을 향상시키고자 하는 열정을 기반으로, WSA 는 보청기 업계의 선도 기업으로 성장하고 있습니다.
jobs.description:
사람들의 삶의 질을 향상시키고자 하는 열정을 기반으로, WSA 는 보청기 업계의 선도 기업으로 성장하고 있습니다. 난청인들이 소리를 통해 윤택한 삶을 영위하도록 비즈니스 혁신을 가속화하며 시장을 확대하여 더 많은 사람들에게 더 효과적으로 다가가고자 합니다.

담당 업무

  • 보청기(시그니아/와이덱스) 제품 및 피팅 관련 교육 프로그램 기획 및 운영

  • 내부(Sales/CS/MKT) 및 외부(보청기 센터, 병원 등) 대상 제품 교육 및 실습 진행

  • 신제품 출시 관련 교육 기획 및 실행

  • 교육 콘텐츠(PPT, 매뉴얼 가이드 자료 등) 개발 및 유지관리

  • APAC/Global 교육자료 Localization 및 국내 시장에 맞는 콘텐츠 개발

  • 제품 기능, 피팅, Troubleshooting 등 Technical Support 제공

근무 조건

자격 요건

  • 청각학(Audiology) 학사 이상

  • 보청기 업계 또는 의료기기 교육 경험

  • 교육 및 프레젠테이션 역량

  • 교육 콘텐츠 제작 경험 (PPT, 영상 자료 등)

  • 원활한 커뮤니케이션 및 협업 능력

  • 영어 문서 이해 및 이메일 커뮤니케이션 가능

  • 국내외 외근 및 출장에 결격사유가 없는 자

우대 사항

  • 청능사 자격 보유

  • AI를 활용한 콘텐츠 제작 및 업무 효율화 역량

  • 신제품 Launch Project 경험

  • 영어 회화 가능자

기업소개

WSA 는 보청기 업계에서 가장 저명하고 혁신적인 브랜드들이 모여 Sivantos와 Widex의 합병을 통해 2019년에 설립되었습니다.

WSA 는 난청인들이 소리를 통해 윤택한 삶을 영위하도록 돕는 기술을 개척하는 데 140여 년간의 경험을 통합하여 난청으로 고통 받는 모든 사람들에게 청력의 기적을 돌려주고 성장할 수 있도록 돕고 있습니다.

이러한 과정은 매우 보람 있는 일이며 우리가 하는 모든 일의 원동력입니다. 우리의 목표는 모든 사람들의 삶에서 멋진 사운드를 만들어 잠재력을 이끌어내는 것입니다.

WSA 는 오늘날 전 세계 사람들이 착용하는 보청기 3개 중 1개를 제조하고 있으며, 130개 이상의 시장에서 활동하며 전 세계적으로 12,000명의 직원을 고용하고 있습니다.

jobs.title: Appeals and Grievances Clinical Specialist III
jobs.excerpt: Medica is a nonprofit health plan with more than a million members that serves communities in Minnesota, Nebraska, Wisconsin, Missouri, and beyond.
jobs.description:
Medica is a nonprofit health plan with more than a million members that serves communities in Minnesota, Nebraska, Wisconsin, Missouri, and beyond. We deliver personalized health care experiences and partner closely with providers to ensure members are genuinely cared for.

We're a team that owns our work with accountability, makes data-driven decisions, embraces continuous learning, and celebrates collaboration — because success is a team sport. It's our mission to be there in the moments that matter most for our members and employees. Join us in creating a community of connected care, where coordinated, quality service is the norm and every member feels valued.

The Appeals and Grievances Clinical Specialist III position is responsible for the review, investigation, and resolution of member and provider appeals and grievances requiring clinical expertise. This role ensures compliance with regulatory requirements, accreditation standards, and organizational policies while promoting quality outcomes, member satisfaction, and STARs performance. The specialist works collaboratively with medical directors, clinical staff, and operational teams to support timely and accurate determinations and oversee clinician-to-clinician (C2C) challenge activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct clinical review of member and provider appeals, including pre-service, concurrent, and post-service cases.
  • Evaluate medical necessity, appropriateness of care, and benefit coverage using clinical guidelines and evidence-based criteria.
  • Investigate grievances by reviewing medical records, claims, and related documentation to determine root cause and resolution.
  • Prepare clear, concise, and compliant determination letters that meet regulatory and accreditation standards (e.g., CMS, NCQA).
  • Collaborate with Medical Directors for cases requiring physician review and support case presentations as needed.
  • Oversee and support Clinician-to-Clinician (C2C) challenges, including coordination, documentation, and ensuring timely completion in accordance with regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor and assess the impact of appeals and grievances on STARs measures, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities for performance improvement.
  • Partner with quality and operations teams to address trends that may negatively impact STARs ratings and member experience.
  • Ensure all appeals and C2C activities are processed within required turnaround times.
  • Identify trends, quality concerns, and potential process improvement opportunities through case analysis.
  • Maintain accurate and complete documentation in case management systems.
  • Serve as a clinical resource for non-clinical staff regarding appeals, grievance processes, and clinical escalation pathways.
  • Participate in audits, regulatory reporting, and quality improvement initiatives as required.

Education & Experience

  • Active, unrestricted RN license required
  • 5+ years of clinical experience
  • Prior experience in Appeals & Grievances, Utilization Management, or Managed Care strongly preferred.
  • Experience with C2C processes, regulatory turnaround requirements, and STARs metrics preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of medical terminology, clinical guidelines, and healthcare delivery systems.
  • Understanding of regulatory requirements (CMS, Medicare/Medicaid, commercial guidelines, NCQA standards).
  • Familiarity with STARs measures and how clinical decisions impact quality performance outcomes.
  • Excellent critical thinking and clinical decision-making skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate clinical information into member-friendly language.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
  • Proficiency in case management systems and Microsoft Office applications.

This position is a Remote role. To be eligible for consideration, candidates must have a primary home address located within any state where Medica is registered as an employer - AR, AZ, FL, GA, IA, IL, KS, KY, MI, MN, MO, ND, NE, OK, SD, TN, TX, VA, WI

The full salary grade for this position is $70,200 - $120,400. While the full salary grade is provided, the typical hiring salary range for this role is expected to be between $70,200 - $105,315. Annual salary range placement will depend on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, education, work experience, applicable certifications and/or licensure, the position's scope and responsibility, internal pay equity and external market salary data.  In addition to compensation, Medica offers a generous total rewards package that includes competitive medical, dental, vision, PTO, Holidays, paid volunteer time off, 401K contributions, caregiver services and many other benefits to support our employees.

The compensation and benefits information is provided as of the date of this posting. Medica’s compensation and benefits are subject to change at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

Eligibility to work in the US: Medica does not offer work visa sponsorship for this role. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application. Employment is contingent on verification of identity and eligibility to work in the United States.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer, where all qualified candidates receive consideration for employment indiscriminate of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.excerpt: Corporate Travel Consultant - Virginia TeamFCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.
jobs.description:
Corporate Travel Consultant - Virginia Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 8 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for then APPLY NOW.

Have questions about this opportunity? Reach out to our recruitment team at

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly pay rate of $28.85 plus commission/incentive earnings based on achievable targets. On target earnings average range between $60,000 - $67,000. The annual salary range listed represents the total compensation package, excluding benefits.

For this position, you may earn between 2-29% in marginal commission rates based on qualified sales achieved during each month.

Before applying to any internal position you must have been with the company or your current role for a minimum of 6 - 12 months and notify your leader prior to applying.

Our number one philosophy? Our people. Flight Center Travel Group USA’s promise is to provide an environment with equality of respect, dignity and opportunity for all our employees. We value an inclusive and supportive workplace which truly reflects the diversity of our society.

We are an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer committed to providing a barrier-free pathway throughout our recruitment process. We welcome accommodation requests to help make our hiring and onboarding experience as accessible as possible. About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority, and we need a design leader who consistently turns design into business outcomes. As Lead Product Designer, you set the quality bar for our app, own our design system and drive our biggest product bets from first idea to shipped result. You are hands-on: you prototype, you craft, you ship.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. You will be the design partner who keeps the whole product consistent and high quality, together with our Lead UX Writer and a Senior Product Designer.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical, high-visibility role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Direction & Outcomes

  • Set the design direction and quality bar across the app, from new features to health insights and early vision work.
  • Define the success measures for your work and own the business results.

Design System & Prototyping

  • Own our design system, built to work with AI tools, and keep it consistent through tokens and clear decisions.
  • Show instead of tell, with high-fidelity prototypes and motion built with AI tools and our design system.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Raise the bar for the team. Support, coach and unblock other designers, and give clear feedback.
  • Challenge product and engineering with evidence, persuade stakeholders and make clear, documented decisions.
  • Work daily with product managers and design engineers.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Proven design leadership, with a track record of consistently delivering strong business outcomes.
  • 2 to 3 shipped case studies that demonstrate high impact: the problem, your hypothesis, your decisions, the measured result.
  • Outstanding visual design craft: hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes and videos of your work, ideally built with AI tools such as Claude or Lovable.
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools and experience with AI-ready design systems.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Strong product thinking: you work with data, hypotheses and measurements.
  • Ideally health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • Mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You are already playing with AI tools and you are excited about what they make possible.
  • Builder — You ship, and you can spin up something from nothing.
  • Bias for action — You are autonomous and self-sufficient. You don't wait for a brief and you don't need chasing.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what. You can explain who made each decision and how.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need all requirements, research and data before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

jobs.description:
Position Summary
Prometheus Federal Services (PFS) is a trusted partner of federal health agencies. We are exploring adding a highly experienced Lead Pharmacogenomics to support a high-profile federal precision medicine and pharmacogenomics (PGx) initiative. This role will provide strategic leadership, clinical implementation expertise, and stakeholder engagement support to facilitate the adoption of pharmacogenomic programs, clinical pathways, and decision-support tools across multiple healthcare sites.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive healthcare project management experience, a strong understanding of clinical operations, and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary stakeholders including physicians, pharmacists, laboratory professionals, and healthcare administrators. This individual will help design scalable implementation strategies, optimize clinical workflows, and support the integration of evidence-based pharmacogenomic practices into patient care. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to nationally significant healthcare transformation efforts while advising federal stakeholders on best practices for clinical implementation, workflow design, and sustainable program adoption.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  • Lead and manage pharmacogenomics (PGx) initiatives across multiple sites and/or virtual environments, ensuring successful implementation and adoption.
  • Oversee the design, development, and implementation of clinical pathways, workflows, and toolkits that incorporate pharmacogenomic best practices.
  • Manage and coordinate multidisciplinary teams, including clinicians, pharmacists, laboratory personnel, and other stakeholders.
  • Support the review and interpretation of pharmacogenomic information, including drug-gene interactions and associated clinical implications.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) to facilitate clinical discussions, gather feedback, and drive consensus on PGx-related initiatives.
  • Contribute to the development and optimization of clinical decision support tools and processes.
  • Evaluate and apply evidence-based pharmacogenomic guidelines and resources, including CPIC, PharmGKB, DPWG, and FDA labeling.
  • Engage internal and external stakeholders to support project goals, implementation activities, and long-term sustainability.
  • Provide strategic recommendations and scalable solutions to advance pharmacogenomics programs and clinical integration efforts.
  • Monitor project milestones, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to ensure timely and successful delivery of objectives.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Master's degree in Public Health Administration, Health Management, Nursing, Health Administration, or a related healthcare field.
  • Demonstrated project management experience within a healthcare environment.
  • Experience implementing new clinical pathways, processes, or workflows involving multidisciplinary stakeholders.
  • Experience managing and leading cross-functional or multi-member teams.
  • Knowledge of pharmacogenomics principles, including drug-gene interactions and their application to clinical care.
  • Familiarity with evidence-based pharmacogenomic guidelines and resources, including CPIC, PharmGKB, DPWG, and FDA labeling.
  • Experience with clinical workflow design, process improvement, or toolkit development.
  • Experience supporting the development or implementation of clinical decision support tools.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to provide strategic guidance and develop scalable, sustainable healthcare solutions.
  • Ability to work in the U.S. indefinitely without sponsorship
  • Ability to obtain a public trust

Location: Fully Remote
Position Type: Independent Contractor
Schedule: Part-time (10 hours per week minimum)

About the Role

Nao Now is looking for enthusiastic and engaging STEM educators to inspire the next generation of young learners.

This is a fully remote, part-time independent contractor position where you'll teach 1-on-1 English lessons to children ages 5–12 using our structured, interactive curriculum. We're looking for teachers who can naturally bring science, technology, engineering, mathematics, and critical thinking into classroom conversations.

If you have a background in STEM and enjoy making complex ideas simple and exciting for children, we'd love to hear from you.

No lesson planning is required. All curriculum and teaching materials are provided, allowing you to focus on delivering energetic, engaging lessons that build students' confidence in speaking English.

Key Responsibilities

  • Teach 25-minute, one-on-one online English lessons to children ages 5–12

  • Deliver engaging lessons using Nao Now's structured curriculum

  • Incorporate age-appropriate STEM concepts and real-world examples into classroom discussions when appropriate

  • Encourage curiosity, critical thinking, and confident English communication

  • Create a fun, supportive, and interactive learning environment

  • Provide thoughtful lesson feedback after each class

  • Maintain a professional, energetic, and encouraging on-camera presence

  • Commit to a consistent weekly teaching schedule

Schedule Requirements

  • Minimum of 10 teaching hours per week

  • Available during peak teaching hours:

    • Monday–Friday

    • 5:30 PM–10:00 PM KST

  • Minimum 3-month commitment

  • Consistent weekly availability required

Compensation

  • Starting at $20 USD per hour

  • Paid per completed 25-minute lesson

  • Compensation based on qualifications, experience, and evaluation performance

  • All curriculum and teaching materials provided

  • No unpaid lesson planning required

  • Training and onboarding are unpaid

Required Qualifications

  • Native English speaker

  • Bachelor's degree or proof of current enrollment in a bachelor's program

  • Academic background in one or more of the following:

    • Biology

    • Chemistry

    • Physics

    • Mathematics

    • Engineering

    • Computer Science

    • Environmental Science

    • Health Sciences

    • STEM/STEAM Education

    • Other related STEM disciplines

  • Experience working with children ages 5–12

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

  • Friendly, engaging, and energetic teaching style

  • Reliable wired internet connection (minimum 60 Mbps)

  • Quiet, professional teaching environment

  • Headset (noise-cancelling preferred)

Preferred Qualifications

We're especially interested in candidates with experience as:

  • Science teacher

  • Mathematics teacher

  • STEM educator

  • Engineer

  • Researcher

  • University teaching assistant

  • Science communicator

  • Robotics instructor

  • Coding instructor

  • Online educator

  • Youth mentor or coach

Previous ESL or English teaching experience is an asset but is not required.

Technical Requirements

  • Wired ethernet connection

  • Stable internet connection (minimum 60 Mbps)

  • Computer less than five years old recommended

  • Professional, distraction-free workspace

Nao Now is an online English education platform serving young learners around the world. Founded by Ivy League graduates, we combine structured curriculum, interactive technology, and engaging instruction to help children become confident English communicators.

Many of our students are naturally curious and enjoy discussing science, technology, engineering, mathematics, and the world around them. We're looking for educators who can spark that curiosity while making English learning engaging, interactive, and fun.

Work spans hybrid, edge, and air-gapped deployments built on the Mirantis K0rdent stack.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior SRE who thinks past dashboards to the contract between a platform and its operators. The right candidate can look at raw telemetry from Kubernetes, bare metal, and NVIDIA infrastructure, decide which signals actually predict user-visible reliability, and turn them into SLIs and SLOs that operators can act on. You are equally comfortable writing the service that exposes those SLIs through an API and reasoning about error budgets, alerting quality, and signal-to-noise. You should be self-directed, able to own reliability definitions end to end, and effectively communicate them across teams.

Responsibilities

  • Define SLIs and SLOs based on the signals available across the platform — Kubernetes, bare-metal hosts, and NVIDIA infrastructure (BMC, InfiniBand, NVLink, UFM).

  • Design and build the API that exposes SLIs and reliability state to Platform Administrators and downstream systems.

  • Establish alerting and error-budget practices that maximize signal and minimize noise.

  • Partner with infrastructure, storage, and networking teams to ensure the right signals are instrumented and collected.

  • Diagnose reliability and performance issues across the observability stack and drive their resolution.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in SRE, platform reliability, or a closely related software/infrastructure role.

  • Strong software engineering skills (e.g., Go or Python) with experience building and operating APIs or services in production.

  • Demonstrated experience defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets for real production systems.

  • Hands-on experience with observability tooling — metrics, logging, and tracing (e.g., Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry, Grafana).

  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes and the signals it and its workloads emit.

  • Strong written and verbal communication with technical audiences.

Preferred

  • Experience instrumenting or monitoring bare-metal and NVIDIA infrastructure (BMC/Redfish, InfiniBand, NVLink, UFM).

  • Experience with the Mirantis K0rdent stack (K0rdent Enterprise, K0rdent AI, KOF) and Cluster API.

  • Familiarity with VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs at scale.

  • Proven experience in sovereign or high-security air-gapped environments.

What does Mirantis offer you?

  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;
  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;
  • Professional development and training;
  • Attend conferences and working groups;
  • Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;
  • Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan.

jobs.title: Telesales Executive - Tamil
jobs.excerpt: About Lokal :In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet.
jobs.description:
About Lokal :

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

    • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
    • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
    • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
    • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs)
    • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
    • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
    • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
    • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.

Role Overview :

We are looking for a driven Telesales Executive (Tamil-speaking) to support Lokal App’s growth by engaging potential users through outbound calls and converting leads into customers. This role involves understanding user needs, pitching relevant solutions, managing the sales funnel end-to-end, and consistently achieving monthly sales targets.

You’ll work closely with the marketing team to capitalize on campaigns, maintain accurate CRM records, and provide on-ground customer insights that influence future strategies. This is an ownership-heavy role suited for someone who enjoys targets, conversations, and real impact.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct outbound calls to prospective clients and effectively promote Lokal App's services.
  • Engage with users to identify their needs and create tailored solutions that fit their requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records of calls, interactions, and leads in the CRM system.
  • Follow up on leads and manage the sales process from initial contact through to closing.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to leverage campaigns and enhance sales efforts.
  • Provide feedback on customer interactions and market trends to help shape future strategies.
  • Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to the overall growth of Lokal App.

Requirements

  • Fluency in Tamil and a good command of English.
  • Previous experience in tele sales or sales roles is preferred.
  • Excellent verbal communication and persuasive skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with CRM software, Excel and sales tracking tools is a plus.
  • Motivated and goal-oriented individual with a passion for sales.
  • Experience required: 1 Year (Minimum).

Why Join Us?

We’re scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and access. At Lokal, you’ll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts.

jobs.title: Senior IT Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?
jobs.description:
Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?

Welcome! Super excited you dropped by 🥳

At the end of this journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to raise cyber resilience, so that every organization can stay ahead of tomorrow’s threats.🚀🔒💻

✨The core mission of the Senior IT Platform engineer:

As an Internal Platform Engineer, you will own and evolve the internal tooling and enterprise platforms that keep a 300+ person, globally distributed company running securely and productively. This is not a helpdesk role — you'll be the engineering backbone behind identity & access management, corporate email and collaboration, device management, SaaS orchestration and our centralised AI/LLM gateway. You'll ensure that every team at HTB has the right tools, properly integrated, secured and automated.

Engineer, integrate and operate HTB's internal platform stack — from identity (Okta) and email (Google Workspace) through endpoint management (Jamf/Intune) and security tooling (SIEM, EDR) to our centralised LLM gateway — so that the company scales securely without friction.

🏢 Location & Work Mode:

  • Europe/Greece
  • Choose between fully remote work across Europe or relocating to our Athens Tech Hub with relocation support.

Fully Remote / Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 days remote, plus one month of work from anywhere) - If only in Greece: When hiring in Greece, we’re open to candidates from all locations. Those based within 55 km of our Athens office will follow a hybrid work model. For candidates located beyond that radius, a fully remote arrangement is available.

✈️ Relocation

  • We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your move.
  • In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction on your income as part of the relocation.
  • We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks

⚔️ Tools & weapons you’ll be using:

Identity & Access: Okta (SSO, SCIM, Lifecycle Management, Okta Workflows), Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Admin Console)

Endpoint & Device Management: Jamf Pro (macOS/iOS), Microsoft Intune (Windows), Kolide / osquery

Security & Compliance: CrowdStrike Falcon (EDR), Elastic SIEM / Splunk, Vanta or Drata (compliance automation), HashiCorp Vault (secrets management)

AI / LLM Gateway: LiteLLM or Portkey (centralised LLM routing, cost controls, audit logging), API key management

Collaboration & Productivity: Slack, Atlassian (Jira, Confluence), Notion, GitHub (org-level administration)

Automation & Integration: Okta Workflows, Tines / Workato (SOAR / workflow automation), Terraform, Python scripting

Observability: Datadog or Grafana Cloud (SaaS monitoring), PagerDuty (on-call & incident management)

🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming Senior IT Platform Engineer at Hack The Box:

  • Administer and engineer Okta as the central identity provider: SSO integrations, SCIM provisioning/de-provisioning, MFA policies, Okta Workflows for lifecycle automation (onboarding, offboarding, role changes)
  • Own Google Workspace administration: domain management, email routing and security policies (DKIM/DMARC/SPF), shared drives governance, DLP rules and Google Vault for eDiscovery/retention
  • Deploy and operate a centralised LLM gateway (e.g. LiteLLM, Portkey) to give teams governed access to AI models with usage tracking, cost controls, rate limiting and audit logging
  • Manage endpoint fleets via Jamf Pro (macOS/iOS) and Intune (Windows): OS patching, app deployment, compliance baselines, disk encryption enforcement
  • Integrate and maintain EDR (CrowdStrike Falcon or equivalent) and SIEM (Elastic/Splunk) for corporate endpoint and SaaS log visibility
  • Operate and improve compliance automation tooling (Vanta/Drata) to maintain continuous SOC 2, ISO 27001 and similar audit readiness
  • Manage secrets and credential distribution using HashiCorp Vault (or similar), ensuring zero-trust access patterns for service accounts and CI/CD pipelines
  • Administer SaaS platforms at the org level: Slack (Enterprise Grid), Atlassian suite, Notion, GitHub (org/team/repo policies, SAML, audit logs)
  • Build workflow automations (Tines, Workato or Okta Workflows) for repetitive IT and security operations: access requests, alert triage, onboarding checklists
  • Maintain documentation, runbooks and internal knowledge-base articles so that common procedures are self-service where possible
  • Participate in on-call rotation for identity, email and critical SaaS platform incidents

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Senior IT Platform Engineer at Hack The Box:

  • 3–7 years of professional experience in IT engineering, internal platform engineering or infrastructure with a strong focus on enterprise SaaS and identity systems
  • Deep hands-on experience with Okta (or a comparable enterprise IdP: Azure AD/Entra ID, OneLogin) including SSO, SCIM provisioning and MFA policy management
  • Strong Google Workspace administration skills (domain management, email security, DLP, Vault, Admin SDK)
  • Experience managing macOS and/or Windows fleets at scale using MDM tools (Jamf, Intune, Kandji or similar)
  • Familiarity with at least one SIEM platform (Elastic, Splunk, Datadog Security) and one EDR solution (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Carbon Black)
  • Comfortable writing automation scripts (Python, Bash) and working with APIs to integrate SaaS tools
  • Solid understanding of network and application security fundamentals: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, SAML, SCIM, DKIM/DMARC/SPF, TLS, zero-trust principles
  • Ability to translate security and compliance requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27001) into practical engineering controls
  • Strong written communication for documentation, runbooks and cross-team collaboration in a remote-first environment
  • Being cyber security-minded is a strong plus — at HTB, this isn't an afterthought, it's the business

Bonus Points:

  • Experience deploying and operating a centralised LLM/AI gateway (LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway or equivalent) with cost and access controls
  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager or similar secrets management platforms
  • Familiarity with compliance automation platforms (Vanta, Drata, Secureframe)
  • Experience with SOAR / workflow automation tools (Tines, Workato, Torq)
  • Understanding of Golang for building internal tooling
  • Okta Certified Professional or Administrator, Google Workspace Administrator certification, or equivalent
  • Experience scaling internal platforms through a period of rapid company growth (100 → 500+ employees)

🕹️ What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:

  • 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.
  • 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
  • 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, levelling up as our organisation grows.
  • 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

💰 The gems you’ll be enjoying as Senior IT Platform Engineer:

  • 25 annual leave days
  • Paid parental leave
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
  • State-of-the-art equipment
  • Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉
  • Flexibility in working hours

Our benefits package is designed to provide strong support to our team, but it may vary depending on location and type of employment (e.g., UK, US, Greece, Australia, or engagement through an Employer of Record or contract).

🗺️ The Quest of Becoming Hack The Box’s Senior IT Platform Engineer:

  • Level 1: To complete level one’s objective, submit your application.
  • Level 2: Meet the Talent Acquisition team. Level’s objective: highlight your past achievements, ambitions, and values.
  • Level 3: Meet the hiring team. Level’s objective: have a technical conversation that aligns with day-to-day job-related tasks and responsibilities.
  • Level 4: Level's objective: connect with the hiring team and share with them your achievements.
  • Level 5: Congratulations! Not many reach this level 💪. Level’s objective: have a constructive, final conversation with senior leadership to explore the role and your future at HTB.
  • Level 6: You've officially received an offer from HTB! To complete the last level and the Quest, all you need to do is accept the offer.
  • Quest complete. Congratulations, you’re officially one of us 🥳🎉🎇Your next quest: complete the onboarding.

jobs.title: Remote Physician Pro Fee Coding Specialist-Cardiology
jobs.excerpt: Job Summary The Remote Physician Pro Fee Coder-Cardiology is responsible for reviewing, analyzing, and assigning accurate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes for professional fee services documented in the medical record.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Remote Physician Pro Fee Coder-Cardiology is responsible for reviewing, analyzing, and assigning accurate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes for professional fee services documented in the medical record. This role ensures proper sequencing, modifier use, and place-of-service coding in compliance with governmental regulations, third-party payer policies, and corporate standards. The Physician Coder plays a key role in revenue cycle accuracy by identifying documentation gaps, ensuring coding integrity, and working collaboratively with internal teams to support physician coding compliance and reimbursement.

Essential Functions

  • Assigns accurate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes for professional services, procedures, diagnoses, and treatments based on provider documentation.
  • Ensures compliance with governmental regulations, third-party payer policies, and corporate coding protocols, following National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) edits, Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), and National Coverage Determinations (NCDs).
  • Performs coding audits and quality reviews, verifying accuracy of documentation and identifying areas for provider education.
  • Works coding-related claim edits, holds, and scrubs in the electronic billing system (e.g., Athena Collector), ensuring timely claim resolution and reimbursement.
  • Collaborates with physicians, revenue cycle teams, and coding education staff, requesting clarification when necessary to ensure optimal documentation and compliance.
  • Performs edit checks on coded data before transmittal, identifying and correcting errors as needed.
  • Maintains strict confidentiality of patient records, provider information, and financial data, adhering to HIPAA and corporate compliance policies.
  • Escalates documentation or coding issues to the coding education team for provider training and improved documentation practices.
  • Assists in coding-related special projects, ensuring accurate reporting and analysis of coding data for operational improvement.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • H.S. Diploma or GED required
  • Associate Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred
  • 2-4 years of experience in physician coding, professional fee coding, or medical billing required
  • Experience with multiple specialties, surgical coding, or high-volume professional fee coding preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems for physician/professional fee services.
  • Understanding of modifier usage, place-of-service coding, and payer billing guidelines.
