Cette offre d’emploi est disponible en anglais et en français (Canada). Veuillez faire défiler pour la version française.

Remote - U.S. & Canada Only | Full-Time

Compensation:

  • $65K–$95K USD (U.S.-based candidates)
  • $80K–$115K CAD (Canada-based candidates)

Description

We’re not looking for someone to “manage campaigns.”

We’re looking for someone to own performance.

Level Agency is hiring a hands-on, performance-obsessed Paid Media Manager to drive measurable impact across key accounts.

You’ll be deep in-platform—building, optimizing, testing, and improving campaigns every day. This is not a coordination role. This is for someone who takes pride in execution and feels accountable for results.

If “good enough” has never felt good enough to you, you’ll fit right in.

This Isn’t for Everyone.

We’re building something rare: a place where performance, accountability, and growth all show up—every day.

You’ll thrive here if:

✅ You enjoy being in-platform and owning campaign execution end-to-end
✅ You think in outcomes (pipeline, revenue, efficiency)—not just clicks
✅ You constantly test, iterate, and push performance forward
✅ You take initiative and solve problems without waiting
✅ You care deeply about the quality and impact of your work

And you’ll struggle here if:

❌ You prefer high-level strategy over hands-on execution
❌ You wait for direction instead of taking ownership
❌ You’re comfortable with “good enough” performance
❌ You avoid digging into data or troubleshooting issues
❌ You see campaign management as a checklist—not a craft

About Level

Good enough isn’t.

Level Agency is an AI-powered performance marketing agency built for brands ready to shatter yesterday’s wins.

We help complex, high-consideration brands outperform their last result using AI, data science, creativity, and relentless iteration.

We specialize in markets where the stakes are high and the journeys are complex — education, B2B technology, financial services, healthcare, CPG, ecommerce, and more. Our work spans the full performance ecosystem: media planning & buying, performance creative, SEO & AI search, CRM & automation, and advanced analytics.

In 2025, Level acquired BAM Strategy — expanding our capabilities into digital experience, CRM strategy, personalization, and loyalty. The result is a fully integrated growth engine that connects acquisition to retention, media to lifecycle, and performance to long-term customer value.

Today, our 250-person team operates fully remote across North America, supporting 150+ ambitious brands.

Your Role (and Impact)

As a Paid Media Manager, you’ll serve as the day-to-day performance owner across key accounts—driving execution, optimization, and results.

You will:

Own Campaign Execution & Performance

  • Build, launch, and manage campaigns across platforms including Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, DV360, and more
  • Continuously optimize campaigns—bidding, budgets, audiences, creative, and structure
  • Manage pacing and performance against business-critical KPIs (MQLs, revenue, pipeline)
  • Ensure campaigns are not just running—but improving

Drive Performance & Insights

  • Analyze campaign performance to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities
  • Translate data into immediate, actionable optimizations
  • Push beyond benchmarks—never settling for baseline results
  • Partner with analytics teams to deepen insights and improve attribution

Lead Through Execution

  • Guide and support Media Analysts in campaign management and troubleshooting
  • Provide hands-on mentorship that improves execution quality
  • Serve as a go-to problem solver for campaign performance challenges

Own Reporting & Narrative

  • Build dashboards and performance visualizations (Looker, Tableau, PowerBI)
  • Translate results into clear, compelling narratives for clients
  • Turn insights into recommendations and next steps

Collaborate Across Teams

  • Partner with strategy, creative, and analytics teams to align on goals
  • Actively contribute to client conversations and performance planning
  • Ensure paid media efforts are fully aligned with broader business objectives

Requirements

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of hands-on paid media experience managing paid search and paid social campaigns
  • Strong platform expertise across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn (additional platforms a plus)
  • Proven ability to drive outcomes beyond leads (MQLs, revenue, efficiency)
  • Experience with Google Analytics (UA & GA4) and Google Tag Manager
  • Strong data fluency and ability to translate insights into action
  • Experience building reports and dashboards (Looker, Tableau, PowerBI)
  • A mindset that values execution, iteration, and continuous improvement

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in EDU, B2B, or financial services verticals
  • Familiarity with programmatic platforms (DV360, Trade Desk, OTT)
  • Experience with media automation, attribution, or AI-driven optimization
  • Experience mentoring or guiding junior team members

AI Expectations

At Level, AI is a core skill — not an afterthought.

In this role, you will:

  • Constantly experiment with tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and platform-native AI capabilities
  • Use AI to accelerate campaign analysis, optimization, and insight generation
  • Improve efficiency and effectiveness in how campaigns are built and managed
  • Document and share prompts, workflows, and learnings with your team
  • Treat AI as a force multiplier, not a shortcut

Our Core Values

  • No Ego, All In
    We win together — boosting others, owning outcomes, and never hiding behind hierarchy.
  • Better Every Day
    Feedback fuels us — especially when it stings.
  • Relentless for Results
    Activity without impact isn’t work — it’s noise.
  • Driven by Truth
    We make decisions based on data, not assumptions.

Benefits

Perks & Benefits

At Level, we support our people across the U.S. and Canada with benefits designed to promote flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth.

  • Fully remote across the U.S. & Canada, plus monthly WFH stipend and Summer Fridays
  • Generous time off, including unlimited PTO (U.S.), competitive vacation (Canada), and parental/family leave options
  • Comprehensive health benefits, mental health support, and company-paid disability & life coverage
  • Employer retirement contributions (401(k) in the U.S., RRSP match in Canada)
  • Quarterly performance reviews and career advancement opportunities

Remote First

This role is open to U.S. and Canada residents.

We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.

Level Is Built on Inclusion

We are committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB).

Level is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer — we celebrate what makes you, you.

Ready to Apply?

Click below to submit your resume. You’ll also answer a few thoughtful questions — take your time.

We care more about how you think than where you’ve worked.

Let’s build something together.

Gestionnaire, Médias Payants

Nous cherchons quelqu’un pour livrer de la performance.

À propos de Level

Le « assez bon », ce n’est pas suffisant.

Level Agency est une agence de marketing de performance propulsée par l’IA, conçue pour dépasser les résultats d’hier.

Nous aidons des marques complexes, à cycles longs, à surpasser leurs performances grâce à l’IA, à la data science, à la créativité et à une culture d’itération constante.

Nous évoluons dans des secteurs où les enjeux sont élevés — éducation, technologie B2B, services financiers, santé, CPG, ecommerce, et plus encore. Aujourd’hui, notre équipe de 250+ personnes travaille entièrement à distance à travers l’Amérique du Nord et soutient plus de 150 marques ambitieuses.

Votre rôle (et votre impact)

En tant que Gestionnaire, Médias Payants, vous serez responsable de la performance quotidienne des campagnes sur des comptes clés — en pilotant l’exécution, l’optimisation et les résultats.

Vous allez :

Exécution & performance

  • Construire, lancer et gérer des campagnes sur Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, DV360 et plus

Performance & insights

  • Analyser les performances pour identifier tendances, inefficacités et opportunités
  • Transformer les données en optimisations concrètes et immédiates
  • Dépasser les benchmarks — sans jamais se contenter du minimum

Leadership par l’action

  • Offrir un mentorat concret qui améliore la qualité d’exécution
  • Être une référence pour les enjeux de performance

Reporting & narration

  • Créer des tableaux de bord et visualisations (Looker, Tableau, PowerBI)

Collaboration

  • Contribuer activement aux discussions clients
  • Aligner les efforts média avec les objectifs d’affaires

Exigences

Profil recherché

  • 2+ ans d’expérience en gestion de médias payants (search et social)
  • Expertise sur Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn (autres plateformes : un atout)
  • Capacité démontrée à générer des résultats au-delà des leads (MQL, revenus, efficacité)
  • Expérience avec Google Analytics (UA & GA4) et Google Tag Manager
  • Solide capacité d’analyse et d’exécution
  • Expérience avec des outils de visualisation (Looker, Tableau, PowerBI)
  • Mentalité orientée vers l’exécution, l’itération et l’amélioration continue

Atouts

  • Expérience en automatisation média, attribution ou IA
  • Expérience en mentorat ou accompagnement de profils juniors

Attentes en matière d’IA

Dans ce rôle, vous devrez :

  • Documenter et partager vos apprentissages, prompts et workflows
  • Voir l’IA comme un amplificateur — pas un raccourci

Nos valeurs fondamentales

  • Meilleurs chaque jour

  • Implacables face aux résultats
    L’activité sans impact, c’est du bruit.
  • Guidés par la vérité
    Nous prenons des décisions basées sur les données, pas sur des suppositions.

Avantages et bénéfices

Chez Level, nous soutenons les membres de notre équipe aux États-Unis et au Canada avec des avantages conçus pour favoriser la flexibilité, le bien-être et la croissance à long terme.

Télétravail d’abord

Standard Job Description

Join Lockheed Martin’s digital transformation journey as we accelerate the OneLM Mission-Driven Transformation through our 1LMX program. This strategic priority is reshaping our operations and business processes to better serve our customers in terms of cost, quality, and capabilities, while delivering the speed, agility, and insights necessary to stay ahead of rapidly-evolving threats.

The 1LMX Finance Applications Team is hiring an ERP Business Analyst, Senior with a strong Oracle EPM background to support the overhaul of our business application systems.

What You Will Be Doing:

As the Oracle EPM Testing & Defect Lead, you will work with the team to lead coordination for all testing cycles including Functional Unit Test (FUT), Integrated Testing (ITC), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Regression Testing, & Performance Testing. You will also be responsible for managing test execution progress, defect linkages, and defect resolution processes to unblock testing.

Your responsibilities will include the following:
• Collaborate & report status into the central Test Management PMO team on Oracle EPM's status of test scope identification (scenarios, cases, scripts, data prep), and status of tester needs.

Sales Closer

Position Type: Full-Time | Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, we are hiring for one of our clients seeking a Sales Closer to join their growing sales team.

This role is ideal for a proven salesperson who knows how to manage a pipeline, conduct consultative sales conversations, handle objections, follow up consistently, and close deals.

You do not need experience in international moving. The client will provide training on the industry, services, and processes. What matters most is that you already know how to sell.

The ideal candidate is confident taking ownership of opportunities from the initial conversation through quoting, negotiation, follow-up, and close.

Responsibilities

Sales & Lead Management

  • Respond to and engage with new leads through the company's lead management system.
  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand customer needs, timelines, destinations, and requirements.
  • Manage opportunities throughout the complete sales cycle.
  • Maintain consistent follow-up with prospects and open opportunities.
  • Prioritize leads based on buying intent, customer needs, and revenue potential.

Consultative Selling & Closing

  • Ask effective discovery questions to identify customer needs and buying motivations.
  • Present solutions based on each customer's specific requirements.
  • Prepare and explain quotes clearly and professionally.
  • Handle objections and communicate the value of the company's services.
  • Negotiate appropriately and guide qualified prospects toward a decision.
  • Identify buying signals and use effective closing techniques.
  • Convert qualified opportunities into booked business.

Pipeline & CRM Management

  • Take complete ownership of the sales pipeline from lead engagement through close.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, notes, follow-ups, and opportunity stages.
  • Ensure qualified opportunities are consistently followed up with.
  • Keep customer information and sales activity up to date.
  • Manage multiple opportunities while maintaining strong attention to detail.

Client & Internal Coordination

  • Build strong relationships with prospects throughout the sales process.
  • Communicate pricing, services, expectations, and timelines clearly.
  • Coordinate with internal pricing and operations teams when needed.
  • Ensure proposed solutions align with customer requirements and service capabilities.
  • Maintain proactive communication with both customers and internal teams.

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • You already know how to sell—you don't need to be taught the fundamentals of sales.
  • You have experience taking prospects through a sales process and closing business.
  • You are confident conducting discovery calls and asking the right questions.
  • You are comfortable handling objections, negotiating, and asking for the sale.
  • You are persistent with follow-up and do not need to be reminded to move opportunities forward.
  • You take ownership of your pipeline and are accountable for your results.
  • You are motivated by performance and commission-based earning potential.
  • You are comfortable working with warm/inbound leads and, ideally, outbound opportunities.
  • You can quickly learn a new industry and become knowledgeable about the product or service.
  • You are organized, proactive, and comfortable working independently.
  • You communicate confidently in both English and Spanish.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of proven sales experience preferred, with strong candidates demonstrating exceptional sales performance considered.
  • Demonstrated experience managing opportunities through the sales process.
  • Proven ability to handle objections, follow up consistently, and close deals.
  • Strong consultative and needs-based selling skills.
  • Experience using a CRM or sales pipeline management system.
  • Strong computer literacy and ability to work across multiple systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Fluent or professional Spanish.
  • Comfortable working U.S. business hours.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal sales coaching or supervision.

Typical Day

  • Review and prioritize new and existing leads.
  • Conduct discovery calls with prospective customers.
  • Understand customer needs and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Prepare and follow up on quotes and proposals.
  • Handle objections and negotiate with qualified prospects.
  • Follow up with open opportunities and move them toward a decision.
  • Coordinate with pricing and operations teams when necessary.
  • Update CRM records and pipeline stages.
  • Close qualified opportunities and contribute to weekly booking targets.
  • Continuously manage and improve your sales pipeline.

Compensation & Earning Potential

  • Base Salary: Starting around $1,000 USD/month.
  • Commission: Performance-based commission tied to the profitability of booked business.
  • Commission earnings increase based on sales performance and booking volume.
  • Typical production expectations are approximately $5,000–$8,000 in weekly bookings.
  • Strong performers have meaningful opportunity to increase their monthly earnings through commission.

This role is designed for sales professionals who are motivated by performance and want their earning potential to grow alongside their results.

Interview Process

  • Initial screening with Pavago.
  • Client interview.
  • Final selection and onboarding.

jobs.excerpt: About Better Impact Better Impact builds software for organizations that rely on people showing up for one another and their communities.
jobs.description:
About Better Impact

Better Impact builds software for organizations that rely on people showing up for one another and their communities.

Our platforms help nonprofits, hospitals, government agencies, volunteer centers, and corporate community programs recruit, onboard, schedule, train, communicate with, and understand the impact of their volunteers. More than 85,000 organizations across 20 countries use Better Impact today. In January 2026, Better Impact and Galaxy Digital combined to create a larger platform dedicated to volunteerism and community engagement.

We are now a team of more than 100 employees and FTEs, operating across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Australia. We are growing, integrating, and building the systems a company at our stage needs. That includes the People function.

About HandsOn Connect

HandsOn Connect is our volunteer management platform, built natively on Salesforce. Nonprofits, companies, and universities use it to recruit, schedule, track, and report on their volunteers through a branded portal that runs on their own Salesforce data.

Our Team & Culture

We think good software should make community work easier, not add to the pile. We are a remote team that ships carefully, shares credit, and gives people real room to grow.

We welcome different backgrounds and perspectives. If you meet most of what is listed below but not all of it, apply anyway. We would rather hear from you.

The Role

You are the person our customers count on when something in Salesforce is not behaving, and the person who sets them up so that happens less often.

The job blends hands-on Salesforce work, customer support, and onboarding. You will work directly with clients, and you will also shape how support and onboarding actually run here: the process, the training, the documentation.

We are looking for someone who likes untangling a messy technical problem, likes the person on the other end of the ticket, and cannot leave a broken process alone.

It is a good fit if you like to lead by doing, if you enjoy teaching and coaching, and if you are happiest when you can fix the thing and then fix the reason it broke.

Core Responsibilities

  • Customer Support Leadership. Be the escalation point for the hard ones. Work tickets alongside the team, give clear answers quickly, and set the bar for what good support looks like here.
  • Onboarding Program and Team Lead. Own onboarding from the first call to go-live. Walk new clients through setup and configuration on a timeline that fits them, then turn what works into a repeatable process.
  • Client Training & Resource Development. Run customer trainings and build the materials that scale them: guides, short videos, knowledge base articles. Help customers get past the basics and actually use the platform well.
  • Retention & Expansion Support. Work with Customer Success to spot accounts that are drifting, and step in early. Use usage data and support trends to find where customers could be getting more out of the product.
  • Team Leadership & Process Improvement. Mentor the support team and help build a function that runs well without heroics. Improve workflows, documentation, and how tickets move between people.

Requirements

Salesforce Technical Expertise

You should have hands-on experience with:

  • Custom object and field creation
  • Salesforce Flow design and implementation
  • SOQL query writing
  • User permission management
  • Email templates, alerts, and list views
  • Reports and dashboards
  • Data import/export and Translation Workbench
  • Troubleshooting configuration and data issues

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing role, preferably in SaaS
  • 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience
  • Experience mentoring or leading people on a support, onboarding, or customer success team
  • At least one current Salesforce certification (Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Nonprofit Cloud Consultant, or similar)
  • Comfortable working remotely and running client calls and trainings
  • Strong communication, documentation, and project management skills
  • Able to juggle several priorities without dropping the thread

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with HTML and CSS
  • Experience creating customer training materials or video tutorials
  • CMS experience (Wix, WordPress, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of HTML, SOQL, or similar technical languages

Benefits

Salary Range: $85,000-$95,000

Our benefits package includes:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance (after 90 days)
  • 401(k) (after 90 days)
  • Unlimited PTO after 90 days, plus 9 paid holidays
  • Paid maternity and paternity leave
  • Fully remote work environment
  • We review salaries every year and adjust based on your performance and how the company is doing. This is a full-time, fully remote position.

    • IaC: desarrollo directo (escribir desde cero)
    • Servicios avanzados de AWS
    • Experiencia en entornos altamente regulados
  • Nice to have
    • Certificación AWS
    • Experiencia en sector financiero
    • Experiencia en entornos corporativos auditados
    • Conocimiento de CI/CD (no ownership completo)


Primer Frente: — BACKEND—

No se requiere que hayas diseñado arquitecturas de empresa completas, pero sí que puedas construir componentes de forma autónoma, tomar decisiones técnicas fundamentadas y entender el impacto de tu código en el sistema completo. No se busca un arquitecto que delega, se busca alguien que ejecuta con criterio.

(Hands-on real)

  • Experiencia desarrollando APIs en producción (Node, Python, C#, Java)
  • Diseño de APIs REST (endpoints, validaciones, manejo de errores)
  • Implementación de autenticación/autorización (JWT, OAuth2 o similar)
  • Manejo de base de datos (SQL y/o NoSQL)
  • Experiencia real ejecutando (no solo diseñando o liderando)

Stack backend

  • C# (.Net) o Node.js o Python como lenguaje principal. No importa cuál, lo que importa es la profundidad.
  • Desarrollo de APIs REST: diseño de recursos, versionamiento, autenticación (JWT, OAuth2), autorización por roles.
  • Manejo de bases de datos relacionales (SQL) e idealmente alguna NoSQL. Queries optimizadas, transacciones, índices.
  • Manejo de errores robusto: respuestas consistentes, logging estructurado, trazabilidad.
  • Pruebas unitarias e integración: no solo saber que existen también saber escribirlas y mantenerlas.

Esperamos identificar en ti:

  • Facilidad para hablar de tus APIs con propiedad de producto: conoces el input, el output, los casos de error, quién lo consume y por qué se diseñó así.
  • Claridad para explicar paso a paso cómo construiste o modificarías un servicio real: desde la definición del endpoint hasta su despliegue en producción.
  • Agilidad cuando se te presenta un escenario técnico: daR una solución concreta sin evadir o desviar el caso.
  • Capacidad para reconoces trade-offs: saber cuándo usar una Lambda vs un contenedor, una BD relacional vs una NoSQL, y poder justificarlo.
  • Transparencia para compartir cuándo has tenido incidentes en producción y poder describir cómo los identificaste, atendiste y previenes.

Buenas prácticas — 'CÓDIGO LIMPIO'

Este punto es crítico. El código es evaluado automáticamente en cada promoción entre ambientes, por lo que es importante contar con buenas prácticas bien consolidadas desde el inicio.

Patrones de diseño — deberás conocer y saber aplicar al menos uno

  • Clean Architecture (también llamada Arquitectura Limpia): separación de capas, dependencias apuntando hacia adentro, dominio independiente de infraestructura.
  • Arquitectura en Capas (Layered / N-tier): presentación, negocio, datos — claramente separados.
  • Arquitectura de Cebolla (Onion Architecture): núcleo de dominio rodeado por capas concéntricas de adaptadores.

Clean code — lo que esperamos ver en tu forma de trabajar
Se espera que puedas explicar cómo estructuras tu código, cómo separas responsabilidades y cómo manejas errores en servicios reales, con ejemplos claros de lo que has construido.

  • Separación clara de responsabilidades: cada clase, función o módulo cumple un propósito específico.
  • Uso de nombres descriptivos que hagan el código fácil de entender sin necesidad de explicaciones adicionales.
  • Lógica de negocio ubicada en las capas correctas (servicios o dominio), no en controladores.
  • Código limpio y mantenible, evitando redundancias o elementos innecesarios.
  • Manejo explícito de errores, con control y trazabilidad adecuados.

Seguridad en código — requerida, no opcional

  • Validación de inputs en backend (no confiar en el frontend para validar).
  • Protección de endpoints: autenticación + autorización correctamente implementada.
  • No hardcodear credenciales, API keys ni secrets en el código — uso de variables de entorno o servicios como AWS Secrets Manager.
  • Conocimiento básico de OWASP Top 10: SQL injection, XSS, broken auth, etc.
  • Logging sin exponer datos sensibles (PII, tokens, passwords).


Segundo Frente: — CLOUD AWS —

AWS es un componente clave del rol.

Se espera experiencia real en producción y entendimiento de cómo el backend vive dentro de un entorno cloud, pero el enfoque principal sigue siendo backend.

Se espera capacidad de explicar cómo ha desplegado servicios, cómo se conectan entre sí y cómo su código impacta el entorno.

Importante que el candidato:

  • Haya trabajado con AWS en producción (no solo teoría)
  • Entienda cómo se despliegan servicios y se promueve código entre ambientes
  • Comprenda cómo su código impacta seguridad, despliegue y operación

Servicios con los que se espera experiencia práctica

  • Lambda: creación, configuración de triggers, conexión con otros servicios, manejo de timeouts y errores.
  • API Gateway: creación de APIs, integración con Lambda, manejo de stages y autorizadores.
  • S3: gestión de objetos, permisos, políticas de acceso, lifecycle rules.
  • DynamoDB o RDS: operaciones CRUD, índices, conexión desde servicios backend.
  • IAM: roles, políticas, principio de menor privilegio — sabe por qué importa y cómo aplicarlo.


    Infraestructura como Código (IaC) — conocimiento funcional obligatorio:
  • Entiende qué es y para qué sirve: no se crean recursos manualmente en consola.
  • Puede leer y entender una plantilla de CloudFormation o un módulo de CDK/Terraform aunque no sea su especialidad.
  • Sabe cómo se declara una Lambda, un API Gateway o un rol IAM en código.
  • Entiende el ciclo: escribir IaC → plan/preview → deploy controlado.


    Seguridad en nube — nivel esperado
    • Entiende buenas prácticas básicas de seguridad al trabajar en AWS
    • Sabe que el acceso entre servicios debe manejarse mediante roles (no credenciales hardcodeadas)
    • Tiene noción de cómo se protegen APIs expuestas
    • Conoce prácticas básicas para manejo seguro de secretos
  • No se requiere especialización en seguridad cloud, pero sí criterio suficiente para desarrollar sin comprometer el entorno.


    Tercer frente: — REACT / NEXT.JS —

    El candidato no desarrollará frontend. Pero sí construirá el backend que lo alimenta. Debe entender suficiente para garantizar que sus servicios funcionen correctamente en integración.

    -Cómo el frontend consume una API- Entiendes qué estructura de respuesta espera, qué headers necesitas, cómo manejar errores HTTP
    -fetch / axios o equivalente:     Sabe cómo se hace una llamada desde frontend — puede diseñar su API pensando en quien la llama.
    -Manejo de estado básico:     Entiendes qué datos guarda el frontend y cuándo necesita refrescarlos desde el backend.
    -Qué es un hook (nivel conceptual): Sabes que el frontend maneja efectos asíncronos
    -Validación de formularios:     Entiendes qué valida el frontend vs qué debe validar el backend (y por qué el backend siempre debe validar).
    -Protección de endpoints consumidos por frontend:     Sabes implementar autenticación/autorización pensando en un cliente React.

Benefits

🚀 Integración a marcas globales y startups disruptivas.

🏡 Trabajo remoto/Home office.

📍 En caso de requerir modalidad híbrida o presencial, serás informado desde la primera sesión.

📅 Trabajo de lunes a viernes.

🛡️ Seguro de vida (aplica para México).
🌎 Equipos de trabajo multiculturales.
🎓 Acceso a cursos y certificaciones.
📢 Meetups con invitados especiales del área de IT.

jobs.title: Gestionnaire de Compte
jobs.excerpt: Libérez votre potentiel chez Steritech – Où les carrières se construisent de l'intérieur Chez Steritech, nous cultivons une culture d'apprentissage continu et de développement professionnel.
jobs.description:
Libérez votre potentiel chez Steritech – Où les carrières se construisent de l'intérieur

Chez Steritech, nous cultivons une culture d'apprentissage continu et de développement professionnel. Nous sommes fiers de dire que la majorité de notre équipe de direction a commencé son parcours avec nous en tant que spécialiste. Cela témoigne de notre forte conviction en la promotion interne et de la reconnaissance du potentiel de chacun de nos membres. Lorsque vous rejoignez Steritech, vous ne prenez pas simplement un emploi – vous entrez sur un chemin de carrière qui offre des opportunités de croissance et d'avancement à tous les niveaux. Nous vous fournissons les outils, les ressources et le mentorat pour vous aider à réussir, car votre succès est notre succès. Faites partie d'une équipe qui s'engage à votre développement et vous aider à monter dans votre carrière !

Sommaire du poste

Le gestionnaire de comptes (GC) est un poste au sein de l'équipe de l'expérience client, relevant du directeur des comptes stratégiques de son segment de marché. Le GC est le principal point de collaboration pour apporter de la valeur aux clients assignés. Le portefeuille de clients présente une complexité faible à moyenne. Le GC est la personne responsable de développer des relations solides, de fournir un soutien quotidien et d'apporter des perspectives techniques afin d'exécuter une stratégie de compte maximisant le rendement pour le client et pour Steritech.

Une partie essentielle de ce poste consiste à orchestrer la mise en œuvre des services, à assurer la qualité et la calibration des spécialistes évaluant les sites, à respecter les ententes sur les niveaux de service, ainsi qu’à communiquer et acheminer les problèmes aux instances supérieures lorsque nécessaire.

De plus, le gestionnaire de comptes doit posséder une compréhension approfondie du secteur des normes de marque (Brand Standards), des protocoles et procédures de Steritech, ainsi que des exigences spécifiques des marques clientes afin d'assurer un service de haut niveau et de faciliter une excellente communication entre Steritech et tous les paliers de l'organisation cliente.

Requirements

Responsabilités et tâches principales

  • Gestion de la relation client : Établir des relations productives, professionnelles et consultatives avec le personnel clé (niveaux franchise et siège social).
  • Coordination interne : Coordonner l'implication de l'équipe verticale (spécialistes, soutien, technique, opérations) pour atteindre les objectifs de performance.
  • Lien stratégique : Mettre en relation les parties prenantes du client avec l'équipe Steritech (revues d'affaires, rencontres de haute direction, sessions d'innovation).
  • Expertise de marché : Maintenir une connaissance approfondie du segment de marché, partager les tendances et les meilleures pratiques.
  • Suivi de la performance : Évaluer proactivement la qualité, la calibration, la répartition des tournées et gérer les ententes de service.
  • Objectifs financiers : Atteindre les cibles de croissance, de rentabilité et de recouvrement (A/R). Travailler avec le département de la comptabilité pour les factures en souffrance.
  • Contrats : Gérer les renouvellements de contrats et les négociations d'augmentation de prix.
  • Planification : Exécuter les plans stratégiques incluant les cibles financières et les étapes critiques.
  • Analyse des besoins : Valider proactivement les besoins des clients pour ajouter de la valeur à leurs programmes.
  • Rapports : Soumettre les rapports hebdomadaires, mensuels et annuels requis.

Profil du candidat

Expérience et qualifications requises

  • Bilinguisme (français et anglais) : Un atout majeur pour ce poste.
  • Minimum de trois ans d'expérience en vente stratégique (B2B) ou en gestion de comptes.
  • Expérience dans l'industrie de la restauration, de l'alimentation, des dépanneurs ou de la restauration rapide (QSR).

Leadership et aptitudes personnelles

  • Autonomie et capacité à performer sous pression avec tact et habileté.
  • Capacité démontrée à mener à bien des projets et des initiatives complexes.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit.
  • Capacité de négociation efficace et sens des affaires aiguisé.
  • Grand souci du détail et solides compétences en prise de décision.
  • Maîtrise des applications Google (Docs, Sheets, Calendar, Drive, etc.).
  • Disponibilité pour voyager (auto et avion) pour rencontrer les clients et assister aux conférences.
  • Réussite des vérifications d'antécédents (conduite, casier judiciaire, dépistage de drogues).

Éducation et formation

  • Baccalauréat en administration, en gestion ou domaine connexe OU trois ans d'expérience progressive en gestion dans une industrie de services OU réussite du parcours interne de gestion de comptes.

Benefits

  • Prime annuelle
  • Téléphone cellulaire et ordinateur portable fournis par l’entreprise
  • Congés fériés, vacances et congés de maladie payés par l’entreprise
  • Excellents avantages sociaux, incluant les assurances médicale, dentaire, visuelle et vie
  • Programme d’aide aux employés offrant notamment des services de counseling gratuits et d’autres avantages
  • Régime d’épargne-retraite avec une contribution de l’employeur très compétitive de 3,5 %
  • Rabais employés
  • Excellents programmes de remboursement des frais de scolarité et de bourses d’études

Overview

Under general direction, the Senior Benefits Analyst is responsible for the strategic planning, administration, compliance, and continuous improvement of the company's employee benefits programs. This role oversees the day-to-day management of health and welfare plans, retirement programs, wellness initiatives, communication, and related benefits operations while ensuring compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

The Senior Analyst serves as a key advisor to the Vice President of Global Benefits, employees, vendors, and business partners regarding benefits strategy, program design, compliance requirements, and employee experience. This role analyzes benefit plan performance, identifies opportunities for enhancement, manages vendor relationships, and leads benefits-related projects and initiatives. The U.S. Benefits Senior Analyst relies on extensive knowledge of U.S. benefits regulations, industry best practices, and benefits administration processes to achieve organizational objectives.

Benefits & Time Off: As a full-time position, Company benefits are offered in compliance with the Affordable Care Act (ACA), state and federal law, and Company policies. These benefits include Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program, Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Legal, Identity Protection, Pet Insurance, and 401k.Full-time employees are eligible to receive paid time off (PTO) benefits based on the Company’s current paid time off policies and in accordance with applicable state law. Further, Colorado residents are eligible for Paid Sick and Safety Leave, per applicable state law provisions and Company policy. All benefits are subject to any plan changes at the Company’s sole discretion.

Compensation: this position will be paid on a salaried basis with a pay range between $75,000 and $85,000 annually depending on prior experience. This base pay is subject to all applicable statutory deductions and authorized withholdings as required by law. This base pay is also subject to any authorized deductions to contribute toward the employee’s portion of benefits premiums and/or 401(k) contributions.

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to improve operational effectiveness and employee experience

    • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
    • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite
    • Experience with HRIS, payroll, and benefits administration systems
    • Strong vendor management and relationship-building skills

The employee is occasionally required to walk; use hands and fingers to operate, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; and reach with hands and arms. jobs.title: Vice President Data Center Design
jobs.excerpt: At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure.
jobs.description:
At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Founder-led with $1.5B backed by Stonepeak, Montera is driven by a future-focused vision: to develop and operate hyperscale data centers essential for tomorrow's technology. Our mission is to deliver strategically located, hyperscale data centers designed for speed, reliability, and scalability. Backed by decades of experience in design, construction, and operations, we don’t just build—we execute with purpose.

Our Values

  • Client First Alignment: We align every solution to our clients’ goals.
  • Speed with Certainty: Velocity matters. We deliver with urgency and precision.
  • Operational Excellence: Decades of experience drive our high standards.
  • Safety & Integrity: Safety is non-negotiable. We lead with integrity and transparency.
  • Ownership Mentality: We think like owners, because we are.

The Opportunity

Montera is seeking a Vice President Data Center Design leads the delivery of Montera’s facility designs across the portfolio. Reporting to the CTO, the VP owns design execution end to end — from reference architecture through IFC and construction support — and is the senior leader of Montera’s Principal Engineering & Architecture Leadership family and its external design and construction partners.

This is a people-leadership and delivery-accountability role, distinct from the CTO’s external technical and customer-facing mandate. The CTO owns customer requirements capture and is the technical external face of Montera; the VP converts those requirements into buildable, coordinated, on-schedule designs and drives them through the design and construction partner ecosystem (CSA, MEP, design-assist trades, GC/CM, and specialty consultants) to a predictable, commissioned outcome.

The VP manages the five Principal ICs — Architect & Master Planning, Electrical, Mechanical, Controls, and Network — aligning their reference architectures into a single coherent facility design, resolving cross-discipline conflicts, and holding the integrated design schedule and budget. The role is accountable for design quality, constructability, multi-discipline coordination, and the design inputs to cost, schedule, and availability targets across active projects (currently Eagle and Goldeneye) and the broader pipeline.

Requirements

What You'll Do

Design Delivery & Program Execution

  • Own end-to-end design delivery across the portfolio — concept, SD, DD, IFP/IFC, and construction-phase support — against committed schedule milestones (e.g., schematic design and IFC dates) and yield-on-cost targets.
  • Hold the integrated, multi-discipline design schedule and budget; drive the critical path across architectural, electrical, mechanical, controls, and network scopes.
  • Govern design change control, trade studies, and value-engineering decisions, protecting design intent, reliability targets (five-nines availability), and operability.
  • Own the design basis of design (BOD) and its consistent application across projects, and the design deliverables that feed permitting, procurement, and construction.

Leadership of the Principal Engineering & Architecture Family

  • Directly lead and develop the five Principal ICs (Architect/Master Planning, Electrical, Mechanical, Controls, Network); set objectives, review performance, and build the discipline centers of excellence.
  • Integrate discipline reference architectures into one coherent, coordinated facility design; arbitrate cross-discipline trade-offs (e.g., power vs. cooling vs. space, controls data model vs. network segmentation).
  • Ensure the Controls–Network interlock on customer data exposure is delivered jointly and coherently, consistent with the single-tenant model and the requirements the CTO captures.
  • Enforce portfolio-wide design standards, playbooks, and prototypical modules that enable rapid, repeatable deployment.

Design Contracts & Partner Governance

  • Define, review, negotiate, and manage design contracts with design partners (CSA and MEP engineers of record, design-assist trades, and specialty consultants) — owning scopes of work, deliverable schedules, standard of care, fee structures, and design responsibility matrices.

Constructability, Commissioning & Handover

Job Title: Therapeutic Specialist Tzield Dallas TX

  • Location: Dallas, TX

About the Job:

Therapeutic Specialist, Tzield are part of the National Tzield Sales Team and play a pivotal role in bringing a paradigm-shifting Type 1 Diabetes product to market. Therapeutic Specialists leverage their deep sales experience and expertise to accelerate Tzield adoption across providers and accounts and collaborate closely with all respective cross-functional partners. This role will develop territory-specific sales strategies, educate endocrinology and primary care providers on both Tzield and screening, and build a robust Tzield customer base.

Join the team transforming how healthcare is delivered for chronic and specialty conditions worldwide. In General Medicines, you’ll help drive meaningful outcomes in diabetes, transplant, and immunology - with the scale and urgency patients deserve.

About Sanofi:
We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Brand Awareness & Intent to Treat with Endos.

  • Build belief in Tzield mechanistic rationale and clinical narrative (e.g., MOA involving beta cell preservation, approved indication, efficacy / safety profile).

  • Develop in-depth knowledge and understanding of key accounts across territory, including barriers to Tzield use.

  • Contribute to priority account strategy development lead by SAMs and own execution to engage endocrinology and primary care providers on Tzield use.

  • For non-priority Endo in territories, own the development and execution of growth-oriented account & business plans (e.g., account mapping, influence mapping, etc.).

  • Identify account champions / KOLs and engage them as necessary and appropriate to communicate with peers and patients about Tzield.

  • Screening Awareness & Development of T1D Ecosystem.

  • Build belief in T1D early detection and importance of screening for T1D in asymptomatic, undiagnosed, early detection population.

  • Conduct strategic planning at territory level to understand and contribute to development of broader T1D ecosystem in order to prioritize time, engagement, and education strategy.

  • Contribute to screening strategy development and own execution to engage PCP / Ped on early detection & screening.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify and educate on importance of urgent referrals for identified patients within narrow treatment window.

  • Educate relevant stakeholders on at-risk populations, screening / monitoring best practices, and the value of early detection (e.g., DKA avoidance).

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional Sanofi teams to support customers.

  • Attending local, regional, and national meetings as directed.

  • Maintaining strict adherence to all legal, regulatory, ethical, administrative, and financial duties.

  • Achieving and exceeding assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual sales quotas.

About You:

Qualifications:

  • B.A. / B.S. degree required.

  • 3+ years of pharmaceutical, biotech or medical device sales experience.

  • Account Management sales and / or rare specialty product experience.

  • Demonstrated ability to understand and use data to drive improved business management and oversight of the sales within customer territories.

  • Proven results of increasing educational awareness, provider adoption and customer engagement.

  • Experience successfully launching products in the field.

  • Experience collaborating and working in a matrix environment across multiple different sales, medical and support functions.

  • Strong business acumen and solution-oriented mind-set

  • Ability to strategically plan and execute work.

  • Robust communication skills and ability to engage in two-way stakeholder dialogue.

  • High accountability for all feedback, coaching, and results

  • Valid driver’s license.

  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time to customers, conventions, training, and other internal meetings.

Why Choose Us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.

  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.

  • Help shape the future of care for chronic and complex conditions like aT1D, Type 2 diabetes, transplant, and cardiovascular disease.

  • Be part of a simpler, digital- and AI-powered business that’s rethinking how we work and engage with the world.

  • Drive meaningful impact at global scale: our medicines reach more than 100 million people each year.

  • Contribute to innovations that improve outcomes, relieve pressure on healthcare systems, and expand access worldwide.

Overview

Your AI strategy is only as strong as the data behind it. Quest Software builds the foundation for enterprise AI with solutions in data governance, cybersecurity, and platform modernization. More than 45,000 companies — including 90% of the Fortune 500 — trust Quest to solve their most critical challenges. Quest Software is seeking an AI Software Engineer to help define and advance AI-first software development practices for a cloud-native SaaS product on the Microsoft Azure platform. This role is intended for an experienced developer who combines strong C#/.NET, Python, Azure, AWS, cloud architecture, and backend engineering skills with proven hands-on experience using AI coding agents, AI-assisted development platforms, and agentic development workflows in production software engineering.

The successful candidate will be expected to contribute directly to the product codebase while also helping the team adopt AI coding approaches that improve development speed, code quality, test coverage, refactoring and troubleshooting.   • Design, build, test, and maintain scalable, serverless, cloud-native SaaS capabilities using Python/TypeScript and AWS technologies, including EKS, DynamoDB, S3 and Lambda Functions.
  • Contribute to architecture, technical decision-making, code reviews, CI/CD, release readiness, and ownership of critical product components in an Agile SCRUM environment.

Qualifications

  • Completion of a computer science undergraduate degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Five or more years of professional software development experience, including strong hands-on C#, .NET and Python experience.
  • Demonstrated professional experience using AI coding agents, AI-assisted development tools, or agentic development workflows as a substantial part of real software development work.
  • Advanced practical experience with GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Windsurf, or comparable AI-powered development platforms.
  • Design reusable prompts, agent instructions, development workflows, validation steps, and guardrails that enable consistent and responsible AI-assisted software development.

Nice to have:

  • Experience developing and maintaining YAML CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Github Actions, Terraform or similar systems.
  • Experience with Azure OpenAI Service, large language model APIs, evaluation frameworks, observability, or AI application security.
  • Experience with Angular or React and TypeScript.
  • Experience with PySpark (Python + Spark)

Company Overview

Quest Software enables organizations of all sizes to better secure, manage, monitor, protect, and analyze information and infrastructure to help fuel innovation and drive their businesses forward.

Quest builds solutions across data governance, cybersecurity, and platform modernization. More than 45,000 companies, including 90% of the Fortune 500, trust Quest to solve critical IT challenges, from securing identities and modernizing platforms to preparing enterprise data for AI.

Why Quest

  • Work on enterprise-scale commercial software used by customers worldwide.
  • Collaborate with dedicated professionals who are passionate about technology and practical innovation.
  • Help shape how AI-assisted development practices are applied to a mature on-premises product and engineering team.
  • Grow your career through learning opportunities, mentorship, leadership programs, and a collaborative global team environment.
  • Benefit from competitive pay, annual bonuses, comprehensive benefits, flexible work options, generous PTO, and wellness programs.

Quest is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. jobs.description:
ChampionAI is QAD | Redzone agentic platform, purpose-built for manufacturing and utilized by the various business units within QAD | Redzone. This engineer joins the core platform team with three main areas of focus: building new capabilities into the platform, helping Applied AI teams at partner business units build and ship Champions correctly, and directly building Champion agents for business-unit use cases when needed.
You will work in the same codebase as the Applied AI engineers you support, which keeps the enablement work
practical and the platform work focused on real problems.

Key Responsibilities
Platform Development

  • Build and ship features across the Champion platform repositories
  • Improve developer experience: tooling, scaffolding, internal documentation, and onboarding paths for Applied AI engineers.
  • Maintain and evolve the MCP tool server and agent infrastructure that BU teams depend on.
  • Identify and address friction points that slow down Champion development or deployment

Applied AI Enablement

  • Support BU Applied AI engineers in building, deploying, and operating Champions correctly
  • Review agent implementations for prompt quality, scope enforcement, auth configuration, and deployment setup
  • Contribute to internal engineering guides and skill documentation
  • Pair with BU engineers on first K8S manifest creation, database registration, and LaunchDarkly prompt rollout

Agent Development

  • Design and build Champion agents for BU use-cases when the platform team is directly engaged
  • Write and iterate on system prompts, tool bindings, and context injection for production agents
  • Register agents in Champion Server and configure LaunchDarkly-gated prompt rollout across environments

Engineering Practices
We follow trunk-based development with PR-gated merges to main. Engineers are expected to:

  • Write tests before implementing. TDD is the expectation, not a nice-to-have.
  • Keep PRs small and focused; use feature flags to ship partial work incrementally
  • Follow conventional commit format (feat:, fix:, etc.)
  • Be mindful of API and schema backward-compatibility; prefer additive changes over breaking ones
  • Review your own diff before requesting review

Core Requirements

  • Python: Proficient in async Python, Pydantic, type hints, and FastAPI. Experience with the Strands agent SDK or a comparable agentic framework. Testing is non-optional: candidates should be comfortable with pytest, pytest- asyncio, and DeepEval for agent-specific evaluation. We test agent behavior, not just unit logic.
  • Prompt Engineering: Able to write and iterate on production system prompts: XML-structured, scope-enforced, with tool descriptions that guide LLM delegation reliably.
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP): Solid understanding of MCP and hands-on experience building or consuming MCP servers. Familiarity with Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol is a strong plus.
  • Agent Patterns: Familiar with multi-agent architectures and orchestration patterns beyond basic ReAct: supervisor/subagent delegation, parallel tool use, handoffs, and context management across agent boundaries.
  • Agent Evals: Able to design and run evaluation suites for agent behavior: correctness checks, scope enforcement tests, regression coverage, and systematic prompt iteration based on eval results.
  • Docker: Comfortable authoring Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, and local dev environments via docker-compose / make.
  • PostgreSQL: Comfortable with templated INSERT/SELECT, foreign key relationships, and reading an ER diagram.
  • Git / Semantic Versioning: Follows conventional commit format (feat:, fix:) and a PR-based trunk workflow.

Nice to Have

  • Kubernetes: Working knowledge of Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and ServiceAccounts. Able to read and adapt K8s manifests and use kubectl for basic troubleshooting.
  • AWS: Working knowledge of ECR, EKS, IAM, and Bedrock (inference layer).
  • OAuth2 / OIDC: Conceptual understanding of Authorization Code Flow with PKCE, token exchange, and agent auth delegation.
  • Terraform: Beginner-level familiarity; able to make targeted changes to existing modules and interpret a plan diff.
  • LaunchDarkly: Experience managing feature flags or AI config overrides for environment-gated rollout.
  • Document Intelligence / OCR: AWS Textract or comparable pipeline experience for use cases involving structured document extraction.

AI-Native Development

  • We run an AI-native SDLC. AI-assisted tools (Claude Code, Cursor) are part of the standard engineering workflow at every stage: planning, implementation, review, and documentation. This is not optional or supplemental; it is how we work. Candidates should be comfortable with AI-assisted development and willing to invest in getting good at it.
  • Use Claude Code and Cursor actively across planning, implementation, and code review
  • Know when AI output is wrong and push back on it.
  • Help drive adoption across the team by sharing what works

What This Role Is Not
This is not an ML research or data science role. The platform team owns cluster networking, observability pipelines, auth configuration, and LLM routing, so deep expertise in those areas is not required. The job is building reliable
software on top of that infrastructure and helping others do the same.

jobs.description:
About Foodsmart:

Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

👥 Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.
🚀 Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.
🤝 One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

About the Role:

Foodsmart’s value proposition rests on a claim: we improve outcomes for the members who need it most, and we save payers real money doing it. We’re looking for a Senior Director of Health Economics & Actuarial Analytics who can make that claim airtight, rigorous enough to hold up when a payer’s own actuarial team pressure tests it.

This role owns the full chain from clinical improvement to economic value. It starts with measuring what actually changed for a client’s members: weight loss, A1c improvement, blood pressure control, HEDIS performance. It ends with quantifying what that improvement is worth and defending that number in front of the people writing the check.

You’ll also help shape our value-based care strategy, including which populations we should be targeting and what performance we can credibly commit to.

Health economists and actuaries approach these problems differently, and either can be excellent here. What matters is the standard you hold yourself to. Our numbers get validated by payers’ own actuarial teams, which means the work has to be built the way they would build it, with their assumptions about trend, credibility, and risk adjustment.

This is our most senior data science leadership role, reporting directly to the VP of Analytics & Data Science. You’ll lead a small team while staying deeply hands-on with the methodology yourself, and you’ll be expected to use AI as a genuine force multiplier, to move faster, go deeper, and extend your reach well beyond what the headcount alone would suggest. You’ll also be a partner on our peer-reviewed research work, which we pursue with academic collaborators and our founder and Chief Science Officer.

The strongest candidates will have done this inside a telehealth or digital health company, or will have built their foundation on the payer or consulting side and then moved into digital health. What matters most is that you have proven value to payers before, repeatedly, and know what it takes for those numbers to be believed.

You will:

  • Own how we measure clinical outcomes across client member populations: weight loss, A1c, blood pressure, food insecurity, HEDIS measures, and the quality metrics our clients hold us to.
  • Own Foodsmart’s ROI methodology: translating those clinical outcomes into economic value, and identifying which member populations we help the most.
  • Represent that methodology directly to payers and external actuarial and consulting firms, defending our approach under real technical scrutiny rather than just presenting a final number.
  • Own the analytical substance of the value story we tell individual clients, grounded in their own members’ outcomes rather than generic benchmarks.
  • Help shape our value-based care strategy, including which member populations to target and what performance we can credibly stand behind.
  • Build our outcomes and ROI methodology as a scalable system, one that extends to new populations and new client conversations without being rebuilt from scratch each time.
  • Partner on peer-reviewed research with academic collaborators
  • Work with our clinical team to translate findings and best practices into how care is actually delivered.
  • Lead and develop a small team while staying hands-on, and lean on AI and other tooling to extend how much ground you and your team can cover.

You are:

  • Rigorous in the way a payer’s actuarial team is rigorous. You reason about cost, utilization, risk, and credibility with real discipline, and you know where a methodology is most likely to be attacked.
  • Fluent in both clinical quality measurement and economic value, and comfortable moving between the two. You can look at a change in A1c across a population and know how to turn it into a number a payer will accept.
  • Comfortable being the technical counterpart to a payer’s own actuaries and consultants: unintimidated by scrutiny, and able to defend methodology choices in real time.
  • Seasoned. You have proven value to payers repeatedly, and you are not learning ROI methodology on the job.
  • A systems builder who thinks in terms of scale: a repeatable methodology, not a one-off analysis redone for every new client or payer.
  • Able to translate technical findings into how care actually gets delivered, working alongside clinical and care delivery teams.
  • Someone who treats AI as a genuine lever on your own impact. You actively look for ways to use it to work faster and go deeper, and you have a point of view on where it helps and where rigor still demands a human.
  • Comfortable leading a small team while staying personally hands-on with the hardest analytical work yourself.

You have:

  • A background in health economics, actuarial science, or a closely related quantitative field, with a track record of applying it to healthcare cost and value questions. An advanced degree or actuarial credentials (ASA, FSA, MAAA) are a plus but not required if you have equivalent hands-on depth.
  • Experience proving ROI and value inside a telehealth or digital health company, or a foundation on the payer or consulting side followed by time in digital health.
  • Hands-on experience measuring clinical outcomes and quality across populations, including familiarity with HEDIS and common chronic condition measures.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with healthcare claims data, both medical and pharmacy (Rx), including the practical realities of using it for cost and utilization analysis.
  • Deep expertise in causal inference as applied to healthcare cost and outcomes: matched cohort design, risk adjustment, and quasi-experimental methods.
  • Direct experience presenting and defending ROI methodology with payers, actuaries, or similarly technical external audiences.
  • Experience with value-based care arrangements and a point of view on what a provider or vendor can credibly commit to.
  • Peer-reviewed publication experience is a plus.
  • Experience partnering with clinical or care delivery teams to translate findings into practice.
  • Comfort working directly with data (SQL, R, or Python) to conduct your own analysis.
  • Familiarity with AI-native tooling (Claude Code, or equivalent) as a way to accelerate analysis.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write for external, technical, and non-technical audiences alike.

About our benefits and perks:

✅ Remote-First Company

✅ Unlimited PTO

✅ Flexible & remote location

✅ Healthcare Coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
✅ 401k & bonus

✅ Registered Dietitian Sessions

It is our firm policy to extend equal employment and advancement opportunity to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship status, religious creed, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth and/or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, marital status, disability (physical or mental) and/or a medical condition, genetic information, ancestry, veteran status or service in the uniformed services, and any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards.
Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi).
This role is focused on Jeeves’s growth programs and emerging revenue channels — including our partnerships channel and new market expansion initiatives — where we need rigorous, scalable analytics to match the pace of growth.
You’ll be responsible for the analytical layer that connects our sales activity to revenue outcomes: building the dashboards our leadership relies on, maintaining shared responsibility for the integrity of our performance data, and proactively surfacing the insights that shape how we operate. You’ll work closely with the Head of Revenue Operations and contribute meaningfully to planning and review cycles alongside GTM leadership.
The pace here is real. Priorities shift, timelines compress, and the ground moves under your feet — not occasionally, but constantly. We need someone who is energized by that, not worn down. You won’t wait for someone to tell you what to look at. You’ll already know.

Key Responsibilities

    GTM Analytics & Growth Program Insights

    • Build and maintain Tableau dashboards tracking performance across our partnerships channel and new growth initiatives — serving audiences from country leads to executive leadership.

    • Analyze conversion rates, pipeline health, ramp trends, and revenue attainment across programs and segments, surfacing patterns before they become decisions that have already been made.

    • Come with a point of view. When a program is underperforming or a trend shifts, bring an interpretation and a recommendation (not just a chart).

    • Support quarterly and annual GTM business reviews with structured analysis: cohort breakdowns, market-level benchmarks, and forward-looking indicators.

      • Revenue Planning & Target Analysis

      • Contribute to GTM capacity planning and quota-setting cycles — modeling scenarios, building attainment reports, and stress-testing assumptions before plans are finalized.

      • Maintain performance-against-target reporting for growth programs and emerging channels: track attainment, flag outliers early, and ensure data is always reconciled.

      • Support variable compensation analysis for relevant programs — running calculations, auditing for accuracy, and partnering with Finance to ensure payouts are correct and timely.

      • Build and maintain data structures that support reliable rolling forecasts for new and high-growth segments.

Butterfly Network, Inc. (NYSE: BFLY) is driving a digital revolution in ultrasound imaging and sensing with its proprietary Ultrasound-on-Chip™ semiconductor technology and software solutions. Through Butterfly Embedded™, partners can build and scale novel ultrasound applications powered by Butterfly’s proprietary semiconductor chip and software platform. Butterfly’s innovations have been recognized by Prix Galien USA, Fierce 50, TIME’s Best Inventions and Fast Company’s World Changing Ideas, among other achievements.

We’re a team of bold thinkers, problem-solvers, and innovators ready to shape the future of medical imaging. Let’s build something extraordinary together!

AI agents are changing how businesses operate, and how they get authorized, governed, and secured is being defined right now—largely by us. We build for solo founders and Fortune 500s alike, and the tension between those two is where the real product work lives.

What you’ll do

You'll set the vision and drive the roadmap for how every principal, human, agent, or app, gets access to a Stripe account. You'll do it by talking directly to the founders, admins, and developers who use it.

  • Design the experience of granting access, everywhere. Signing up, inviting a teammate, creating an API key, authorizing an agent or a third-party app.
  • Make agents a first-class citizen. Define how agents authenticate, what they're allowed to do, and how businesses stay in control, including approvals and human-in-the-loop checkpoints for the actions that matter most. You're defining an experience that will set the industry standard.
  • Drive least privilege, made easy. Build custom roles, smart permission defaults, and usage-based recommendations that make the secure choice the obvious one instead of the tedious one.
  • Push toward a world without secrets. Make secretless authentication (Workload Identity Federation) the default way developers integrate with Stripe, eliminating API key leaks as a category of risk rather than reducing their blast radius.
  • Partner across nearly all of Stripe. Pitch an ambitious vision, then get teams across Dashboard, API Platform, Security, Payments and Money Movement genuinely excited to build it with you, even though none of them report to you.
  • Ship, learn, and iterate: Run experiments, follow real usage, and adjust quickly rather than waiting for the perfect plan.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Bare Metal as a Service & Datacenter Networking
jobs.excerpt: About the TeamOur engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments.
jobs.description:
About the Team

Our engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments. We operate on a T-shaped engineering model: while each engineer brings deep expertise in a primary domain, every team member maintains practical fluency across neighboring systems. This shared foundation enables rigorous design reviews, effective cross-domain code reviews, and dependable on-call coverage. Our development is fundamentally based on open-source projects, and contributing to them is a major part of our work.

We develop primary control plane software in Rust and Go, leverage Kubernetes operators, and foster an OpenTelemetry-first operational culture.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong software architecture principles with deep technical domain expertise in Datacenter Networking and DPU architectures. Fitting into our T-shaped engineering model, you will drive the development of control planes powering high-density, high-throughput infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads. Familiarity with automated bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management is a strong asset.

Core Responsibilities

  • Control Plane Development: Design, build, and maintain production-grade control plane microservices, custom Kubernetes operators, and robust reconciliation engines in Rust and Go.

  • Architecture & API Design: Author clear Functional (FR) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), architectural specs, system sequence diagrams, and clean gRPC/Protobuf and REST API schemas.

  • Network Integration: Develop custom integration modules and integrations for modern network operating systems (SONiC, NVUE, Cumulus) and DPU hardware platforms.

  • Observability & Diagnostics: Instrument services end-to-end using OpenTelemetry (OTel) traces and metrics, performing systematic root-cause analysis across polyglot distributed systems.

  • Quality & Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous, review-gated pull request workflows across Rust, Go, and SQL codebases while ensuring high test coverage via mock-driven testing.

  • Language Proficiency: Primary mastery of Rust (Tokio async runtime, Tonic, Axum, sqlx) and strong proficiency in Go.

  • Data & APIs: Advanced SQL / PostgreSQL fluency, gRPC/Protobuf contract design, and schema evolution.

  • Concurrency & Reliability: Strong background in async concurrency models, lock-free patterns, distributed state handling, and mock-driven testing discipline.

  • Datacenter Protocols & OS: Expertise in BGP, MP-BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, L3VNI, route targets, and route server design. Hands-on experience with SONiC, Cumulus Linux, and NVUE (featuring a first-class NVUE client).

  • DPU & Fabric Ecosystem: Deep knowledge of NVIDIA DOCA, Host-Based Networking (HBN), BlueField DPU architectures, and the DPF (DOCA Platform Framework) operator model (BFB, DPUSet, DPUNode CRDs).

  • High-Performance Interconnects: Understanding of InfiniBand fabrics, NVLink / NMX-M partitioning, and RoCEv2.

  • Linux Kernel Networking: Advanced grasp of Linux netlink, network namespaces, routing tables, and internal DHCP/DNS service implementations (the project ships its own services).

  • Cloud & Kubernetes Networking: Familiarity with CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium). OVS and DPDK experience is a plus.

  • Provisioning & Boot Infrastructure: Expertise in PXE/iPXE, UEFI, Secure Boot, measured boot, and TPM attestation.

  • Hardware Management: Proficiency in Redfish, IPMI, and BMC abstractions across heterogeneous hardware platforms (Dell, Lenovo, NVIDIA reference hardware).

  • Linux Systems Internals: In-depth knowledge of boot chains, systemd, initramfs, BIOS configuration matrices.

  • Identity & Security: Practical experience with PKI, X.509 certificates, TLS, SPIFFE/SVID, Vault, KMS, Keycloak (OAuth2/JWT), and RBAC.

  • Virtualization: Experience with KubeVirt / KVM.

  • Kubernetes Control Planes: Experience writing custom controllers/operators using kube-rs or controller-runtime with CRD-driven reconciliation loop patterns.

Universal Requirements

  • Testing Discipline: Commitment to test-driven design, writing highly testable code with mock interfaces for external hardware and network dependencies.

  • Collaborative Architecture: Proven track record of writing crisp architectural specs and engaging in constructive, cross-functional design reviews.

Educational & Experience Baseline

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in cloud-native platforms, systems programming, networking, or infrastructure automation.

  • Demonstrated participation or maintainership in open-source systems projects is a plus.

What does Mirantis offer you?

- Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
- Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
- Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;
- Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;

- Professional development and training;

- Attend conferences and working groups;

- Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;

About the Team

Our engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments. We operate on a T-shaped engineering model: while each engineer brings deep expertise in a primary domain, every team member maintains practical fluency across neighboring systems. This shared foundation enables rigorous design reviews, effective cross-domain code reviews, and dependable on-call coverage. Our development is fundamentally based on open-source projects, and contributing to them is a major part of our work.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong software architecture principles with deep technical domain expertise in Datacenter Networking and DPU architectures. This role also provides technical leadership for integrations across platforms such as Okta, Auth0, Azure, AWS, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and custom applications, with an emphasis on security, reliability, maintainability, and business enablement.

      • Lead the architecture and design of CIAM and IAM solutions that support secure customer, partner, and workforce identity use cases across digital and enterprise environments.

      • Define reference architectures, technical standards, integration patterns, and guardrails for identity services, authentication flows, authorization models, and lifecycle automation.

      • Architect solutions for federation, single sign-on, adaptive authentication, MFA, delegated administration, identity proofing, registration, account recovery, consent, and progressive profiling.
