jobs.excerpt: Keeper Security is hiring a Senior Software Architect to provide technical leadership for our Browser Extension team and help shape the architecture of one of Keeper’s most widely used client experiences.
jobs.description:
Keeper Security is hiring a Senior Software Architect to provide technical leadership for our Browser Extension team and help shape the architecture of one of Keeper’s most widely used client experiences. This is a 100% remote position, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL or El Dorado Hills, CA metro areas.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help define the technical foundation for secure, high-performance browser experiences used by customers around the world.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Job

As a Senior Software Architect for Keeper’s Browser Extension team, you will define and guide the architecture of secure browser-based experiences across Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari and other supported platforms.

This is a highly hands-on technical leadership role focused on application architecture, browser extension frameworks, security, performance and cross-platform reliability. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Security, QA and UX teams to solve complex technical challenges, establish scalable design patterns and guide the long-term evolution of Keeper’s browser platform. You will remain close to the code while providing architectural direction across the team, ensuring that new capabilities are secure, maintainable and aligned with Keeper’s zero-knowledge security model.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and drive the technical architecture and long-term direction of Keeper’s browser extension platform
  • Lead architectural design for complex browser-based features, shared services and cross-platform capabilities
  • Design scalable solutions using JavaScript, TypeScript and modern web application technologies
  • Guide architecture across Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari and other supported browser environments
  • Establish patterns for secure communication between browser extension components, web applications, backend services and native integrations
  • Lead technical decisions involving extension lifecycle, background services, content scripts, messaging, storage and browser APIs
  • Ensure architectural decisions align with Keeper’s zero-knowledge and zero-trust security principles
  • Identify and address performance, memory, reliability and scalability challenges across browser environments
  • Guide migration and modernization initiatives as browser extension standards and platform capabilities evolve
  • Partner with Product and UX teams to translate complex product requirements into scalable technical designs
  • Collaborate with Security teams on threat modeling, secure design and remediation of security-sensitive browser functionality
  • Lead architecture reviews, design reviews and technical standards across the Browser Extension engineering team
  • Mentor senior engineers and help raise engineering quality, architecture discipline and technical decision-making across the team
  • Work closely with adjacent Vault, Desktop, Mobile and backend teams where functionality or architecture overlaps
  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar platforms to improve architecture research, prototyping, debugging, code analysis, documentation and engineering efficiency

Requirements

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with true full-stack development expertise spanning databases, backend services, APIs, infrastructure and modern user interfaces
  • Demonstrated 0-to-1 architecture experience designing and delivering complex software systems from initial concept through production
  • Strong knowledge of software architecture and object-oriented design patterns, including common Gang of Four design patterns
  • Deep understanding of performance engineering, including profiling, load testing, bottleneck analysis and real-time debugging across the full application stack
  • Experience designing highly available, scalable systems and evaluating tradeoffs between centralized and decentralized architectures
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, serverless architectures and event-driven application design
  • Experience with cloud-native technologies and platforms, including AWS, Lambda, Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of database architecture and data modeling across transactional systems, sharded or horizontally scaled databases and analytical or warehouse platforms
  • Experience designing secure authentication, authorization and identity architectures, including IAM, CIEM and least-privilege access concepts
  • Strong knowledge of web and application security concepts, including CORS, OWASP guidance and secure software development practices
  • Experience with static analysis, code quality or application security tooling such as SonarQube, Checkmarx or similar platforms
  • Strong understanding of modern software development methodologies, CI/CD practices, automated testing and release engineering
  • Demonstrated ability to make sound architectural tradeoffs across performance, security, scalability, reliability, maintainability and delivery speed
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across database, backend, infrastructure, network and UI layers
  • Proven ability to lead architecture discussions, influence technical direction and mentor senior engineers without relying on formal people-management authority
  • Ability and willingness to use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar platforms to support architecture research, prototyping, debugging, code analysis and technical documentation
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep experience with modern browser applications, browser extensions or client-side platform architecture
  • Experience building or integrating enterprise security platforms in areas such as IAM, CIEM, privileged access management or endpoint security
  • Familiarity with enterprise product categories such as GRC, Integrated Risk Management (IRM), SCADA or other specialized security and operational platforms
  • Familiarity with high-scale SaaS, security-sensitive or zero-trust application architectures
  • Experience with compliance and security frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 and GDPR
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards such as WCAG
  • Experience with product analytics platforms such as Google Analytics 4 or similar technologies
  • Familiarity with modern data and analytics platforms such as Databricks
  • Experience with machine learning, AI-enabled products, computer vision or reinforcement learning workflows
  • Experience integrating native applications, desktop software or endpoint components with browser or web platforms

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Electromagnetic and Cyber Group (EM&C) is responsible for developing flexible and survivable advanced electronic warfare and secure communications equipment while providing the industry’s leading signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and cyber experts.  Metrea specializes in signal classification, direction finding, advanced geolocation techniques, and waveform development including waveforms for MANET and LPI/LPD applications. Metrea also develops special purpose radios for government customers and licenses DF and geolocation solutions to multiple OEMs. 

Position Summary

This role is responsible for providing technical operations expertise, mission support, research and development, and solution design in support real world ISR mission efforts.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as a subject matter expert dedicated to identifying, developing, and delivering technical solutions in support of real world ISR mission efforts
  • Serve as a command and control liaison between the customer and mission platforms
  • Conduct research and development on emerging technologies, equipment, and TTPs in support of MSO’s operational solutions

  • Must possess above average initiative and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision or guidance
  • Must possess strong technical proficiency in Signals Intelligence, Electronic Warfare and Cyberspace theory, operations, TTPs, equipment, and associated technologies, to include, but not limited to: LINUX, computer networking, antenna construction/employment, and HF/VHF/UHF, DMR, GSM, CDMA, UMTS, LTE, 802.11, and Bluetooth protocols
  • Must possess experience and a working proficiency in Human Intelligence/Counterintelligence TTPs
  • Must possess the ability to maintain and quickly gain proficiency on emerging technologies and TTPs
  • Must possess strong communications skills and a solid command of the English language, both oral and written, and be comfortable with public speaking and briefing customers
  • 20 years’ experience including at least five deployments with Special Operations Forces or the IC in a technical role (SI/EW operator, tactical Cyber operator, or equivalent)

  • Must be a U.S. citizen
  • Valid Driver's License
  • Clearance required at time of hire: Active TS clearance with eligibility to obtain a TS/SCI clearance is required at time of hire, and the ability to maintain it throughout employment. Candidates will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with federal requirements
  • Position may require passing a government-administered background check

AAP/EEO Statement

Metrea Spectrum Operations LLC an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

It defines how we show up, how we work together, and how we solve complex problems.

Our team Firmware creates a web-like, hyper-collaborative, dynamically hierarchical way of working that helps us adapt quickly, communicate openly, and distribute decision-making to where expertise actually lives. Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team:

Web Presence & Platform (WPP) is organized into two pillars: Platform and Presence. The Platform pillar builds internal systems, tooling, and infrastructure to support the web. The Presence pillar owns Stripe’s public-facing storytelling across stripe.com, including our homepage, product landing pages, industry and solutions pages, and other high-impact go-to-market surfaces. Together, we shape how millions of people understand what Stripe is and what it can do for them.

Designers on the Presence team work at the intersection of craft and impact—balancing clarity, polish, and systems thinking with strategic storytelling and experimentation. We collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, content, and product to deliver work that is not only beautiful, but measurably moves the business.

What you’ll do

As a Designer on the Presence team, you'll contribute to the strategy and execution of Stripe’s most visible web surfaces. You’ll design new product pages, evolve storytelling for specific industries or audiences, and refine reusable patterns that make it easier to scale exceptional work across stripe.com. This is a high-impact role for a thoughtful, collaborative designer who deeply values visual craft, user clarity, and iteration.

We’re looking for someone who’s excited to operate at the intersection of storytelling, systems, and scale—and who takes pride in the pixels. Your work will directly shape how millions of users understand Stripe, and help convert interest into action across a range of audiences—from founders to enterprise CTOs.

Responsibilities

  • Design new and improved experiences across stripe.com, including product, industry, and solution landing pages
  • Collaborate with engineers, PMMs, and content designers to define problems, explore solutions, and bring them to life
  • Partner with other designers to maintain and evolve systems that uphold Stripe’s design standards at scale
  • Balance storytelling with usability to create pages that are engaging, credible, and easy to navigate
  • Use user research, user testing, and data to guide and validate your decisions
  • Participate in critique and feedback sessions, contributing to the overall quality bar of the team
  • Demonstrate a meticulous attention to craft—ensuring designs are not only functional, but visually excellent

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every preferred qualification.

Minimum requirements

  • 2–4 years of relevant design experience, ideally in web or product marketing contexts
  • A strong portfolio of web design work that demonstrates exceptional visual design skills, systems thinking, and attention to detail
  • Ability to independently scope and lead small to medium-sized projects
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset
  • Fluency in layout, typography, color, hierarchy, and interaction fundamentals

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with front-end development workflows or an ability to speak fluently with engineers
  • Understanding of web performance, accessibility, and SEO best practices
  • Experience designing for international audiences or multilingual websites
  • Previous experience in fast-paced, cross-functional environments

How we work

We care deeply about craft—but also about moving with urgency and focus. We seek feedback early and often, because we believe design gets stronger through collaboration and iteration. We keep our users front and center—whether that’s a small business owner evaluating Stripe for the first time, or a CTO trying to understand a complex product at a glance. And we take pride in delivering work that is not only beautiful and precise, but that delivers clear, measurable impact.

We value curiosity, humility, and resilience. You’ll do well here if you love to learn, enjoy working across disciplines, and bring energy and optimism into your work.

This is a great opportunity for someone eager to grow. Designers on the Presence team have gone on to lead major product launches, shape system-wide improvements, and take on leadership roles. You'll be supported by experienced peers and have space to develop your craft, influence, and ownership over time.

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe is looking for a senior product strategist-operator to join the Strategic Business Performance (SBP) team. SBP is the "connective tissue" of Stripe. You will have a front-row seat to how the company operates and a direct hand in ensuring we hit our most important goals. If you are a technical strategist who loves to move fast and fix high-stakes problems, we’d love to hear from you.

SBP is a small, high-leverage group within Central Strategy & Operations at Stripe. Our mission is to create strategic clarity around Stripe’s performance. We work with partner teams to report on the business; dive into it to support and pressure-test our strategy, driving change wherever we find soft spots and enabling the success of other teams.

We are looking for someone who connects across data, financials and product & business strategy. and can unearth a signal in the noise and either fix the problem directly or convene the right people to fix it fast.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will work cross-functionally within our group and across Stripe’s technical and user-facing teams to solve problems and design workflows that benefit our users. Specifically:

  • Own the "Signal": You will define and maintain the metrics that actually matter for in-year performance. You’ll develop a "morning read" discipline—a curated, high-signal view of the business that drives immediate action,
    moving far beyond standard dashboarding.
  • Deep-Dive Interventions: You will lead "surge" projects to diagnose and unblock critical goals at risk. You aren't just identifying problems; you are staying in the arena until the trajectory has measurably changed.
  • Bridge Product & Strategy: You will translate long-horizon corporate theses into in-year operational reality. You’ll take ambiguous opportunities that cut across product, risk, and marketing and decompose them into structured
    workstreams.
  • Synthesize for Leadership: You’ll think ahead of our executive team, preparing CEO/COO-level materials that translate unstructured signals into structured diagnoses they can act on.
  • Pressure-test our Assumptions: You’ll work closely with Corporate Strategy and Product teams to identify gaps between our external market forces and our internal execution.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 12+ years of experience in product/data analytics within product organizations or strategic business performance teams at high-growth tech companies
  • Experience in Product Strategy, Product Management, or GM-style roles where you owned a P&L or a specific
    business outcome
  • Deeply curious about business models and data, probing into signals, understanding trends and customer usage patterns to uncover novel insights
  • A proven track record of directly driving business growth through analytical insights and execution
  • Apply AI to enhance decision-making and operational efficiency, know when and how to use the right AI tools to move faster without sacrificing rigor or quality
  • Strong product sense and the ability to understand the technical mechanics of how software products are built and scaled
  • Experience navigating ambiguous, cross-functional problems and leading high-stakes interventions with senior stakeholders
  • Prior experience with fintech products or complex financial systems is a plus, but not required
  • Experience facilitating senior leadership/ stakeholder meetings to drive meaningful conversations regarding Stripe’s business performance

Preferred qualifications

  • Payments ecosystem, or experience in finance or fintech is a plus
  • Ability to build trust and partner with senior leaders and CXOs
  • Technical proficiency in SQL / Python / R and data analysis; ability to self-serve and perform independent deep-dives into complex datasets
  • Experience driving creative solutions with and effectively informing the roadmap of cross-functional teams
  • Ability to understand the implications of Stripe ships such as product features, policy changes, and marketing outreach on the user experience and resulting support experience

jobs.description:
About Moniepoint

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in annual digital payment transaction value.

About The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Relations Partner to join the Corporate Affairs and R&D teams. You will work closely with our engineering teams to tell the story of what we’re building in a language that other expert engineers understand.

This is a content execution role. You will translate what our engineers build and learn into high-quality narratives: the kind that earns genuine respect in engineering communities, gets accepted at top-tier conferences, and attracts exceptional engineers from around the world.

The right person for this role is a former engineer who has found their voice as a writer and communicator; someone who can walk into a room of engineers as a peer, ask the right questions, and come out with a story worth telling.

Who You Are

To succeed in this role, you must have:

  • A background in software engineering or computer science. You have written code professionally and understand how engineering teams think and work.
  • Experience in a fintech, infrastructure, or high-scale engineering environment.
  • Exceptional writing skills: clarity, precision, and the ability to make complex ideas compelling without oversimplifying them.
  • The instinct to find stories; you don't wait to be assigned a topic, you spot what's interesting and go after it.
  • A genuine understanding of what makes technical content credible, shareable, and respected in global engineering communities.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines independently in a fully remote environment.

It's a strong plus if you have:

  • Experience in developer relations or managing technical communities; you already know how to engage engineers authentically at scale.
  • Experience writing conference talk abstracts or proposals, with evidence of submissions accepted at recognised events.
  • Experience writing video scripts or working closely with creative and production teams.
  • An existing presence in engineering communities (your own blog, open source contributions, speaking experience, or a following in developer spaces).

What to expect in the hiring process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter
  • A take-home assessment
  • Panel interview
  • Executive interview

jobs.description:
Trusted empowers the healthcare workforce with technology-first solutions to optimize the clinical workforce. By combining our AI-powered staffing platform with dynamic labor marketplaces, we help leading employers automate the matching and fulfillment of clinical staff---driving down labor costs and reducing administrative burden. Our mission, to help people everywhere get care, has support from top institutional investors such as Craft Ventures, Felicis Ventures, Stepstone, and Founder Collective as well as healthcare innovators like Texas Medical Center, Mercy Health, Intermountain Ventures, and Town Hall Ventures.

What we're looking for:

You will use your direct experience as a Recruiter or Account Manager in the Travel Nursing Industry to serve as a partner and key collaborator with our clients to understand their staffing needs. You will proactively solve problems, fill open jobs, and ultimately grow these strategic relationships to maintain and expand our business. The Account Manager will take initiative, setting objectives and creating actionable plans to deliver results. You will be a resourceful, solution oriented problem-solver, expertly navigating areas such as how and when jobs are posted, upcoming projects or staffing challenges, what the job submission requirements are, and the interview and offer process cadence. You will remove barriers where possible and work collaboratively with the product and Nurse Advocate teams to increase our submission-to-offer rate. The Account Manager will be the day-to-day relationship support required to place and retain Clinicians.

Your responsibilities:

  • Maintain trusted relationships with assigned clients, resulting in a 100% retention rate of current and future accounts.
  • Meet assigned targets for growth.
  • Develop new relationships that result in successful additions to our client roster.
  • Gather and track feedback from clients and create reports on the health of relationships and opportunities for improvement.
  • Collaborate with leadership on the Nurse Advocate team to improve standing with clients through higher quantity and quality of placements.
  • Proactively identify and offer solutions to barriers for growth in our accounts and placements.

Who you are:

  • Strategic-thinker. You anticipate future trends, helping the team to understand and use complex analyses to achieve goals. You clearly distinguish and leverage the organization’s key differentiators, incorporating them into a solid long-term strategy. You are highly alert to the future, developing hypotheses and enabling their team to address change, tackle challenges and capture new possibilities. You see the big picture in a relationship and know how the little things you do today to provide value can create big things down the road.
  • Customer-focused. You champion the needs of clients, helping team members deepen insight into customer needs. You have a long-term understanding of client needs, building roadmaps with measurable outcomes that address current and anticipated problems.
  • Influencing & Persuading. You make it a priority to broker relationships and forge connections that contribute to others success and advance Trusted's goals.
  • Personable and reliable. You can create and grow relationships with key stakeholders by providing value and meeting their needs in order to grow these relationships.

You have:

  • 3 or more years of experience in healthcare staffing with direct experience working with RNs, either in Account Management or Recruitment, preferably at a high-growth startup and/or a healthcare or staffing company.
  • Experience in building and maintaining strategic relationships and growing a book of business with RNs through excellent presentation and communication skills with the ability to hold challenging conversations.
  • Knowledge and understanding of the healthcare staffing landscape and buyers (VMS/MSP/Direct).
  • Knowledge of compliance criteria and Joint Commission requirements for RN professions.
  • Worked cross-functionally and enjoy working as a team to achieve a goal.
  • A High School Diploma is required, Associate's or Bachelor's Degree preferred.

We offer:

  • Paid vacation & sick time, paid family leave, and flexible work hours
  • Employer-paid health insurance, vision, and dental
  • Employer-paid life insurance
  • Monthly cell phone reimbursement
  • Employer-sponsored 401k
  • Variable compensation plan

Trusted reasonably anticipates the below to be the annual base salary range for this role. The final compensation for this position will vary based on geographic location and candidate experience relative to what Trusted reasonably anticipates for this position. We are committed to transparency, and any compensation questions will be addressed early in our recruitment process.

$79,292—$89,203 USD

jobs.excerpt: At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members.
jobs.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:
• Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
• Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
• Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights – technology plays an invaluable role in our success. Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog!
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

Your Role:

We are seeking an articulate, highly organized, and collaborative L3 Product Marketing Manager to lead high-reach product communications and stakeholder alignment across our technology suite. In this role, you will act as the primary voice of our technology products. You will own product positioning, craft compelling messaging, launch new features, and drive sustained user engagement among internal stakeholders, with the opportunity to expand your scope to artists, songwriters, and managers. Working closely with cross-functional partners across Product, Marketing, Corporate Communications, Label Services, and Artist Relations, you will build alignment and translate complex product roadmaps into compelling, accessible narratives for our global network. If you thrive on blending broad communication strategy with tailored 1:1 outreach, building executive alignment, and rallying teams around new tech, we encourage you to apply.

Here you'll get to:

  • Design and execute high-impact, wide-reaching communication plans for platform rollouts, tech initiatives, and feature updates across the organization.

  • Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional stakeholders across Product Management, Global Marketing, Label Services, and Artist Teams to ensure seamless alignment on GTM timelines.

  • Author and oversee consistent product messaging across high-visibility channels, including company-wide announcements, executive briefs, newsletter broadcasts, and product release notes.

  • Partner with stakeholder leads to develop tailored enablement toolkits, pitch decks, and briefing materials that empower frontline teams to champion technology products.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for business stakeholders regarding product communication, release cadences, and go-to-market schedules.

  • Coordinate cross-functional communication launch calendars to prevent message fatigue and ensure clear, strategic timing across all internal and external channels.

  • Establish clear comms protocols and templates to standardize product messaging across different global territories and business units.

  • Monitor engagement metrics across communication channels (e.g., email open rates, portal visits, executive readership) to continuously refine communication reach and clarity.

  • Be the central communicator shaping how technology features and platforms are announced to the global music community.

  • Work at the intersection of music culture, corporate strategy, and tech innovation.

  • Build an extensive network of cross-functional partners across North America and international territories.

  • Own broad communication channels and scale messaging that reaches executives, artists, and internal teams alike.

  • Grow your career in a collaborative environment built on strong mentorship, creative freedom, and clear communication.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Public Relations, or a related field.

  • 2-3 years of professional experience in product marketing, strategic communications, or marketing operations (tech, media, or music industry preferred).

  • Strong track record of running broad, scaled communication campaigns and managing multi-channel messaging strategies.

  • Proven ability to build consensus, navigate matrixed organizations, and maintain trust with cross-functional stakeholders at varying levels.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to simplify technical jargon into punchy, compelling, and broad-appeal stories.

  • Solid understanding of or strong passion for the digital music ecosystem, creator platforms, and emerging music technologies.

  • Highly organized with strong project management skills and meticulous attention to detail in cross-team coordination.

  • You are an exceptional communicator who excels at broadcasting clear, energetic, and tailored messages across large audiences.

  • You are a natural relationship-builder, skilled at balancing diverse stakeholder interests and keeping everyone aligned and informed.

  • You possess strong narrative discipline—knowing how to distill complex technical roadmaps into executive-level summaries and high-impact announcements.

  • You are proactive and structured, keeping projects on schedule and ensuring communication flows smoothly across teams.

  • You bring high empathy and adaptability, easily tuning your communication style whether speaking to tech engineers, label executives, or artist representatives.

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.
Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.
Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.
Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
WMG is committed to inclusion and diversity in all aspects of our business. jobs.description:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA | Remote / Home-Based
Travel: Domestic travel required
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Business Development Manager to drive the growth of our data center thermal management business in North America.

This role will focus on developing strategic relationships with hyperscale data centers, AI infrastructure companies, server/OEM partners, system integrators, and other key players across the data center ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines strong business development capabilities with hands-on knowledge of data center cooling technologies, particularly liquid cooling and advanced heat-transfer solutions. This is a highly entrepreneurial position for someone comfortable independently developing a market, building customer relationships, and driving opportunities from initial engagement through commercial execution.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Market Expansion

  • Develop new business opportunities within the North American data center and AI infrastructure market.
  • Identify and engage hyperscalers, OEMs, system integrators, data center operators, and other strategic customers.
  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of new accounts, projects, and partnership opportunities.
  • Independently drive the full business development cycle, from prospecting and initial engagement to technical discussions, commercial negotiations, and project conversion.

Key Account Management

  • Develop and maintain relationships with key customer stakeholders across engineering, procurement, supply chain, infrastructure, and business teams.
  • Identify opportunities for account expansion, new programs, product upgrades, and additional applications.
  • Establish long-term customer relationships that support recurring and scalable revenue.

Solution & Technical Selling

  • Promote thermal management products and solutions for next-generation data center and high-performance computing applications.
  • Work with technical and engineering teams to understand customer requirements and develop appropriate thermal solutions.
  • Support customer discussions involving liquid cooling, cold plate technologies, heat exchangers, air cooling, and related thermal management architectures.
  • Translate customer technical requirements into actionable commercial opportunities.

Market Intelligence & Partnerships

  • Monitor developments in AI infrastructure, high-density computing, liquid cooling, and data center technologies.
  • Identify potential channel, technology, and ecosystem partners in the North American market.
  • Provide market feedback regarding customer requirements, competitive landscape, technology trends, and emerging opportunities.

Industry Engagement

  • Represent the company at relevant data center, AI infrastructure, thermal management, and technology industry events.
  • Participate in customer visits, technical seminars, conferences, and trade shows as needed.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience within the data center, electronics, thermal management, or related infrastructure industry.
  • 3+ years of sales or business development experience in North America.
  • Direct experience selling data center thermal management, liquid cooling, cold plates, heat exchangers, cooling systems, or closely related infrastructure solutions.
  • Strong understanding of data center cooling technologies and the differences between liquid and air cooling architectures.
  • Demonstrated success developing new customers and building business opportunities from the ground up.
  • Experience managing complex B2B sales cycles involving technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Willingness to travel for customer meetings, industry events, and business development activities.
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal/Fluid Sciences, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Business, or a related discipline preferred. Equivalent industry experience will also be considered.

Preferred Experience

  • Existing relationships within the North American AI infrastructure, hyperscale data center, OEM, server, system integration, or colocation ecosystem.
  • Experience supporting major cloud service providers, AI computing companies, or large-scale data center customers.
  • Experience with high-density computing and next-generation liquid cooling applications.
  • Established relationships with engineering, procurement, supply chain, or infrastructure decision-makers.
  • Previous experience launching or expanding a product line or business territory in North America.
  • Experience working in a global or cross-border organization is a plus.

What We're Looking For

This position is particularly well suited for a hunter-oriented business development professional who understands both the technical and commercial sides of the data center cooling market.

The successful candidate should be comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy, developing new relationships from scratch, navigating technical customer organizations, and turning early-stage opportunities into long-term strategic accounts.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionAs a Liberty Mutual Insurance Actuary on the Global Surety Actuarial Pricing team, you’ll apply your analytical talents to non-traditional actuarial problems that directly shape Surety pricing and underwriting decisions.
jobs.description:
Description

As a Liberty Mutual Insurance Actuary on the Global Surety Actuarial Pricing team, you’ll apply your analytical talents to non-traditional actuarial problems that directly shape Surety pricing and underwriting decisions. You’ll work in a collaborative, dynamic environment where you own a core pricing capability, contribute to a variety of Surety analytical projects, and partner closely with underwriting leadership to bring value to the business. In this position, you will support the profit, growth, and operational objectives of Global Surety, with a primary focus on Subcontractor Default Insurance (SDI).

Responsibilities:

  • Own the SDI pricing model— run, maintain, and continuously improve the SDI pricing tool, which applies a distinct methodology from the broader risk-based pricing (RBP) suite. Design and implement enhancements to the underlying methodology and develop new functionality to keep the tool at the leading edge of SDI analytics.
  • Perform and review complex actuarial analyses for the SDI segment to inform pricing decisions, business strategy, and financial planning — including price adequacy reporting, premium forecasting, and risk transfer analyses.
  • Provide actuarial support for the annual SDI reinsurance renewal process, delivering the analyses and insights needed to support renewal negotiations and decisions.
  • Contribute to broader Surety projects and analyses — apply your actuarial expertise to a range of initiatives across the Global Surety portfolio beyond SDI, supporting the team’s evolving priorities and the profitability and growth of the business.
  • Serve as a trusted actuarial advisor to the SDI underwriting organization — communicating directly and frequently with the SDI Chief Underwriting Officer and underwriting team to support pricing decisions and enhance underwriting capabilities.

Title:

Senior Human Resources Generalist

The Senior Corporate Human Resources Generalist serves as a trusted People Team partner to leaders and employees across Trinzic's corporate functions. Working closely with the Manager, Corporate People Partner, this role provides guidance and support on employee relations, performance management, talent initiatives, organizational effectiveness, and workforce planning activities. The position requires sound judgment, strong employee relations expertise, and the ability to address complex workplace issues while supporting business needs and maintaining compliance with company policies and employment practices.

Trinzic is being established as an independent public company through the planned separation of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, which is expected to be completed on January 4, 2027. This role offers a rare opportunity to join the organization during a pivotal period of growth and transformation, helping build and support people programs, policies, and practices that will position the company for long-term success while supporting critical government and commercial missions around the world.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with leaders and employees across corporate functions to provide guidance on employee relations, performance management, employment practices, and People Team policies.
  • Manage employee relations matters, including workplace concerns, investigations, conflict resolution, and performance-related issues.
  • Coach managers on employee engagement, talent development, performance management, and effective leadership practices.
  • Support organizational changes, workforce planning activities, and restructuring initiatives in partnership with business leaders and People Team stakeholders.
  • Partner with Compensation, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, Mobility, and People Operations teams to deliver integrated people solutions.
  • Support talent management processes, including performance reviews, succession planning discussions, and development planning activities.
  • Review workforce data and people metrics to identify trends, support decision making, and inform People Team recommendations.
  • Assist with the development, implementation, and communication of People Team programs, policies, and initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with employment laws, company policies, and established HR practices.
  • Participate in special projects and strategic People Team initiatives associated with Trinzic's growth and evolution as a standalone public company.

Basic Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive Human Resources experience.
  • Experience managing employee relations matters and conducting workplace investigations.
  • Experience partnering directly with managers on performance management, employee engagement, and organizational change initiatives.
  • Experience supporting a corporate or professional employee population in a complex organizational environment.

Professional Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of employee relations principles, HR practices, and employment law fundamentals.
  • Demonstrated ability to build credibility and influence leaders across multiple levels of an organization.
  • Strong business partnership, coaching, and consultation skills.
  • Ability to assess and resolve complex employee situations using sound judgment and discretion.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining confidentiality and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, or SHRM-SCP certification.
  • Experience supporting corporate functions within a public company environment.
  • Exposure to global employee populations and HR practices.
  • Experience with Workday or similar HRIS platforms.
  • Experience supporting organizations during periods of growth, transformation, or organizational change.

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.

jobs.description:
CCI Group | Remote, International | Independent Contractor About the Opportunity CCI Group is looking for an experienced Interpreting Operations Coordinator to provide remote independent contractor support to our Interpreting Department and senior operations team. This opportunity is specifically intended for professionals located outside of the United States. Candidates may be based internationally but must be able to consistently provide support during CCI Group's primary operating hours of 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday. If you know interpreting, you know there is rarely such a thing as a completely predictable day. An interpreter becomes unavailable. A client sends an urgent request. A hard-to-fill language lands in the queue. An invoice needs clarification. Three assignments need coverage at the same time. Somehow, all the pieces still need to come together accurately, professionally, and with a great experience for our clients and interpreting resources. That’s where you come in. We’re looking for someone who already understands the language services industry and can independently support interpreting operations, including scheduling, interpreter recruitment, resource communication, documentation, and invoice review. What You’ll Support As an Interpreting Operations Coordinator, your responsibilities will include: Coordinating interpreting assignments across multiple clients and projects. Identifying and assigning qualified interpreters based on language, location, availability, credentials, experience, modality, and client-specific requirements. Recruiting and sourcing new interpreters, particularly for hard-to-fill languages, geographic areas, and specialized assignments. Communicating regularly with interpreters regarding availability, assignment details, confirmations, changes, documentation, and project requirements. Maintaining accurate assignments, interpreter profiles, notes, documentation, and scheduling information within our scheduling platform. Monitoring upcoming assignments and proactively identifying potential coverage issues. Supporting senior team members with high-volume, complex, urgent, and specialized interpreting requests. Assisting with interpreter onboarding and ensuring required documentation is collected and maintained. Reviewing interpreter invoices and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness. Following up with interpreting resources regarding missing invoices, timesheets, verification of service, or other required documentation. Maintaining accurate project and assignment records to support invoicing, reporting, and overall operational efficiency. Communicating professionally and promptly with interpreters, clients, and CCI team members. Assisting with last-minute cancellations, replacements, schedule changes, and other unexpected situations. Collaborating with CCI's Project Management, Operations, Finance, Recruiting, and other functions as needed. Identifying opportunities to improve workflows and processes instead of simply accepting, "That's how we've always done it." Requirements What We’re Looking For Required Qualifications: Minimum 3 years of professional experience in interpreting coordination, language services project management, interpreter scheduling, interpreting operations, or a closely related role. Demonstrated experience scheduling and coordinating interpreters in a professional language services environment. Hands-on experience with ScheduleInterpreter® is strongly preferred, or experience with a comparable interpreter scheduling or language services management platform. Experience recruiting, sourcing, and maintaining relationships with freelance interpreters and language professionals. Experience reviewing interpreter/vendor invoices and supporting service documentation. Strong understanding of interpreting operations and the lifecycle of an interpreting assignment. Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken. This role communicates in English with clients, interpreters, and internal team members throughout the day, including time-sensitive and sometimes difficult conversations, so a high level of written clarity and professional tone is essential. Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail. Ability to independently manage multiple assignments, deadlines, priorities, and last-minute changes. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to take initiative. Ability to consistently provide remote support during 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, regardless of the contractor's local time zone. Reliable high-speed internet access and the technology necessary to provide services remotely. Must be located outside of the United States and able to provide services as an independent contractor in accordance with applicable requirements in their country of residence. Even Better If You Have Experience coordinating multiple types of interpreting services, including ASL, spoken-language interpreting, on-site interpreting, remote interpreting, simultaneous interpreting, and consecutive interpreting, is highly valued. Experience supporting government, education, legal, healthcare, corporate, or conference interpreting programs is also a plus. Bilingual or multilingual professionals are strongly encouraged to apply. Benefits Who Will Thrive With CCI? CCI isn't the kind of environment where every day follows the same script. We move quickly. We solve problems. We communicate. We help each other. And when something unexpected happens, because in interpreting something unexpected will happen, we focus on finding the solution. You’ll probably enjoy working with us if you: Notice a potential problem before someone has to point it out. Actually enjoy solving a complicated scheduling puzzle. Can communicate warmly while still getting the information you need. Understand that interpreters are not simply names on a roster and that strong relationships with our resources matter. Can have ten things happening and still recognize which one needs attention first. Are comfortable asking questions, sharing ideas, and suggesting better ways to do things. Take ownership of your commitments and follow them through to completion. Can work independently while collaborating effectively with a busy remote team. Like working with people who take the work seriously without making the workplace painfully corporate. Why CCI? At CCI Group, interpreting is ultimately about people. Our clients depend on us to make communication accessible, and our interpreters depend on us to provide the information, coordination, and support they need to deliver excellent service. We are a collaborative, resourceful team that values communication, accountability, creativity, problem-solving, and people who aren't afraid to jump in when things get busy. For the right person, this is an opportunity to work alongside experienced language services professionals while making a meaningful contribution to interpreting operations across a variety of clients, industries, languages, and service types. Engagement Details Engagement Type: Independent Contractor Location: Remote, outside the United States Operational Coverage Needed: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time Experience: Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience ScheduleInterpreter®: Strongly preferred, or experience with a comparable interpreter scheduling platform English Proficiency: Professional working proficiency required If you understand interpreting operations, love making complicated schedules work, know how to build relationships with interpreting resources, and believe that "I'll figure it out" is sometimes a perfectly reasonable first step toward solving a problem, we'd love to hear from you. Equal Opportunity CCI Group is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants on qualifications and experience, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know and we will work with you.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT US Calibrate is on a mission to change the way the world treats weight by redefining obesity care as a matter of biology, not willpower.
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Calibrate is on a mission to change the way the world treats weight by redefining obesity care as a matter of biology, not willpower. Designed by world leaders in metabolic health, our program combines clinical research, personalized coaching, and lifestyle intervention to deliver lasting weight loss and improved metabolic outcomes. With obesity as America’s largest chronic condition, impacting 175mm adults in a $600B market, we’re closing the care gap by offering the first value-based model in obesity treatment.

Since launching Direct-to-Consumer in 2020, we’ve expanded into Enterprise channels to improve access, and our app-based experience supports members with coaching, tailored education, daily tracking, and community engagement across the four pillars of metabolic health: food, sleep, exercise, and emotional wellbeing.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a coach at Calibrate, you will be dedicated to fostering accountability, delivering real results, and ensuring an exceptional experience for our members.

We are seeking experienced coaches with strong interpersonal skills and a positive attitude to provide exceptional care to our valued members. As a coach at Calibrate, you will guide members in improving their relationships with food, sleep, exercise, and emotional health. You will support them in setting and achieving incremental goals as they progress through the Calibrate program, celebrating their successes, addressing challenges, and holding them accountable as they build sustainable, healthy habits. Additionally, you will be responsible for administrative tasks, resolving member inquiries, and ensuring an outstanding member experience, all while helping our members achieve their desired outcomes.

The shift options for this role are 10am-3pm PST or 1pm-6pm PST, Monday-Friday. This is a part-time position consisting of 25 hours per week with a rate of $20 per hour.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Implement core coaching competencies to inspire and support members throughout their lifestyle journey, strategically setting goals while leveraging the Calibrate Intensive Lifestyle Intervention Program.
  • Engage, support, and retain members by establishing strong rapport, demonstrating empathy, and consistently going the extra mile to deliver compassionate, solution-focused service.
  • Ensure that quality member experiences are consistently delivered across all channels (asynchronous messaging, phone, live chat) while adhering to local, state, and federal guidelines.
  • Handle inbound member calls in a professional, timely, and caring manner, ensuring accurate and helpful responses.
  • Assist Calibrate members with a variety of tasks, including responding to general program inquiries, verifying information, processing account updates, and efficiently navigating multiple systems to provide accurate and timely information.
  • Proactively identify members’ needs by asking clarifying questions, researching issues, and providing solutions or alternatives within established workflows.
  • Contribute to achieving Calibrate’s service level agreements through effective collaboration with team members, leaders, and other departments.
  • Embody and demonstrate Calibrate’s values in every interaction with members.
  • Personalize the Calibrate program for each member by setting relevant, achievable, and incremental goals that align with their unique needs.
  • Actively listen to members, empowering them to discover their own motivation and solutions for sustainable habit change.
  • Utilize key engagement metrics to effectively support members in achieving their goals.
  • Apply company policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues with precision and care.
  • Provide accurate, complete, and valid information by using the right methods and tools, seeking support when necessary to align with member requests.
  • Effectively escalate member concerns to coach leadership in a timely and appropriate manner and calmly de-escalate situations involving dissatisfied members, offering empathetic assistance and solutions.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of all member interactions, next steps, and escalate issues to your manager as needed.

These are key responsibilities and may evolve with changing business needs, as a member of the Calibrate coaching team it is essential that you are ready to adapt accordingly.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of professional work experience required
  • A minimum of 2 years of coaching experience is required, or 1-year plus a coaching certification. NBHWC preferred
  • Customer service experience preferred
  • Bilingual Spanish is a plus
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills. Patient, personable, and kind -- in writing, in person, on the phone, and on video
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport quickly and communicate effectively with members and other team members of Calibrate
  • Ability to effectively work remotely having strong computer skills (Google Suite, Slack, Video Conferencing) and ability to work on a computer for extended periods of time
  • Flexible, adaptable and self-motivated
  • Predictable and regular attendance during scheduled work hours
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment, startup experience preferred.
  • A self-starter with the ability to hold yourself accountable in a remote working environment

OUR VALUES

Members First. Always.

Every decision starts with one question - Will this improve the health and the experience of the people we serve?

Outcomes That Matter.

We measure success through sustained weight loss and meaningful improvements in cardiometabolic health.

Integrated Care Wins.

Obesity care requires more than medication alone. We combine clinical care, behavior change, and technology into one coordinated care model.

Relentless Improvement.

We continuously learn from outcomes, data, and our experience to refine our care model and raise the standard of obesity treatment.

Great Partners.

We strive to be easy to work with and trusted by patients, employers, clinicians, partners, and our fellow Calibraters.

Calibrate is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to all team members. To achieve our mission of changing the way the world treats weight, we are building an environment where every Calibrater can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do the best work of their careers. We value diversity and recruit, hire, and promote individuals solely based on talent, qualifications, competence, and merit. We evaluate candidates without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other protected characteristics as required by law and as a matter of our company values.

You are

The ideal candidate will be able to work autonomously and confidently, make underwriting decisions that provide the best offer within their assigned approval authority and protect mortality. They will also be able to transform conceptual thinking into competitive decisions that align with company philosophy and department guidelines.

You have

  • Minimum of 15-20 years of experience in individual life underwriting
  • Proven track record handling large and complex cases for high-net-worth applicants
  • Industry related education (FALU, FLMI, etc.)
  • Specialized depth and breadth of expertise in individual life underwriting, including authority on complex and high dollar cases.
  • Demonstrated experience working within reinsurance frameworks, including interpreting treaty language, understanding retention limits, applying automatic and facultative reinsurance rules, and collaborating with reinsurance partners.
  • Expertise reviewing complex financial statements, tax returns, etc.
  • Familiarity with emerging technologies (Electronic Health Record (EHR), GenAI, wearable technology) and behavioral economics concepts.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, able to adapt precedent and develop innovative approaches.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, capable of influencing peers and supporting leadership.

You will

  • Serve as the large case underwriting and financial specialist, adjudicating the most complex and high-value cases, reviewing appeals, reference, reinsurance submissions, ensuring decisions align with underwriting guidelines, mortality, morbidity, and product expectations.
  • Provide expert judgment and guidance on escalated cases, troubleshooting complex issues for all levels of staff and management.
  • Communicate with field partners and home office personnel for the purpose of acquiring necessary information, solving problems, negotiating appeals, and conveying decisions in a polite, confident, and professional manner.
  • Build and strengthen partnerships with distribution leaders, agencies, and field partners to ensure alignment and service excellence and understanding of adverse decisions
  • Apply deep reinsurance expertise to ensure appropriate use of automatic and facultative reinsurance, evaluate treaty requirements, and partner with reinsurance underwriters as needed.
  • Serve as a trusted underwriting partner to Distribution and Field leadership, delivering clear guidance, responsive support, and consultative expertise to drive case placement, strengthen relationships, and ensure a seamless experience for producers and customers.
  • Maintain deep knowledge of underwriting guidelines, risk assessment methodologies, and regulatory requirements, ensuring compliance and consistency.
  • Champion the adoption and effective use of modern underwriting tools and platforms, ensuring integration into daily workflows.
  • Mentor, train, and guide underwriters in advanced financial underwriting.
  • Monitor industry trends and share insights to inform prudent business decisions.

As our Underwriting Large Case Specialist, you will report to our Head of Underwriting Risk Management

This position is a remote position.

jobs.description:
Established in 2009, Impact Fire Services was the vision of a group of experienced industry professionals that wanted to build a best-in-class fire protection and life safety company. Through superior customer service and technical expertise, we have developed long-standing relationships with the leading businesses in our markets. We are a full-service fire protection company, providing installation, maintenance, inspection, monitoring, and retrofit of fire safety systems. Come join a dynamic team of fire protection professionals, many of whom carry NICET and manufacturer certifications in leading brands. Impact Fire has deep experience supporting many industries including retail, healthcare, education and restaurants. Today, we operate over 52+ district offices and employ over 2,100 employees across multiple states throughout the USA.

At Impact Fire Services you can learn a trade with multiple career paths in fire and life safety while benefiting from an employee focused company culture that allows you to gain mentorship and training provided by leading experts at one of the fastest growing companies in the industry. Whether you have transferable skills, prior industry experience, or are looking to start your journey, our apprenticeship programs will give you the support and knowledge you need to go further in your career.

Why work with us?

At Impact Fire, we are a group of hardworking, dedicated fire protection professionals committed to protecting lives and property from fire. Our cohesive team spirit and customer service-oriented culture are expressed in all that we do. We operate with the belief that every team member plays a critical role in our success. We operate in 52+ district office locations across the United States, supporting industries ranging from retail and healthcare to education and restaurants.

Please text “ImpactFire” to 512-722-7592 to connect with Ember, Impact Fire’s Recruiting Assistant, to learn more about this position and the company.

Benefits of joining Impact Fire Services

When you join Impact Fire you will receive:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Pay is on a weekly cycle, every Friday
  • Career Advancement Opportunities
  • Competitive benefits, including healthcare, dental, vision, life insurance, paid time off and holidays
  • Company paid short and long-term disability
  • Immediately vested in our 401(k) company match
  • Full-time employees participate in our Shared Ownership Program which offers a monetary bonus aligned to the company's long-term success. This program fosters an ownership mindset and ensures that every employee meaningfully shares in the success they help create.
  • Exceptional guidance and support from our managers
  • Collaborative culture & environment
  • Robust training opportunities with company reimbursement upon achieving required licensing
  • Apprenticeship programs for fire sprinkler, fire alarm and inspection positions
  • Opportunity to work alongside some of the best talent in the fire protection industry

OBJECTIVES:

The Director, Project Operations (Fire Protection) provides strategic leadership for a large and fast growing fire protection project business, including fire sprinkler, fire alarm, suppression, and special hazards system installations. This role ensures strong financial performance, consistent project execution, and scalable growth across multiple branches. This position partners closely with finance, local branch leadership, and regional Impact Fire leadership to support forecasting accuracy, margin improvement, and operational process discipline. The Director also plays a key role in supporting Impact Fire’s merger and acquisition strategy, performing operational reviews, job walks, and project evaluations for prospective acquisitions. The Director serves as the enterprise leader for project performance, partnering with District Managers and Regional Vice Presidents to improve profitability, forecasting accuracy, execution consistency, project governance, and operational scalability across all project operations

NATURE OF POSITION:

This role oversees multi branch protection project operations with an emphasis on NFPA compliant installations, accurate planning, and effective field execution. The Director also supports the evaluation of acquisition targets, reviewing operational structure, project backlog, field practices, and technical capabilities.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategic & Operational Leadership

  • Provide multi location oversight for fire protection project operations, ensuring alignment with corporate and regional goals.
  • Implement standardized processes for estimating, design, installation, commissioning, and closeout across all branches.
  • Collaborate with regional and local leadership to ensure project capacity supports pipeline and backlog growth.

Financial Management & Forecasting

  • Partner with operations on P&L oversight for project operations, including revenue, gross margin, labor productivity, and cashflow.
  • Partner with finance on budgeting, WIP reviews, cost to complete accuracy, and financial forecasting.
  • Strengthen cost controls, change order processes, field productivity metrics, and material management strategies.

Project Execution & Technical Oversight

  • Ensure all fire protection projects meet NFPA code requirements and comply with Authority Having Jurisdiction expectations.
  • Provide hands-on guidance to resolve complex project challenges, including engineering coordination, fabrication logistics, and field execution.
  • Establish quality control checkpoints at project kickoff, mid project, and closeout.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a key operational link between project teams, finance partners, branch leaders, and regional Impact Fire leadership.
  • Support integration and alignment efforts for newly acquired companies.
  • Partner with design and engineering teams to improve submittal processes, permitting workflows, and system installation planning.

Team Development & Leadership

  • Develop and mentor project managers, estimators, coordinators, and design staff across multiple branches.
  • Support branch leaders in recruiting and evaluating project related talent.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, safety, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

Growth & Market Expansion

  • Support organic growth by improving project execution, enhancing estimating effectiveness, and expanding operational capabilities.
  • Lead scalability planning for new geographic territories or service line expansions.

Safety & Compliance

  • Champion a strong safety culture across all project and field operations.
  • Ensure project teams meet all OSHA requirements and comply with NFPA standards and Authority Having Jurisdiction mandates.
  • Partner with safety leadership to improve training, audits, and jobsite practices.

M&A Support Responsibilities

  • The Director will support Impact Fire’s acquisition strategy through technical and operational assessments of prospective businesses:
  • Conduct job walks at potential acquisition targets to evaluate installation quality, project management discipline, safety practices, and field execution standards.
  • Review active and upcoming project backlog, identifying risks related to scheduling, labor planning, or margin exposure.
  • Assess estimating accuracy, engineering workflow, material procurement processes, and overall operational maturity.
  • Participate in due diligence sessions to analyze technical readiness, NFPA compliance, and alignment with Authority Having Jurisdiction requirements.
  • Develop written recommendations for senior leadership outlining strengths, risks, and integration needs.
  • Assist with operational onboarding and process alignment for newly acquired project businesses.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • 10+ years of experience in fire protection, life safety, mechanical contracting, or construction project management.
  • 5+ years leading multi location project operations in the fire protection industry.
  • Strong knowledge of NFPA codes, Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) requirements, and fire protection system installation standards.
  • Proven experience managing project P&Ls, forecasting, WIP reviews, and job costing.
  • Experience supporting or participating in M&A operational due diligence is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, fire protection, construction management, or related discipline preferred.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to travel regularly for branch visits, project reviews, and acquisition evaluations.

Successful completion of a drug test and pre-employment background screening is required. MVR checks are required for all driving positions.

We look forward to talking with you about career opportunities with Impact Fire Services. For consideration, please apply on-line.
