jobs.excerpt: Summary The Mitigator III manages mortgage modification program cases from intake through final resolution.
jobs.description:
Summary The Mitigator III manages mortgage modification program cases from intake through final resolution. This role gathers and validates borrower and case information, prepares and reviews loss mitigation submissions, administers Portal activity and deadlines, facilitates communications and conferences, documents compliance, prepares required reports and court filings, and maintains complete and confidential case records. The Mitigator III serves as a knowledgeable, neutral point of coordination for borrowers, counsel, creditors and servicers, trustees, and the Court, while training and supporting team members in established procedures. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Manage assigned mortgage modification program matters from intake and case setup through final resolution.
  • Schedule and conduct client interviews; gather and validate required bankruptcy, household, employment, income, expense, and mortgage information; and assist with applications, questionnaires, and forms.
  • Review data and supporting documentation for completeness, accuracy, and currency, and promptly resolve missing, stale, inconsistent, or incorrect information.
  • Prepare, assemble, and quality-control Initial MMP Packages and other loss mitigation submissions; upload documentation through the Portal; and coordinate required notices and court filings.
  • Apply MMP rules, procedures, forms, deadlines, participant responsibilities, creditor documentation requirements, and available loss mitigation options when guiding participants and administering cases.
  • Support access to and use of the Court-approved Portal and Document Preparation System, troubleshoot workflow questions, and create or update user guides and support materials.
  • Monitor Portal communications, case activity, participant obligations, and case-specific deadlines, taking appropriate action to keep each matter progressing toward a decision.
  • Prepare for, schedule, and conduct MMP conferences as needed; coordinate with parties and counsel; issue required advance notice; and document conference activity in the Portal.
  • Identify and objectively document non-compliance, preserve supporting evidence, prepare required certificates and reports for Court review, and escalate delays, unresolved disputes, or failures to prosecute.

10. Monitor trial loan modifications through execution of a final modification or denial, maintaining appropriate Portal access and case oversight throughout the trial period. 11. Maintain complete and confidential case notes, ECF updates, status records, reports, correspondence, and other program documentation; coordinate with approved outside professionals when directed. 12. Train, coach, and supervise team members on assigned procedures, quality standards, and workflows, and maintain supporting process and training documentation. 13. Work independently, manage a high-volume caseload and competing deadlines, support required operating coverage, and complete assigned projects and operational reporting. Education and/or Work Experience Requirements

  • College degree required.
  • Professional experience working with attorneys, courts, creditors and servicers, trustees, customers, and other stakeholders.
  • Mortgage loss mitigation knowledge is essential; prior experience as a Loss Mitigation Specialist is preferred.
  • Bankruptcy, legal support, court-program, mediation-program, paralegal, or comparable regulated case-administration experience is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing deadlines, case workflows, document exchanges, quality-control review, and electronic court filing or docket-review processes, including ECF/PACER-related workflows.

About Lend Home Improvements
Lend Home Improvements (LHI) provides financing solutions for home improvement contractors. Our dealers — bath remodelers, roofers, and full-service home improvement companies across the country — use our platform to offer their customers financing at the point of sale. We work with multiple lending partners to make sure every dealer has the right program for their business.

About the role
We're hiring a Dealer Onboarding Coordinator to own the dealer experience from the moment they sign to the moment they're trained and processing their first applications.
This is a process and coordination role. You won't be selling, and you won't be building or delivering training content. You'll be the person who moves each dealer through every step of activation, clears the required compliance review, hands them off to training on schedule, and follows up at 30 days to make sure they're actually using the platform.
The dealers we onboard are busy contractors. If we let them sit in limbo for two weeks, we lose them. Your job is to make sure that never happens.

What you'll do
Manage dealer data across our lending platforms
  • Keep dealer records accurate and current in HubSpot, including platform status, active financing programs, contacts, and account ownership
  • Move dealer information between our internal systems and our lending partners on a set weekly schedule
  • Prepare, send, and track partner agreements through DocuSign, and follow up on outstanding paperwork
  • Track each dealer's lender status and relay account credentials and merchant identifiers between partners
  • Catch and resolve data problems — duplicate records, mismatched email addresses, missing contacts — before they hold up an activation
Run the compliance review
  • Schedule and conduct a scripted compliance read-through with each new dealer ahead of their activation date
  • Submit the required compliance documentation to the appropriate lending partner
  • Maintain an accurate list of which dealers still need to complete this step
Coordinate the training handoff
  • Once a dealer is live, send them clear instructions on what happens next and where their platform invitation was sent
  • Book both training sessions — admin platform training and sales team training — with the correct internal owner
  • Confirm sessions took place and log the outcome
Own the 30-day follow-up
  • Check in with every dealer 30 days after activation
  • Determine whether they're transacting normally, need to be re-engaged, or should be escalated to their sales rep
  • Report what you find clearly and factually
What we're looking for
  • Exceptional follow-through. You close loops without anyone having to ask twice.
  • Strong organizational skills and comfort working in spreadsheets and a CRM every day
  • Clear, professional written communication — you can write a short email a contractor will actually read on his phone

  • HubSpot experience

  • Background in lending, home improvement, or contractor-facing operations
Not required
  • Sales experience
  • Lending or credit expertise
  • Training or curriculum development experience

Base salary, plus a per-dealer bonus for completing onboarding within the target window.

About This Role

Climate Power is seeking a Managing Director, Development to join its Core Leadership team. The Managing Director, Development will work closely with the President, Executive Director, and Chief of Staff to create, lead, and direct all development, donor events, and fundraising efforts on behalf of Climate Power. They will develop and implement development plans to ensure the organization meets its goals. The right candidate will be a strategic thinker and partner with the Executive Team to communicate and action organizational goals, strategies, and tactics.

This position reports directly to the Chief of Staff and will work with organization leadership to support the mission of elevating climate and clean energy solutions into the political conversation, as well as identifying opportunities to shift the national political narrative. This position will need to work independently and deliver high-quality writing, fundraising, support.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a principal driver of fundraising and development success for Climate Power.
  • Develop and implement stewardship programs and build major donor relationships with key supporters. This includes planning consistent donor outreach, meetings, and events, if needed.
  • Develop both short and long term strategies for increasing Climate Power’s revenue and donor engagement.
  • Provide thought leadership for increased growth, opportunities for innovation, and efforts to increase diversity among donors and diversification of gifts.
  • Work closely with the Executive Team and Core Leadership Team on all development, messaging, marketing, events, branding, and positioning efforts for the organization.
  • Build and manage an internal team as appropriate, mentor and develop staff, establish and monitor staff performance and development goals
  • Lead strategy to work with all internal stakeholders and contractors on all fundraising efforts.
  • Oversee the development of all donor materials including proposals and grant reports, including writing and editing strategic proposals.

Additional responsibilities may be assigned as need and capacity dictates.

Climate Power is a strategic communications organization focused on winning the politics of climate. We’re educating Americans about our climate progress, highlighting how clean energy investments benefit local communities, and holding Big Oil accountable for polluting our air and water. It’s our job to tell the story of how climate action and clean energy investment are rebuilding our economy, lowering energy costs, and protecting our planet for future generations. We call out disinformation from bad actors like the Big Oil lobby, and make the climate stakes real for voters.

The IHM will provide on-label product information to designated key opinion leaders, health care providers/accounts, and will be responsible for establishing and maintaining relationships within the cGVHD community.

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

  • Expected to deliver promotional messages in support of the product-approved indication(s) via approved channels of delivery, I.e face-to-face and virtual platforms.

  • An unwavering commitment to teamwork; sharing what is learned from customer dialogues with Sanofi cross-functional teammates enabling us to be an agile, valued partner in serving our customers and their patients

  • Proven/successful performer in generating and driving sales results.

  • Product launch experience.

  • Proven proficiency in live engagements to HCPs and staff.

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong time management and organizational skills.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

  • Willingness to travel 20% of the time or greater.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Traditional pharmaceutical experience is inclusive of field sales, hospital/academic institution sales and Managed Care experience within the oncology/hematology – transplant market.

jobs.title: SEO Team Lead
jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. This company looks for people who show up as their whole selves, take ownership without being asked twice, and want more responsibility than their current title gives them.
locationRestrictions: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

This company looks for people who show up as their whole selves, take ownership without being asked twice, and want more responsibility than their current title gives them. If that sounds like you, keep reading.
They provide marketing services exclusively to independent professionals and brands in the automotive detailing, paint protection film, ceramic coating, and window tint industries. They are not a general agency. They understand this market's customers, how they search, and what turns a Google search into a booked job.
They currently manage roughly 100 SEO accounts through outside white label vendors, and they are on pace to launch around 225 new client websites a year. That volume is outgrowing what a packaged vendor relationship can give them in quality control, scope flexibility, and client communication. This role exists to change that.
Why This Role Exists Now
SEO, and local SEO specifically, is one of the highest value services they sell and deliver for their clients. Right now, most of that work is executed through outside white label vendors. This hire changes that relationship. They need someone who can run those vendors, evaluate whether their contracts and scopes of work still make sense for the company, and start building the internal team and processes that let them bring the highest value work in house over time.
  • They need more control over quality, scope flexibility, and client communication than a packaged white label model can provide.
  • They need someone who can evaluate their current vendors on their merits: cost, scope, turnaround, and quality, and make a clear recommendation on each.
  • They want an internal SEO leader who can document how the work should be done, train others to do it, and build a department that integrates tightly with web development & support.
AboutThe Role
They are hiring a Director of SEO to own their SEO strategy end to end: local SEO delivery for their small business clients, their growing use of AI in search, and the relationships they currently hold with white label SEO vendors.
You will start executing and advising from week one. In the first 45 to 60 days, you will audit their current white label vendor contracts and performance, and begin identifying and building out a handful of scopes of work they can bring in house, work that either mirrors or improves on what those vendors deliver today, along with the standard operating procedures that make that work repeatable. As you prove out results and judgment, this role is built to grow into leadership over an internal SEO team.
You will also serve as the company’s internal SEO consultant on website development builds, working with their web team early in the build process so new sites launch search ready rather than getting audited and fixed after the fact. This is an advisory role on the web side. They are not asking you to manage web development vendors, only SEO vendors.
You'll Love This Job If...
  • You'd rather own outcomes than tickets; you want to be the person a shop owner's rankings live or die by, and you take that seriously.
  • You're already thinking about how AI search (AI Overviews, LLM citations, zero-click behavior) changes local SEO, and you want a place to actually test that thinking.
  • You can look at content someone else wrote and make it meaningfully better; structurally, not just line edits, without needing to write every word yourself.
  • You want a leadership track, not just a bigger workload. You're motivated by eventually building and running a team, not just doing more of the same work solo.
You'll Dislike This Job If...
  • You want a fully built department, existing SOPs, and someone checking your work daily; none of that exists yet. You're building a chunk of it.
  • You see vendor management or contract review as beneath your role. Evaluating what they are paying for and deciding what to bring in house is core to this job, not a side task.
  • You need certainty about title and comp progression on day one and the growth path is real but earned, not guaranteed on a calendar.
Core Responsibilities
White Label Vendor Oversight and Evaluation
  • Own the working relationship with the company’s current white label SEO vendors: scope, deliverables, turnaround, and quality.
  • Evaluate vendor contracts on their merits, pricing, scope of work, service levels, and exclusivity or termination terms, and provide the company with a clear recommendation on each: keep, renegotiate, or replace.
  • Within a 45 to 60 day span, identify a small set of scopes of work to begin bringing in house, ones that mirror or enhance what their vendors currently deliver, and start building the standard operating procedures that make those scopes repeatable without you personally in the loop on every account.
Local SEO Execution
  • Own Google Business Profile optimization, map pack ranking strategy, and on-page SEO for a portfolio of small-business (automotive detailing, PPF, tint) client accounts.
  • Diagnose ranking issues and build a prioritized action plan per client, not a generic checklist.
  • Track and report on local ranking movement, map pack visibility, and organic traffic using Ahrefs and other tools.
AI and Answer Engine Optimization Strategy
  • Build and evolve their point of view on how AI Overviews, LLM-based search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini), and zero-click behavior affect local SEO for small businesses.
  • Translate that strategy into concrete, testable deliverables: content structure, schema/structured data, citation-worthy page formats, not just trend commentary.
  • Track algorithm and AI search changes, and proactively adjust client strategy in advance.
Content Direction & Editing
  • Direct and edit SEO content produced by writers and contractors; briefs, structure, on-page optimization, and quality control before publication.
  • Make sure content ties back to each client's actual ranking and conversion goals, not just word count.
Tools, Reporting & Communication
  • Use Ahrefs (required) for keyword research, competitor analysis, and rank tracking; comfort with Local Falcon or a similar local-rank tool is a plus.
  • Report results in plain language that a shop owner can act on; no jargon, no fluff.
  • Analyze performance trends and translate insights into actionable improvements for future campaigns.
Their Core Values
Before you apply, make sure these land for you. They don't just post values on a wall; they hire, fire, and celebrate based on them.
  • Delivering a WOW experience through service
  • Embrace and drive change
  • Create fun and a hint of weirdness
  • Be adventurous, creative, and open-minded
  • Pursue growth & learning
  • Build a positive team and family spirit
  • Create open and honest relationships built on communication
  • Be humble
  • Never be afraid to ask for help
  • Do it right, or don't do it at all.

What Success Looks LikeFirst 45 Days

  • Completed a full audit of the company’s current white label SEO vendor contracts and performance, with a clear keep, renegotiate, or replace recommendation for each.
  • Identified two to four scopes of work to begin bringing in house, chosen because they mirror or enhance what their vendors currently deliver, and started drafting the standard operating procedure for at least one of them.
  • Independently managing Google Business Profile, map pack, and on page SEO for your assigned client portfolio.
  • Embedded as SEO consultant on at least one active website development build.
First 90 Days
  • Shown measurable ranking or map pack improvement across your client portfolio.
  • Built a documented process for content briefs and editing standards that another writer could follow.
Long-Term
  • Own SEO strategy across all client accounts.
  • Help hire, train, and lead additional SEO team members as the department grows.
  • Help them settle the right long term mix of internal and vendor delivered work, informed by what the first internalized scopes of work actually prove out.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of hands-on SEO experience with demonstrable results improving local/SMB rankings (map pack position, GBP visibility, organic traffic); bring examples, not just a resume line.
  • Working knowledge of Ahrefs and or Comparable Tool: keyword research, rank tracking, competitor, and gap analysis.
  • Competence across the range of what modern SEO now covers: traditional technical and on page SEO, local map grid tracking, AI driven SEO, and answer engine optimization. You do not need to be a master of every one of these. You do need to know enough in each to direct the work, judge whether it is good, and recognize when you should bring in outside expertise or hire someone who covers a gap you do not.
  • Experience editing or directing content written by someone else, with a clear point of view on what actually makes SEO content rank and convert.
  • A genuine, current interest in AI-driven search, not just awareness that it exists.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote, contract-to-hire structure with limited existing infrastructure.
  • Proven ability to translate high-level SEO strategy into measurable business results.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain the impact of SEO to non-technical stakeholders and clients.
​Nice to Have
  • Management or team-lead experience, though we're weighing trajectory and hunger to lead over a management title you've already held.
  • Background working with local or small-business clients, ideally in a service industry.
  • Familiarity with Local Falcon, Google Search Console, or other local-rank and search-performance tools.

Benefits

  • $3800 - $4000 USD/monthly
  • 100% remote from anywhere in Latam

jobs.excerpt: Who are we and why should you join us? BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone.
jobs.description:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there—as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As a Senior Manager, Social and Creator Marketing at BetterHelp, you’ll join our Brand Team alongside a diverse group of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy.

You’ll help shape how BetterHelp shows up in culture and how our brand reaches people organically—building the strategy, channels, partnerships, and systems that turn great brand ideas into sustained attention, conversation, and relevance.

As a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day—with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for an experienced brand marketer and content distribution strategist to lead BetterHelp’s organic brand presence and help more of our ideas travel.

You’ll own the strategy for how BetterHelp builds attention, relevance, and community across owned and earned channels—from social and creators to partnerships, community, long-form content, PR amplification, and emerging platforms. You’ll think beyond individual posts or influencer campaigns to build an interconnected organic ecosystem: identifying where our audiences spend time, what they care about, what BetterHelp has permission to say, and how the right ideas can reach the right people.

This role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, culture, content, and distribution. You’ll pair strong creative instincts with a rigorous understanding of channels and audiences, helping BetterHelp create work that people actively choose to engage with, share, and participate in.

What will you do?

  • Own BetterHelp’s organic brand and distribution strategy, defining how the brand earns attention and builds relevance across social, creators, partnerships, community, long-form content, PR amplification, and emerging channels.
  • Build an audience-first distribution model that identifies where our audiences spend time, how they consume and share content, and which channels and formats are best suited to different brand ideas.
  • Turn brand strategy into channel strategy, translating BetterHelp’s positioning, campaigns, and cultural point of view into distinctive platform-native programs and always-on content.
  • Develop the organic amplification strategy for major brand moments, working closely with Brand, Creative, PR, Partnerships, and Growth teams to extend campaigns beyond their initial launch and maximize their cultural reach and lifespan.
  • Lead our owned social strategy across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn, establishing clear roles for each channel and continuously evolving our approach based on audience behavior and platform shifts.
  • Lead creator and influencer strategy as a core organic distribution channel, developing thoughtful programs and long-term relationships that give creators meaningful ways to participate in and extend the BetterHelp brand.
  • Build relationships with creators, cultural voices, communities, and partners who authentically align with our mission and can help BetterHelp participate in relevant conversations.
  • Identify new and emerging distribution opportunities, testing new platforms, formats, communities, partnerships, and content models that can expand BetterHelp’s organic reach.
  • Develop a strategy for long-form and search-driven brand content, including YouTube, podcasts, SEO/AEO, and other formats that can compound audience and brand value over time.
  • Create an international organic distribution strategy, identifying which approaches can scale globally and where local platforms, creators, cultural context, and audience behaviors require a differentiated approach.
  • Lead planning for organic brand activations and cultural moments, including creator programs, events, partnerships, and community-led initiatives designed to generate participation and earned conversation.
  • Act as the connective tissue across organic, earned, and paid distribution, ensuring strong ideas move effectively across channels while maintaining a consistent brand strategy and point of view.
  • Partner closely with Growth and Paid Social teams to identify organic content, creators, formats, and audience insights that can inform paid amplification—while using performance learnings to sharpen organic strategy.
  • Develop measurement frameworks for organic brand impact, looking beyond surface-level engagement to understand audience growth, conversation, share of attention, content velocity, brand impact, and the downstream value of organic distribution.
  • Manage and mentor a growing team across organic social, creators, and related distribution functions, establishing clear priorities, operating rhythms, and opportunities for development.
  • Manage budgets and external partners across creators, agencies, partnerships, content production, and brand activations, ensuring investments ladder back to a clear distribution strategy.
  • Build scalable operating systems, including briefs, playbooks, channel frameworks, compliance guardrails, measurement systems, and AI-assisted workflows that allow the team to increase its impact without proportional headcount growth.
  • Partner with Legal and Compliance to develop practical frameworks for social, creator, and organic content across US and international markets.
  • Stay deeply connected to culture and the evolving media landscape, bringing emerging behaviors, platforms, creators, communities, and distribution models back into BetterHelp’s brand strategy.

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success.
  • You will NOT be confined to your "job". You will get involved in product, marketing, business strategy, and almost everything we do.
  • You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here!
  • You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. We operate on PST and candidates in any time zone are welcome to apply. We ask employees to travel to our San Jose, CA office up to three times per year plus one company-wide offsite to collaborate in person and strengthen working relationships. Travel expenses are covered and reasonable accommodations are made for those under unique circumstances who cannot travel.

Benefits

  • Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company
  • Competitive compensation
  • Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more)
  • Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution
  • The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love
  • Any piece of hardware or software that will make you happy and productive
  • An awesome community of co-workers

The base salary range for this position is $175,000 - $200,000. In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and the extensive benefits listed here (subject to eligibility requirements): Teladoc Health Benefits 2026. Total compensation is based on several factors – including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable to all full-time positions.

  • Contribute to initiatives that strengthen Precision for Medicine’s scientifically driven approach and client offering.

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related discipline.
  • At least two years of relevant experience in clinical trial feasibility, clinical operations, site intelligence, epidemiology, clinical research, or a related area.

  • Experience in oncology, rare disease, or other complex clinical-development programs.
  • Experience presenting analyses and recommendations to clients or senior stakeholders.

Skills

  • Ability to develop and communicate a clear rationale for feasibility assumptions and recommendations.
  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining awareness of the overall study strategy.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent deliverables, stakeholders, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Confidence working with web-based data, intelligence, and analytics platforms.

  • Collaborative working style and ability to operate effectively in a matrix environment.

Precision for Medicine brings together clinical-trial execution, scientific expertise, laboratory capabilities, and advanced data sciences to help life sciences organizations improve the speed, cost, and likelihood of successful clinical development. jobs.description:
Commercial Director

About the company:

In the coming decades, our world needs substantially more critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt, to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. The mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago, because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.

KoBold is a leading scientific mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to make discoveries faster—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. We made our first discovery—Mingomba, one of the world’s largest undeveloped high-grade copper deposits—after spending materially less than the industry average. This asset is expected to operate for decades, and be a leading global copper supplier. KoBold is actively running exploration programs in 8 countries worldwide, all with the potential for another high-quality discovery.

We are developing Mingomba by applying the same technical rigor to resource development and mine planning as we do to exploration. Mingomba is also a scientific laboratory where we prototype new technology and workflows, combined with the expertise of veteran engineers. Our multidisciplinary team consists of mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. We want to develop world-class mining projects that are safer and have more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

About the role

This is a senior Engineering leadership role for the development of a significant Copper mining complex in Zambia. The Mingomba deposit contains over 10 million tonnes of copper more than half of which exceeds 6% grade. This role will help turn that world class deposit into a world class mine.

The Commercial Director establishes the commercial strategy, contracting approach, procurement and market engagement plan, and contractor management disciplines required to deliver the Mingomba project safely, competitively, and predictably. The role owns the commercial pathway from PFS and engineering delivery through package strategy, tendering, negotiation, award, contract administration, contractor performance, transition to operations and commercial close out. The Mingomba project is expected to require capital expenditure of more than US$2 billion, so the role requires a commercial leader who has built and run major-project commercial functions before.

What this role is accountable for delivering

This role provides the strategic commercial leadership for a significant greenfield project by setting the commercial direction, developing and implementing the strategies that flow from it and building and directing the team that delivers them. The successful candidate will be measured on:

  • A commercial strategy — delivery model, contracting approach, market engagement, and packaging — approved through project governance, delivered on schedule, and updated as conditions change.
  • A capable, high performing contracting, procurement and supply chain team built, developed and directed to deliver the targets with clear accountabilities and growing local capability
  • Major packages tendered and awarded to the baseline schedule with no critical path slippage attributable to procurement or contract formulation
  • Final contract outlays within the agreed band of the approved estimate, with commitments, cost exposure and forecasts visible to the project and finance at all times.
  • Claims and variation exposure quantified, contained and actively managed with no material unresolved disputes at handover to operations
  • Local content targets met with auditable evidence of local supplier participation and capability development
  • A procurement and contracting function that passes independent commercial audits and stage gate review without material qualification
  • A clean integrity record with no sanctions, bribery or conflict of interest findings in the supply chain and contracting workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Commercial governance and routines: Establish the commercial policies, approval thresholds, procurement gates, contract governance, tender review cadence, award recommendations, change controls, claims controls, and vendor management routines needed to support safe, competitive, and predictable project delivery.
  • Project delivery model and contracting options: Develop the project delivery model and contracting strategy (EPC, EPCM, design-and-build, owner-managed, or hybrid), assessing each option against risk, cost, schedule, market capacity, local content, and value for money
  • Commercial leadership and decision support: Lead commercial inputs into the project, executive forums and technical committees ensuring that contracting and procurement status, market intelligence and feedback, contractor risks, cost exposure, and package readiness are visible and early enough for management action.
  • Interface with engineering: Partner with the Senior Engineering & Integration Manager under a defined split of authority (engineering responsible for design authority and technical bid evaluation). The Commercial Director is responsible for commercial evaluation, contract formation and administration, with a single joint change control process spanning technical and commercial impacts.
  • Commercial roadmap and readiness: Develop the commercial plan for engineering, construction, and transition to operations. Lead contractor intelligence and prequalification activities, establish commercial and procurement delivery plans, and identify long-lead commitments and critical award milestones to support efficient project delivery.
  • Procurement, sourcing and contracting: Lead market engagement and package strategy implementation inclusive of tendering, negotiation, award, and contract formation for major packages, including engineering, construction management and delivery services, long-lead equipment, logistics, and site services.
  • Supply chain and logistics: Oversee supply chain execution and logistics strategy, including cross-border movement into Zambia, customs interfaces, freight forwarding, expediting, critical-path equipment delivery, logistics contractor performance, and contingency planning for high-risk routes and packages.
  • Local contractor engagement and local content: Own the local contractor engagement and local content strategy, including supplier mapping, capability assessment, package design, tender access, mentoring, joint-venture pathways, performance expectations, and reporting.
  • Cost control & forecasting: Partner with Finance on budgeting, forecasting, commitments, and cost discipline.
  • Risk & performance management: Provide systematic oversight of contractor performance management and commercial risk (market, forex movement, geopolitical, contractor claims, variations, and disputes), including the implementation of integrated, cross-functional frameworks alongside project management and controls to provide comprehensive oversight and ability proactively flag and mitigate any deviation to plans.
  • Insurance and risk transfer: Shape and place the project insurance program (construction all risks, marine cargo, delay in start up) in accordance with corporate insurance and align contractual risk allocation with insurance coverage.
  • Team & partner management: Lead the contracting, procurement and supply chain team and build ethical, values aligned supplier partnerships.

Qualifications

  • 15+ years of commercial leadership experience on multi-billion dollar mining, oil and gas, infrastructure, or large industrial projects, including direct accountability for commercial strategy, market engagement, procurement, contracting, contractor management, and project outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success forming and implementing high-value EPC, EPCM, design-and-build, engineering services, drilling, construction, logistics, and long-lead equipment contracts on major capital projects, including experience in Africa and direct involvement from package strategy through negotiation, award, administration, claims, variations, and close-out.
  • Deep working knowledge of major construction contract structures (including FIDIC and NEC forms), contracting models, risk allocation, payment mechanisms, incentives, securities, warranties, limits of liability, change management, claims, dispute resolution, and contractor performance remedies.
  • Track record developing local supplier and contractor capability in Africa, Asia, or Latin America, with evidence of measurable outcomes such as increased local participation, improved contractor performance, stronger compliance, safer execution, or reduced delivery risk.
  • Experience working with Chinese suppliers, contractors, and equipment manufacturers will be advantageous, including market engagement, tendering, negotiation, contract formation, technical-commercial alignment, expediting, performance management, and executive-level issue resolution.
  • Proven ability to design and implement commercial systems, governance, and reporting for major projects.
  • Strong business judgement, ethical leadership, and a commitment to transparency.
  • Experience building and leading multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Recognized qualifications in Quantity Surveying, Construction Law, Business, engineering, supply chain, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Ability and willingness to travel internationally to Zambia, with anticipated travel of 90+ days per year.

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative-action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunities for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, or disability.

Location: Global with Africa or Europe (preferred) otherwise North America.

jobs.description:
About VGS

VGS is the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce.

We tokenize over 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

We’re helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.

Trusted Engineering That Matters

Engineering at VGS

Our vision is clear: VGS is building the platform powering agentic commerce and global payments infrastructure. VGS Engineering is the pillar that supports that vision. We create a platform that is an indispensable, ubiquitous component of our partners' payments and security infrastructure. To achieve this, we build and operate high-scale, reliable, and resilient systems that manage mission-critical payment data across the globe. We don't just participate in the payments ecosystem; we power it.

Our Environment & Culture

  • Tooling as Leverage for Impact: We value speed and impact. To ensure nothing slows you down, we arm you with a highly consistent modern stack (e.g. AWS, Kubernetes, Java, TypeScript, Python) and world-class AI-augmented SDLC tooling. We strip away the friction so you can focus on building simple things that work, pushing boundaries, and delivering value faster.

  • Impact Over Input: Scaling global payments infrastructure requires individuals who take personal ownership of outcomes from day one. We look for builders who combine high agency with deep strategic alignment; channeling their urgency and relentless iteration into what matters most. Leading from the front means multiplying the impact of those around you so we win collectively.

  • Mission-Critical Accountability: We power payments infrastructure for global market leaders, making system trust and integrity our core deliverable. We don't treat compliance (PCI, SOC2, ISO27001), security patching, and platform maintenance as administrative overhead—we engineer them with first-class product discipline. We apply the same rigor, roadmap thinking, and speed to system health as we do to new features. In high-scale payments, reliability isn't background work; it is our product.

Learn More: See how our engineering practices drive trust and innovation in our official blog and our reliability practices.

About the Role

As a Senior Staff Infrastructure Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader on our Platform Engineering team. You will architect, scale, and fortify global cloud infrastructure designed to handle mission-critical, high-throughput payments applications with zero downtime.

You will take ownership of key platform foundations powering our core payments infrastructure. Rather than executing against a rigid task list or holding blanket ownership over the entire platform, you will drive the technical strategy, architecture, and reliability standards for your designated domains within our multi-region AWS environment. We are looking for high-agency engineers who want to own complex distributed system challenges end-to-end and elevate how the entire engineering team operates.

If you thrive on solving complex distributed systems problems, building automated resiliency, and driving modern SRE practices, we want to build the future with you.

What You'll Do

  • Build Immutable, Self-Healing Systems: Design, build, and optimize multi-region, high-availability AWS infrastructure. You will drive our evolution from hand-crafted environments to a standardized, globally scalable fleet managed entirely through code.

  • Drive Resiliency & Automation: Replace manual toil with self-healing, automated infrastructure using GitOps, modern CI/CD pipelines, and IaC.

  • Deep Observability & Resiliency: Build end-to-end telemetry (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to proactively spot bottlenecks. You will own incident management and conduct blameless post-mortems to continuously harden our reliability baseline.

  • Force-Multiply Engineering Velocity: Partner closely with Product, Security, and Core Engineering teams and lead from the front by designing "Golden Paths" that strip away friction for feature teams. You will influence company-wide engineering practices and mentor the organization on how to move fast with high alignment.

  • Customer Impact: Architect and operate high-performance, low-latency private connectivity to optimize the experience for external customers. Partner strategically with internal engineering teams at the design and architectural level for platform enablement and adoption.

What You Bring

  • Ownership at Scale: 10+ years of experience taking personal ownership of outcomes in complex, large-scale distributed systems within mission-critical environments.

  • AWS & Infrastructure-as-Code: Advanced proficiency in AWS ecosystems leveraging Terraform to build reproducible environments.

  • Containerization & Orchestration: Strong, hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, and GitOps workflows (Flux, Argo, GitHub Actions).

  • Automation & Scripting: Strong coding skills in Python, Go, or Bash to automate infrastructure and build operational tools.

  • Observability Expertise: Deep experience implementing Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry at scale.

  • Security & Networking Foundations: Solid understanding of cloud security, API Gateways, load balancing, and network isolation, viewing security as a fundamental engineering constraint, not an afterthought.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with tokenization, payment processing, cryptology, or security products

  • BA/BS degree

  • A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Experience managing distributed data streaming platforms like Kafka (MSK).

  • Database performance tuning and query optimization skills.

  • Familiarity with Java / Spring Framework services.

jobs.description:
SOSi is seeking a Kubernetes Engineer to support mission requirements for a structured approach to further develop, integrate, and sustain a scalable, federated data ecosystem that enhances interoperability, governance, and mission-driven analytics for a DoD customer. The primary objective of the program is to bridge the operational gaps between DoD, IC, interagency, and non-traditional international partners to enable real-time information sharing, dynamic data integration, and mission-tailored analytical capabilities.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Configure, deploy, and maintain Kubernetes clusters tailored for each IL environment (IL2, IL4, IL5), ensuring support for ESRI ArcGIS services and integration with agency-provided infrastructure from WO-001.
  • Develop and manage Helm charts and Kubernetes Operators for declarative deployment and automated scaling of ESRI services, including Notebook Server and GeoAnalytics Server.
  • Configure persistent volume claims and provision container-native storage (e.g., AWS EBS, Azure Disks) to support ESRI workloads, ensuring durability and compliance with backup and recovery policies.
  • Integrate Kubernetes-native monitoring and logging solutions (e.g., Prometheus, Fluentd, or OpenTelemetry) to support observability and IL-compliant reporting across environments.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cloud Computing, or a related field, or; five (5) years of equivalent experience in Kubernetes administration.
  • Demonstrated experience in deploying and managing Kubernetes clusters, troubleshooting containerized applications, and implementing service mesh architectures such as Istio or Linkerd.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible is required.
  • Possess the knowledge and capability to design, deploy, and manage containerized applications in a cloud-native environment using Kubernetes.
  • Proficient in Kubernetes cluster orchestration, container networking, Helm chart deployment, and automation of CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure services (AWS, Azure, GCP), security best practices, and Kubernetes monitoring/logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack) is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Desirable but not required certifications include Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, or Google Cloud Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.

Work Environment

  • Offsite/remote.
  • Must have strong internet connection.
  • Quit workspace free from interruptions and background noise.

  • The contractor shall configure identity and access management (IAM) solutions, enforce role-based access controls (RBAC), and manage cloud security groups and firewalls.
  • The contractor shall optimize cloud networking configurations, including VPC peering, VPNs, and cross-domain connectivity to ensure secure and efficient cloud operations.
  • The contractor shall support the development of Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, CloudFormation, or ARM templates to automate secure cloud deployments.
  • The contractor shall contribute to the Cloud Security & Performance Optimization Report, detailing cloud security configurations, resource utilization efficiencies, and compliance measures.

  • The contractor shall advise the Government on workload placement and optimization strategies across IL2, IL4, and IL5 environments to reduce cost while maintaining performance and security compliance.
  • The contractor shall provision and maintain IL2, IL4, and IL5 GovCloud infrastructure using native Azure and/or AWS tools where feasible. The contactor shall implement cloud-native services for monitoring (e.g., CloudWatch, Azure Monitor), cost tracking, and compliance automation to support scalability, security, and chargeback alignment.
  • The contractor shall provision infrastructure in coordination with other Work Orders.
  • The contractor shall provision and manage shared container environments and storage for dependent Work Orders, ensuring secure, efficient resource allocation and cross-Work Order operability.
  • Knowledge and capability to design, deploy, and maintain GovCloud-based infrastructures across AWS and Azure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security for mission-critical applications.
  • Required expertise includes cloud architecture, networking, virtualization, containerization, and security best practices, with proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
  • Personnel must have experience in hybrid and multi-cloud configurations, including Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) peering, identity management (IAM), and cross-domain solutions.
  • Strong expertise in the Authority to Operate (ATO) process is required, including preparing security documentation, conducting compliance assessments, and maintaining continuous monitoring per DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF), NIST 800-53 Rev. 5, FedRAMP, and DoD IL-4/IL-5 security mandates.
  • Personnel must also optimize cloud resources for compute, storage, and networking efficiency while ensuring full compliance with DoD governance policies.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or;
    • five (5) years of equivalent experience in cloud engineering.
  • Personnel must have experience designing, deploying, and managing AWS and Azure cloud environments with a focus on security, automation, and scalability. Required expertise includes Identity and Access Management (IAM), role-based access control (RBAC), Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), and cloud networking configurations such as VPC peering, subnets, VPNs, and security groups.
  • Personnel must demonstrate proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or ARM templates, ensuring secure and scalable deployments. Experience supporting Authority to Operate (ATO) processes is required, including preparing System Security Plans (SSP), Security Assessment Reports (SAR), and Plans of Action & Milestones (POA&M), and maintaining compliance with DoD governance frameworks and NIST requirements.
  • Personnel must also collaborate with cybersecurity teams to implement security controls in accordance with FedRAMP, RMF, and DoD IL-4/IL-5 security mandates, while optimizing cloud resource allocation for efficiency.

jobs.excerpt: Job Position: Marketplace & Merchandising ManagerCompany: Pro Coffee Gear Location: Remote (Anywhere) Full - Time About Us: Pro Coffee Gear is a thriving e-commerce company located on our scenic 20-acre ranch in Austin, Texas.
jobs.description:
Job Position: Marketplace & Merchandising Manager

Company: Pro Coffee Gear

Location: Remote (Anywhere)

Full - Time

About Us: Pro Coffee Gear is a thriving e-commerce company located on our scenic 20-acre ranch in Austin, Texas. We specialize in providing top-tier espresso machines and related parts to coffee enthusiasts worldwide. Our dedication to excellence extends beyond our products; we're committed to building a talented team that shares our passion for coffee and exceptional customer service.

Job Description: The Marketplace & Merchandising Manager owns the performance, quality, and scalability of our online product catalog across all sales channels, including Shopify, Amazon, eBay, and Walmart. This role is responsible for accelerating time-to-market for new listings, ensuring competitive and profitable pricing, and delivering a consistent, high-quality brand experience across platforms.
This manager will lead a team of 4-6 and build scalable workflows, quality standards, and performance metrics to maximize revenue, improve conversion, and strengthen multi-channel visibility. Success in this role means faster listings, smarter pricing, and a best-in-class marketplace presence that drives sustainable growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Review Offer Competitiveness: Continuously evaluate our product offers against key competitors across all marketplaces to ensure we are competitively positioned on price, shipping, promotions, and value. Identify gaps and opportunities where adjustments are needed to win conversion while protecting margin.
  • Own Merchandising Decisions (Sales, Promotions, Discounts): Make data-driven decisions on sales, promotions, and discount strategies across channels. Balance revenue growth, inventory goals, and margin targets while aligning promotions with marketplace dynamics and business priorities.
  • Set Team Priorities and Create Execution Tickets: Translate merchandising strategy into clear, actionable priorities for the Parts Specialist, Listings Specialist, QA Specialist, and A+ Content Lead. Create and manage tickets that define scope, urgency, and success criteria to ensure efficient execution across the team.
  • Review Marketplace Performance and Identify Improvements: Monitor performance across all marketplaces (Shopify, Amazon, eBay, Walmart), including revenue, conversion, visibility, and operational metrics. Identify underperforming areas, diagnose root causes, and define improvement plans to drive continuous optimization.
  • Evaluate and Approve New Product Onboarding: Review new products and inventory opportunities to determine readiness and priority for onboarding across Shopify and marketplaces. Assess product fit, demand potential, competitive landscape, and operational feasibility to maximize return on new listings.

Requirements:

  • Technical Requirements:
  • Knowledge Multi-Channel Marketplace Management (Shopify, Amazon, eBay, Walmart)
  • Pricing Strategy & Competitive Analysis
  • Catalog & Listing Management
  • Performance Analytics & Reporting
  • Workflow & Ticketing Systems
  • Promotions & Discount Management
  • Marketplace Policies, Compliance & QAMarketplace Policies,
  • Compliance & QA
  • Bonus: SEO & Content Optimization
  • Skills:
  • Strategic Merchandising & Decision-Making
  • Data-Driven Analysis & Problem Solving
  • Cross-Functional Team Leadership
  • Prioritization & Execution Management
  • Competitive & Market Awareness
  • Process Design & Workflow Optimization
  • Attention to Detail & Quality Control
  • Clear Communication & Stakeholder Alignment
  • Ownership & Accountability
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule with opportunities for growth
  • Work remotely from the comfort of your own home
  • Join a dynamic and passionate international team in the exciting world of coffee

How to Apply:

If you're ready to join our team and play a key role in shaping our talented workforce, please submit your resume in English (resumes in other languages will be immediately disqualified). We look forward to hearing from you!

Pro Coffee Gear is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.
Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.

About the role

Avalere Health is seeking a Consultant with experience in health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), real world evidence (RWE) generation, and/or real-world data analytics to join our Evidence & Strategy practice.

You will manage and conduct RWE and HEOR studies, provide research support (including development of study protocol, technical reports, statistical analysis plans, manuscripts, abstracts, etc.), interpret quantitative and qualitative study results and convey the results in lay English to a variety of audiences. A background in healthcare research consulting is preferred.

About the Evidence & Strategy Practice

Avalere Health is a vibrant community of innovative thinkers dedicated to solving the challenges of the healthcare industry. We dig deep into the healthcare system and work closely with clients to develop practical solutions. At Avalere Health, we prize curiosity, resilience, a positive attitude, and an enthusiasm to embrace new challenges. Join us and get ready to make your mark on healthcare!

Avalere’s Evidence & Strategy practice provides exceptional consultation, evidence, and insights on key aspects of healthcare – including patient-centric HEOR, US real world evidence (RWE) studies leveraging claims, EHR, and other data sources, data optimization, quality, shared decision-making, value-based care, and health equity – and to shape strategy for our clients.

jobs.excerpt: Job Position: Paid & Performance Marketing LeadCompany: Pro Coffee Gear Location: Remote (Anywhere) Type: Full-time Reports to: VP of Product & Growth About Us:Pro Coffee Gear is a fast-growing ecommerce and wholesale distributor of commercial and home espresso equipment.
jobs.description:
Job Position: Paid & Performance Marketing Lead

Company: Pro Coffee Gear

Location: Remote (Anywhere)

Type: Full-time

Reports to: VP of Product & Growth

About Us:Pro Coffee Gear is a fast-growing ecommerce and wholesale distributor of commercial and home espresso equipment. We serve cafés, roasters, restaurants, and serious home baristas with new and refurbished espresso machines, grinders, and accessories from the most respected brands in coffee. We’re building a disciplined, data-driven growth engine — and paid media is a critical part of that foundation.

The Role: We’re hiring a Paid & Performance Marketing Lead to own the strategy, performance, and evolution of paid acquisition at PCG. This role will manage and lead our existing Google and Meta ad agencies, while also setting the roadmap to progressively bring paid media in-house as the business scales.

You will be the single owner of paid performance — accountable for results, agency direction, channel expansion, and long-term capability building.

What You'll Own:

1. Paid Media Ownership & Agency Leadership

  • Own overall paid media strategy and performance across Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube) and Meta (Facebook & Instagram)
  • Act as the primary owner and point of accountability for external paid media agencies, channel-level strategy and prioritization, and budget allocation and pacing
  • Set clear goals, KPIs, and expectations for agencies
  • Review performance, challenge assumptions, and approve strategy
  • Ensure agency work aligns with PCG business goals, merchandising priorities, and creative and brand standards
  • You are not a passive agency manager — you own the outcome

2. Transition from Agency-Led to In-House Execution

  • Assess what should remain agency-managed vs brought in-house
  • Build a roadmap to reduce agency dependency over time and increase internal ownership of strategy and execution
  • Personally execute and optimize campaigns where appropriate
  • Define tooling, processes, and documentation required to scale in-house
  • Hire or develop additional paid media support as needed

3. Google Ads (Primary Revenue Channel)

  • Own Google Ads performance end-to-end, whether executed by agency or in-house: brand, non-brand, and SKU-level search; shopping and feed optimization; Performance Max (with strict controls); YouTube for upper-funnel education
  • Partner with merchandising to prioritize SKUs, manage inventory constraints, and support launches, refurbished inventory, and clearance
  • Ensure strong alignment between search intent, landing pages, and conversion tracking

4. Meta Ads (Demand Creation + Retargeting)

  • Own Meta strategy across prospecting (education-driven, high-intent audiences), retargeting (site, CRM, engagement-based), and product launches and promotional bursts
  • Direct creative strategy in partnership with internal creative teams
  • Review and approve creative testing plans and results
  • Ensure Meta is used to create demand, support high-AOV consideration cycles, and feed lifecycle marketing

5. Channel Expansion & Experimentation

  • Own testing and expansion into additional paid channels: Reddit, LinkedIn (wholesale, restaurant operators), affiliate and partner marketing, and influencer whitelisting/paid creator ads
  • Decide when experiments are agency-led vs in-house
  • Define clear hypotheses, success metrics, and scale/kill decisions

6. Measurement, Reporting & Forecasting

  • Own performance reporting across all paid channels and agencies
  • Track and optimize toward blended MER, contribution margin, paid revenue vs plan, and lead revenue conversion (30/60/120 days)
  • Build clear weekly and monthly reporting for leadership
  • Ensure attribution, tracking, and data integrity are solid and improving

7. Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with merchandising (inventory, pricing, promotions), lifecycle marketing (email/SMS, lead nurturing), creative (ads, landing pages, messaging), and sales/wholesale (lead quality, follow-up loops)
  • Translate company goals into actionable paid media strategy
  • Represent paid media in planning, launches, and retrospectives

What Success Looks Like:

First 3–6 months

  • Clear ownership and accountability over agency performance
  • Strong visibility into spend, performance, and ROI
  • Improved alignment between paid media, merch, and creative

6–12 months

  • More paid execution owned internally
  • Reduced agency dependency without performance loss
  • At least one new paid channel successfully tested
  • Paid media viewed as a predictable, scalable growth engine

Who You Are:

Required

  • 5–8+ years in paid/performance marketing
  • Deep experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads
  • Proven experience managing and scaling agency relationships
  • Strong analytical and financial mindset
  • Comfortable owning revenue and efficiency metrics

Bonus

  • Experience bringing paid media in-house from agencies
  • High-AOV ecommerce or B2B-adjacent experience
  • Shopify-based ecommerce experience
  • Experience in coffee, hospitality, or equipment-based businesses

Why This Role Is Compelling:

  • True ownership over a critical growth lever
  • Authority to challenge agencies and set direction
  • Opportunity to build a best-in-class in-house paid function
  • High-impact role with visibility across the business
  • Work on meaningful, long-consideration products

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule with opportunities for growth
  • Work remotely from the comfort of your own home
  • Join a dynamic and passionate international team in the exciting world of coffee

How to Apply:If you're ready to join our team and play a key role in shaping our talented workforce, please submit your resume in English (resumes in other languages will be immediately disqualified). We look forward to hearing from you!

Pro Coffee Gear is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Job Position: Paid & Performance Marketing Lead

Company: Pro Coffee Gear

Location: Remote (Anywhere)

About Us:Pro Coffee Gear is a fast-growing ecommerce and wholesale distributor of commercial and home espresso equipment. We serve cafés, roasters, restaurants, and serious home baristas with new and refurbished espresso machines, grinders, and accessories from the most respected brands in coffee. We’re building a disciplined, data-driven growth engine — and paid media is a critical part of that foundation.

The Role: We’re hiring a Paid & Performance Marketing Lead to own the strategy, performance, and evolution of paid acquisition at PCG. This role will manage and lead our existing Google and Meta ad agencies, while also setting the roadmap to progressively bring paid media in-house as the business scales.

You will be the single owner of paid performance — accountable for results, agency direction, channel expansion, and long-term capability building.

What You'll Own:

1. Paid Media Ownership & Agency Leadership

  • Own overall paid media strategy and performance across Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube) and Meta (Facebook & Instagram)
  • Act as the primary owner and point of accountability for external paid media agencies, channel-level strategy and prioritization, and budget allocation and pacing
  • Set clear goals, KPIs, and expectations for agencies
  • Review performance, challenge assumptions, and approve strategy
  • Ensure agency work aligns with PCG business goals, merchandising priorities, and creative and brand standards
  • You are not a passive agency manager — you own the outcome

2. Transition from Agency-Led to In-House Execution

  • Assess what should remain agency-managed vs brought in-house
  • Build a roadmap to reduce agency dependency over time and increase internal ownership of strategy and execution
  • Personally execute and optimize campaigns where appropriate
  • Define tooling, processes, and documentation required to scale in-house
  • Hire or develop additional paid media support as needed

3. Google Ads (Primary Revenue Channel)

  • Own Google Ads performance end-to-end, whether executed by agency or in-house: brand, non-brand, and SKU-level search; shopping and feed optimization; Performance Max (with strict controls); YouTube for upper-funnel education
  • Partner with merchandising to prioritize SKUs, manage inventory constraints, and support launches, refurbished inventory, and clearance
  • Ensure strong alignment between search intent, landing pages, and conversion tracking

4. Meta Ads (Demand Creation + Retargeting)

  • Own Meta strategy across prospecting (education-driven, high-intent audiences), retargeting (site, CRM, engagement-based), and product launches and promotional bursts
  • Direct creative strategy in partnership with internal creative teams
  • Review and approve creative testing plans and results
  • Ensure Meta is used to create demand, support high-AOV consideration cycles, and feed lifecycle marketing

5. Channel Expansion & Experimentation

  • Own testing and expansion into additional paid channels: Reddit, LinkedIn (wholesale, restaurant operators), affiliate and partner marketing, and influencer whitelisting/paid creator ads
  • Decide when experiments are agency-led vs in-house
  • Define clear hypotheses, success metrics, and scale/kill decisions

6. Measurement, Reporting & Forecasting

  • Own performance reporting across all paid channels and agencies
  • Track and optimize toward blended MER, contribution margin, paid revenue vs plan, and lead revenue conversion (30/60/120 days)
  • Build clear weekly and monthly reporting for leadership
  • Ensure attribution, tracking, and data integrity are solid and improving

7. Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with merchandising (inventory, pricing, promotions), lifecycle marketing (email/SMS, lead nurturing), creative (ads, landing pages, messaging), and sales/wholesale (lead quality, follow-up loops)
  • Translate company goals into actionable paid media strategy
  • Represent paid media in planning, launches, and retrospectives

What Success Looks Like:

First 3–6 months

  • Clear ownership and accountability over agency performance
  • Strong visibility into spend, performance, and ROI
  • Improved alignment between paid media, merch, and creative

6–12 months

  • More paid execution owned internally
  • Reduced agency dependency without performance loss
  • At least one new paid channel successfully tested
  • Paid media viewed as a predictable, scalable growth engine

Who You Are:

Required

  • 5–8+ years in paid/performance marketing
  • Deep experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads
  • Proven experience managing and scaling agency relationships
  • Strong analytical and financial mindset
  • Comfortable owning revenue and efficiency metrics

Bonus

  • Experience bringing paid media in-house from agencies
  • High-AOV ecommerce or B2B-adjacent experience
  • Shopify-based ecommerce experience
  • Experience in coffee, hospitality, or equipment-based businesses

Why This Role Is Compelling:

  • True ownership over a critical growth lever
  • Authority to challenge agencies and set direction
  • Opportunity to build a best-in-class in-house paid function
  • High-impact role with visibility across the business
  • Work on meaningful, long-consideration products

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule with opportunities for growth
  • Work remotely from the comfort of your own home
  • Join a dynamic and passionate international team in the exciting world of coffee

The opportunity.

Trumid is seeking a Technology Compliance Associate to join our Technology Compliance team. Reporting to our Technology Compliance Manager, you’ll take ownership of key areas — including client security questionnaires and day-to-day security operations — while getting hands-on exposure across AI governance and SOC 2 program operations, working alongside clients, auditors, and regulators. AI Governance

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal skills across technical and non-technical audiences

  • Security Tools: CrowdStrike Falcon Complete, Vanta, vulnerability scanners

  • AI & Observability: AI Gateway tools, LLM monitoring platforms, observability tools

  • Infrastructure: Cloud-native services

  • Compliance Frameworks: SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST

  • Highly competitive compensation

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Overview

As a machine learning engineer in the Economics team, you will build state-of-the-art systems that blend rigorous economic thought with sophisticated machine learning algorithms to tackle some of the company's most challenging problems. Working in a horizontal team, you will have the opportunity to collaborate closely with partners across multiple functions to operate on a highly diverse set of problems, contributing both economic and engineering expertise in a fast-paced environment filled with exciting opportunities for technically-minded economists.

The Economics team at Instacart works on a range of interesting and challenging problems across our platform, from aligning the incentives in our multi-sided marketplace to analyzing the role of prices and product placement in our customers' decision-making. Some of the core areas of focus for our team include matching and logistics, online advertising, uplift and long-term value modeling, and general causal inference.
