jobs.description:
About Mozilla.org

Mozilla is a mission-driven portfolio of companies and organizations working together to shape an internet that serves people and the public good.

Currently, this portfolio includes: the Mozilla Foundation, which champions our mission through philanthropic risk capital; Mozilla Corporation, which makes Firefox; MZLA, which makes Thunderbird; Mozilla Ventures, which invests in responsible tech startups; Mozilla.ai, which creates open source AI developer tools; Mozilla Data Collective, a data sharing platform for human agency and fair value exchange. It also includes a handful of smaller strategic investments and Mozilla's investment reserve.

Mozilla.org serves as a steward of this portfolio, managing Mozilla's assets and investments to ensure they are used to advance the vision outlined in the Mozilla Manifesto. In this role, it shapes long term strategy, allocates funding and manages Mozilla’s brands. Ultimately, its job is to enable the success of all of Mozilla’s organizations in the pursuit of the overall nonprofit mission. Over the coming years, our ambition is to actively grow the portfolio—helping existing organizations grow and mature while creating or investing in new organizations that can extend Mozilla’s reach and build long-term financial value.

About the Role

As a part of the Mozilla.org team, the Director, Portfolio Management sits at the intersection of portfolio planning, governance, performance management, and cross-organizational execution. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role for an operator who can bring structure to complexity, translate portfolio priorities into clear plans and processes, and ensure leaders across Mozilla have the information, forums, and operating rhythms needed to make effective decisions.

The role reports directly to Mozilla’s COO and, along with everyone on the Mozilla.org team, is housed within the Mozilla Management Company.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Planning & Performance

  • Lead the portfolio planning process, integrating organizational strategies, operating plans, capital requirements and portfolio-level priorities. This includes double bottom line goal setting and capital allocation across Mozilla’s portfolio organizations.
  • Develop and maintain the information architecture for portfolio management, including portfolio-level dashboards, scorecards, and reporting that provide visibility into organizational priorities, performance, risks, and dependencies.
  • Partner with Finance and operating organization leaders to connect strategic priorities, operating plans, and resource allocation.
  • Develop comparative analyses, benchmarks and portfolio insights. Identify trends, opportunities and areas requiring management attention.
  • Synthesize information across the portfolio into clear insights, recommendations, and decision points for Mozilla.org leadership.

Portfolio Governance & Operating Model

  • Maintain and evolve operating frameworks, decision rights, authority matrices, and playbooks that clarify how Mozilla.org, and portfolio organizations work together.
  • Serve as a systems thinker — constantly looking to optimize the interface between strategic ambition and operational muscle.
  • Coordinate portfolio governance processes and help prepare materials for leadership and Board discussions.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve decision-making, and reduce unnecessary coordination across organizations.

Cross-Portfolio Execution

  • Lead or coordinate high-priority initiatives that span multiple Mozilla organizations.
  • Translate Mozilla.org portfolio priorities into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, dependencies, and delivery cadences.
  • Surface risks and execution gaps early and work with leaders across the portfolio to resolve them.
  • Build lightweight processes that create accountability without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.

Leadership & Decision Support

  • Serve as a strategic and operational partner to the COO and broader Mozilla.org leadership team.
  • Design and facilitate portfolio-level operating forums and working sessions.
  • Build trusted relationships across Mozilla’s portfolio organizations and influence effectively without relying on direct authority.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in a multi-entity holding company or an investment management, private equity, venture capital, or development finance organization.
  • Direct prior experience in a portfolio-level role, along with experience in strategy, business operations, portfolio operations, strategic program management, or related roles.
  • A strong connection to Mozilla’s mission and an interest in helping build an organizational model that combines mission impact with strong operational and business discipline.
  • Familiarity with Board governance and capital allocation processes strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and actions.
  • Expertise in managing qualitative and quantitative metrics tracking, dashboards, and systems thinking.
  • Experience leading significant cross-functional initiatives involving senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive-level materials.
  • Strong judgment and discretion when working with sensitive organizational and leadership topics.
  • Ability to operate effectively in environments with distributed decision-making and significant stakeholder complexity.

What Success Looks Like

You help Mozilla.org provide an effective management and coordination layer across the Mozilla portfolio. Leaders across Mozilla understand priorities, decision rights, performance, and dependencies; portfolio-level decisions are supported by useful data and analysis; and important cross-organizational initiatives move from strategy into execution with clear ownership and accountability.

Ultimately, your work helps Mozilla.org more effectively steward its organizations, resources, and mission over the long term.

Sprout Social is looking to hire a Staff Software Engineer, Web to the Engineering team.

Instead of being a small cog in a massive machine, you’ll solve complex distributed systems problems alongside exceptional peers in an environment built for high autonomy and fast execution. Because our platform is a multi-product suite, you have the unique opportunity to explore new technologies, shift across domains, and continuously diversify your skills without ever needing to change companies—accelerating your career while making a direct impact on our customers every single day.

What you’ll do

  • Experience working with Node.js

  • Experience building and/or maintaining an internal UI library
  • Communication and project management skills from collaborating with people across different teams and functional areas.

  • Adhere to the team’s engineering best practices, such as testing expectations, shared patterns, and documentation.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

Most recently, SecurityScorecard was named to Fast Company’s annual list of theWorld’s Most Innovative Companies for 2023 and to the Achievers 50 Most Engaged Workplaces in 2023 award recognizing “forward-thinking employers for their unwavering commitment to employee engagement.” SecurityScorecard is proud to be funded by world-class investors including Silver Lake Waterman, Moody’s, Sequoia Capital, GV and Riverwood Capital.

About the Role:

The Country Manager, Japan is the senior sales leader responsible for building and scaling SecurityScorecard's commercial presence in Japan. This is a sales-led country role: the Country Manager carries a direct new-ARR quota, builds and manages a local sales team over time, and is the primary driver of pipeline generation, channel development, and deal execution in market. Customer success, solutions engineering, and marketing remain centrally resourced and regionally supported; the Country Manager is expected to multi-thread closely with those functions rather than own them locally. This person reports to the President of International Sales and is a key voice in shaping SecurityScorecard's go-to-market strategy for Japan.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own new-ARR bookings for Japan against an assigned quota, with disciplined forecasting and pipeline coverage (typically 3–4x of remaining quota) reported on a weekly cadence.
  • Build, run, and progress a pipeline of enterprise, financial services, insurance, and public-sector opportunities across both self-monitoring (SM) and third-party risk management (TPRM) use cases.
  • Apply MEDDPICC discipline to every material opportunity — Economic Buyer access, Decision Criteria/Process, Champion development, and Competition displacement (primarily BitSight; also UpGuard, Black Kite, and Panorays) — and bring gap analysis and next steps to weekly pipeline reviews.
  • Identify, recruit, and manage a channel and alliance ecosystem in Japan (system integrators, MSSPs, resellers, and referral partners) to extend coverage and influence sourced/influenced ARR.
  • Multi-thread with global Customer Success and Solutions Engineering to ensure smooth onboarding, retention, and expansion of Japan accounts; flag at-risk renewals early and coordinate save plans.
  • Represent the voice of the Japan market back to Product, Marketing, and Legal — localization needs, regulatory drivers (APPI, FSA/METI guidance, financial-sector cyber frameworks), competitive intelligence, and pricing/paper-process norms (hanko/e-signature practices, procurement cycles, data residency questions).
  • Build and execute a go-to-market plan for Japan in partnership with the President of International Sales, including named-account targeting, event and field-marketing priorities, and localized messaging.
  • As the team grows, recruit, coach, and manage additional Japan-based sales hires; instill MEDDPICC-based deal qualification and forecasting discipline from day one.
  • Provide accurate, source-verified forecast and pipeline data for weekly and quarterly business reviews with the CRO and, as needed, the Board.

What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)

  • Quota attainment against an agreed first-year new-ARR target, with pipeline coverage sustained at target levels each quarter (specific targets to be set jointly with Finance/RevOps prior to start).
  • A qualified, MEDDPICC-scored pipeline of enterprise and financial-services logos in both SM and TPRM use cases, with at least [N] Economic-Buyer-confirmed opportunities in active evaluation.
  • At least [N] active channel/alliance relationships generating sourced or influenced pipeline.
  • Clean, on-time forecasting with no late-stage surprises — commit deals scored Strong/Some on MEDDPICC, gaps flagged early.
  • A documented Japan go-to-market plan reviewed and approved by the President of International Sales.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of enterprise software/SaaS sales experience in Japan, including a track record of consistent quota overachievement; direct experience selling cybersecurity, GRC, or TPRM solutions strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to sell to and navigate large enterprise, financial-services, insurance, or public-sector buying committees in Japan, including CISOs, risk/compliance leaders, and procurement.
  • Working knowledge of Japan's cyber risk and regulatory landscape relevant to TPRM/GRC buying behavior (e.g., APPI, FSA/METI guidance, sector-specific security requirements) — deep legal/compliance expertise not required, but fluency in how these drivers shape enterprise buying is expected.
  • Experience building or contributing to a partner/channel ecosystem (SIs, MSSPs, resellers) in Japan.
  • Comfort operating with a MEDDPICC or comparable qualification methodology, and forecasting rigor in a matrixed, US-headquartered organization.
  • Native or near-native Japanese and business-level English (written and spoken); able to work directly with a US-based CRO and cross-functional counterparts.
  • Willingness to travel within Japan (and periodically to APAC/US HQ) as needed.
  • Prior experience as a first sales hire or early country-building role is a plus, but not required if the candidate has strong individual sales performance and channel-building experience to build from.

Benefits:

Why Engineering at Dataiku?

Dataiku’s on-premise, cloud, or SaaS-deployed platform connects many data science technologies, and our technology stack reflects our commitment to quality and innovation. We integrate the best of data and AI tech, selecting tools that truly enhance our product. From the latest LLMs to our dedication to open source communities, you'll work with a dynamic range of technologies and contribute to the collective knowledge of global tech innovators.   • Data Consumption: build the experience that makes data accessible and actionable for everyone.

    • Develop new chart types and optimize visualization performance
    • Enhance dash boarding capabilities to deliver fast and flexible experiences
    • Tech stack: React, AngularJS, Angular, D3.js, ECharts, Node.js, Java, Spring
  • MLOps: Develop back-end capabilities for automating and monitoring ML model lifecycles while supporting cross-functional collaboration.

  • Platform: Focus on scaling and securing the platform while improving cloud integrations and supporting a wide array of data sources and engines.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.excerpt: At Champion, we believe that the biggest growth catalyst doesn’t lie outside, but within.
jobs.description:
At Champion, we believe that the biggest growth catalyst doesn’t lie outside, but within. It’s not about more, but about untapping the potential from opportunity that already exists — from within your champions and yourself.

As a product and a company, we’re set on creating deeper partnerships with organizations and their champions so each and every person can do more, together. Our mission is to help organizations activate their happiest customers as advocates — turning advocacy into a true growth engine.

But “Champion” isn’t just about business growth. It represents individual and professional growth. We’re building a company where every team member is empowered, celebrated, and supported to become their best.

As an early-stage startup, you’ll be part of the starting lineup — helping build the foundation for Champion’s GTM success alongside the founding team.

About the Role

Champion is looking for a motivated Business Development Representative (BDR) to be the first point of contact with potential new customers. You’ll engage with Customer Marketing Leaders, Chief Marketing Officers, and GTM executives about driving growth through customer advocacy, while working closely with our Account Executives (AEs) and VP of Marketing to develop and execute a coordinated go-to-market motion.

This is more than a traditional BDR role — it’s an opportunity to reimagine how outreach is done. At Champion, we believe the best growth comes from human connection, customer-centricity, empathy, and curiosity. You’ll help pioneer a motion that replaces transactional outreach with meaningful engagement — where every conversation builds trust, not just pipeline.

Your goal is to develop relationships with prospects in our Ideal Customer Profile and convert them into high-quality opportunities through authentic outreach, warm introductions, re-engagement of past conversations, and by driving attendance to Champion’s in-person and virtual events. You’ll partner closely with our AEs to identify and develop opportunities and with our VP of Marketing to align outreach with campaigns, content, events, and broader marketing initiatives.

We will also invest heavily in your professional growth and Champion YOU!! You’ll be invited to join the Pavilion GTM community to learn from your peers, receive professional coaching, and have direct mentorship from the CEO and COO.

What You’ll Do

  • Prospect and Engage: Lead outreach to prospective customers through thoughtful, human-centric communication across email, social, and events.
  • Build Relationships: Develop authentic connections with customer marketing, advocacy, and GTM leaders across mid-market and enterprise accounts.
  • Create Pipeline: Identify new opportunities through warm introductions, event engagement, and outbound campaigns, aligning closely with our CEO and COO.
  • Market Intelligence: Research target accounts to identify organizational priorities, customer programs, and advocate signals that align with Champion’s mission.
  • Marketing Collaboration: Support campaigns, events, and launches — turning engagement into meaningful conversations.
  • Process Evolution: Help build and redefine the SDR motion — tools, messaging, metrics, and playbooks. You’ll leave your fingerprint on how we scale and build a human-centric framework for driving growth.
    Own Results: Set and achieve measurable goals for outreach, meetings booked, and pipeline created, while ensuring quality stays high.

What You’ll Bring

  • A self-starter mindset — resourceful, proactive, and driven by results.
  • Genuine interest in customer marketing, GTM innovation, and AI in B2B.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to connect quickly and authentically.
  • Deep empathy and human-centric communication — you understand that great selling starts with listening, curiosity, and trust.
  • Curiosity and confidence to engage executives with purpose and thoughtfulness.
  • Ability to learn quickly, stay organized, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.
  • Perseverance: You push through challenges with consistency and optimism, always finding a way forward.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $65,000–$70,000
  • On-Target Earnings (OTE): $75,000–$85,000
  • Equity: Early-stage equity grant
  • Benefits:
    • Healthcare, dental, and vision coverage for employees
    • Monthly equipment stipend for laptop, monitor, and tools
    • Flexible time off policy

Values We Live By

Go On Offense We’re a culture of experimentation, speed, and adaptation — we play to win.

Be Better Than Yesterday In our arena of growth, every day is a new game.

Get Curious, Not Critical We ask questions before making assumptions, driving deeper learning and greater impact.

Check Your Ego at the Door We collaborate openly, welcome feedback, and celebrate great ideas — no matter where they come from.

One Team, One Goal We believe and understand that we all impact the collective goal.

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

The Fulfillment Services team at Instacart is at the heart of building the picking technology platform that powers the fulfillment needs of the world's largest retailers and millions of customers. Our work directly shapes how shoppers experience their day-to-day work and how customers receive the quality orders they expect — and we're just getting started.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Enterprise Fulfillment engineering team. In this role, you will drive the stability, scalability, and extensibility of the systems that underpin the shopper app experience. You'll collaborate closely with engineering and product leaders across Instacart's R&D organization, as well as with retailer leadership and cross-functional business development partners, to build innovative grocery picking solutions at scale.

This is a high-impact leadership role where you will own the technical direction for a team of 10+ engineers, set the bar for enterprise-grade engineering quality, and help shape the future of how the world's largest retailers fulfill grocery orders. If you thrive in a fast-moving environment where the problems are complex, the stakes are high, and the opportunity to make a real difference is enormous, this role is for you.

About the Job

  • Define, communicate, and drive the technical vision and strategy for the Enterprise Fulfillment team, ensuring alignment with the broader product strategy and key company bets — including scoping and advocating for new technical investments that position the team for long-term success.
  • Own the engineering roadmap and enable high-quality execution of key business outcomes, overseeing technical and product decisions that keep the team moving fast without compromising on reliability or scale.
  • Establish and champion best practices for production services, holding the team to an exemplary enterprise-grade standard that meets the expectations of the world's largest retailers and their millions of customers.
  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of 10+ engineers building best-in-class picking experiences for retailers and shoppers, fostering a culture of ownership, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive recruiting and hiring efforts to attract top engineering talent, while partnering across a broader organization of ~50 engineers and a cross-functional network spanning R&D, business development, and occasionally retailer stakeholders directly.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5+ years in engineering management with a track record of leading teams of 15+ engineers and delivering complex consumer-facing or enterprise-facing products.
  • Demonstrated ability to craft and execute strategic engineering roadmaps that align with business objectives and translate product strategy into technical direction.
  • Experience as a hands-on technical leader, with prior background performing or closely overseeing individual contributor work at a senior or staff-equivalent level.
  • Strong track record of staffing, mentoring, and developing engineering teams, including performance management and career development.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with product managers, engineering manager peers, and senior individual contributors in a fast-paced environment.
  • Highly structured and proactive communicator, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading multiple teams or managing other managers, including scaling a team from early stages to 10+ engineers.
  • Prior experience managing engineering teams that own mission-critical, high-availability business systems.
  • Experience building and maintaining enterprise-grade software systems at scale.
  • Technical familiarity with Ruby on Rails, Go, Swift, and/or Kotlin.

About the role

Hi, my name is Diep N, VP, Finance at Customer.io, and I'm looking for a Global Controller to take the close, the books, and our control environment and make them theirs.

We're a global, remote-first, private company built on subscription and usage-based revenue, and as we grow we need a controller who can lead the team already in place and sharpen the fundamentals. You'll lead a team of ~7, growing, across revenue accounting, close, AP/AR, payroll, and treasury, and partner closely with me and, given our CFO's broad remit, with stakeholders across Sales, Legal, IT, HR, and Engineering.

What you'll do

  • Lead monthly and quarterly close, GL, AP/AR, payroll, and account reconciliations, delivering accurate, timely US GAAP financials. Close currently runs ~10 business days; get us to 6-8 days within your first 12 months, with fewer post-close adjustments and aged reconciliations.
  • Own revenue accounting and serve as our technical accounting authority on subscription and usage-based revenue recognition (ASC 606), including the ARR-to-GAAP bridge: reconciling ARR, billings, deferred revenue, contract assets, and usage true-ups to reported revenue, and explaining the delta to leadership and the board in plain terms.
  • Author technical accounting position memos on contract modifications, SSP allocation, variable consideration, and capitalized contract costs, the work that makes "technical accounting authority" real.
  • Own equity compensation accounting (ASC 718): grant accuracy, 409A timing, expense, modifications, and cap-table integrity, in partnership with stock plan administration.
  • Manage and grow a team of ~7, with room to scale, building trust quickly and developing the leads beneath you.
  • Build a control framework suited to a global, remote-first, private company with subscription and usage-based revenue, keeping the books audit-ready.
  • Own our accounting systems roadmap (NetSuite, Stripe/Metronome, Ramp, Avalara, FloQast) and drive automation across close and reporting.
  • Own select treasury operations, including cash management and banking relationships, and partner on FX exposure monitoring given our multi-currency footprint.
  • Run our external audit relationship and coordinate with external tax partners on compliance, provisions, and filings.
  • Manage the realities of a distributed, remote-first global team: statutory accounting coordination, payroll and contractor controls, entity reporting, and working with Legal, HR, and Tax on international compliance.

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including leading a team through managers or leads.
  • A Big 4 (or equivalent top-tier public accounting) foundation.
  • Deep US GAAP mastery, particular strength in subscription and usage-based revenue recognition (ASC 606).
  • A concrete, personally-owned automation or AI deployment in accounting with a measurable result, eliminating a manual reconciliation, reducing close time, or lowering error rate, that you can speak to in detail.
  • Experience scaling an accounting function that was already running, not building one from zero.
  • A proven track record with external audits and keeping books audit-ready.
  • Strong leadership and communication skills, with credibility partnering with senior, cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Nice to have: internal controls or SOX-readiness experience; remote-first/globally distributed company experience; M&A or deal accounting exposure; CPA license, active or inactive.

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role ranges from $250k to $280k USD (or equivalent in local currency), structured by geographic zone and depending on experience:

Zone 1: $260k-$290k

Zone 2: $250k-$280k

Zone 3: $244k-$265k

Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  1. 30-minute recruiter screen
  2. 45-minute hiring manager screen
  3. Two 30-minute cross-functional chats: one with a Legal partner, one with a People partner
  4. 60-minute case review call
  5. 30-minute bar raiser call with our CFO

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact .

Join us!

jobs.description:
Convergent Research is a non-profit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO): a startup-style team built to tackle one ambitious scientific problem that academia and industry can’t. We’re launching moonshot science projects which may change the trajectory of scientific progress. Today we support 14 FROs and counting across the US, the UK and Chile, with an annual budget of $75 million and growing. Large-scale brain mapping, climate measurement and software for math all have something in common: they each need a nonprofit legal entity, payroll providers, health benefits, boards, contracts, office space, press releases, websites… For every FRO we support, Convergent provides the backend infrastructure that lets them move fast.

About the Role

As the Controller, you oversee the full accounting operation across Convergent, its disregarded entities and its subsidiaries, from the general ledger and monthly close to internal controls, audit and regulatory compliance. You will also build and run our federal grants program: designing the compliance infrastructure, monitoring every award, and executing against 2 CFR Part 200 from award setup to closeout. Reporting to the Head of Finance, you will lead a team of Finance & Accounting Managers and serve as our in-house expert on GAAP and federal grant compliance, weighing in on matters of significance with team, FRO and Convergent leaders.

This is a fully remote position with domestic travel required quarterly for team and organizational onsites, and as needed.

You Are

  • A seasoned nonprofit accountant. You bring deep, hands-on experience across the full accounting cycle in nonprofits, including fund accounting, net asset restrictions, multi-entity consolidation, and revenue recognition for contributions, grants and exchange transactions. You enjoy solving complex reconciliation challenges and have a passion for financial accuracy.

  • The in-house GAAP expert. You support the Head of Finance in researching and documenting technical accounting positions, such as conditional grants, restricted gifts, leases and intercompany transactions, and leaders rely on your judgment on matters of significance.

  • Audit-seasoned. You have participated in more audits and single audits than you can count and have filed just as many 990s. You know what the auditors will ask before they ask it.

  • A federal grants program builder. You know all the components of 2 CFR Part 200. You have built federal grant compliance programs from the ground up: written the policies, procedures and control documentation, stood up the systems, and audited them yourself. You are comfortable across agencies and award types, including grants, cooperative agreements and other transactions.

  • A people leader. You have led accounting teams, including managers. You set clear standards, review work closely and help your team grow.

  • Pleasantly detail-obsessed. You sweat the details, but don’t get hung up on immaterial ones. You know when it’s appropriate to push back for compliance or GAAP sake.

  • Systems-savvy. You enjoy working with multiple systems and have a firm grasp of accounting systems. You know when to ask for systems help too!

  • A natural collaborator. You can translate a complex journal entry into plain English for a non-finance colleague without breaking a sweat.

You Will

  • Own the close. You oversee monthly reconciliation and close across Convergent, its disregarded entities and its subsidiaries, including consolidation and intercompany. You set the close calendar and review standards, and you know the ins and outs of every detail on those balance sheets.

  • Lead the accounting team. Manage and develop a team of Finance & Accounting Managers. Set priorities, review their work, and design metrics to measure performance and team successes.

  • Build the federal grants program. Design and implement Convergent’s federal grants compliance program under 2 CFR Part 200, including policies and procedures, internal controls, allowable cost review, time and effort reporting, cost allocation, indirect and fringe rate support, and subrecipient monitoring.

  • Oversee every award. Make sure the Finance & Accounting Managers manage each federal award across Convergent and its FROs correctly from award setup through closeout. Review their budget-to-actuals, burn rates, cost share, drawdowns and invoicing, federal financial reports, SEFA and procurement documentation such as debarment checks and sole-source justifications, and step in early when risks or errors surface.

  • Own audit readiness. Lead preparation for the annual audit and the Single Audit, including PBC requests, supporting schedules, SEFA and corrective action plans, coordinate 990 workpapers with our preparer, and own regulatory financial reporting.

  • Own revenue and restrictions. Make sure revenue recognition, donor restriction tracking and releases, payroll allocations and time and effort reporting are accurate across every entity.

  • Turn numbers into insight. As first line reviewer of monthly financial reports, you review monthly financials for relevancy, consistency, and completeness, and advocate for changes that make reports useful for decision-making.

  • Strengthen systems and controls. Write and maintain accounting SOPs and internal control documentation, improve workflows and systems, and keep controls tight across every entity.

  • Lead the in-house transition. Partner with the Head of Finance to move work from our outsourced accounting firm in-house, mapping each task to an owner and keeping the close on track during the handoff.

  • Partner on budgets and policy. Support the Head of Finance on the annual budget, financial policies and internal control design, and serve as backup on chart of accounts changes.

  • Bring the whole team along. You make financial insights accessible and actionable, whether you're talking to a scientist, an engineer, or a program lead.

In 6 months you will have (6 months goals)

  • Learned the business of each FRO and understood its accounting and grant needs.

  • Built strong relationships with your team, internal teams, FRO leaders, auditors and external accounting partners.

  • Assessed our federal grants compliance against 2 CFR Part 200, delivered a roadmap, and put the priority policies and controls in place.

  • Set up award-level monitoring for every active federal award.

  • Brought the monthly close onto a consistent calendar with clear review standards across your team.

We Offer (Amazing Benefits)

  • A rare chance to build institutional architecture for frontier science and work with some of the smartest and most talented experts from different fields

  • Competitive Salary: $176,000. Convergent uses a consistent compensation philosophy across all roles, and we offer a 5-10% premium for those working from especially high cost of labor locations (e.g. NYC, San Francisco) or from our NYC office. This structure helps us keep pay transparent, consistent, and equitable.

  • Up to a 6% 401k match because future-you deserves comfort

  • Top-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance—majority of options are fully covered for you and your dependents. Stay healthy, my friend

  • Company-paid life insurance, AD&D, long- and short-term disability insurance, as well as voluntary supplemental insurance options

  • 19 holidays (including a full week off at the end of the year—yes, we enforce it)

  • 3 weeks PTO with tenure increases, with separate allotments for sick and parental leave

  • Generous fertility benefits and childcare reimbursement—because tiny humans are a big deal

  • Education and professional development benefits

  • Wellness allowance for fitness and wellness activities (treat yourself to climbing shoes or Calm.com—no judgment)

  • 3x/year offsite team retreats and additional opportunities to meet your teammates in person

Convergent Research aims to help fill a structural gap in today's R&D system. We enable fundamental research that requires unusual levels of scale and coordination yet is not rapidly monetizable by industry. We’re bringing together top talent from academia, industry, and startups to build a new model for innovative R&D.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We are more than a proud Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Our goal is to foster a healthy, safe, and respectful environment where all employees are valued and treated with dignity. Harassment of any kind is not tolerated here.

jobs.title: Tech Lead, Agentic Development
jobs.excerpt: About T-InnovaT-Innova has built the software that runs sports centers, gyms and clubs in Spain since 1993, from its base in Castelldefels, Barcelona.
jobs.description:
About T-Innova

T-Innova has built the software that runs sports centers, gyms and clubs in Spain since 1993, from its base in Castelldefels, Barcelona. Deporwin and DeporSite handle memberships, bookings and activities, payments and billing, reception point of sale and the access control at the door for around 300 clients, from single facilities to chains of dozens of centers. T-Innova is part of the Manos Group within Valsoft, a Canadian group that acquires and grows vertical-market software companies, which gives it the backing of a larger group while it runs as a focused, independent product company.

After more than 30 years in this market, T-Innova is building its next product: a new cloud platform, designed agentic-first from day one. The groundwork is done. The existing system has been mapped into a documented catalog of thousands of use cases, and the scope of the first release has been agreed across the company. The new product is built fresh from that catalog. The hard part is the bridge: many clients run customized on-premise installations of today's system, and every one of them has to keep running well until it moves across. We're growing the engineering team to do both.

The role

You'll own technical delivery at T-Innova: the engineering team, the code, the release discipline and the technical decisions, working within the shared architecture and standards the Manos Group provides across its companies. You'll be hands-on, building with AI coding agents every day, and you'll set the bar the rest of the team learns from.

Two things matter, in this order. First, today's clients never feel the rebuild. Second, the new product ships in steady, usable releases. You'll lead both, and you'll be the person the managing director and the group's technology leadership turn to for a straight answer on where things stand.

What you'll do

Lead the team

  • Lead, mentor and grow the engineering team, including the hiring of new engineers, and build a culture where people own the quality of what they ship.
  • Lead the move to agentic development by working that way in the open: specifications, agent-sized tasks, review and tests, every day.
  • Work with product, professional services, support and the managing director so that technical decisions follow business priorities and how clubs actually use the software.

Build the new product

  • Turn agreed use cases into specifications and working, tested software, building end to end with AI coding agents.
  • Shape the technical design with the group's technology leadership: data model, multi-tenant SaaS architecture, APIs, integrations and the agentic features built into the product.
  • Build AI into the product for clients, such as assistants, smart search, forecasting and the automation of routine admin, reliably, cost-aware and with care for client data.

Keep today's clients running

  • Own the health of the live platform: a mature estate of Visual Basic 6, .NET Framework services, a PHP web tier and SQL Server databases, much of it running in customized on-premise environments and on Windows Server and Remote Desktop Services.
  • Use agents to read, explain and safely change code nobody has touched in years, and reduce the per-client maintenance burden as you go.
  • Plan how clients move from today's system to the new product, one group at a time, without disrupting the clubs that depend on it.

Engineering quality

  • Bring in and own automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code and observability, where some of it does not exist yet.
  • Set the standard for code review and release, and decide what must be proven before a change reaches a client.

What we're looking for

  • At least eight years of professional software development, including at least two years leading engineers or holding technical ownership of a production system that real clients depend on.
  • Demonstrable agentic development: you ship production code with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot agents as your normal way of working, you can show how you specify, steer and verify their work, and you have helped others work the same way.
  • Hands-on experience building AI features into a real product: integrating LLM APIs with prompting, retrieval, evaluation and guardrails.
  • Strong backend skills in at least one modern stack (.NET and C#, Python, Node.js, Go or similar) and in relational databases, including SQL Server design, migrations and performance tuning.
  • Experience with a cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP), automated testing and CI/CD, ideally introduced into a team or codebase that did not have them.
  • The patience and skill to change a mature codebase safely. You do not need to love legacy code. You need to make it behave.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, and the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers.
  • Proactive: you spot what needs fixing before anyone asks, propose a solution and follow through.

Nice to have

  • Spanish (strongly preferred) and Catalan.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS architecture, and moving on-premise clients onto a cloud-hosted product.
  • Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Bicep or similar) and observability tooling.
  • Visual Basic 6, .NET Framework, PHP or Laravel, and Windows Server and Remote Desktop Services environments.
  • Tool integration through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and familiarity with the EU AI Act.
  • Payments, invoicing and Spanish regulatory requirements such as Veri*Factu, GDPR and the Esquema Nacional de Seguridad (ENS).
  • Sports, fitness, leisure or club management software, membership and booking systems, or access control and IoT hardware.

How we work

We hire for agentic development first and a tech stack second. AI coding agents do most of the typing, and engineers do the thinking: writing the specification, breaking the work into tasks an agent can carry out, reviewing every change, and proving it works with tests before it ships. The product itself uses agentic AI to take routine work off our clients' hands.

The team sets its own working method. The Manos Group supplies the shared architecture, an engineering standard for product AI and a shared framework for agentic user experiences, so T-Innova builds on what works across the group rather than starting alone.

Why T-Innova

You'll hold real technical ownership of a product that sports facilities across Spain rely on every day, and you'll define what agentic development looks like at T-Innova, both in the product and in how the team works. You'll build on more than 30 years of market presence and a loyal client base, with the backing of the Manos Group and Valsoft.

The essentials

Location: Remote, working European time zones (a working day that overlaps Central European Time). Occasional travel to the Castelldefels office near Barcelona.

Language: Fluent English is required. Spanish is strongly preferred: colleagues and clients are Spanish-speaking.

Reports to: Xavi Trallero, Managing Director, T-Innova.

Employment: Full time.

How to apply

Apply through Workable with your CV and, if you can, one example of work you built agentically: the specification you wrote, how you steered the agent, and how you proved the result. A repository, a write-up or a short screen recording all work. Shortlisted candidates do a practical session building a small feature with an AI coding agent, followed by a conversation about how you would lead a team through the same way of working.

You'll work closely with IT teams in India and the United States, along with finance, business, and other cross-functional teams, and you'll help strengthen the PMO team's practices and tools.

Senior QA Automation Engineer / SDET (Canada-only)

Digital Banking & Credit Union Transformation

Company: Aequilibrium Software Inc.
Location: Canada (Remote)
Employment type: Full-time or contract, depending on client engagement
Seniority: Senior
Industry: Financial Services / Credit Unions

About Aequilibrium

Aequilibrium is a Canadian digital transformation and software engineering company specializing in digital banking, financial services, customer experience, and emerging technologies. We partner with Canadian and US credit unions to modernize digital banking platforms, integrate enterprise systems, and deliver reliable, intuitive member experiences. We are expanding our QA engineering capability to support multiple Canadian credit union clients undergoing digital banking modernization, platform migrations, and integration initiatives.

The Opportunity

We are looking for experienced Senior QA Automation Engineers / Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs) who combine strong technical testing expertise with practical knowledge of banking and credit union operations. You will work with developers, business analysts, solution architects, product owners, and client teams to ensure complex digital banking applications are secure, reliable, accessible, and production-ready.

This is a hands-on engineering role. We are particularly interested in candidates who can design and maintain automated testing frameworks, validate end-to-end banking workflows, and test integrations between digital banking platforms and core banking systems.

Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Quality Engineering

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, and integration tests for web and mobile banking applications.

  • Build reusable test automation frameworks and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Develop test strategies, test plans, scenarios, and traceability aligned with business requirements.

  • Execute functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, and exploratory testing.

  • Investigate defects, analyze logs, identify root causes, and collaborate with developers to resolve them.

  • Improve test coverage, automation reliability, and quality reporting.

Digital Banking & Credit Union Testing

  • Validate member-facing journeys, including login, MFA, account balances, transfers, bill payments, Interac e-Transfer, mobile cheque deposit and account servicing.

  • Test commercial banking capabilities such as delegated access, entitlements, approvals and business payments.

  • Validate integrations between digital banking platforms, core banking systems, payment services, lending applications and CRM systems.

  • Support data migration testing, reconciliation and regression testing during platform replacements.

  • Participate in system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), release readiness and production validation.

  • Collaborate with client business teams to ensure test scenarios reflect real banking operations and member needs.

Engineering & Delivery

  • Work within Agile delivery teams and contribute to sprint planning, refinement and acceptance criteria.

  • Integrate quality engineering practices into development workflows.

  • Support performance, security, and accessibility testing in collaboration with specialists.

  • Provide clear quality metrics, defect reporting, and release-readiness assessments.

  • Help establish automated quality gates for AI-assisted software development.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software testing or quality engineering experience.

  • 3+ years of hands-on test automation development.

  • Experience testing financial services, banking, credit union or other transaction-intensive applications.

  • Strong proficiency with at least one modern test automation framework such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Appium.

  • Programming or scripting experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, C#, or Python.

  • Strong API testing skills using tools such as Postman, REST Assured or equivalent.

  • Experience testing REST APIs, authentication, authorization and system integrations.

  • Experience with SQL, data validation, and troubleshooting integration issues.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or Jenkins.

  • Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, defect management and risk-based testing.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate directly with client stakeholders.

Highly Desirable Experience

  • Direct experience with Canadian credit unions or digital banking transformation programs.

  • Testing digital banking platforms such as VeriPark, Backbase, Central 1 Forge/MemberDirect, Intellect Design, Temenos, Lumin or eBankIT.

  • Integration testing with core banking systems, especially Fiserv DNA or CGI RFS360.

  • Experience with Canadian payment capabilities, including Interac e-Transfer, bill payments, and payment processing.

  • Knowledge of mortgage lending, loan origination, commercial banking or CRM workflows.

  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure, and . NET-based enterprise environments.

  • Mobile application testing across iOS and Android.

  • Performance testing with JMeter, k6, or similar tools.

  • Accessibility testing aligned with WCAG standards.

  • Experience testing AI-generated code or implementing automated quality controls in AI-assisted development environments.

  • Experience supporting banking platform migration, cutover or production hypercare.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, you will be expected to:

  • Understand the client's digital banking architecture, critical workflows and integration dependencies.

  • Establish or improve automated regression coverage for high-priority banking journeys.

  • Identify gaps in test coverage and recommend practical improvements.

  • Contribute to reliable release-readiness reporting and defect management.

  • Reduce manual regression effort while improving confidence in production releases.

Why Join Aequilibrium?

  • Work on meaningful digital banking modernization projects with Canadian credit unions.

  • Collaborate with experienced engineers, designers, architects, and banking specialists.

  • Contribute to complex integration, automation, and member-experience challenges.

  • Help shape modern quality engineering practices, including AI-assisted development and testing.

  • Join a remote-first Canadian team focused on purposeful impact and technical excellence.

To apply: Please submit your resume and highlight your test automation expertise, financial services experience, banking platforms, and core banking integrations in your cover letter.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Developer to join Ashbury on a contract basis, starting immediately, to build out our portfolio of AI-assisted regulatory and artwork tools. This is a hands-on development role: most of your week will be spent designing, writing, testing and shipping code, taking prototypes that already exist and turning them into tools our advisors use every day.

Ashbury is a trusted technical and regulatory services provider to the food industry. We are developing tools that improve the speed, accuracy and consistency of specification and artwork work, including Pack Copy and final-artwork alignment, artwork version comparison, international regulatory adaptation and retailer-specific specification checks. These tools combine document processing, OCR and rules with generative AI, and you will work alongside our IT team and regulatory specialists to deliver them in small, usable releases.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and build the features behind Ashbury’s regulatory and artwork tools, taking working prototypes through to production and delivering in small, frequent releases that save advisor time and reduce regulatory or artwork risk.
  • Choose the right approach for each problem, blending deterministic rules, document processing, OCR and generative AI, and favouring reproducible, explainable outputs where they feed regulated decisions.
  • Build LLM-backed features properly: structured prompting, evaluation against representative test data and golden outputs, and clear thresholds for accuracy, latency and cost before anything is released.
  • Work directly with our regulatory specialists to turn retailer and market knowledge into testable rules, reusable components and terminology mappings.
  • Write well-tested, maintainable code in source control, ship through our existing Azure DevOps pipelines and document what you build so the internal team can support and extend it.
  • Follow secure-by-design practices (least privilege, secrets management, privacy controls, dependency hygiene) and take part in code reviews with the rest of the development team.
  • Help shape the technical direction of the tools as they grow, including how they are hosted on Azure, working with Ashbury’s IT team rather than owning the platform alone.

Experience:

Essential

  • Senior-level software engineering experience, including building new products, developing and maintaining existing ones in production.
  • Hands-on proficiency with C#/.NET and Azure (Functions, App Service, storage and AI services), with strong API, data-processing and systems-integration skills.
  • Practical experience building LLM-backed features: prompt design, evaluation, guardrails and cost control, using Azure OpenAI or similar APIs.
  • Experience taking prototypes or digital products through to production launch, controlled rollout and ongoing improvement.

Please note: This role is contingent upon a contract award. While it is not an immediate opening, we are actively conducting interviews and extending offers in anticipation of the award.


The Work

At ICF our Digital Modernization Division is an information technology and management consulting organization that delivers integrated, strategic solutions to federal clients. Join a team accelerating the modernization of a large federal agency's enterprise data and analytics ecosystem. As demand continues to grow, the team is focused on migrating legacy workloads, streamlining onboarding and support, expanding platform capabilities, and helping organizations across the enterprise adopt modern data and AI solutions at scale.

We are seeking a Senior FinOps Analyst to provide specialized cloud financial management expertise supporting the Summit program. This role will help make cloud cost, utilization, and performance transparent and actionable across platform, data, AI/ML, and customer-facing workstreams.


The Senior FinOps Analyst will develop dashboards, forecasts, trend analyses, and optimization recommendations that help technical and product teams understand how cloud architecture and workload decisions affect cost. The role will partner closely with Product Operations, engineering, data, and technical leads to identify opportunities to improve efficiency while balancing cost, utilization, and performance.


Job Location: Remote, however, strong preference for candidates who live in the Washington DC Metro Area. There will be occasional onsite meetings on the client site in Washington, DC.


*If you accept this position, you should note that ICF does monitor employee work locations, blocks access from foreign locations/foreign IP addresses, and prohibits personal VPN connections.


What You Will Do:

  • Develop and maintain FinOps dashboards and executive reporting that provide visibility into cloud spend, utilization, trends, and performance.
  • Analyze cloud consumption and identify cost optimization, rightsizing, and efficiency opportunities.
  • Develop cloud cost forecasts and analyze actual spend against projected usage and demand.
  • Evaluate cost-performance tradeoffs associated with architecture, platform, data, and AI/ML decisions.
  • Analyze Azure and Databricks consumption and cost patterns to identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities.
  • Partner with Product Operations and technical leads to make the cost impact of planned work visible before priorities and investments are committed.

  • Establish metrics and reporting that improve accountability and visibility around cloud consumption.
  • Support ongoing FinOps practices surrounding cost allocation, forecasting, optimization, and cloud financial governance.
  • Identify unusual spending or utilization patterns and work with technical teams to understand root causes and potential corrective actions.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.


We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer to join our team. As a Senior Salesforce Developer, you will design, build, and maintain scalable solutions on the Salesforce customer relationship management (CRM) platform, applying both declarative tools and programmatic capabilities to meet complex business requirements. You will also design and support integrations that connect Salesforce with external systems through Application Programming Interface (API) connections, delivering secure, efficient, and real-time data exchange.


Your solutions will support the teams that deliver clinical research, helping bring new therapies to patients with greater speed and quality. Healthcare, clinical development, or related experience is preferred. Responsibilities include designing and developing Salesforce solutions, building API integrations, leading code quality, and supporting release and production operations, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence business and project outcomes.


You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through strategic Salesforce solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud (Pardot), and Contract Lifecycle Management. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Salesforce Developer can explore career paths and expand skills across Salesforce and clinical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build scalable Salesforce solutions that meet business requirements and follow best practices. Translate technical specifications into high-quality solutions using declarative tools (such as Flows and Lightning App Builder) and programmatic capabilities (such as Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components)
  • Design, develop, and maintain robust Salesforce API integrations using REST, SOAP, and Bulk APIs, connecting Salesforce with external systems for efficient data exchange, real-time synchronization, and strong security and performance

  • Partner with business analysts, project managers, and stakeholders to understand requirements, provide technical insight, and offer expert-level Salesforce guidance that keeps projects on track
  • Develop and execute comprehensive unit tests, participate in integration testing, and support user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure high-quality deliverables that meet defined requirements and standards
  • Provide technical support and resolve complex incidents and issues across Salesforce solutions, working closely with the support team and Salesforce technical support when needed
  • Own and contribute to technical documentation, including solution design documents and technical specifications, so development is well documented for knowledge sharing and future maintenance
  • Stay current on Salesforce features, trends, and industry developments. Research and propose innovative solutions to complex business problems, leveraging new Salesforce functionality or third-party applications
  • Support sprint release deployments that move work smoothly from development to production. Sprint releases are scheduled on weekends once every 3 weeks

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strong Salesforce expertise across Marketing Cloud (Pardot), Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and AppExchange solutions such as Contract Lifecycle Management and Introhive
  • A deep understanding of the Salesforce data model, security model, automation tools, and integration capabilities
  • Strong architecture and design skills to create scalable, maintainable solutions aligned with best practices, performance, and scalability considerations
  • Hands-on familiarity with integration techniques and data management tools, including REST, SOAP, Bulk API, Data Loader, Workbench, and ETL tools
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug code, analyze system behavior, and apply creative solutions
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience deploying complex changes across sandbox and production environments, and working in Agile teams using Scrum or Kanban with tools such as Jira
  • A passion for continuous learning, a team-first mindset, and the flexibility to adapt to changing project priorities and requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Salesforce administration and development
  • Salesforce Administrator Certification, Salesforce Platform App Builder Certification, and Salesforce Platform Developer I Certification
  • Experience designing and implementing Salesforce development projects and integrating Salesforce with external systems
  • Experience troubleshooting and resolving production issues
  • Experience with CRM software and working knowledge of relational database design
  • Experience with contract lifecycle management (CLM) software
  • Knowledge of the full sales cycle, from lead generation and request for proposal through the contract lifecycle (work orders to change in scope)
  • Understanding of incident and problem management in a technology support environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Advanced Administrator Certification and Sales Cloud Consultant credential
  • Salesforce Platform Developer II Certification
  • Experience in healthcare, clinical development, or a related field
  • Knowledge of Agent force (AI) and Data Cloud
  • Knowledge of Einstein Analytics configuration, with YAML experience as an advantage
  • Experience implementing version control systems (such as Git or Azure DevOps) and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) processes

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

jobs.description:
Director of Development & Automation

Why Digacore?

We’re a fast-paced, people-first MSP recently recognized as one of New Jersey’s Top Workplaces for 2026, with:

  • Real career growth
  • Autonomy to own projects and make decisions
  • A collaborative culture (we back each other up — no egos)
  • The chance to shape a function — your structure, your standards, your scorecard

About the Role

Reports to: CTO

We’re looking for a Director to take ownership of Digacore’s Development & Automation (DNA) team — a capable group of developers, data, product, and AI specialists working across three streams: AI services for clients, internal data and reporting, and a client-facing software product. The direction is set; now it needs a leader to turn it into structure, consistency, and results, so the CTO can step back from the day-to-day.

You’ll start by getting to know the team and what’s in flight, then put the foundation in place — SOPs, guidelines, a delivery cadence, and KPIs that give leadership a clear view of where things stand — and grow the team as the work demands. You’re comfortable rolling up your sleeves to unblock a build or prove out a solution, but your impact comes from leading through others, not writing the code yourself.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the existing team: learn each person’s strengths, set clear ownership, and manage each one the way they need — including senior specialists who are deeper than you in their own domains
  • Set the standards: write and roll out SOPs and guidelines for how the team works — intake, prioritization, delivery, documentation, and handoffs — starting with our repeatable client AI Services processes
  • Own the KPIs: define and track the metrics that prove impact (time to deploy, delivery against dates, time saved, adoption, ROI) and give the CTO a clear monthly view of what’s on track and what isn’t
  • Run the team’s weekly delivery cadence so every initiative has an owner, a priority, a next step — and status is visible at any point without chasing people down
  • Own the roadmap across all three streams — when urgent asks compete, decide what comes first, what waits, and what doesn’t happen, and reset expectations with stakeholders
  • Take ownership of client AI engagements — assessment, setup, training, and custom builds — so they move from signed to live quickly and run without escalating to the CTO
  • Oversee product releases with the Product Owner and developers — pressure-test estimates, surface risk early, and hold to commitments
  • Back the internal data and reporting work — the data warehouse and leadership scorecard, including AI Services results — so leadership gets numbers it trusts
  • Be the escalation point on client issues — including security, compliance, and data privacy questions — and prepare the team to handle them well
  • Partner with leadership and department heads to identify manual work and friction, and turn it into automation and AI solutions
  • Grow the team when needed — identify gaps, define new roles, and hire and onboard as the function scales
  • Own tooling and vendor decisions, budget input, and capacity planning for the function

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • Every team member known with clear ownership, and every initiative inventoried with an owner, priority, and next step
  • A weekly delivery cadence running, and a monthly KPI report the CTO can read in two minutes
  • Core SOPs written and followed, starting with client AI deployment
  • The CTO out of routine client engagements, with client builds moving from signed to live on a fast, predictable timeline
  • Shipped wins with documented ROI, and a clear view of where the team needs to grow next

What You Bring

  • Proven leadership: 7+ years in automation, development, data, or technical operations, including 3+ years leading a technical team with direct reports — coaching, accountability, and running a delivery cadence
  • You’ve built the playbook: a track record of putting SOPs, operating rhythms, and KPIs in place for a team that didn’t have them — and getting people to actually follow them
  • Experience leading people more technical than you — you set outcomes and check progress without micromanaging
  • Shipped AI, automation, or software that moved a measurable number — not pilots and slide decks
  • Strong technical grounding in the Microsoft stack (M365/Azure, Power Platform, Power BI), APIs, and integrations — enough to unblock, review, and build when needed
  • Comfortable in client-facing work, including tough conversations around data, security, and compliance
  • Strong business translation — you turn “we need X” from non-technical stakeholders into a delivered solution
  • Thrives in a lean, fast-moving environment — candidates who need heavy corporate structure won’t be the right fit

Nice to Have

  • MSP, SaaS, or multi-client service experience
  • Background in software product delivery or data/BI leadership

Compensation:

$150,000–$180,000 Annually (depending on experience)

Perks & Benefits

  • Nationwide medical, dental, life, and LTD insurance (we cover LTD + life 100%)
  • Generous PTO + Mental Health Days
  • 401(k) with company match
  • HSA & FSA options
  • Paid training & certification assistance
  • $500 sign-on bonus
  • Quarterly team events and career coaching
  • Equal opportunity employer — veterans encouraged to apply

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer!

Salary: $150,000-$180,000, DOE

JOB TITLE: Product Owner REPORTS TO: Product Manager DEPARTMENT: Product Management LOCATION: Remote Job Overview Help bring AI to education and certification. Our team exists to deliver AI-centered features for the education and certification industry. As Product Owner, you'll lead and organize that work, turning product vision into a clear, prioritized backlog the engineering team can deliver with confidence. You'll sit between two groups of experts. On one side are the subject matter experts, educators and certification bodies who understand learning and assessment deeply. On the other are the AI engineers and scientists working with a technology that changes month to month. You won't need to be an expert in either; your job is to learn quickly from both, ask the right questions, and make sure each side understands what the other needs, so that real-world problems become features the team can build. You won't just execute the vision; you'll help shape it. Working closely with the Product Manager, you'll bring what you learn from users, experts and the delivery team to the roadmap for your area. About Us Prometric is a global leader in credentialing and skills development, building the workforce of tomorrow across industries and professions in 180+ countries. With more than 30 years of assessment expertise, we support organizations across the assessment lifecycle, from development through delivery and beyond. Main Duties & Responsibilities

Own and prioritize the team backlog: write user stories and acceptance criteria, lead refinement, and represent the team in PI Planning. Partner day to day with the engineering and AI science teams to deliver features in lean, iterative increments. Work with education and certification experts to understand their needs and turn them into AI powered features, making sure both sides understand the trade-offs. Help shape the roadmap with the Product Manager, drawing on user research, customer feedback and delivery data. Demo the product and communicate progress to stakeholders, users and clients. Support Product Line Marketing with product knowledge for launches.

Who You Are

You have a bias to action: you ship small, learn fast and iterate. You're curious and comfortable working with ambiguity. You move easily between the big picture and the detail. You communicate clearly and confidently with technical and non-technical audiences. You're organized and self-directed working remotely, and a strong team player. You're a fast learner who's comfortable not being the expert in the room, and you ask good questions.

Essential Criteria

2+ years as a Product Owner or Business/Product Analyst owning a backlog in an Agile team, including writing user stories and acceptance criteria. Regular hands-on use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude, and curiosity about applying AI to real problems. Experience working within SAFe or another scaled Agile framework. Comfortable with Azure DevOps, Jira and Confluence, with a working understanding of software development. Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent experience.

Desirable Criteria

Experience in education, assessment or certification, or working closely with subject matter experts in another specialist field. Experience with product discovery or user research. Experience delivering AI/ML-powered product features. SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager (POPM) certification.

Employee Benefits

Pension Scheme Healthcare Scheme Life Assurance Employee Health and Wellbeing Initiatives Enhanced Annual Leave 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme Enhanced Maternity/Paternity Leave

Job Title: Principal Cloud Solutions Architect – Azure Cloud

Location: US, Canada (Remote)

Employment Type: Full-time


About Altera


Altera, a member of the N. Harris Computer Corporation family, delivers health IT solutions that support caregivers around the world. These include the Sunrise™, Paragon Daneli, TouchWorks EHR, Altera Opal, Ventus, HealthQuest™ and dbMotion™ solutions. At the intersection of technology and the human experience, Altera Digital Health is driving a new era of healthcare, in which innovation and expertise can elevate care delivery and inspire healthier communities across the globe. A new age in healthcare technology has just begun.


Overview


We are seeking a seasoned Principal Cloud Solutions Architect to join our Cloud Solutions Architecture team and drive the design of comprehensive, enterprise-grade solutions in Microsoft Azure. This role is highly client-facing and requires a strategic thinker who can bridge business needs with technical execution while partnering closely with development teams.

The ideal candidate is an expert in Azure architecture with deep experience across data platforms (including Databricks), cloud networking, identity and access management, and operational excellence. They will play a critical role in shaping solution strategy, guiding implementation, and ensuring scalable, secure, and resilient cloud environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Partner with business stakeholders, clients, and engineering teams to define and architect end-to-end cloud solutions aligned with strategic objectives
  • Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performing Azure architectures across multiple domains
  • Lead architecture for data and analytics platforms, including Azure Databricks and modern lakehouse patterns
  • Develop and enforce cloud networking strategies, including VNet design, hybrid connectivity, private endpoints, and secure access patterns
  • Define and implement Identity & Access Management (IAM) frameworks using Azure AD, RBAC, Conditional Access, and Zero Trust principles
  • Collaborate with development teams to ensure architectural alignment, best practices, and successful solution delivery
  • Drive operational excellence, including monitoring, logging, observability, resiliency, and disaster recovery strategies
  • Establish and promote architecture standards, governance frameworks, and design patterns across the organization
  • Lead architecture reviews and provide guidance on technical decision-making and trade-offs
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for clients and executive stakeholders
  • Mentor and guide engineers and junior architects to elevate overall cloud architecture maturity
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and continuously improve the organization’s cloud capabilities and innovation roadmap

Required Qualifications


  • 15+ years of experience in IT, with at least 10 years focused on cloud architecture (Azure preferred)
  • Proven track record of working directly with clients and cross-functional development teams to deliver enterprise solutions
  • Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure services, including compute, storage, security, and platform services
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks and modern data architecture (data lakes, ETL/ELT, streaming, lakehouse)
  • Strong knowledge of cloud networking (hub-and-spoke architectures, VPN/ExpressRoute, DNS, load balancing)
  • Extensive experience with Identity & Access Management, including Azure AD, RBAC, SSO, MFA, and Zero Trust frameworks
  • Experience designing for operational excellence, including monitoring, automation, incident response, and high availability
  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates) and CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence both technical and executive stakeholders
  • Experience delivering complex, multi-tier, distributed application architectures in a cloud environment

Core Competencies


  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively with clients, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
  • Client-focused mindset with the ability to build trusted relationships and deliver solutions aligned to business goals
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound decisions in complex environments
  • Highly organized and results-driven, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
  • Commitment to quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team culture

Travel


Up to 20% travel may be required for client meetings, project work, or team collaboration


Salary range: $140,000 - $170,000 USD. The salary range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including experience, skills, education
