BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

BeOne Medicines Global Research and Development Technology Solutions (GRDTS) team is seeking a motivated, enthusiastic, and experienced Digital & Technology Systems Director to join our Development Technology team. The director, Global Digital & Technology Systems will own the end-to-end system management life cycle of the portfolio of external systems and solutions used by the Global Clinical Operations (GCO) function at BeOne.

The ideal candidate should bring deep knowledge of the clinical space and experience working in Cloud/SaaS environments with the ability to manage multiple projects across different functions in a global, geographically diverse environment. The candidate should also be experienced at running technology projects from a strategy, technology, security, process, finance, and people management standpoint. As a system owner, the individual must demonstrate a strong understanding of system lifecycle management and be able to provide technical expertise while guiding system administration activities. Additionally, they should be adept at fostering collaboration among stakeholders to ensure the system aligns with organizational goals and meets regulatory requirements.

Essential Functions of the Job:

  • Accountable for the entire lifecycle management of all external Global Clinical Operations (GCO) applications and platforms.

  • Responsible for end-to-end system management and oversight of all GCO external systems:

    • Implementation and delivery of systems/applications and projects that meet GCO business needs, including key initiatives to support GCO goals and objectives.

    • Provide data, digital, and technology systems expertise to GCO stakeholders for their domain related needs.

    • Coordinate and drive system maintenance such as security patching, version upgrades, enhancements and configuration changes focused on improving business processes, addressing gaps, and enabling automation and organizational growth.

    • Collaborate with GCO and GRDTS leadership to develop long-term strategies for external systems enhancements and technology investments.

    • Partner with stakeholders and subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop business cases that justify and prioritize system initiatives, ensuring alignment with the overall business plan.

    • Develop and manage budget around external systems ensuring alignment with organization objectives and cost-efficiency.

    • Ensure data integrity, security, and proper governance of information processed through external systems.

    • Coordinate and manage incident response for external system issues, ensuring timely resolution and communication with stakeholders.

    • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation related to system architecture, functionality, and operational procedures.

    • Provide guidance and support to end-users, facilitating training programs to enhance system utilization and productivity.

    • Identify potential risks related to GCO external systems, establish mitigation strategies, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

    • Engage and collaborate with third-party vendors, service providers, and stakeholders to manage contracts, performance and service level agreements (SLAs).

    • Foster collaboration across functions to ensure seamless integration of clinical systems with corporate enterprise systems, thereby enhancing overall operational effectiveness.

Collaboration within GRDTS:

  • Collaborate with other GRDTS capabilities & teams, including Technology & Systems Engineering, GRDTS Operations to deliver solutions for the GCO function within allocated budgets.

  • Ensure all GCO-related systems and data platforms adhere to relevant pharmaceutical industry regulations and internal functional & Enterprise policies including security policies.

  • Liaise with computer system vendors, IT partners, audit, and compliance to coordinate system implementation and change activities.

  • Work within a framework and operating model that supports the current and future technology needs for GCO, that comprises requirements management, solutioning, build, implementation, and administration (run) of global Development platforms, master data, and system interfaces

GRDTS GCO Systems Management Team Leadership:

Team Leadership & Talent Development:

  • Lead, mentor, and manage a high-performing GCO Systems Management team focused on end-to-end system lifecycle management for all external GCO systems and platforms.

  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability and drive professional development.

Operational Excellence, Compliance & Governance:

  • Ensure all systems and platforms adhere to relevant pharmaceutical industry regulations and internal security policies.

  • Liaise with vendors, Enterprise IT partners, audit, and compliance to coordinate system implementation and change activities

  • Ensure the team is trained in and embeds CSV, compliance, and health authority requirements into operational activities.

Collaboration & Partnership:

  • Collaborate with R&D functions and teams on standards and best practices to attain business goals

  • Engage with peers to define, sponsor, and execute continuous improvements.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience working on validated applications in a pharmaceutical or regulated environment, primarily clinical applications and/or systems management in a pharmaceutical or medical device industry especially in CTMS, eTMF, IRT, EDC, SSU management.

  • 8+ years of experience working in a GxP or regulated environment with a strong understanding of SLC methodology, 21CFR Part 11 and GAMP principles.

  • 5+ years of proven leadership at a senior level managing a team of direct reports and associate staff

  • Proven experience in overseeing the direction, planning, installation, implementation, and maintenance of software solutions especially in the SaaS/Hybrid cloud environment.

  • Good working knowledge of O365, active directory technology and schema, and SaaS to SaaS application integration framework.

  • Working knowledge of IaaS (Amazon Web Services, Azure) PaaS and SaaS architectures and technology options a plus.

  • Extensive experience in business and technical analysis, including developing requirements and translating them into data-driven and technical solutions

  • Strong expertise in data management practices, including data integrity, accuracy, and reliability

  • Significant experience delivering technical projects and managing multiple initiatives across diverse functions in a global environment

  • Ability to quickly learn and adapt to several technology areas, demonstrating a proactive approach to industry trends and innovations

Supervisory Responsibilities:

· Manage team members (employees and contingent workers) at global sites, including coaching and mentoring of staff with training and professional development.

· Must be an effective leader and communicator and considered to be a developer of people comfortable working with a broad cross-section of people in direct and matrixed relationships.

Key Capabilities

  • Strategic System Roadmap: Translating long-term clinical objectives into a multi-year system capability roadmap for external GCO systems.

  • Clinical & Technical Translation: Fluency in "clinical domain speak" related to GCO to accurately translate complex clinical workflows into structural, technical system and data requirements.

  • Stakeholder Orchestration & Influence: Navigating a matrixed environment to align with various clinical functions, internal IT groups, and external vendors around external systems standards.

  • Solution Lifecycle Oversight: Managing the end-to-end delivery of digital & technology systems & solutions—from initial scoping and vendor selection through deployment and value realization.

Key Competencies

  • Pharma Industry R&D Domain Literacy: Understanding of the pharmaceutical research and development value chain, mainly for the Clinical Operations function.

  • AI & Data Literacy: Comprehensive understanding of how AI solutions integrate within external systems and platforms, including knowledge of machine learning lifecycles, foundational models, and the requirements for "AI-ready data" to ensure effective clinical systems implementations and management.

  • Strategic Communication: Ability to articulate the business value proposition of external systems and platforms to clinical leadership, helping them understand the strategic roadmap and how the platform aligns with organizational goals and objectives

Key Deliverables

  • GCO function Data, Digital, & Technology Roadmap for external systems: Short-term and long-term strategic blueprint mapping technology solutions directly to clinical capability milestones.

  • Platform Operating Models: Governance structures co-authored with the Systems Engineering capability & GTS to ensure GCO platforms remain stable, highly available, and optimized during production runs.

  • Delivery & launch of AOP projects based on approved requirements, specifications, development activities & implementation plans.

Other Qualifications:

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in multi-cloud architectures and cybersecurity, a proven track record of supporting large-scale, high-availability networks, and hands-on experience operating with hyperscaling environments. You’re a decisive problem-solver who thrives in fast-paced settings and moves with urgency to meet the demands of modern infrastructure.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Design & Integrate:Collaborate with the network architecture team to review and comment on network designs.

  • Manage & Optimize Infrastructure:Lead the deployment, management, and troubleshooting of firewall, load balancing, and IDS/IPS solutions across both on-premise and cloud environments.

  • Enhance Visibility & Intelligence:Evolve our security feature set by using telemetry and advanced analytics to improve network observability and proactive threat detection.

  • Governance & Compliance:Define and maintain comprehensive security guidelines for on-premise and cloud deployments, ensuring consistent alignment with compliance and defense-in-depth standards.

  • Threat Mitigation:Orchestrate rigorous vulnerability management, including patching and bug scrubs, to proactively eliminate potential threat vectors.

  • IAM Strategy:Design Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies and controls specifically for services owned and operated by the global networking team.

  • Operational Excellence:Serve as a key stakeholder in security reviews and ACL approvals, ensuring safe, efficient, and resilient network operations.

  • Incident Response & Triage:Lead incident response efforts by investigating security alerts, conducting root cause analysis, and executing remediation plans in alignment with security incident handling frameworks.

  • Operational Enablement:Partner with the global operations team to ensure they have the necessary operational tools, documentation, and actionable information required to provide rapid first-response to network and security incidents.

What We Need To See:

  • Network & Cloud Security Architecture:Proven expertise in secure cloud-native and hybrid network architectures across major CSPs (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI), ensuring seamless connectivity and stringent security posture.

  • Secure Network Infrastructure:Proficiency in securely deploying and managing Fortigate (FortiManager), Arista, Cisco, and Cumulus OS devices.

  • Advanced Threat Protection:Comprehensive operational knowledge of IDS/IPS, SSL inspection, URL filtering, and anti-malware/bot mitigations to maintain high-throughput secured traffic.

  • Virtualization & Connectivity:Strong understanding of network virtualization (VRFs, VxLAN) and CSP-specific virtualized firewall deployments.

  • Dynamic Routing Protocols:Proficient in dynamic routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, IS-IS to ensure resilient and efficient network connectivity.

  • Professional Experience:8+ years of dedicated network security experience with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, coupled with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally with global security teams.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:

  • Multi-Cloud Security Expertise:Deep proficiency in OCI, GCP, AWS, and Azure cybersecurity frameworks.

  • Infrastructure Proficiency:Working knowledge of Mellanox/Cumulus OS and network routing paradigms.

  • Automation & AI-Assisted Development:Proven ability to leverage Python, Shell scripting, and AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to build efficient automation, frameworks, and operational dashboards.

  • Large-Scale Experience:Demonstrated success in designing and securing hyper-scale network environments.

  • Innovation Outlook:Passion for driving progress through the adoption of groundbreaking technologies.

NVIDIA is leading the way in ground breaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for great people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence.

jobs.description:
POSITION PURPOSE

The Full Stack Engineer builds and owns features across YPO’s layered, AI-first platform from the member-facing React experience through the GraphQL API layer, into the AI-powered intelligence and data services that drive personalized leadership insights for YPO’s global member base.

This is a high-ownership, end-to-end role spanning the experience layer (React, TypeScript, Apollo GraphQL), API and orchestration (Apigee, Auth0, Redis, Kafka), the AI-powered Leadership Intelligence layer (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Neo4j, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow), systems of record (Salesforce, PostgreSQL), and DevOps/hosting (AWS/Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog): taking features from concept through production release, instrumenting them, and iterating on data.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the full feature lifecycle architecture, implementation, code review, QA, deployment, and post-launch monitoring.

  • Build responsive React/TypeScript frontends integrated with Optimizely; design Apollo GraphQL schemas and resolvers served through Apigee; build modular Node.js/NestJS backend services using Redis for caching and Kafka for event-driven workflows.

  • Design and query PostgreSQL schemas (TypeORM/Prisma); collaborate on Snowflake pipelines and dbt models feeding the Leadership Intelligence layer.

  • Integrate OpenAI and Google Gemini APIs for AI-powered discovery, recommendations, and matching; work with Neo4j graph data for relationship-driven insights.

  • Use AI-assisted development workflows (pair programming, code generation, test scaffolding) to increase velocity without compromising quality; handle AI feature failures, timeouts, and token costs with a production mindset.

  • Instrument features with PostHog and Datadog; design and run A/B experiments and feature-flag rollouts via Optimizely; use data to drive iteration.

  • Contribute to architecture decisions, ADRs, and post-incident reviews; address performance bottlenecks across the stack (GraphQL resolvers, N+1 queries, frontend rendering, mobile time-to-interactive).

  • Partner with product, design, the Lead Security Engineer, and DevOps to ensure features are secure, well-architected, and operationally sound from the start.

SKILLS

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multi-cultural organization with international members, helping them achieve excellence in voluntary roles for YPO initiatives. 

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including strong diplomacy skills with the ability to build meaningful relationships with all levels of associates, members and vendors. Adaptable, insightful, empathetic and reliable. Great sense of humor and humility. 

  • Resourceful and able to work independently with initiative and common sense. Effective time management, organization and prioritization skills with the ability to focus on varied projects simultaneously. 

  • Possesses a distinct global mindset, sensitive to local and international customs and protocols.  

  • Demonstrate empathy through active listening and asking the right questions to find the source of an issue. 

  • Able to identify problems, research alternatives, provide solutions and/or resolve issues in a timely manner. Anticipates member/internal client needs and delivers with clarity. 

  • Analytical thinker with ability influence and guide processes with appropriate approach and execution. Natural curiosity and desire to learn more; proficiency and interest in applying new technologies and tools. 

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including proof reading, with a meticulous attention to detail. Adjusts communication style appropriately to the audience.  

  • Professional presence, appearance, and stature to interact easily with YPO members, C-level executives and peers at all levels within the organization.  

EXPERIENCE/BACKGROUND

  • 5–7 years of professional software engineering experience shipping production-grade products end-to-end.

  • Strong TypeScript/React skills (component architecture, state management, hooks, performance).

  • Backend experience with Node.js and NestJS building modular, tested services.

  • GraphQL experience (schema design, resolvers, subscriptions, Apollo client/server) and familiarity with API gateway patterns (Apigee or equivalent).

  • PostgreSQL proficiency (query optimization, schema design, TypeORM/Prisma).

  • Experience with Auth0 or equivalent identity platforms.

  • Familiarity with Redis and Kafka (or similar) for caching and event-driven/message-queue patterns.

PREFERED

  • Production experience with OpenAI, Google Gemini, or other LLM APIs (prompt engineering, rate limiting, fallback handling, cost management).

  • Strong architectural thinking and clear technical communication; experience with high-autonomy, end-to-end ownership.

  • Neo4j or other graph database experience.

  • Snowflake/data warehouse experience with dbt or Airflow.

  • Optimizely or similar experimentation/feature-management platforms.

  • Salesforce integration experience.

  • AWS experience (ECS, RDS, Lambda, S3, CloudWatch).

  • Docker, Kubernetes, or Terraform.

  • Testing with Vitest, Jest, or Playwright (unit, integration, e2e).

EDUCATION/TRAINING/CERTIFICATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to work flexible and/or extended hours as needed to accommodate members and team members in multiple time zones.

  • Willingness and ability to travel, domestically and internationally, without restrictions, approximately 5-10% per year.

EOE

Pax8 is hiring a Senior Application Security Engineer in the United States to help secure the cloud marketplace, financial platforms, and agentic AI products powering our next chapter.

🚀 Build what’s next, securely

Pax8 is evolving quickly, and our Platform Security team is growing alongside our product landscape. You’ll join a small, collaborative remote team where you’re trusted to take ownership, work independently, and bring security into engineering conversations early.

We’re building at the intersection of cloud, security, automation, and AI. Get to know more about Pax8 and explore our latest developments in the Pax8 US Newsroom.

🔐 What you’ll get ownership of

  • Be a trusted security partner to your product area, working alongside engineering leads and architects to influence secure design and implementation.
  • Lead practical threat modeling, helping teams understand where risk lives and turning that insight into actionable engineering decisions.
  • Go beyond automated findings with hands-on code review, design review, and security testing that identifies the issues requiring real human judgment.
  • Own the vulnerability lifecycle, evaluating findings from static application security testing, software composition analysis, dynamic application security testing, and secret-scanning tools and helping teams prioritize what genuinely matters.
  • Make security tooling better, tuning and maintaining security tooling within delivery pipelines and bringing useful security insight directly into developer workflows.
  • Build for the AI era, creating agentic tooling that can improve vulnerability triage, deduplication, exploitability enrichment, and remediation guidance while maintaining appropriate human oversight.
  • Help secure AI-assisted development, shaping guardrails for AI-assisted and agent-generated code and validating whether those controls work in practice.
  • Turn identified vulnerabilities into resolved vulnerabilities, partnering with engineering teams to reproduce issues, shape remediation, and validate fixes.
  • Represent security in architectural decisions, clearly explaining technical risk, tradeoffs, and practical paths forward.
  • Raise security capability around you, mentoring teammates and engineering security champions while turning recurring defects into focused learning.
  • Support penetration-testing findings, bug bounty triage, and security incidents when your application security expertise is needed.

🎯 The impact you’ll make

You’ll help bring security closer to the engineering teams building Pax8’s next generation of products. Your work will make application security more scalable, measurable, and useful to developers while helping the business innovate confidently across established cloud products, new financial technology, and emerging agentic AI capabilities.

You won’t simply point out risk. You’ll help engineering teams understand it, solve it, and build more securely the next time.

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As a Technical Owner you’ll own every technical decision behind our programs, from the first conversation with a course author to the bug that never reaches a learner. This is a technical partner role, not a coding job: you weigh each decision against cost, time to learner, and bugs shipped, and you lead one engineer who writes autotests. The role is fully remote and full-time, for candidates based outside the US.

What you will do

  • Own each program’s technical setup. Know its environments, services, providers, and autotests, and keep a written map of what each program depends on.
  • Shape new and updated programs. Collect requirements from authors and constraints from product, test the options, and land on a workable trade-off.
  • Replace what no longer fits. Find, cost, and run the switch when a tool, provider, or setup is outdated or too expensive.
  • Manage providers. Compare offers, negotiate terms, and own integrations with external providers.
  • Lead autotest coverage. Set coverage and priorities for the autotest engineer, and write or fix tests yourself when needed.
  • Be our customer to engineering. Write specs with acceptance criteria for automation, API, and platform needs, and chase each one to done.
  • Cut bugs reaching learners. Trace each bug to where it entered, close the gap with a test, check, or process change, and track the trend.

Requirements

Must have

  • End-to-end technical ownership. 3+ years in engineering, QA automation, or technical operations, including choosing a product’s setup and living with the trade-off after launch.
  • Solid mid-level coding. Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, Git, CI, containers, and REST APIs: enough to read unfamiliar code, fix bugs, and write autotests.
  • English for requirements work. Strong enough to run requirements sessions and write specs engineering teams accept without a round of questions.

Nice to have

  • Leading engineers. Leading or mentoring at least one engineer, ideally in test automation.
  • EdTech and content validation. LMS or autograded courses, QA or release work, or agents that check content for accuracy and freshness.
  • Automation and data stack. Claude Code, MCP, n8n or Make; SQL and dashboards.

What we can offer you

  • Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.
  • Remote and flexible. Fully remote collaboration
  • Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this senior role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD based on experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the strong expertise and significant contributions expected at this level. This is a fully remote role. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. Work from where you do your best work.

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform, to build and own the platform the security team runs on: the services that discover, scan, triage and route security findings, the event-driven bus that connects them, and the CI security gates every team's pipeline runs through.

This is a development role on the security team, not a security-analyst role. Most of your time goes into designing, building and operating services in Go and Python on Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, the existing fleet where it has grown faster than its upkeep, and the NATS-based event platform that moves findings, inventory changes and notifications between them. The security gates in our GitLab CI (SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning) and the agentic triage and review workflows are part of that platform, not the whole of it. Your job is to make these systems fast, low-noise, and reliable enough to be trusted by default without slowing delivery.

You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own detection and response and network and zero trust — your platform is what their work composes with.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we build. In this role you will build reusable agentic workflows (Claude Code skills, CI review agents, automated triage and verification) that multiply what the team can cover, and hold that review discipline in the platform code you own.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, build, and operate security engineering services primarily in Golang and Python, on AWS and Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, and the upkeep, hardening and retirement of the existing ones.
  • Own the event-driven platform between the security services: the NATS bus, its contracts and consumers, delivery guarantees and observability — so a finding, an inventory change or an alert reaches every service that acts on it.
  • Integrate the platform end-to-end: scanners → finding system-of-record → tickets → metrics, so remediation state is visible and exam evidence is a by-product of engineering.
  • Own delivery of the security gates — SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning: scanner selection and tuning, suppression workflow mechanics, false-positive burn-down, and the rollout tooling that takes a gate from advisory reporting to enforcing without blocking delivery.
  • Build agentic security workflows: CI review agents, automated finding triage and verification, remediation helpers — tooling other engineers actually adopt.
  • Build the triage-to-remediation automation: validate true positives by hand enough to prove the tooling right, then automate the loop — reproduction context, fix guidance, and routing to the owning teams and to vulnerability-management operations.
  • Participate in threat modeling and secure design reviews for the services you build and the pipelines you own.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own.

What We Look For:

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience.
  • Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days.
  • Strong proficiency in Golang, plus working proficiency in Python.

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As a Technical Owner you’ll own every technical decision behind our programs, from the first conversation with a course author to the bug that never reaches a learner. This is a technical partner role, not a coding job: you weigh each decision against cost, time to learner, and bugs shipped, and you lead one engineer who writes autotests. The role is fully remote and full-time, for candidates based outside the US.

What you will do

  • Own each program’s technical setup. Know its environments, services, providers, and autotests, and keep a written map of what each program depends on.
  • Shape new and updated programs. Collect requirements from authors and constraints from product, test the options, and land on a workable trade-off.
  • Replace what no longer fits. Find, cost, and run the switch when a tool, provider, or setup is outdated or too expensive.
  • Manage providers. Compare offers, negotiate terms, and own integrations with external providers.
  • Lead autotest coverage. Set coverage and priorities for the autotest engineer, and write or fix tests yourself when needed.
  • Be our customer to engineering. Write specs with acceptance criteria for automation, API, and platform needs, and chase each one to done.
  • Cut bugs reaching learners. Trace each bug to where it entered, close the gap with a test, check, or process change, and track the trend.

Requirements

Must have

  • End-to-end technical ownership. 3+ years in engineering, QA automation, or technical operations, including choosing a product’s setup and living with the trade-off after launch.
  • Solid mid-level coding. Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, Git, CI, containers, and REST APIs: enough to read unfamiliar code, fix bugs, and write autotests.
  • English for requirements work. Strong enough to run requirements sessions and write specs engineering teams accept without a round of questions.

Nice to have

  • Leading engineers. Leading or mentoring at least one engineer, ideally in test automation.
  • EdTech and content validation. LMS or autograded courses, QA or release work, or agents that check content for accuracy and freshness.
  • Automation and data stack. Claude Code, MCP, n8n or Make; SQL and dashboards.

What we can offer you

  • Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.
  • Remote and flexible. Fully remote collaboration
  • Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

jobs.title: Tech Lead
jobs.excerpt: Who we areFlow Pouch makes functional mushroom pouches.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Flow Pouch makes functional mushroom pouches. People use them as a clean alternative to nicotine pouches and energy products: no nicotine, no caffeine, no crash. We launched in 2024, we have grown quickly, mostly through subscriptions, and we manufacture in the US. We are a remote team of about 30 people across the US, Europe and the Philippines.

Why we are hiring

Our technology has grown faster than our ownership of it. The Shopify store and its apps, the A/B testing stack, a growing set of internal AI tools the founders have built themselves, a VPS or two, and soon a mobile app: today all of this is looked after by the founders, an agency that is being phased out, and freelancers. We want one technical person who owns all of it, keeps it running, decides what gets built in-house and what gets bought, and leads the developer, the designer and the AI builders who do the work.

You would report to Djordje, our co-founder who runs operations and work closely with both founders. This is a hands-on lead role: you will write and review code yourself, and you will also be the person the rest of the company calls when something technical breaks.

What you will own

  • The store. Shopify theme, apps, checkout, settings, integrations with our subscription, email and analytics tools. Nothing breaks, and when it does you know first.

  • Testing and site changes. The A/B tests our team wants to run get implemented quickly and correctly, about eight a month today.

  • Internal tools. The AI-assisted apps the founders have built for the creative team: take them over, harden them, host them properly, and build the next ones.

  • The mobile app. We are planning an iOS and Android app. You scope it, pick the approach and the people, and run the build.

  • Infrastructure and security. Hosting, VPS maintenance, access control, backups, domains, the basics done properly.

  • The team. A Shopify developer and a web and brand designer report to you from day one, AI builders join as we grow, and you will help hire our SEO lead. You set standards, review work and unblock people.

What this role is not

This is not a CRO strategy role; our team decides what to test, you make the tests happen. It is not a pure management role either: with a team this small you will be in the code most days. And it is not an agency relationship; we want one person who treats our stack as their own.

Who we are looking for

  • You have five or more years as a developer and at least two leading a small technical team or being the sole technical owner at a company.

  • You know Shopify deeply: Liquid and OS 2.0 themes, apps and checkout extensibility, the common DTC app stack (Recharge or Skio, Klaviyo, a CRO tool, GA4).

  • You are comfortable across the stack: a modern JavaScript or TypeScript codebase, a Python or Node backend, Linux servers, Git, basic networking and security.

  • You build with AI tools every day and have shipped something real with them, and you can tell us what they are bad at.

  • You have shipped or managed a mobile app, or you can show us how you would approach a first one.

  • You communicate clearly in English with non-technical founders and you say no when something is a bad idea.

  • You are based in Europe or within a few hours of Central European time; some overlap with US Eastern afternoons is needed.

What is hard about this

We would rather you hear it now than in month three:

  • You inherit systems built fast by founders and freelancers, with thin documentation. The first months are as much archaeology as engineering.

  • The founders are technical enough to build their own tools and will have opinions. You need to earn the right to say "we do it this way" through results.

  • Priorities change quickly. A request on Monday can be live by Thursday, and you will be the one keeping that from becoming chaos.

  • The team is small. There is no platform team behind you.

The engagement

Type

Full-time contractor

Compensation

Very competitive, set with the person. We would rather hear your expectation than anchor you with a number.

Location

Remote. Europe preferred.

Reports to

Djordje, our co-founder who runs operations

Team

Shopify developer and web and brand designer from day one; AI builders and SEO to follow.

Start

November 2026.

How to apply

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile, plus short answers to three questions:

  1. A system you took over from someone else and made reliable. What did you find, what did you change first, and why?

  2. Something you have built with AI tools in the last six months that is in real use. What did the tools get wrong?

  3. Your location, time zone, notice period and earliest start date.

jobs.title: Lead Kubernetes Architect (AKS and GKE)
jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community Humana is seeking a Lead Kubernetes Architect to lead the architecture, engineering standards, and lifecycle strategy for enterprise Kubernetes platforms, with a primary focus on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana is seeking a Lead Kubernetes Architect to lead the architecture, engineering standards, and lifecycle strategy for enterprise Kubernetes platforms, with a primary focus on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). This role is central to advancing Humana’s container platform maturity and enabling secure, scalable, resilient, and highly automated Kubernetes capabilities across cloud environments.

The Lead Kubernetes Architect will partner across Cloud Engineering, Security, Network, Platform, SRE, DevOps, and application teams to define Kubernetes reference architectures, establish platform best practices, guide roadmap execution, and support Day 2 operational excellence. This individual will serve as a technical leader for multi-cluster design, platform resiliency, security controls, automation, observability, AI/ML-enabled operations, and GitOps-driven delivery patterns supporting Humana’s Cloud Platform strategy.

This is a hands-on architecture leadership role for someone who can operate strategically and tactically—shaping standards, solving complex technical issues, mentoring engineers, and driving Kubernetes platform adoption at enterprise scale.

Key Responsibilities


Kubernetes Platform Architecture


  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise Kubernetes platforms across AKS and GKE, from initial planning through production deployment and ongoing lifecycle management.
  • Define and maintain Kubernetes reference architectures, design standards, and reusable platform patterns for secure, scalable, and resilient container hosting.
  • Develop and execute a Kubernetes product maturity roadmap aligned to Humana’s Cloud Platform strategy and business priorities.
  • Design for multi-cluster, multi-region, and highly available deployment models, including failover and disaster recovery considerations where required.

Engineering and Delivery Leadership


  • Lead new Kubernetes platform capabilities from concept through design, build, validation, release, and operational support.
  • Drive adoption of Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and CI/CD delivery models for Kubernetes platform provisioning and workload enablement.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to onboard applications and build platform capabilities that improve developer experience, security, and operational consistency.
  • Facilitate technical workshops, architecture reviews, roadmap sessions, whiteboarding sessions, and design reviews.

AI/ML, Automation, and Cost Optimization


  • Identify and implement AI and ML-driven enhancements to improve Kubernetes platform operations, accelerate incident detection and remediation, and drive measurable cost reduction and operational efficiencies.
  • Evaluate and apply intelligent automation for capacity forecasting, workload placement, anomaly detection, rightsizing recommendations, and platform performance tuning.
  • Partner with engineering and operations teams to incorporate data-driven insights into platform scaling, utilization management, and service reliability decisions.
  • Define strategies to improve platform efficiency through predictive analytics, automation, and continuous optimization of cluster and workload resources.

Kubernetes Resource Optimization and Capacity Management


  • Lead the optimization of Kubernetes resources, including CPU, memory, storage, node pools, autoscaling policies, and workload scheduling to maximize efficiency and platform performance.
  • Establish and manage capacity planning practices for Kubernetes clusters and supporting network dependencies to ensure adequate performance, scalability, and availability.
  • Monitor and improve cluster utilization, node health, and workload distribution to reduce waste, prevent resource contention, and maintain service stability.
  • Partner with network and platform teams to ensure network stability and reliability, including planning for ingress, egress, load balancing, DNS, traffic management, and cluster networking dependencies.
  • Define proactive thresholds, alerts, and remediation patterns to prevent capacity-related incidents and support reliable growth across AKS and GKE environments.

Security, Reliability, and Governance


  • Establish and enforce Kubernetes best practices across networking, ingress, load balancing, identity and access management, certificate management, pod security, policy controls, and observability.
  • Ensure platform designs align with Humana enterprise standards for cloud onboarding, security, automation, and operational readiness.
  • Drive platform resiliency through auto-scaling, upgrade planning, health monitoring, rollback strategies, and operational guardrails.
  • Support compliance-aligned architecture decisions, including secure defaults and approved platform integrations.

Operations and Lifecycle Management


  • Define and evolve a Kubernetes lifecycle support model, including cluster provisioning, upgrades, patching, deprecation strategy, Day 2 operations, support processes, and service ownership boundaries.
  • Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex platform issues in real time, including production-impacting incidents and cross-team escalations.
  • Improve platform observability, logging, alerting, and operational readiness using approved enterprise tooling.
  • Contribute to cost optimization strategies for Kubernetes environments, including cluster right-sizing, autoscaling, and non-production optimization practices.

Leadership and Collaboration


  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through technical leadership, coaching, and delegation.
  • Provide architectural guidance to application teams, product teams, and cloud engineers deploying containerized workloads.
  • Build strong partnerships with internal stakeholders, vendors, and engineering teams to drive platform adoption and long-term success.
  • Lead technical demonstrations and communicate architecture decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.


Use your skills to make an impact


Required Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, cloud engineering, or infrastructure engineering.
  • Demonstrated enterprise experience architecting, implementing, and supporting Kubernetes platforms, including AKS, GKE, and/or EKS.
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying cloud infrastructure through CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code in Azure, GCP, or AWS.
  • Experience developing and operationalizing a Kubernetes lifecycle support model, including upgrades, support, reliability, and Day 2 operations.
  • Strong experience with Kubernetes architecture fundamentals, including:Cluster design and provisioningNetworking and ingressLoad balancingRBAC and identity integrationPod security and policy enforcementCertificate and secret managementMonitoring, logging, and troubleshooting
  • Experience optimizing Kubernetes resource utilization, scaling strategies, and cluster capacity management in enterprise environments.
  • Experience leading engineering initiatives in Agile delivery environments and managing work through tools such as Azure DevOps.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex technical challenges in fast-paced environments.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with AKS and GKE in large-scale enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting Day 2 operations for Kubernetes clusters in production.
  • Experience applying AI/ML, predictive analytics, or intelligent automation to cloud operations, cost optimization, observability, or capacity planning.
  • Experience with GitHub, Terraform, and GitOps delivery models such as ArgoCD.
  • Experience with enterprise platform tooling such as:DynatracePrisma Cloud / TwistlockHashiCorp VaultSplunkJFrog ArtifactoryApigee
  • Familiarity with service mesh, backup/recovery tooling, policy enforcement, and cluster security controls.
  • Experience with container technologies such as Docker.
  • Working knowledge of application and data platform dependencies, including APIs and relational databases such as SQL.
  • Cloud certifications in Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS.
  • Kubernetes certifications such as CKA, CKAD, or CKS.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer (Core & MLOps) - Remote
jobs.excerpt: Why Zyte? At Zyte, we don’t just collect web data—we solve complex web data challenges at scale.
jobs.description:
Why Zyte?

At Zyte, we don’t just collect web data—we solve complex web data challenges at scale. We are a globally distributed team that is bold, curious, and dedicated to building innovative ways to deliver clean, reliable web data from across the internet.

  • Data is our passion: We unlock access to open web data, empowering organizations—from startups to global enterprises—to power competitive intelligence, analytics, and AI pipelines.
  • Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere in the world. With over 260 Zytans across 33 countries, our strength comes from diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
  • Engineering excellence: We love diving deep into complex code bases, evaluating emerging technologies, and pushing technical boundaries. If you thrive on creative problem-solving and reliably delivering production-grade solutions, you will fit right in.
  • Established system design framework: We systematically analyze functional and product requirements alongside architectural trade-offs to make informed, sustainable design decisions.
  • Real-world distributed systems challenges: Tackle rare engineering problems in custom networking, high-throughput streaming, and large-scale orchestration under real-world operational constraints.
  • Strong product ownership: Work on a profitable, market-leading platform with dedicated time and resources allocated for architectural research and strategic feature engineering.

Why This Role?

Zyte API powers a suite of Java and Python microservices running across multiple cloud providers and data centers. Every engineering team—spanning Core API, Browser, Edge, Antiban, AI, and Agentic products—relies on foundational infrastructure managed by our team: Kubernetes clusters, high-throughput Kafka pipelines, billing engines processing per-request metrics, and robust inter-service contracts.

We are evolving Zyte API into an automated software factory: a platform where developers and AI agents seamlessly create, validate, deploy, and maintain data extractors and workflows through governed interfaces. Two foundational layers drive this evolution. The control plane (service/schema registries, health-aware routing, automated canary releases) is actively under deployment. The context plane, which synthesizes observational signals to guide automated repair and optimizations, represents our next major design effort. As a Staff Engineer, you will own both architectures, setting the engineering standard for how services at Zyte are designed, built, and operated. You will be the technical lead in the Core & MLOps squad, collaborating closely with the Team Lead, Senior Engineers, DevOps, and QA, while directly influencing the release velocity and architecture of five neighboring squads.

Requirements

What You’ll Do

  • Architect the control and context planes. Advance the control plane (service registry, schema registry, SLO enforcement, CLI tooling) into a robust production substrate. Design and build the context plane to aggregate operational signals—such as domain extraction histories, IP reputation scores, and BigQuery cost/performance telemetry—creating automated feedback loops between intent, execution, and self-healing maintenance.
  • Own the service chassis and golden path. Maintain and refine multi-language client libraries (Java and Python), standardized workload specifications, Helm charts, and deployment pipelines, driving seamless adoption across all product teams.
  • Define inter-service contracts. Establish gRPC and Protocol Buffer definitions, API gateway transcoding, versioning policies, and schema evolution rules to enable autonomous, safe deployments across teams.
  • Operate the platform substrate. Partner with infrastructure engineers to run Kubernetes (across OCI, Hetzner, Servers.com, and GCP), Terraform, HAProxy/Nginx ingresses, Confluent Kafka, real-time event-billing pipelines, Valkey, and ongoing database modernizations (MySQL to PostgreSQL).
  • Drive architectural strategy via RFDs. Lead Requests for Discussion (RFDs) on critical platform initiatives, including durable workflow orchestration (Temporal/DBOS), per-request gateway orchestration, multi-cluster routing, and automated failover.
  • Institutionalize reliability engineering. Establish clear SLOs and error budgets for core capabilities, implementing health-aware traffic isolation and automated weighted canary deployments to eliminate manual release bottlenecks.
  • Share production ownership. Participate in the shared infrastructure on-call rotation, lead incident post-mortems, and translate operational lessons into platform improvements.
  • Elevate engineering standards. Mentor engineers across squads on distributed systems design, review system proposals, and establish intuitive best practices that make building reliable software effortless.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of experience building scalable distributed backend systems, with a proven track record of authoring internal platforms or core libraries widely adopted by engineering teams.
  • Expertise in Java (using reactive frameworks like Vert.x or Netty) alongside strong proficiency in Python.
  • Deep gRPC & Protobuf experience, with demonstrated success managing schema evolution and backward compatibility in mission-critical environments.
  • Hands-on infrastructure expertise with production Kubernetes at scale, Terraform, and event streaming with Kafka.
  • Feedback loop designer: Experience designing automated telemetry pipelines, materialized views, or feature stores that dynamically adapt system behavior based on production data.
  • Reliability mindset: Proven success defining SLOs/SLIs, analyzing blast radius, and designing fault-tolerant systems built around rigorous service contracts.
  • Technical leadership: Exceptional technical writing skills with the ability to articulate complex designs clearly and drive technical alignment across multi-functional teams.
  • Async communication: Strong interpersonal and written communication skills tailored for a globally distributed, remote-first environment.
  • Curious problem solver: Passionate about continuous learning and evaluating novel tools, architectures, and techniques.

Our Tech Stack

  • Languages: Java 21, Python.
  • Frameworks & Tools: Vert.x, Netty, gRPC and protobuf, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, CircleCI.
  • Infrastructure: Multi-cloud (OCI, GCP) and data centres (Hetzner, Servers.com), blue/green deployments everywhere.
  • Data & Messaging: Confluent Kafka, BigQuery, Valkey, MySQL (Postgres next), HBase, Google Pub/Sub.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry.

Bonus Points

  • Durable execution engines: Hands-on experience with Temporal, DBOS, or similar workflow platforms.
  • MLOps: Experience in model serving, performance monitoring, and drift detection in production environments.
  • Zero-trust networking & service meshes: Familiarity with SPIRE, mTLS, Cilium, Istio, or Envoy.
  • Developer tooling: Track record of building CLIs, SDKs, or project generators adopted across an engineering organization.
  • Web scraping & crawling experience: Familiarity with the technical challenges of large-scale web data extraction.
  • Open source contributions: History of contributing to or maintaining open-source projects in distributed systems or data extraction.

Why Join Us?

  • Impact at scale: Architect core infrastructure powering web-scale data pipelines for top-tier global enterprises.
  • Autonomy and flexibility: Enjoy a genuine remote-first culture with flexible working hours and high organizational trust.
  • Continuous innovation: Solve emerging, complex technical challenges as AI and web data extraction rapidly evolve.
  • Global community: Collaborate with a passionate, diverse team of distributed systems engineers and data specialists across the world.

If you are a Staff Engineer excited by the prospect of building core platform substrates that empower multiple engineering teams, we would love to hear from you. Join us in shaping the control plane behind web data extraction at Zyte.

Benefits

By joining the Zyte team, you will:

  • Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team
  • Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work
  • Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe
  • Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

jobs.description:
About Skylight

Skylight is a digital consultancy using design and technology to help government agencies deliver better public services.

We’re at the forefront of a civic movement to reinvent how all levels of government serve families, patients, and many others in today’s digital world.

If you want to play a part in driving this critical movement forward, we’d love for you to join our growing team of public interest technologists.

The work we do matters.

About the job

At Skylight, data scientists organize, synthesize, and analyze data to help government stakeholders and product teams make informed decisions. They apply a variety of analytical models to find meaningful insights in both structured and unstructured data, and they communicate these insights in an easily digestible format.

This project supports the HHS Office of the Chief Data Officer (OCDO) in modernizing enterprise data management, improving data accessibility, and strengthening coordination across HHS Divisions. The team provides end-to-end delivery—from discovery and roadmap development through engineering, implementation, and ongoing operations—across three core areas: the HHS Data Inventory, the AI Use-Case Inventory, and OCDO strategic and programmatic support.

Key activities include automating metadata collection and validation, expanding inventory coverage, supporting data catalog modernization and migration, coordinating Division data calls, and publishing public inventories. The team also supports data governance, statutory reporting, executive communications, and analytical needs. Together, these efforts help HHS reduce data silos, improve visibility into data and AI assets, meet federal reporting requirements, and establish sustainable infrastructure and processes for enterprise data sharing.

In this role, you’ll focus on the AI Use-Case Inventory and broader OCDO priorities, turning ambiguous policy and reporting requirements into practical, repeatable analytical workflows.

What to know going in

This is early-stage, high-visibility work with shifting priorities. Decisions often arrive unresolved, and you’ll help shape them rather than execute against a fixed spec. Client leadership believes moving too slowly is a bigger risk than being wrong, so you’ll do well here if you like prototyping quickly and sharing early, imperfect work.

You’ll work alongside a broader Skylight team. In your first 30 days, you’ll get access to existing systems, learn the current workstreams, and start contributing analysis to them.

What you’ll do

  • Develop repeatable data quality checks, validate schemas, and standardize metadata across HHS’s data and AI inventories
  • Evaluate, classify, and document risks for enterprise AI use cases in accordance with federal and agency governance standards
  • Clean, integrate, and analyze complex data from multiple sources to surface trends, gaps, and patterns
  • Apply machine learning and natural language processing to automate data tagging, classification, and metadata enrichment
  • Prepare reporting datasets and turn findings into clear dashboards and recommendations for technical and executive audiences
  • Choose the right tool for the job, whether that’s a straightforward analysis, a simple automation, or a model, with a preference for open-source solutions
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers, and other specialists as part of a cross-functional team

What we’re looking for

Basic qualifications

  • Experience working with AI systems, modern AI tooling, and enterprise AI model workflows
  • Background in metadata standards, data profiling, and schema validation
  • Can think about and use data strategically to identify the right questions to ask, communicate ideas, surface opportunities, and drive decisions
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience cleaning, validating, and preprocessing data from diverse sources
  • Ability to analyze a data set using the appropriate analytical method, and to design, prototype, and build statistical models that are credible, effective, and accessible
  • Ability to preserve privacy and security when performing data analysis
  • Can articulately communicate your data, models, and findings to technical, non-technical, and executive audiences
  • Ability to use the appropriate visualization tools to highlight actionable insights, trends, and recommendations from data
  • Champion leading practices within data science to your team and others
  • Experience working on cross-functional teams (product, design, engineering, ops) in iterative delivery
  • A mindset and work approach that aligns with our core values

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience conducting risk assessments, evaluations, and compliance classifications for AI use cases against federal or industry frameworks
  • Strong data engineering skills, including working directly in backend pipeline code, ETL workflows, and metadata processing
  • Practical experience applying AI, machine learning, and natural language processing to automate data tagging, classification, and metadata enrichment
  • Familiarity with federal data governance, AI governance, enterprise AI model inventories, or open data reporting
  • Proficiency with Power BI
  • Experience delivering technology in government, regulated industries, or other public-benefit settings
  • A track record of staying aligned and accountable on remote teams

Don’t meet every qualification but think you can do the job? We’d still love to hear from you. If you’re excited about the role, apply. We consider candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences.

Other requirements

  • Some of our available roles are on federal contracts that require a degree or additional years of experience as a substitute.
  • All work must be conducted within the U.S., excluding U.S. territories.
  • You must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. now and in the future without sponsorship.
  • This role requires you to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
  • You must complete a company background check successfully.

Logistics

Position type

This is a full-time, exempt position.

Location

This is a fully remote position.

Travel

This role may require occasional or regular travel based on company, client, or contract needs.

Care package

Salary

We want to give you the most competitive salary possible. After all, you deserve it! To that end, we use the results of our interview process to determine what salary is most appropriate given your current level of seniority. For a Data Scientist at Skylight, the current salary ranges are as follows:

  • Associate Data Scientist: $90,000–$125,000
  • Data Scientist I: $120,000–$140,000
  • Data Scientist II: $135,000–$160,000
  • Senior Data Scientist: $150,000–$185,000
  • Staff Data Scientist: $170,000–$203,000
  • Principal Data Scientist: $180,000–$230,000

Benefits

Your well-being is important to us, so we focus on supporting you in a variety of ways:

  • Medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Life and AD&D insurance
  • Dependent care FSA, healthcare FSA, health savings account
  • Dollar-for-dollar 401(k) match up to 10% of your salary with no vesting period
  • Flexible paid-time-off policy (generally around 25 days per year), plus 11 paid federal holidays
  • Up to 12 weeks paid-time-off for all eligible new birth, adoption, or foster parents
  • Performance rewards, including annual salary increase, annual performance bonus, spot bonuses, and stock options
  • Business development / sales bonuses
  • Referral bonuses
  • Annual $2000 allowance for professional development
  • Annual $750 allowance for tech-related purchases
  • Annual swag budget of $100 to display your Skylight pride with some merchandise (hoodies, hats, and more)
  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment
  • An environment that empowers you to unleash your superpowers for public good

Interview tips

Our process includes a preliminary screen, a skills interview, a behavioral interview, and a reverse interview where you meet your potential team — usually four conversations across two to three weeks. Here are some tips to help you prepare for a successful interview:

  • Visit our join page to learn more about how our interview process works.
  • Check out our Career Pathways framework to learn more about the different roles within Skylight and the skills needed to do them.
  • Browse our case studies to learn more about our work.

If you’d like to request reasonable accommodations during the application or interviewing process, please contact our recruiting team at .

We participate in E-Verify and upon hire, will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you’re authorized to work in the U.S.

Where do you belong?

Your career is more than just a job, it's part of your life. Whether you’re a clinician, or non-clinical professional, at USACS you'll feel a sense of connection working with clinicians and office staff who share your interests and values. We want you to love coming to work each day because you believe in what you do and the people with whom you work. We care about your success.

USACS also understands that location is important. We offer career opportunities for clinicians and non-clinical support staff from New York to Hawaii and numerous points in between. Our supportive culture, outstanding benefits and competitive compensation package is best in class.

Job Description

The Revenue Analytics Finance Manager is responsible for providing timely and accurate insights into the organization’s revenue performance, empowering the business with actionable decision support tools, and keeping stakeholders informed of perceived impacts. As a revenue subject matter expert, the incumbent will analyze, quantify and concisely summarize revenue data, develop well-founded and defensible financial models and projections, and articulate key points to clinical and executive leadership. In addition, this role drives continuous improvement of the revenue model and close process, refining model logic as business practices and payer behavior change.

Location: Remote


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:


  • Key business partner for financial modeling, budget & forecast, performance tracking, and ad-hoc research for Finance, Accounting, Payor Contracting, and Revenue Cycle Management functions
  • Establishes monthly revenue recognition results, reconciles and documents key takeaways, and provides inputs needed for the Accounting close process
  • Identifies, documents and implements methodology improvements to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of the revenue recognition process

jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this senior role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD based on experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the strong expertise and significant contributions expected at this level. This is a fully remote role. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. Work from where you do your best work.

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform, to build and own the platform the security team runs on: the services that discover, scan, triage and route security findings, the event-driven bus that connects them, and the CI security gates every team's pipeline runs through.

This is a development role on the security team, not a security-analyst role. Most of your time goes into designing, building and operating services in Go and Python on Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, the existing fleet where it has grown faster than its upkeep, and the NATS-based event platform that moves findings, inventory changes and notifications between them. The security gates in our GitLab CI (SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning) and the agentic triage and review workflows are part of that platform, not the whole of it. Your job is to make these systems fast, low-noise, and reliable enough to be trusted by default without slowing delivery.

You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own detection and response and network and zero trust — your platform is what their work composes with.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we build. In this role you will build reusable agentic workflows (Claude Code skills, CI review agents, automated triage and verification) that multiply what the team can cover, and hold that review discipline in the platform code you own.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, build, and operate security engineering services primarily in Golang and Python, on AWS and Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, and the upkeep, hardening and retirement of the existing ones.
  • Own the event-driven platform between the security services: the NATS bus, its contracts and consumers, delivery guarantees and observability — so a finding, an inventory change or an alert reaches every service that acts on it.
  • Integrate the platform end-to-end: scanners → finding system-of-record → tickets → metrics, so remediation state is visible and exam evidence is a by-product of engineering.
  • Own delivery of the security gates — SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning: scanner selection and tuning, suppression workflow mechanics, false-positive burn-down, and the rollout tooling that takes a gate from advisory reporting to enforcing without blocking delivery.
  • Build agentic security workflows: CI review agents, automated finding triage and verification, remediation helpers — tooling other engineers actually adopt.
  • Build the triage-to-remediation automation: validate true positives by hand enough to prove the tooling right, then automate the loop — reproduction context, fix guidance, and routing to the owning teams and to vulnerability-management operations.
  • Participate in threat modeling and secure design reviews for the services you build and the pipelines you own.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own.

What We Look For:

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience.
  • Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days.
  • Strong proficiency in Golang, plus working proficiency in Python.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating event-driven or message-based systems (NATS, Kafka, or similar): contracts, idempotent consumers, replay, back-pressure.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipeline tooling — jobs, shared templates, runners — GitLab CI at fleet scale is a strong plus.
  • Hands-on web application security knowledge: the OWASP Top 10 in real code — able to find these issues, fix them yourself, and encode the detection so they stop recurring.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, SCA, and secret-scanning tooling (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, Trivy, Grype, gitleaks), including tuning them to a signal-to-noise ratio developers will tolerate.
  • Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your development work today, have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't, and have built agentic workflows that other engineers adopted.
  • Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes as deployment targets for the services you build.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or consumer lending, especially with systems in cardholder-data or regulated scope.
  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS and SOC 2 as they apply to software development and change management — the platform you build is what produces that evidence.
  • Software supply-chain integrity: SBOM pipelines, dependency governance, artifact signing and provenance (Sigstore, SLSA).
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code and admission control (OPA, Kyverno, conftest) — your gates compose with the cluster's runtime policy-enforcement layer.
  • Exposure to bug bounty or external vulnerability report triage — enough to know what the automation you build has to get right.
  • Experience with threat modeling at a system level.

About You:

  • You measure yourself by other teams' code - a fix you shipped is good; a vulnerability class that stopped appearing across the fleet is better.
  • You'd rather ship a gate than publish a policy - you know that enforcement changes behavior and documents do not, and you build the enforcement so well that engineers want to keep it.
  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You're not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things.
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting.
    You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git

Job Description:

Strategic Interchange Analyst

Constellation Payment Processing

THE COMPANY

Constellation Payment Processing is a modern Payment Facilitator (PayFac) empowering SaaS businesses to grow revenue through seamless, embedded payments. As part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSE: CSU), a global Canadian-based software leader, we combine the agility of a specialized payments company with the strength and stability of an established global organization.

POSITION

We are hiring a Strategic Interchange Analyst to own and advance interchange, card network, routing and payment-cost optimization across our payments portfolio. This is a hands-on role for a senior payments professional who can combine deep interchange and network knowledge with advanced data analysis, workflow automation and clear business storytelling.

You will build on an established analytical foundation, using transaction-level data to identify qualification issues, cost leakage, routing opportunities and emerging portfolio trends. You will monitor network changes, quantify their impact and turn complex findings into practical recommendations for technical, financial and commercial stakeholders.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own interchange qualification and network-cost performance across the portfolio, identifying downgrade drivers, cost leakage, routing opportunities and remediation priorities.
  • Monitor Visa, Mastercard and other relevant network changes, assess their financial impact and maintain current interchange rules, cost tables and optimization guidance.
  • Analyze routing logic and transaction behavior to identify opportunities that improve qualification and payment economics.
  • Use advanced SQL and other programming or query languages to analyze and reconcile large transactions, interchange, billing and network-fee datasets.
  • Build automated monitoring, reporting and analytical workflows using AI, Python, Java or comparable tools to improve efficiency, accuracy and scalability.
  • Translate complex payments analysis into clear executive insights, financial-impact assessments and practical recommendations.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience in payments, merchant acquiring, payment facilitation, processing, card networks, issuing, gateway operations or a closely related field.
  • Deep knowledge of Visa and Mastercard interchange structures, qualification criteria, downgrade drivers, assessments, network fees and card-brand operating rules.
  • Strong understanding of the payments ecosystem, including card brands, networks, issuers, acquirers, processors, gateways, PayFacs, merchants and sponsor banks.
  • Advanced SQL proficiency, with demonstrated experience independently querying, joining, validating and interpreting large and complex datasets.
  • Hands-on proficiency with Python, Java or another programming or query language used for analysis, automation and data workflow development.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to automate workflows, improve analytical efficiency and communicate data-driven insights.
  • Experience in merchant acquiring, payment facilitation, or processor environments.
  • Knowledge of PIN debit, least-cost routing, FANF, VAMP, assessments, compliance fees and other network-related costs.
  • Experience building interchange reference tables, qualification engines, reconciliation frameworks, portfolio monitoring or profitability models.
  • Familiarity with payment-message data, gateway field mapping and authorization-to-clearing analysis.
  • Degree in a quantitative or technical fields such as Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or Finance.
